Title: Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
Join Readly!

Readly was built on a simple but powerful idea: that curious people should never have to choose between the publications they love and the ones they haven't discovered yet. One subscription. Thousands of titles. Journalism, culture, lifestyle, science, sport, and ideas from around the world, available on any screen, at any moment.

Readly is now part of Cafeyn Group. With the acquisition of Readly's non-Nordic operations, Cafeyn further strengthens its position as the European leader in access to information – combining scale, technology, and deep local market expertise.

Together, the Group now operates across 15 markets, serves 2.5 million users, and provides access to more than 5,200 publications from 1,100 partner publishers.

Our mission?

To empower individuals with access to trusted, high-quality content that fosters personal growth and discovery. Whether it's through the comprehensive collection of news and features on Cafeyn & Readly, the digital publishing solutions of Milibris, the fun and educative content for children on Kidjo, or the collections for manga lovers by Mangas.io, Cafeyn Group stands at the forefront of digital content experiences.

We are looking for a Marketing Data Analyst to join our team and sit at the intersection of Data, Marketing and Product.

In this role, you will own and analyse our key B2C marketing data, helping Marketing teams better understand performance, identify growth opportunities and make data-driven decisions. You’ll go beyond reporting: from analysing the acquisition funnel and running advanced measurement studies to improving attribution, tracking and marketing performance.

You’ll also play a key role in making our Marketing teams more autonomous by building self-serve reporting and AI-powered data products, while ensuring that our tracking and data infrastructure remain accurate, compliant and up to date.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical skills in SQL and Python with a genuine understanding of B2C marketing, strong analytical thinking and the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights. You’ll work closely with Marketing, Product and Data stakeholders, making this a highly cross-functional role with a direct impact on our growth strategy.

Missions


Own B2C marketing KPIs from a data perspective, ensuring that key performance indicators and supporting data points are accurate, reliable and available within a reasonable timeframe for weekly and monthly business reviews.
Support Marketing teams with reporting, helping them define relevant dashboards, reporting frameworks and performance indicators to answer their business questions.
Analyse the acquisition funnel, from awareness through to conversion, to identify growth levers and provide actionable recommendations to Marketing teams.
Run advanced marketing analyses to support strategic decision-making, including initiatives such as Geo-Lift studies, attribution analyses and other measurement approaches. Translate findings into concrete recommendations around budgets, channels and acquisition strategy.
Implement algorithms and analytical solutions to support Marketing Operations, particularly around attribution and marketing measurement.
Improve Marketing team autonomy through self-serve data products, enabling stakeholders to answer their day-to-day data questions without relying systematically on an analyst.
Develop and deploy AI-powered data products and insights, using AI to make marketing stakeholders more autonomous and accelerate access to actionable insights.
Own and maintain marketing tracking, ensuring that implementation remains compliant with regulations and aligned with changes across advertising platforms and the wider tracking ecosystem.
Act as a bridge between Marketing and Product to ensure tracking remains up to date, follows best practices and provides the data and signals required for effective acquisition.
Activate relevant data points within marketing platforms to improve acquisition performance and maximise the value of available customer and behavioural data.


Requirements

We are looking for a data-driven and commercially minded Data Analyst who sits at the intersection of Data, Marketing and Product.

You are naturally curious and enjoy going beyond reporting to understand why performance is changing, identify growth opportunities and turn data into concrete business decisions. You are comfortable owning B2C marketing KPIs and ensuring that the underlying data is accurate, reliable and available when stakeholders need it.

Must-have


Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with the ability to independently query, analyse and manipulate data.
Experience working with B2C marketing data, ideally within a subscription-based business, with a strong understanding of metrics such as acquisition, conversion, trials and churn.
Proven experience in marketing analytics and reporting, including the ability to translate business questions into relevant analyses and actionable insights.
Experience with marketing tracking and measurement, including familiarity with GDPR, SKAN, DMA and the broader digital tracking ecosystem.
Strong analytical storytelling skills, with the ability to identify meaningful insights and clearly communicate recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working cross-functionally with Marketing, Product and Data teams.


Nice-to-have


Experience with Snowflake, Airflow, Segment, GTM and Amplitude
Experience with advanced B2C marketing analytics methodologies such as Geo-Lift studies, Multi-Touch Attribution or Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM).
Experience optimising acquisition strategies through A/B testing, particularly across the upper funnel.
Experience activating and sharing data points with advertising platforms to improve acquisition performance.
Experience developing self-serve reporting tools or AI-powered data products that enable business stakeholders to work more independently.


Hiring process


HR Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Manager (30’)
Hiring manager Interview with our Head of Acquisition & Marketing Measurement
Case study that you will present to our Head of Acquisition & Marketing Measurement and Data Analyst Product & Growth
Last Interview with our Chief of Staff and Head of Marketing


Perks & benefits of working at Cafeyn


🏥 Health insurance – Comprehensive health insurance coverage.
💆 Well-being allowance – €350 gross well-being allowance paid every December.
🧠 Mental health support – Access to Teale, our mental health platform, where you can book appointments with psychologists and monitor your mental health.
🏠 Hybrid policy – Work remotely up to two days per week.
🗞️ Cafeyn access – VIP access to Cafeyn, giving you unlimited access to all content on our platform.
🪅 Team life – Four office meet-ups per year, bringing together our international teams to celebrate company updates and spend quality time together.


You don’t have to match all the requirements, if you feel this offer could be a great opportunity for you, reach out anyways! We hire based on talent and we promote inclusivity inside Cafeyn and strongly believe that our culture is strongest when it is the most diverse.


Founded in 2006
Co-workers 120

Title: Data Analyst (f/d/m)
Description:
Join us as femtasy's first internal Data Analyst (f/d/m). Sit with Marketing, Product, and Finance to turn messy questions into clear, actionable answers, working directly with our Head of Data.




This is femtasy

femtasy is the audio-only streaming platform for sensual audio stories & sexy sounds for women. We inspire women to explore and enjoy on their own terms. We're a female-centric product, led by a female CEO & Founder, with over 90% of our team identifying as women+. We've already positively impacted the lives of hundreds of thousands of women by redefining female pleasure – and we're just getting started.




Your mission and your impact:

Today, all data requests from Marketing (our principal stakeholder), Product, and Finance funnel through our Head of Data, who scopes every ask before an external agency executes it. That doesn't scale. You'll be the first internal hire to change that: sitting directly with stakeholders, turning vague requests into well-defined problems, and delivering a good-enough solution fast.




You'll report to the Head of Data and work alongside an Analytics Engineer who owns the heavier dbt/pipeline work.




Six months in, this is what your impact looks like: you run scoping conversations with Marketing especially, but also Product and Finance independently – no pre-framing needed from your Head of Data. You own the fact tables and models behind your recurring reporting. You've proactively fixed or flagged at least one foundational data issue – because you saw it, not because someone asked. Stakeholders treat you as a go-to resource, not a ticket-taker.




What you'll do

Own first-line scoping conversations with Marketing, Product, and Finance: ask the right clarifying questions, push back on vague or over-scoped requests, and land on a defined problem plus a good-enough solution.
Come up with your own solution after aligned with stakeholders, maximizing the impact and keeping the development time as short as possible.
Build and maintain the dashboards and reports (Tableau today, tool-agnostic long term) that Marketing, Product, and Finance can actually act on.
Build and manage data in dbt: create and maintain the fact tables and models that support your recurring reporting and analyses, with our Analytics Engineer supporting the underlying infrastructure.
Own the day-to-day reliability of what you build: catch issues, flag or fix them – so no one ever has to ask »which number is right«.
Question the status quo at the working level. If something's »always been done that way« and it's slowing a team down, we want you to say so and to work with your Head of Data on what's worth fixing.




What you bring

3+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar analytics role: you can work independently on well-scoped problems and know when to ask for help on ambiguous ones.
Proven stakeholder-facing judgment. You've sat in front of a non-technical stakeholder with a vague ask, asked the right questions, and resisted both over-engineering the answer and under-scoping it.
You frame problems clearly, communicate directly, and challenge assumptions.
Solid SQL, dbt, and hands-on comfort with a BI tool: you build and maintain your models yourself, from raw data to fact table to dashboard. Our Analytics Engineer supports you on infrastructure, but day-to-day dbt work is yours to own.
Comfortable moving across domains. You won't own one fixed area – you will support Marketing and other stakeholders when needed.
Opinionated but coachable. You're willing to challenge »it's always been like that«, and open to direct feedback.
Fluent in English.

A strong plus, not a must

You've worked with Marketing before (at least one real marketing project)
You've experienced a startup environment
You already use AI tools in your day-to-day analysis




This role is hybrid, based in or around Berlin. We're in the office together every Tuesday and Wednesday, with flexibility on the remaining days.




This is NOT for you if…

You want every request fully pre-scoped before you touch it, rather than asking the clarifying questions yourself.
You'd rather just execute the ticket than sit with a stakeholder and challenge whether it's the right ask.
You reach for a dashboard or a data pull before you've actually understood the business problem behind it.
You're not comfortable owning your models end-to-end in dbt, from raw data to the fact table to the final report.
You see yourself as a data service desk instead of creating your own tickets after aligning with stakeholders.




What we offer

🌟 Impact & purpose. The chance to join a huge mission around female empowerment and gender equality.

🦸 Female-led and women-centric. A female-centric product, a female CEO & Founder, and over 90% of our whole team identifies as women+.

🤝 Inspiring, performance-oriented culture. A progressive team culture based on transparency, open feedback, ownership, and collaboration. Check out »radical candor« if you want to learn more about how we work.

🤖 AI-first by default. A company-paid AI subscription of your choice, and a team that automates everything worth automating so you can focus on the work that matters.

📈 Personal and professional growth. Team learning sessions, learning & development budgets, and internal trainings. Every team member, from junior to C-level, has access to personal 1:1 sessions with a professional business coach.

🔄 Healthy approach to taking a break. 26 holidays plus unlimited recharging time on top for when you really need it.

📍 Flexibility. Flexible working hours, hybrid setup with our Berlin office as home base.

🎉 (Really cool) events & benefits like an Urban Sports membership (or alternative offerings), snacks & lunches, mobility and retirement plans, and our famous femtasy parties and team events. We also cook and eat together twice a month and have a big office garden for the best BBQs in Berlin.

💪 Package. A compensation package that fairly mirrors what's expected from you and the impact you'll have on femtasy. Exact range shared in the first call.




femtasy offers equal opportunities for all and encourages applicants of all nationalities, genders, sexual orientations, religious backgrounds, gender identities, and people with disabilities to apply.




Our Recruiting Process

Short application questionnaire (approx. 10 minutes)
30 min Get-to-know-each-other call with one of our recruiters
30 min with our Head of Data
1h 30 min working session with our Head of Data: a live scoping exercise, not a take-home test
45 min interview with one of your future stakeholders (Marketing, Product or Finance)
1h interview with our CEO
Final offer




We are looking to fill this position as soon as possible und usually respond within three days.

Title: Senior Analyst — People & Workforce Intelligence (PWI) (d/f/m)
Description:
Personio's intelligent HR platform helps small and medium-sized organizations unlock the power of people by making complicated, time-consuming tasks simple and efficient. Our team of 1,500 Personios is building user-friendly products that delight our 15,000+ customers and their 1.5 million employees. Ready to make an impact from day one?

This role requires 2 days per week in the office and is based in Munich, Berlin or Dublin.

We empower Personio's decision-making with reliable data and strategic insights, while improving productivity through scalable infrastructure and automation. Be part of our transformative journey in HR technology, where your contributions shape how a leading people management platform understands its own workforce.

The Senior Analyst — PWI sits within the Data, Systems & AI department and partners closely with the People & Workplace Intelligence (PWI) function. This role combines two capabilities that are most powerful together: building the data foundations that make reliable analysis possible, and delivering the analysis itself. You own the infrastructure — writing dbt models from raw sources — and you own the insight: turning that data into clear recommendations for People leadership and partners.

You will work closely with PBPs and People leadership to connect people data sources — HRIS, absence and attendance systems, and others — and enable a self-serve analytics capability across the people domain.

What You'll Do

Data Foundations


Build and own dbt models end-to-end — from raw source ingestion through to staging, intermediate, and reporting layers — for the PWI domain, covering HRIS, headcount, absence, attendance, and adjacent people data sources.
Design and maintain scalable warehouse schemas in Snowflake, with clear data lineage, documentation, and version-controlled code (Git).
Define, document, and steward metric definitions and the semantic layer for people data, ensuring reliable KPI logic and metric consistency across the domain.
Implement data quality testing, monitoring, and alerting so that data issues are caught early and fixed proactively — not discovered by stakeholders.


Analytical Delivery


Deliver structured analysis on headcount, attrition, absence and attendance, org design, manager effectiveness, and compensation for PBPs and PWI leadership — forming clear hypotheses and producing decision-ready outputs, not just data dumps.
Build and maintain intuitive dashboards and reporting that allow stakeholders to self-serve on day-to-day questions without requiring analyst involvement.
Support MBR and QBR cycles with data storytelling: own the narrative, not just the numbers.
Partner with PBPs to diagnose root-cause data gaps, translate urgent business needs into analytical deliverables, and systematically improve the quality of people data over time.


Stakeholder Partnership


Act as the embedded analytical partner for the PWI function — showing up proactively, anticipating needs, and flagging risks before they escalate.
Present findings directly to People leadership with confident, prescriptive recommendations.
Enable PBPs to work more independently with data through documentation, self-serve tools, and direct coaching.


What You Need To Succeed

Must-haves


5+ years in analytics engineering, analytics, or a hybrid of both — you have done both the building and the analysis, not just one side.
Expert-level dbt: you have built models from raw source data, written tests, managed documentation, and understand lineage end-to-end — not just maintained existing models.
Strong SQL: complex queries, performance optimization, ability to work across a Snowflake-based data warehouse without hand-holding.
Analytical rigour: you structure ambiguous problems into hypotheses, identify the right metrics, and produce outputs that lead to decisions — not more questions.
Clear communicator: you translate data into plain language for non-technical stakeholders, present confidently, and write documentation that people actually use.
Experience with BI tooling (HEX, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent) for building stakeholder-facing dashboards and reporting.
Comfortable with Git and version-controlled codebases as a daily practice.
High ownership: you diagnose root causes, drive work independently, and don't wait to be told what matters next.


Nice to have


Experience with people/HRIS data — Workday, BambooHR, or similar compensation and benefits tooling.
Python for analytical workflows and automation.
Exposure to AI/LLM tooling (Claude, GPT) for insight generation or workflow automation.


Why Personio

Personio is an equal opportunities employer, committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. We embrace uniqueness and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. We are proud to have an inclusive workplace environment that will foster your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

At Personio, we value in-person collaboration while also offering flexibility. This role is office-based, with 3 days per week required in your contracted office location. The remaining days can be worked from home or in the office if you prefer. In addition, you’ll have 20 Flex Days per year to work remotely from other locations. Aside from our people, culture, and mission, check out some of the other benefits that make Personio a great place to work:


Receive a competitive reward package – reevaluated each year – that includes salary, benefits, and pre-IPO equity
Enjoy 28 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day after 2 and 4 years
Make an impact on the environment and society with 1 (fully paid) Impact Day
Receive generous family leave, child support, mental health support, and sabbatical opportunities
We enjoy gathering for meals, cultural initiatives, and events like local Summer Sessions and year-end celebrations. There's also healthy snacks, drinks, and a weekly catered lunch.

Title: Business Analytics Manager
Description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Business Analytics Managerto own the analytical agenda for our Germany market– one of our most complex and strategically vital European hubs.

This is a senior Individual Contributor (IC) role with a clear mandate: use data to drive commercial decisions. You will be embedded with the Germany commercial team.

You are not a back-office reporting function. You are the analytical co-pilotfor Category, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Merchant Operations – translating complex data into clear, actionable business recommendations that shape P&L outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Business Performance

Own the Germany market performance narrative – delivering weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews to the Germany Country Manager.
Define and monitor key performance indicators across GMV, orders, revenue, conversion, fulfillment, customer experience, and contribution margin.
Identify growth opportunities and operational bottlenecks through rigorous data analysis – providing clear, data-backed recommendations.
Lead scenario planning and "what-if" modeling to support annual planning, budget allocation, and strategic investments.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with Category teams to optimize assortment, pricing architecture, and promotional calendars.
Collaborate with Marketing to evaluate channel efficiency, customer acquisition costs, and lifetime value.
Work with Supply Chain & Logistics to balance delivery speed, cost, and customer satisfaction.
Advise Merchant Operations on seller segmentation, incentive design, and supply-side retention strategies.
Align with Product & Engineering to prioritize Germany-specific data requirements and instrumentation.

Advanced Analytics & Modeling

Build forecasting models for demand, revenue, and supply – incorporating seasonality, promotions, and macroeconomic indicators.
Design and execute causal inference analyses to measure incrementality of pricing changes, promotions, and marketing investments.
Develop customer segmentation, cohort analysis, and lifetime value models to inform commercial strategy.
Lead strategic deep-dives on high-priority topics – from fulfillment optimization to category expansion and competitive positioning.

Data Infrastructure & Automation

Architect and maintain the Germany market data layer – from automated ETL pipelines to executive dashboards.
Drive automation of recurring reporting, reducing manual effort and enabling focus on high-value strategic work.
Establish self-service data capabilities for local commercial teams.
Ensure data quality, governance, and compliance with GDPR and German data protection regulations.




Qualifications

8 years of experience in Business Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Strategy, Data Science, or Management Consulting with a quantitative focus, includingat least 2 years directly focused on the German or DACH eCommerce, retail, or marketplacesector.
Master's Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research, Supply Chain, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
Expert-level SQL– ability to write complex, optimized queries across petabyte-scale data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift).
Advanced proficiency in Python – with demonstrated experience in forecasting, causal inference, cohort analysis, segmentation, and automation.
Expert-level BI skills– Looker, Tableau, or Power BI – building decision-making tools that commercial teams actually use daily.
Proven track record of directly influencing P&L outcomes– measurable impact on GMV growth, margin improvement, or cost efficiency through data-driven recommendations.
Strong business communication skills– ability to synthesize complex data into executive-ready narratives, board presentations, and actionable recommendations.
Fluent English and required to lead meetings and present to local stakeholders in German. Based in Berlin, with a hybrid working model.

Title: Staff Data Analyst, Paid Search
Description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

This specific position sits within our Growth Analytics team, whose objective is to scale marketing investment toward the most incremental and loyal customers. The role is focused on our paid search channel where black-box auction dynamics, branded vs non-branded incrementality, and elasticity modelling define the analytical problem. The successful candidate will also contribute to cross-channel measurement questions as they arise.

Your mission


Develop quantitative analysis and statistical models to evaluate and steer marketing decisions
Propose and defend strategic recommendations to our top marketing leads
Setup and analyse marketing experiments to drive strategic decision making
Explore large datasets, give meaning to data and numbers, identify opportunities and issues, and present findings to stakeholders
Maintain and improve our marketing measurement tools (Attribution, experimentation framework, Customer lifetime value…)
Serve as a liaison between the marketing teams and the data engineering team
Mentor others in the skills needed for this role
Use AI to accelerate end-to-end analysis — from framing the question to delivering the insight — while holding a high bar for methodological rigor and validation


Your toolkit


8+ years of relevant experience interpreting data in an analytics or data science role
Prior experience analysing paid search and/or SEO performance, using platforms such as Google Ads/Search.
Strong knowledge of SQL and Python for analysis (eg, pandas, scikit-learn, pyspark)
Hands-on experience with causal inference methods (e.g. geo experiments, difference-in-differences, synthetic controls) and/or elasticity modelling applied to marketing spend decisions.
Ability to understand user behavior and meaning behind the numbers and a track record in sharing insights to business stakeholders.
Experience identifying where AI could meaningfully improve your team's analytics workflows or tooling, not just your own output.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g. Looker, Jupyter Notebooks, Databricks).
Desire to work in an international environment, with minimal direction and with highly engaged individuals
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English


How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary


Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
Monthly transportation and fitness budget
Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
Language reimbursement program
Health and wellness benefits


And more…

Title: People Analytics Manager (m/f/x)
Description:
Scalable Capital is a leading digital investment and banking platform with a full banking licence, empowering people across Europe to shape their own finances. Scalable Broker makes it easy and affordable for clients to invest professionally in stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and derivatives, as well as set up savings plans. Scalable Wealth, the digital wealth management service, offers clients professional investment in ETF portfolios, and is also adopted as a white-label solution by banks and other B2B partners. The company’s offerings are rounded off by attractive interest rates, loans, and private equity. With the European Investor Exchange, Scalable Capital offers an exchange specifically for retail investors. Over one million clients have already entrusted more than €30 billion to the platform.



Founded in 2014, Scalable Capital now employs over 700 people across Munich, Berlin, Vienna, Milan, and London. Together with the founding and management team, including Erik Podzuweit and Florian Prucker, they are working on a new generation of financial services.



Visit our finance blog or check out our Social Media channels to find out what our Expert Teams have to say.



Our Company Values guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. To learn more about them, you can find our values here (English).





Job Description



At Scalable, we use data to make better decisions across our business, including People. As our first dedicated People Analytics hire, you will build the foundations for a data-driven People function.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will bring together People data, create reliable reporting, improve our People Tech stack, and turn data into insights that help leaders make informed decisions.





Build a trusted People data foundation by combining data from relevant source systems and ensuring data quality, privacy, and clear ownership
Design and maintain dashboards and reports for core People metrics, such as headcount, hiring, retention, employee lifecycle, and workforce planning
Partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and business leaders to translate business questions into meaningful analyses
Develop clear, actionable recommendations and communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders
Improve and expand our People Tech ecosystem to support reliable data flows and efficient People processes
Establish practical data governance standards for People data, including definitions, access, quality checks, and privacy requirements
Identify opportunities to develop forecasting and predictive analytics capabilities as the data foundation matures
Shape Scalable’s People Analytics and People Tech foundations from day one with a dedicated budget for analytics tooling and continuous learning
Work in close collaboration with People, Finance, and business leadership to directly improve decision-making, employee experience, and business growth


Qualifications


Experience in People Analytics, People Data Management, Business Intelligence, or a comparable data analytics role
Strong SQL skills and experience with data visualisation tools, such as Metabase, Tableau, or Power BI
Experience working with HR systems and integrating data from multiple sources
A sound understanding of data architecture, data quality, data governance, and privacy principles
Ability to explain complex data clearly and turn findings into practical recommendations
Experience with Python or R is a plus, especially for advanced analytics
Fluent English skills. German is a plus
This role requires you to be based in Munich or Berlin and work from one of our office locations


Additional Information


Be part of one of the fastest-growing and most visible Fintech startups in Europe, creating innovative services that have a substantial impact on the lives of our customers
Work with an international, diverse, inclusive, and ever-growing team that loves creating the best products for our clients
Be productive with the latest hardware and tools
Learn and grow by joining our in-house knowledge sharing or career development sessions and spending your individual Education Budget
Learn and experience German culture first hand by joining our free German language classes
Opportunity to work from abroad
Benefit from an attractive compensation package and from the company pension scheme
Monthly contribution of 50% for the ‘Deutschland Jobticket’
Say goodbye to order commissions and say hello to your complimentary subscription of Scalable Capital's PRIME+ Broker
Enjoy flexible and discounted sports activities with Urban Sports Club

Title: Specialist Datenmanagement (m/w/d)
Description:
Worum geht's?


Ausschreibungen: Durch die Aufbereitung und Strukturierung von Daten unterstützt Du die Geschäftsführung bei der Akquise und Erstellung von Inputmaterial im Zuge von Ausschreibungen der Dualen Systeme.
Analyse & Business Intelligence: Du analysierst, visualisierst und überarbeitest verschiedene Datenquellen mit Excel und Power BI und leitest daraus wertvolle Erkenntnisse für das Unternehmen ab.
Programmierung & Automatisierung: Du nutzt Excel/VBA sowie weitere digitale Werkzeuge, um Arbeitsabläufe zu automatisieren und effizienter zu gestalten.
Optimierung: Du entwickelst und verbesserst Prozessabläufe und nutzt Excel, VBA, Power Query sowie DAX, um Daten effizient auf- und vorzubereiten.
Entwicklung: Du entwickelst Dashboards oder Tools und erstellst Dateivorlagen, um Arbeitsprozesse zu vereinfachen und zu standardisieren.
Mitgestaltung: Du wirkst aktiv am Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung der zukünftigen Datenlandschaft mit und gestaltest so die Zukunft des Unternehmens nachhaltig mit.


Neugierig? Deine Vorteile:


Vergütung: Du erhältst eine attraktive Vergütung sowie diverse Zusatzleistungen (Mitarbeitervergünstigungen, kostenlose Getränke etc.).
Team: Du wirst Teil eines motivierten, dynamischen und hilfsbereiten Teams.
Einarbeitung: Wir arbeiten Dich umfassend und strukturiert in Deine Aufgaben ein.
Entwicklung: Du arbeitest in einem innovativen Umfeld mit vielfältigen Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.
Flexibilität: Dank der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten gestaltest Du Deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel.
Benefits: Freue Dich auf Bike-Leasing, Deutschlandticket sowie ein breit aufgestelltes Gesundheitsmanagement und weitere attraktive Zusatzleistungen.
Zukunft: Als Teil eines führenden Umweltdienstleisters gestaltest Du die Zukunft des Unternehmens aktiv mit. Umfangreiche Schulungs- und Weiterbildungsangebote unterstützen Dich dabei.


Dein Profil:


Ausbildung: Du hast eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium im kaufmännischen, IT- oder technischen Bereich abgeschlossen.
Kenntnisse: Du bringst umfangreiche Kenntnisse im Datenmanagement mit und verfügst über Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Ad-hoc-Analysen.
IT-Kompetenz: Du verfügst über umfassende Microsoft-365-Kenntnisse und bist versiert im Umgang mit Excel (fortgeschritten bis Experte). Komplexe Formeln, Pivot-Tabellen, Diagramme, Datenvalidierung, Power Query und Power BI gehören für Dich zum Arbeitsalltag.
VBA & Automatisierung: Du programmierst in VBA oder vergleichbaren Tools, um Arbeitsprozesse zu automatisieren und effizienter zu gestalten.
Power BI & Power Automate: Du erstellst Auswertungen und Dashboards in Power BI und bringst idealerweise Grundkenntnisse in Power Automate für kleinere Automatisierungen mit.
Datenmanagement & Systeme: Idealerweise verfügst Du über Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Unternehmenssystemen, beispielsweise bei der Stammdatenpflege, dem Fehlermonitoring oder der Durchführung von Systemtests. Kenntnisse in SAP sind von Vorteil.
Arbeitsstil: Du arbeitest analytisch, strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich und bringst ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative mit.

Title: Senior Quantitative Analyst
Description:
About Schumacher

Schumacher & Co. is an innovative interior design company that is disrupting the$150 billion-dollar global interior design industry. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. With over 500+ employees and growing, we are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life.We are dedicated to the mission of helping our customers “celebrate the feeling of home”. F. Schumacher & Co designs and produces some of the most beautiful fabrics, wallcoverings, trims, rugs, furniture, and accessories in the world. Our portfolio of products is broad, but they are united by a passion for design, a thirst for what is next, an appreciation for what’s come before, a drive to make our products with enormous care and attention for detail. F. Schumacher & Co is a globally recognized company with a myriad of showrooms both domestically and internationally.

Our Competitive Advantage In The Industry Is Our People. We Believe That Our Employees Are Our Most Important Assets. F. Schumacher & Co Is Deeply Anchored In Our Company Core Values Which Are As Follows


Preserve Our Entrepreneurial Spirit
Take Ownership & Accountability
Be Solutions-Oriented
Demonstrate Courage
Practice Adaptability
Embrace Collaboration


We empower our employees to live these values daily because we understand how it will positively impact the customer's journey. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company to many brands within our portfolio. This role is a 12 month contract and is a part of Data Insights & AI team

Role Overview

We're looking for a hands-on, Senior Quantitative Analyst, Product Portfolio (Statistical Modeling) to own analytics and reporting in support of our Portfolio Development team, with a specific focus on SKU productivity & capital allocation across a portfolio of 20,000+ SKUs and growing. This role will report directly to the Sr. Director of AI & Data Insights, but is expected to work directly with the CEO & Chief of Staff on a day-to-day basis.

This is not a role for someone who takes data at face value. You'll need to distinguish real signal from noise (e.g., a SKU selling poorly because it's out of stock, not because demand is weak), and when you find data that's wrong or inconsistent, you'll have the access and judgment to go into Snowflake and fix it — not just flag it and wait.

What You’ll Do


Work hands-on with CEO & Product Strategy stakeholders to understand key strategic questions, and then build analysis and reporting to address them directly
Use statistical methods (e.g. conjoint analysis, multivariate regression) to identify which product attributes and characteristics (e.g., color, pattern, material, price point, availability) drive productivity, and translate that into data-driven guidance on where the portfolio should expand, contract or shift
Cut through data noise at scale: systematically identify and control for confounders like stock-outs, new/discontinued SKUs, and seasonality so reported trends reflect real pattern performance
Identify data inconsistencies at the source (e.g., ERP, web, product master data) and directly and systematically correct records in Snowflake and work with upstream platform owners to improve the accuracy of source data and downstream analytics
Present findings clearly and independently to executive audiences, adapting the message for technical or non-technical stakeholders
Recommend and maintain recurring analytics & reporting to provide accurate and timely snapshot of SKU productivity
Use AI across your own workflow to explore data faster, automate repetitive reporting, catch errors, and multiply output given the scale and growth of the SKU portfolio


What We're Looking For


2-5 years in data science, analytics, statistics in similar SKU-driven businesses
Solid grounding in statistics or operations research (e.g. regression, hypothesis testing, multivariate analysis, optimization). Able to move beyond descriptive reporting to model relationships between variables and quantify drivers, not just flag correlations
Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on Snowflake experience including writing back to correct or clean production data (not just read-only querying)
A track record of presenting findings and challenging assumptions directly with senior stakeholders and executives
Independent executor — sets analysis priorities against business goals without waiting for direction, and ships accurate, high-impact work in a timely manner
Curiosity — asks why the numbers look the way they do and keeps digging until the answer holds up, rather than reporting the first number that looks plausible
Thinks in terms of SKU-level economics: sell-through, margin, inventory position, lifecycle stage — and knows how to separate a true productivity problem from a data artifact
Treats data quality as part of the job, digging into root causes and correcting them directly rather than working around bad data
Hands-on experience applying AI/ML in a business context for task automation - automating repetitive analysis to spend more time on judgment calls
Strong English communication skills and a high ownership mindset


Nice to Have


Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools alongside Snowflake
Exposure to margin, pricing, or demand forecasting data
Experience in retail, e-commerce, or luxury/home furnishings goods


What We Offer


Competitive salary and benefits, based on experience
Fully remote work within Europe, with optional time in our NYC office (1–2 weeks per year)
Direct visibility with the CEO, with real influence on Product Strategy and Merchandising decisions
Collaborative, inclusive, and low-ego working environment


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and equality in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical and mental disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/assignment, citizenship, pregnancy or maternity, protected veteran status, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

Title: Consultant Data Science - Healthcare (m/f/d)

At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About Statista Healthcare

Statista Healthcare is a vertical business unit of Statista, focused on making healthcare quality transparent, measurable, and comparable across countries, care settings, and specialties. We work with leading healthcare stakeholders worldwide to support data-driven quality measurement and transformation by combining in-depth analytical expertise with scalable technology and communication power.

Our offerings span international rankings, ratings, benchmarking studies, and customized consulting projects. Our global healthcare rankings and hospital ratings are published in collaboration with our trusted media partner Newsweek, enabling high visibility and credibility across markets.

We help healthcare organizations define relevant key performance indicators, validate and harmonize data structures, and translate insights into actionable strategies. At the heart of our approach is a data driven understanding of healthcare quality, grounded in robust methodologies, global comparability, and stakeholder trust.

In our consulting projects, we support healthcare providers and systems in developing tailored KPI frameworks, standardizing and validating data processes, and deriving actionable insights that enable measurable improvements in patient care and system-level performance. We combine structured methodologies with hands-on delivery to unlock the full value of healthcare quality data.

Your Role

As Consultant Data Science - Healthcare, you will join our international team of data professionals, supporting the analytical backbone of Statista’s healthcare activities.

Your work will focus on the collection, processing, and analysis of healthcare data that power our Rankings, Ratings, and Benchmarking projects.

In Benchmarking and custom quality development projects with healthcare providers and other stakeholders you will be part of an interdisciplinary project team that works directly with our clients.

You will work hands-on with large and diverse datasets, transform raw data into clean, structured information, and contribute to the automation of our analytical workflows.

Your work will directly support Statista’s mission to make healthcare quality measurable, comparable, and actionable - globally.

Responsibilities


Support in maintaining and further developing Statista’s ranking and rating databases, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and scalability
Collaborate on data pilots and benchmarking projects — from design and metric development to scoring and results analysis, interacting directly with our clients as part of an interdisciplinary Statista project team
Integrate, clean, and standardize external datasets from hospitals, ministries, and partners for unified use in Statista’s healthcare products
Develop and document data models and scoring frameworks in alignment with the Healthcare Analysis and IT teams
Support the development of Statista’s Unified Health Database and future Healthcare Data Platform
Perform internal analyses and reporting to improve data quality and performance metrics of existing healthcare products
Ensure data validation and reproducibility, including peer review and internal QA checks.
Actively contribute ideas for new data-driven healthcare products and improvement of existing workflows


Your profile


Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Public Health, or related field
4+ years of experience in data analytics, modeling, or applied statistics, ideally within healthcare or another data-intensive field in a consulting or client-facing role
Proven skills in Python and SQL, proven experience with data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar), including dashboard design and storytelling with data
Strong analytical mindset and ability to transform complex data into actionable insights
Basic understanding of healthcare KPIs, quality metrics, or benchmarking concepts is advantageous
Fluent in English, German a plus
Highly structured, curious, and motivated to work in an international and cross-functional environment


What We Offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:


Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year
Hybrid work and flex-time
International team and social events
Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options
Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities
Career & training opportunities
Attractive locations and modern offices
Mental health support with OpenUp


Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

Description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Steuerberatung suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt  als Consultant Data Analytics Global Transformation Tax (w/m/d). Das erwartet dichTeam – Als Teil unseres Global Transformation Tax Teams arbeitest du gemeinsam mit Kolleg:innen aus Tax, Tech und Finance an innovativen End-to-End-Lösungen, die Unternehmen fit für externe regulatorische Anforderungen und die interne Transformation machen.Analyse – Du entwickelst clevere, pragmatische Lösungsansätze zur Strukturierung, Verarbeitung und Validierung von Finanzdaten.Automatisierung – Mit Tools wie der Microsoft Power Platform oder Alteryx entwickelst du smarte Workflows und Prototypen – z. B. für Pillar 2, Tax Control Frameworks oder andere Compliance-Herausforderungen.Visualisierung – Du kreierst interaktive Dashboards und Reports in Power BI, die für die Steuerfunktion und das Management aus Finanzdaten wertvolle Erkenntnisse generieren.Integration – Du verknüpfst Tools, Datenquellen und Systeme – sei es via API, komplexer Datenmodelle oder Connector. Das bringst du mit
Du hast deinen Masterabschluss in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs (bald) abgeschlossen.
Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung z. B. durch Praktika, Uni-Projekte oder Selbststudium mit Datenverarbeitung, Datenmodellierung und -visualisierung und verfügst über solide Kenntnisse in Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps und idealerweise Python.
Du liebst es, mit Zahlen zu arbeiten, Tools auszuprobieren und kreative Lösungen zu finden.
Du bringst Neugier, Eigeninitiative und echten Teamgeist mit.
Du beherrschst die Sprache Deutsch auf dem Level C2 und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
 

 

Deine Benefits

Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.Berufsexamen – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Zusätzlich unterstützen wir dich bei dem Erlangen der Berufsexamina: Wirtschaftsprüfer:in, Voll-WP, Steuerberater:in und Aktuar:in. Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. Gesundheit – Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von vergünstigten Beiträgen in diversen Fitnessstudios oder einer Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft. Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.   Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Corporate Tax Teams behältst du bei nationalen und internationalen Steuerthemen den Durchblick für unsere Mandanten: Von der Buchführung und Steuererklärung über Restrukturierungen bis hin zu grenzüberschreitenden Transaktionen. Dafür sind deine Expertise und deine Ideen gefragt. Mit einem tollen Team an deiner Seite erlebst du eine erfrischende Mischung aus der Arbeit mit Zahlen und dem direkten Kontakt zu unseren Mandanten.  Kontakt Du hast Fragen zu dieser Position oder deiner Bewerbung?Melde dich gerne bei Alisa Kullmann unter +49 69 95852697.

Fundierte Kenntnisse epidemiologischer und statistischer Methoden sowie Grundkenntnisse in HTA-/Market-Access-Anforderungen wünschenswert

Analytisches Denkvermögen, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative
Aufgeschlossene und kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit mit Teamorientierung und Kundenfokus
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (wissenschaftliches Niveau)

Title: Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x) in the field of AI & Satellite Data
Description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

LiveEO uses satellite data and AI to monitor critical infrastructure at scale. As a Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x), you’ll sit at the heart of our operations, working with geospatial and satellite data to make sure our analytics projects are delivered reliably, accurately, and on time.

You’ll work closely with Project Managers, our Operations Support Studio, engineers, and product teams - investigating data, understanding our analytics pipelines, solving delivery issues, and helping us continuously improve how our technology performs in real-world use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure.

This role is a maternity leave cover and is offered on a fixed-term contract for 1 year.

Your challenge


Analyze, validate, and interpret geospatial and satellite data across global customer projects
Take ownership of analytics deliveries and help ensure high technical quality and reliability
Understand and adapt to different analytics use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure
Investigate data and pipeline issues, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly to engineering teams
Work closely with engineers, Project Managers, and the Operations Support Studio to resolve issues and keep deliveries moving
Develop a strong end-to-end understanding of our analytics pipelines and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and quality
Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams when you identify recurring issues or opportunities for improvement
Use AI coding and analysis tools such as Claude or Cursor for data validation, pipeline debugging, and analysis - while critically validating their output before acting on it
Work with tools and technologies including QGIS, Python, SQL, AWS, remote sensing tools, and large-scale geospatial datasets


Your profile


A degree in geoinformatics, remote sensing, geography, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, or another quantitative/technical field
Hands-on experience working with geospatial data and GIS tools, ideally QGIS
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex data or technical issues in a structured way
A high level of ownership and self-management - you ask questions, seek clarity, and proactively move problems toward resolution
Comfortable using AI coding and analysis tools as part of your daily work, while applying your own judgement to verify results
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and customer requirements can change
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
A collaborative working style and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
You live in Berlin or are willing to relocate


Nice to have:


Experience with Python and SQL
Remote sensing / Earth Observation experience
Experience with geodatabases and large-scale data management
AWS or other cloud infrastructure experience
Machine learning or deep learning knowledge
Software engineering experience
Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Prefect


Your Benefits


The opportunity to work with satellite and geospatial data on real-world infrastructure challenges across the globe and contribute directly to how LiveEO delivers its analytics products.
We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.
Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.
A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons, with the opportunity to learn across geospatial analytics, AI and satellite technology.
Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.
Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.
Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, Jobrad, corporate pension program.
A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities.


About Us

LiveEO is a well funded startup founded in 2018 and based in Berlin. Our primary service is modelling risk to our customers’ assets and infrastructure from vegetation, ground deformation and change detection. We currently have around 160 employees from all over the world with a variety of backgrounds

Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

LiveEO uses satellite data and AI to monitor critical infrastructure at scale. As a Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x), you’ll sit at the heart of our operations, working with geospatial and satellite data to make sure our analytics projects are delivered reliably, accurately, and on time.

You’ll work closely with Project Managers, our Operations Support Studio, engineers, and product teams - investigating data, understanding our analytics pipelines, solving delivery issues, and helping us continuously improve how our technology performs in real-world use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure.

This role is a maternity leave cover and is offered on a fixed-term contract for 1 year.

Your challenge

  • Analyze, validate, and interpret geospatial and satellite data across global customer projects
  • Take ownership of analytics deliveries and help ensure high technical quality and reliability
  • Understand and adapt to different analytics use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure
  • Investigate data and pipeline issues, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly to engineering teams
  • Work closely with engineers, Project Managers, and the Operations Support Studio to resolve issues and keep deliveries moving
  • Develop a strong end-to-end understanding of our analytics pipelines and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and quality
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams when you identify recurring issues or opportunities for improvement
  • Use AI coding and analysis tools such as Claude or Cursor for data validation, pipeline debugging, and analysis - while critically validating their output before acting on it
  • Work with tools and technologies including QGIS, Python, SQL, AWS, remote sensing tools, and large-scale geospatial datasets

Your profile

  • A degree in geoinformatics, remote sensing, geography, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, or another quantitative/technical field
  • Hands-on experience working with geospatial data and GIS tools, ideally QGIS
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex data or technical issues in a structured way
  • A high level of ownership and self-management - you ask questions, seek clarity, and proactively move problems toward resolution
  • Comfortable using AI coding and analysis tools as part of your daily work, while applying your own judgement to verify results
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and customer requirements can change
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • A collaborative working style and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • You live in Berlin or are willing to relocate

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Python and SQL
  • Remote sensing / Earth Observation experience
  • Experience with geodatabases and large-scale data management
  • AWS or other cloud infrastructure experience
  • Machine learning or deep learning knowledge
  • Software engineering experience
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Prefect

Your Benefits

  • The opportunity to work with satellite and geospatial data on real-world infrastructure challenges across the globe and contribute directly to how LiveEO delivers its analytics products.
  • We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.
  • Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.
  • A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons, with the opportunity to learn across geospatial analytics, AI and satellite technology.
  • Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.
  • Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.
  • Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, Jobrad, corporate pension program.
  • A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities.

About Us

LiveEO is a well funded startup founded in 2018 and based in Berlin. Our primary service is modelling risk to our customers’ assets and infrastructure from vegetation, ground deformation and change detection. We currently have around 160 employees from all over the world with a variety of backgrounds

Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich M&A oder Corporate Finance, idealerweise auch Carve-out- oder komplexe Deal-Erfahrungen
Fundiertes Wissen in Accounting, Financial Modeling und Unternehmensbewertung

Best-in-class Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University sowie im Rahmen individueller Qualifikationsangebote und Trainings

Title: Senior Campaign Analyst
Description:
Who we are

JustWatch delivers data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment business. From the biggest blockbusters to award-winning shows, major sporting events, and best-selling console games. Not only are we entertainment obsessives ourselves, but we also own the world's largest streaming guide, which gives us unparalleled data and insights on audience behaviours and content tastes.




From a small startup, we've evolved into a 200+ strong team, based in Berlin, around the world, or working remotely. We've been all about building a profitable business while riding that wave of impressive growth.




Who we need

Our Campaign team consists of more than 75+ specialists - and it keeps growing: As our new Senior Campaign Analyst, you are the go-to person for all kinds of data-related requests, reports, and their automation. Your expertise will ensure that our campaigns are fueled by accurate data, actionable insights, and efficient reporting processes.




Learn where your talents can be developed, deliver at your peak, and create value in your work.

Join us and experience a workplace that's the perfect fit for your talent.




What you will be doing

Collaborate with our Business Intelligence department to maintain correct and clearly defined data and KPIs in campaign dashboards.
Stay informed about exceptions made for different clients, reflecting them in reports and analyses.
Accelerate the reporting process for the campaigns team.
Design and provide dashboards, along with data for weekly and monthly reports.
Ensure data sanity in our tools, Thoughtspot/Lightdash, and maintain data quality in external dashboards.
Proactively detect the optimisation potential in our media campaigns.
Conducting benchmarking and forecasting activities.




What we need from you

Proven experience in marketing analytics or a related field, with a deep understanding of business models and digital marketing channels.
Deep understanding of the channels we use (Meta, TikTok, DV360) and their relevant KPIs, including their definition.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to derive actionable insights from complex datasets, KPIs, and benchmarks.
Exceptional skills in Excel and Google Spreadsheets, with the ability to quickly set up reports with data from various sources efficiently.
Excellent communication skills, with the capacity to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders effectively, and simplify complex scenarios, bringing clarity and focus.
Ability to remain composed and deliver error-free reports and dashboards even in high-pressure, stressful situations with tight deadlines, when faced with obstacles.
A can-do attitude and positive mindset with a proactive approach to overcoming challenges and a passion for driving continuous improvement.
Great conduct in English. German is a plus.
Constant learning, delivering results, and creating value are the core characteristics of everyone at JustWatch, and we are looking for these values in every person we hire.




What we offer you

An open-minded and international team that loves to collaborate to reach our goals.
We prioritise meaningful work over perks, and that true fulfilment comes from intrinsic motivation, personal growth, and making a lasting impact.
We believe in a permission-less environment that lets us focus on delivering value without overcomplicating things.
We trust our skilled professionals to maintain a no-nonsense attitude and create an environment that promotes innovation.
We are committed to helping you achieve your personal and professional goals, and we offer a collaborative and supportive environment to do so.
Truly a hybrid work environment. You are not required to come to the office, but you will want to.




Media is important to us, and we are always happy to hear from people who enjoy film! If you feel like you are missing some of the hard skills, don’t worry, we are hiring for the attitude, values, and personality.




If we caught your attention and you're eager to delve into our perspectives and thought processes, we recommend immersing yourself in our blog post, which elaborates on these subjects:

A company culture that really works
Audience as a Service
Or visit our blog here: https://www.justwatch.com/blog




How to apply

Just hit the apply button and leave us your CV, some basic info, and a short introduction that helps us get to know you. Tell us what motivates you, why you want to work at JustWatch, and how you think you can help us achieve our goals.




Please only apply if you are genuinely interested. Copy-paste mass applications will receive a copy-paste rejection email. The same goes for applications that rely heavily on AI-generated content. We want to get to know you as a person first, not your prompts.




If you have any questions, please reach out to our Talent Team via LinkedIn or apply directly through our jobs page.




Research shows women apply when meeting 100% qualifications, men at 60%. JustWatch welcomes all candidates, especially women and marginalized groups. Apply, let's talk and explore if you're a great fit.

Du verbindest fundiertes betriebswirtschaftliches Know-how mit fortgeschrittenen Data-Science-Kompetenzen und möchtest moderne Technologien wie RPA und KI gezielt im Controlling einsetzen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams in Kirchheim bei München oder Berlin als Controller mit Data-Science- und Automatisierungs-Expertise (d/m/w).

Was gibt es zu tun?


Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von KPI-Dashboards und Ad-hoc-Reports
Analyse von Soll-Ist-Abweichungen sowie Ableitung und Nachverfolgung geeigneter Maßnahmen
Erstellung von Szenario-Analysen als Grundlage für Investitions- und Unternehmensentscheidungen
Mitwirkung an Preis- und Rabattmodellen sowie an der Entwicklung datenbasierter Preisstrategien
Anwendung statistischer Methoden und Machine-Learning-Modelle zur Prognose von Umsatz-, Kosten- und Preisentwicklungen
Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Predictive-Analytics-Lösungen, beispielsweise für Preisoptimierung oder Kunden-Churn
Aufbereitung und Analyse von Daten einschließlich Feature Engineering und Modellvalidierung
Konzeption und Umsetzung von RPA-Lösungen, beispielsweise mit Power Automate, zur Automatisierung wiederkehrender Controlling-Aufgaben
Entwicklung und Einsatz KI-gestützter Tools zur Unterstützung von Controlling- und Geschäftsprozessen
Sicherstellung der Datenqualität und -konsistenz zwischen ERP-System, Data Warehouse und Analyse-Tools
Identifikation von Automatisierungspotenzialen sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung bestehender Prozesse
Definition und Pflege von Datenstandards und Reporting-Richtlinien

Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung im Controlling oder Finanzwesen
Praktische Erfahrung in Data Science, insbesondere mit Python oder R, SQL und statistischen Methoden
Kenntnisse im Umgang mit RPA-Tools und Interesse an der Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen
Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Machine-Learning-Modellen oder KI-basierten Automatisierungslösungen
Erfahrung mit Power BI sowie idealerweise Kenntnisse in MS Business Central bzw. Dynamics

Freude daran, datenbasierte Handlungsempfehlungen zu entwickeln und Entscheidungsträger mit fundierten Analysen zu unterstützen
Selbstsicheres Auftreten und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im Austausch mit Fachabteilungen, IT und Management
Teamgeist, Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse


Bewirb dich bei uns - auch wenn du meinst, nicht alles erfüllen zu können, was hier steht. Gemeinsam entfalten wir nach und nach dein volles Potenzial!

Umfangreiche Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kollegen, ein tolles Team und Wertschätzung auf allen Ebenen
Spannende Perspektiven in einem Unternehmen mit stabilem Kerngeschäft und großem Wachstumspotential

Title: (Senior) Retail Media Insights Manager (m/w/d)
Description:
Über Redcare Pharmacy:

Als Europas führende Online-Apotheke wird Redcare Pharmacy von unseren engagierten Teams und modernster Innovation angetrieben. Wir streben danach ein angenehmes und kooperatives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen in dem sich jeder Mitarbeitende wohlfühlt und gerne zu unserer Vision “Until every human has their health” beiträgt. Wenn du eine Karriere mit Bedeutung suchst die mit deinen Werten übereinstimmt komm’ in unser Team und starte deine #Redcareer.

Über die Rolle:

Retail Media ist einer der am schnellsten wachsenden Bereiche bei Redcare Pharmacy. In dieser Rolle verbindest du Daten, Strategie und Storytelling, um unsere Sales Teams mit überzeugenden Insights für Herstellergespräche zu unterstützen und so direkten Einfluss auf kommerzielle Entscheidungen und Wachstum zu nehmen.

Als Teil eines internationalen Umfelds arbeitest du eng mit Sales-, Data- und Retail-Media-Expert:innen zusammen, entwickelst Reporting-Standards weiter und gestaltest datengetriebene Ansätze, die unseren Partnern echten Mehrwert bieten.

Stellenbeschreibung

Über deine Aufgaben:


Entwickle datenbasierte Insights, Markt- und Kategorieanalysen, die unsere Sales Teams bei strategischen Kundengesprächen und Workshops unterstützen.
Identifiziere Wachstums- und Upselling-Potenziale und leite daraus überzeugende Storylines und Handlungsempfehlungen für Hersteller ab.
Nutze Power BI, SQL und analytische Methoden, um Daten aufzubereiten, zu analysieren und für interne sowie externe Stakeholder verständlich zu interpretieren.
Arbeite eng mit internationalen Teams zusammen, um einheitliche Reporting-Standards und Best Practices im Bereich Retail Media Analytics voranzutreiben.
Gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenlandschaft aktiv mit, indem du Datenlücken identifizierst, Anforderungen definierst und gemeinsam mit dem zentralen Data Team priorisierst.


Qualifikationen

Über dich:


Du bringst sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B2) mit.
Du verfügst über Erfahrung im Bereich Retail Media, E-Commerce oder datengetriebener Herstellerberatung.
Du besitzt Kenntnisse in Power BI, SQL sowie im Umgang mit datenbasierten Analysen.
Du arbeitest gerne strukturiert, übernimmst Verantwortung für Themen und fühlst dich in einem internationalen Stakeholder-Umfeld wohl.


Zusätzliche Informationen

Über deine Vorteile:

Um dich bestmöglich bei deinen individuellen Bedürfnissen zu unterstützen - sei es ein gesundes Leben zu führen, genügend Zeit für dich zu haben oder deine Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln - bieten wir eine breite Palette unterschiedlicher, standortspezifischer Benefits an:


Willkommen: Wir möchten, dass Du Dich vom ersten Tag an bei uns wohl fühlst. Deshalb begrüßen wir Dich mit unserem umfassenden Onboarding-Programm.
Homeoffice: Wenn Du für deine Arbeit nicht im Büro anwesend sein musst, können wir den Ort, von dem aus Du arbeitest, individuell gestalten - sogar für bis zu 20 Tage im Jahr irgendwo in der EU.
Entwicklung: Wachse! Wir unterstützen und fördern Deine individuelle Entwicklung durch verschiedene interne und externe Trainings.

Title: Analytical Consultant, Digital First
Description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Munich, Germany; Berlin, Germany; Frankfurt am Main, Germany; Hamburg, Germany.Minimum qualifications:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in media analytics, advertising sales, digital media and marketing, consulting, or financial analysis.


Preferred qualifications:


Experience in translating data into business recommendations, creating and delivering appealing insights-based presentations or business cases with clear recommendations and aligned with customers objectives.
Experience in data analyses and visualization (Google Sheets and Slides), scripting (Google SQL), Dashboard development (Looker Studio), and leverage AI for analytics.
Advertising experience from either the advertiser, agency or other media owner side.
Ability to work closely with multiple stakeholder and cross-functional teams and influence key stakeholders (internally and externally) across all levels.
Ability to communicate in German fluently as this is a client facing role.


About The Job

Digital First, a sector within LCS, is home to a variety of customers, from Travel, Media and Entertainment and many digital natives like marketplaces, aggregators and comparison websites. Our mission is to drive the success and sustainable growth of our Digital First customers through innovation and a customer-first mindset.

As an Analytical Consultant (AC), you will work with top clients across various industries to optimize their online advertising strategies and help them achieve their business objectives. In your role, you will be the point of contact for large customers on anything around data in the form of analysis and strategic insights and you will be a core consultant to the sales teams helping them drive Google’s business growth. You will dive deep into data to uncover hidden opportunities and commercial insights for customers – analyze their market coverage, Google auction performance, optimize their profitability and branding investments and align their efforts with target audiences. You will share these insights as a trusted consultant with the customers as well as to sales teams internally.

To scale your impact, you will help identify solutions and analyses that other customers and teams would benefit from and work together with a cross-functional team to scale and automate them. You promote data fluency by sharing insightful dashboards to visualize key metrics that support their business objectives as well as educating clients and partners on Google's tools. You collaborate with cross-functional teams to act as a data analyst, strategic advisor, and consultant, ultimately driving commercial value for our clients.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €98000 - €100000 (EUR) + 40% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .


Conduct comprehensive bespoke analyses for our high-priority customers to uncover hidden opportunities to optimize their online advertising return on investment.
Consult with clients as a strategic consultant, clearly presenting data-driven insights and recommendations that align with their business goals.
Develop engaging narratives to deliver insights at scale for a wider customer base. Streamline processes by developing scalable templates, dashboards and scripts (together with gCare Insights).
Empower clients and partners with guidance on using Google's data tools via trainings and, democratize insights where needed through insightful dashboards and reports.
Work seamlessly with the teams and stakeholders to drive successful outcomes for clients (e.g., measurement and incrementality specialists).



Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .
