Title: Consultant Data Analytics ERP Migrations (w/m/d)
Description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Wirtschaftsprüfung und prüfungsnahe Beratung suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Consultant Data Analytics (w/m/d).

 

Das erwartet dich

Beratung – Als Teil unseres Teams berätst und/oder prüfst du national und international agierende Unternehmen verschiedener Branchen und unterstützt eine erfolgreiche Projektumsetzung.

IT-Lösungen – Du entwickelst mit deinem Team innovative IT-Lösungen zur Analyse von großen Datenmengen. Dies schließt die Konzeption und die Umsetzung von nachhaltigen Business Intelligence und Big Data Lösungen zur Prüfung und Durchführung von ERP-Transformationsprojekten ein.

Projektarbeit – Du arbeitest in vielseitigen Projekten bei führenden Industrieunternehmen, Banken und Versicherungen im internationalen Kontext. Dabei entwickelst du innovative Produkte und kundenspezifische Lösungen im Bereich Analytics, Reporting und Big Data – Du betreust Kunden und hilfst bei der Neukundenakquise.

Technologieerklärung – Du kennst die Welt der Datenanalyse und kannst Kunden verständlich näherbringen, welche Möglichkeiten ihnen moderne Analytics Methoden und -Werkzeuge im SAP-Umfeld eröffnen und wie sie diese in bestehende BI & Analytics Landschaften integrieren.

 

Das bringst du mit

Dein Studium mit wirtschaftlichem, informationstechnischem oder naturwissenschaftlichem Schwerpunkt hast du erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor.
Du verfügst über Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA in den Bereichen Data & Analytics, Reporting, Planung oder Data Management.
Darüber hinaus bringst du Know-how in Business Intelligence sowie modernen Analysemethoden wie Data Mining, Predictive Analytics oder Machine Learning mit.
Ebenso hast du bereits Erfahrungen im Prüfungs-/Beratungsumfeld gesammelt.
Du kannst sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch einwandfrei kommunizieren und sicher präsentieren, da wir als Team international aufgestellt sind.

 

Deine Benefits

Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.

Masterförderung – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Darüber hinaus bieten wir die Möglichkeit einer Masterförderung für Examensmaster und Spezialisierungsmaster an.

Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. 

Gesundheit –  Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von vergünstigten Beiträgen in diversen Fitnessstudios oder einer Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft

Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.

 

Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Digital Assurance & Transparency (DAT) Teams unterstützt du unsere Kunden – sowohl prüferisch als auch beratend – bei der Bewältigung unternehmerischer Herausforderungen in Zeiten der Digitalisierung und Transformation. Gemeinsam helfen wir dabei, Technologie-, Prozess-, Kontroll- und Projektrisiken frühzeitig zu erkennen und zu minimieren. Dabei verbinden wir regulatorisches Know-how mit technologischer Expertise und begleiten Unternehmen bei Themen rund um IT- und Prozessprüfungen, interne Kontrollsysteme sowie digitale Transformationsprojekte. So schaffen wir Transparenz, Vertrauen und nachhaltige Lösungen in einer zunehmend digitalen Wirtschaft.

Du hast Fragen zu dieser Position oder deiner Bewerbung?

Melde dich gerne bei Nadine Beth unter +49 151 15291123.

Title: Senior Insights Analyst (German Speaking)
Description:
Description

Senior Insights Analyst (German Speaking)

What We’re Looking For

Join Meltwater's Client Insights team, as a Senior Insights Analyst (German Speaking), where you’ll play a central role in transforming complex media data into actionable intelligence for our enterprise clients. Your expertise in social listening, media analytics, and strategic storytelling will shape bespoke reports that inform brand, communication, and business decisions at the highest level.

You’ll collaborate with internal teams and client stakeholders to ensure insights are accurate, timely, and strategically aligned, continuously refining methodologies to keep pace with a rapidly evolving media landscape. Acting as both an analyst and strategic thinker, you’ll turn data into narratives that guide global brands through opportunities and risks across social, digital, and traditional channels.

At Meltwater, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of continuous learning and inclusive leadership, working alongside experienced peers and respected industry experts. Our environment values curiosity, initiative, and accountability, empowering you to drive measurable impact through your analytical and creative contributions.

What You'll Do:


Translate client objectives into structured reporting frameworks, Boolean queries, and dashboards that align with brand and communication KPIs.
Conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis across social, digital, and (online) news media to uncover trends, sentiment shifts, and key narratives.
Transform complex data sets into clear, compelling insight stories independently, by adapting templates to specific client needs, that inform brand strategy, reputation management, and campaign effectiveness, answering the ‘so what?’.
Maintain visibility across reporting timelines, proactively communicating progress, risks, and ensuring methodological and visual consistency.
Build Boolean queries and validate data integrity, perform quality checks, and uphold analytical rigor across all deliverables.
Develop and enhance reporting templates, checklists, and visualization tools to improve insight delivery efficiency.
Build and maintain strong relationships with client and internal stakeholders, own day to day communication and address customer inquiries regarding delivered reports.
Collaborate cross-functionally to identify process improvements, new data opportunities, and automation possibilities that elevate report quality.
Support internal training and learning initiatives by sharing best practices.
Stay current on industry trends, competitor insights, and measurement innovation to ensure Meltwater’s deliverables remain best-in-class.


What You'll Bring:


Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Social Sciences, Communications, Marketing, Media Studies, Data Analytics, or related fields emphasizing research and analysis.
+2 years of experience in insights, research, or analytics, ideally within media, communications, marketing, or PR.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both English & German.
Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills with a proven ability to identify patterns, anomalies, and actionable takeaways.
Critical thinking skills, facilitating insights derived from data analysis.
High attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to balance autonomy with collaboration.
Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to exceptional client servicing.
Strong report writing and insight storytelling capabilities
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with enthusiasm for media, culture, and emerging digital trends.
Comfortable working autonomously and collaborating effectively with remote team members, including reporting to managers situated in distant locations.
Advanced Excel (PivotTables, VLOOKUP, formulas) and PowerPoint proficiency
Experience with social listening or online media monitoring, Boolean search logic or enterprise-level tools such as Meltwater, Brandwatch, Cision, Talkwalker, or Signal AI are a plus.
Willingness to embrace the best of both worlds with our hybrid work schedule. This role requires you to be in the office 1-2 days a week
The ability to legally work in the country of hire is required for this position.


What we Offer:


Enjoy 26 days of annual paid time off plus an additional day off on your birthday!
Enjoy national and global health coverage through our statutory health insurance, ensuring your well-being wherever you are
Benefit from a 30% employer contribution to our Company Pension scheme (BAV)
Enjoy an additional day off on your birthday, promoting a healthy work-life balance
Complimentary CalmApp subscription for you and your loved ones because mental wellness matters.
Energetic work environment with a hybrid work style, providing the balance you need
Opportunity to transfer your career internationally
Opportunity for rapid career progression
Thorough training and continual coaching and development
Benefit from our family leave program, which grows with your tenure at Meltwater.
Thrive within our inclusive community and seize ongoing professional development opportunities to elevate your career.


Our Story

At Meltwater, we believe that when you have the right people in the right environment, great things happen.

Our best-in-class technology empowers our 27,000 customers around the world to make better business decisions through data. But we can’t do that without our global team of developers, innovators, problem-solvers, and high-performers who embrace challenges and find new solutions for our customers.

Our award-winning global culture drives everything we do and creates an environment where our employees can make an impact, learn every day, feel a sense of belonging, and celebrate each other’s successes along the way.

We are innovators at the core who see the potential in people, ideas and technologies. Together, we challenge ourselves to go big, be bold, and build best-in-class solutions for our customers.

We’re proud of our diverse team of 2,200+ employees in 50 locations across 25 countries around the world. No matter where you are, you’ll work with people who care about your success and get the support you need to unlock new heights in your career.

We are Meltwater. Inspired by innovation, powered by people.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Meltwater is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: At Meltwater, we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity and strive to provide a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment.

All employment decisions at Meltwater are made based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by the applicable laws and regulations.

Meltwater does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, and we actively promote a culture of respect, fairness, and inclusivity. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities to apply and join us in our mission to drive innovation and make a positive impact in the world.

We may use AI to assist in aspects of our hiring process, such as reviewing candidate information, capturing interview notes, and supporting interview activities. These tools are used only to assist our team through increased efficiencies. Every output continues to be reviewed by humans, and all hiring decisions are made by humans. Title: Celonis Process Intelligence Consultant (m/w/d)
Description:
Wir sind Proxius. Ein dynamisches Start-up mit einer großen Leidenschaft für Process Intelligence! Unsere Mission: Komplexe Prozesse transparent machen, Potenziale aufdecken und mit Automatisierung und KI echte Verbesserungen schaffen.




Wir arbeiten vor allem mit großen Kunden aus der Telekommunikations- und Energiewirtschaft, deutschlandweit sowie international. Vielleicht kennt man uns außerhalb der Process-Mining-Bubble noch nicht, unsere Kunden aber ziemlich sicher. Proxius ist Celonis Platinum Partner und gehört damit zu den führenden spezialisierten Beratungen in diesem Bereich.




Für unser Team suchen wir ab sofort Consultants (m/w/d) für Process Intelligence & Celonis, die Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns richtig durchzustarten.




Aufgaben




Bei uns bist du nicht einfach ein technischer Umsetzer. Du willst verstehen, wie Prozesse wirklich funktionieren, wo Potenziale liegen und wie wir sie gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden heben können.




Dafür arbeitest du mit Daten, entwickelst Analysen und Lösungen und bringst Automatisierung und KI dort ins Spiel, wo sie echten Mehrwert schaffen. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, hinterfragst Anforderungen und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen.




Process Intelligence & Consulting




Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden an Celonis- und Process-Intelligence-Projekten von der ersten Idee bis zur produktiven Lösung.
Du analysierst Prozesse und Daten, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und entwickelst daraus konkrete Lösungen.
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und wirst mit wachsender Erfahrung zum Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden.
Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Prozesse unserer Kunden und wirst zum Spezialisten für deine Themen und Branchen.




Data, Automation & AI




Du entwickelst Dashboards, Analysen, Automatisierungs-Flows und AI Solutions, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern tatsächlich etwas verändern.
Du entwickelst und optimierst Datenmodelle und Datenanbindungen (ETL) und sorgst dafür, dass aus Rohdaten nutzbares Prozesswissen wird.
Du beschäftigst dich mit der Frage, wie wir Prozesswissen mit Automatisierung und KI verbinden können und entwickelst daraus neue Lösungen.




Proxius weiterentwickeln




Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Standards und Produkte auf der Celonis-Plattform, die wir international einsetzen und vertreiben können.
Du bringst deine Ideen ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir Projekte umsetzen, Lösungen entwickeln und als Unternehmen besser werden.




Profil




Wir suchen einen Charakter!

Natürlich brauchen wir für den Job bestimmte fachliche Skills. Mindestens genauso wichtig ist uns aber, wie du an Dinge herangehst.




Du willst verstehen, warum etwas funktioniert oder eben nicht. Du kannst dich in Daten und Prozesse verbeißen, verlierst dabei aber nicht aus den Augen, welches Problem wir eigentlich lösen wollen. Du arbeitest eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und hast den Anspruch, Dinge wirklich gut zu machen.




Und: Du arbeitest gerne mit Kunden. Das bedeutet für uns nicht, jede Anforderung einfach umzusetzen. Wir suchen Menschen, die mitdenken, gute Fragen stellen und auch mal sagen: „Ich glaube, wir sollten das anders machen.“




Ein paar klassische Traits und Skills solltest du natürlich trotzdem mitbringen:




Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Mathematik, Naturwissenschaften oder BWL oder einen anderen Hintergrund, mit dem du uns überzeugst.
Du bringst Erfahrung mit SQL, BI, Datenbanken oder Datenmodellen mit und fühlst dich im Umgang mit Daten wohl.
Du hast mindestens erste Berufserfahrung im Data-, Process-, Automation- oder Consulting-Umfeld gesammelt.
Erfahrung mit Celonis ist natürlich ein großes Plus. Noch wichtiger ist uns aber, dass du Daten und Prozesse verstehst und Lust hast, dich tief in Process Intelligence einzuarbeiten.
Du kannst komplexe Themen verständlich erklären und trittst gegenüber Kunden professionell, verbindlich und kommunikativ auf.
Du arbeitest eigenständig und strukturiert, bist gleichzeitig aber ein echter Teamplayer.
Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch sind für unsere Kundenprojekte ein Muss.




Du musst nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt erfüllen. Wenn du fachlich stark bist, schnell lernst und richtig Lust auf Process Intelligence hast, sollten wir uns kennenlernen.




Wir bieten




Ein richtig cooles und erfahrenes Team, in dem du viel lernen kannst und gleichzeitig Raum für deine eigenen Ideen bekommst.
Viel Verantwortung und die Möglichkeit, Proxius aktiv mitzugestalten, statt nur Teil eines großen Beratungsapparats zu sein.
Projekte bei großen, bekannten Unternehmen mit komplexen Prozessen und echtem Impact.
Flexibilität, wie und wo du arbeitest: remote oder gemeinsam im Büro in München, Berlin oder Köln.
Eine transparente und faire Vergütung: Consultant 55–65k €
Und für uns eigentlich selbstverständlich und nicht zu erwähnen (tun wir aber trotzdem ;) ): neuestes IT-Equipment mit iPhone und leistungsfähigem Laptop, Wellpass / Sachbezug, Fortbildungen und richtig gute Team-Events.




Warum Proxius?




Weil wir klein genug sind, dass deine Ideen und deine Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied machen und gleichzeitig an Projekten arbeiten, die alles andere als klein sind.

Bei uns bist du keine Nummer und musst dich nicht durch fünf Hierarchieebenen kämpfen, bevor du Verantwortung übernehmen darfst. Wenn du etwas gut kannst, bekommst du den Raum dafür. Wenn du etwas noch nicht kannst, helfen wir dir dabei, es zu lernen.

Und wenn du eine gute Idee hast, wollen wir sie hören.

Title: Business Analyst / Senior Business Analyst (m/w/d) – Daten & Institutssteuerung
Description:
Die Sparkassen Rating und Risikosysteme (SR) ist der zentrale Dienstleister für Verfahren des Risikomanagements in der Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe. Wir unterstützen die Institute mit Standardlösungen in den Bereichen der Risikomessung und -steuerung, der regulatorischen Banksteuerung sowie im Vertrieb mit Data-Analytics-Lösungen. Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern bieten wir den Instituten, von der Konzeption der Verfahren, über deren Weiterentwicklung, IT-Umsetzung und Umsetzungsunterstützung, zentrale und standardisierte Lösungen an.


Business Analyst | Senior Business Analyst (m/w/d) – Daten & Institutssteuerung


ab sofort suchen wir im Fachbereich Institutssteuerung


Das erwartet Dich:
Aufbruch & Datenfokus: Bereich Institutssteuerung, Entwicklung neuer Systeme für Sparkassen; datengetriebene Lösungen zur Steuerung von Risiko und Ertrag, Arbeit mit Daten, Modellen und technischen Lösungen.
Verantwortung & Entwicklung: Je nach Erfahrung übernimmst Du früh eigene Themenpakete und entwickelst Dich hin zu eigenständigem Projektmanagement und sicherem Auftritt vor Kunden und Fachgremien.
Daten & Technik: Du analysierst große Datenmengen, entwickelst Auswertungen, Modelle und Prototypen (z. B. in SQL, Python, R), gestaltest Datenverarbeitungsstrecken und bereitest Ergebnisse für die Steuerung von Sparkassen auf.
Kundensicht & Technik verbinden: Du verstehst Prozesse und Bedarfe unserer Kunden und übersetzt sie in robuste, nachhaltige Daten- und IT-Konzepte – genau diese Brücke zwischen Fachlichkeit und Technik ist Kern Deiner Rolle.
Vielseitiger Arbeitsalltag: Mix aus Datenanalyse, Programmierung und Lösungsdesign, enger Austausch mit Fachbereichen und Anwender:innen; bankfachliches Vorwissen ist ein Plus, den fachlichen Kontext bauen wir mit Dir gemeinsam auf.

Das bringst Du mit:
Abgeschlossenes Studium in einem passenden Fach (z. B. Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science) oder gleichwertige, praxisbasierte Kenntnisse.
Starke Datenanalyse-Skills, sehr gutes SQL, Programmierung in Python oder R; idealerweise Erfahrung mit gängigen Analyse- und Datenverarbeitungspaketen.
Erste praktische Datenerfahrung (Praktika, Werkstudium, Abschlussarbeit oder erste Berufserfahrung); Einstieg je nach Profil als Business Analyst oder Senior Business Analyst möglich.
Hohes Interesse an Kundendialog und daran, Anforderungen in klare, umsetzbare Daten- und Technikkonzepte zu übersetzen; Neugier und Lernbereitschaft, bankfachliche Erfahrung ist ein Plus.
Idealerweise Erfahrung im Projekt- und Anforderungsmanagement; auf Senior-Level fundierte Projekterfahrung und ggf. fachliche Anleitung von Kolleg:innen.
Starke Kommunikation, verbindliches Auftreten, Teamorientierung, pragmatische, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und Lust auf kontinuierliche fachliche wie technische Weiterentwicklung.

Eine unbefristete Tätigkeit in einem hoch versierten Arbeitsumfeld mit anspruchsvollen Aufgaben und einem attraktiven Vergütungspaket
30 Tage Urlaub + 2 Bankfeiertage und zusätzlichen Sonderurlaub für besondere Anlässe
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und vermögenswirksame Leistungen
Individuelle interne | externe Weiterbildung über unsere Akademie

ab sofort suchen wir im Fachbereich Institutssteuerung

Title: Staff Data Analyst, Paid Search
Description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

This specific position sits within our Growth Analytics team, whose objective is to scale marketing investment toward the most incremental and loyal customers. The role is focused on our paid search channel where black-box auction dynamics, branded vs non-branded incrementality, and elasticity modelling define the analytical problem. The successful candidate will also contribute to cross-channel measurement questions as they arise.

Your mission


Develop quantitative analysis and statistical models to evaluate and steer marketing decisions
Propose and defend strategic recommendations to our top marketing leads
Setup and analyse marketing experiments to drive strategic decision making
Explore large datasets, give meaning to data and numbers, identify opportunities and issues, and present findings to stakeholders
Maintain and improve our marketing measurement tools (Attribution, experimentation framework, Customer lifetime value…)
Serve as a liaison between the marketing teams and the data engineering team
Mentor others in the skills needed for this role
Use AI to accelerate end-to-end analysis — from framing the question to delivering the insight — while holding a high bar for methodological rigor and validation


Your toolkit


8+ years of relevant experience interpreting data in an analytics or data science role
Prior experience analysing paid search and/or SEO performance, using platforms such as Google Ads/Search.
Strong knowledge of SQL and Python for analysis (eg, pandas, scikit-learn, pyspark)
Hands-on experience with causal inference methods (e.g. geo experiments, difference-in-differences, synthetic controls) and/or elasticity modelling applied to marketing spend decisions.
Ability to understand user behavior and meaning behind the numbers and a track record in sharing insights to business stakeholders.
Experience identifying where AI could meaningfully improve your team's analytics workflows or tooling, not just your own output.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g. Looker, Jupyter Notebooks, Databricks).
Desire to work in an international environment, with minimal direction and with highly engaged individuals
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English


How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary


Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
Monthly transportation and fitness budget
Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
Language reimbursement program
Health and wellness benefits


And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

Title: Business Analytics Manager
Description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Business Analytics Managerto own the analytical agenda for our Germany market– one of our most complex and strategically vital European hubs.

This is a senior Individual Contributor (IC) role with a clear mandate: use data to drive commercial decisions. You will be embedded with the Germany commercial team.

You are not a back-office reporting function. You are the analytical co-pilotfor Category, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Merchant Operations – translating complex data into clear, actionable business recommendations that shape P&L outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Business Performance

Own the Germany market performance narrative – delivering weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews to the Germany Country Manager.
Define and monitor key performance indicators across GMV, orders, revenue, conversion, fulfillment, customer experience, and contribution margin.
Identify growth opportunities and operational bottlenecks through rigorous data analysis – providing clear, data-backed recommendations.
Lead scenario planning and "what-if" modeling to support annual planning, budget allocation, and strategic investments.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with Category teams to optimize assortment, pricing architecture, and promotional calendars.
Collaborate with Marketing to evaluate channel efficiency, customer acquisition costs, and lifetime value.
Work with Supply Chain & Logistics to balance delivery speed, cost, and customer satisfaction.
Advise Merchant Operations on seller segmentation, incentive design, and supply-side retention strategies.
Align with Product & Engineering to prioritize Germany-specific data requirements and instrumentation.

Advanced Analytics & Modeling

Build forecasting models for demand, revenue, and supply – incorporating seasonality, promotions, and macroeconomic indicators.
Design and execute causal inference analyses to measure incrementality of pricing changes, promotions, and marketing investments.
Develop customer segmentation, cohort analysis, and lifetime value models to inform commercial strategy.
Lead strategic deep-dives on high-priority topics – from fulfillment optimization to category expansion and competitive positioning.

Data Infrastructure & Automation

Architect and maintain the Germany market data layer – from automated ETL pipelines to executive dashboards.
Drive automation of recurring reporting, reducing manual effort and enabling focus on high-value strategic work.
Establish self-service data capabilities for local commercial teams.
Ensure data quality, governance, and compliance with GDPR and German data protection regulations.




Qualifications

8 years of experience in Business Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Strategy, Data Science, or Management Consulting with a quantitative focus, includingat least 2 years directly focused on the German or DACH eCommerce, retail, or marketplacesector.
Master's Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research, Supply Chain, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
Expert-level SQL– ability to write complex, optimized queries across petabyte-scale data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift).
Advanced proficiency in Python – with demonstrated experience in forecasting, causal inference, cohort analysis, segmentation, and automation.
Expert-level BI skills– Looker, Tableau, or Power BI – building decision-making tools that commercial teams actually use daily.
Proven track record of directly influencing P&L outcomes– measurable impact on GMV growth, margin improvement, or cost efficiency through data-driven recommendations.
Strong business communication skills– ability to synthesize complex data into executive-ready narratives, board presentations, and actionable recommendations.
Fluent English and required to lead meetings and present to local stakeholders in German. Based in Berlin, with a hybrid working model.

Als (Senior) Experte HR Data Analytics (m/w/d) erwartet dich eine anspruchsvolle Rolle als Data Scientist zur Entwicklung datengestützter Modelle zur Aufbereitung und Interpretation entscheidungsrelevanter Daten.

Präsentation: Strukturierte Aufbereitung der Inhalte für verschiedene Zielgruppen und Reporting-Anforderungen.
Management: Selbstständig identifizierst und entwickelst du Schritt für Schritt den notwendigen Prozess zur Entwicklung der gesamte Wertschöpfungs- und Engagementkette.

Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Mathematik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Physik bspw. mit Schwerpunkt Statistik, Data Analytics oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung z. B. im Bereich Analytics und/oder Projektmanagement
Der Umgang mit großen Datenmengen in einem hochvertraulichen Umfeld ist für dich kein Problem
(Erste) Programmierkenntnisse in R, Python, SQL oder vergleichbar sowie Erfahrung mit Business-Intelligence-Tools wie Qlik, Sense oder PowerBI
Exzellente analytische Fähigkeiten und einen hohen Anspruch an die eigenen Arbeitsergebnisse

Job Description



At Scalable, we use data to make better decisions across our business, including People. As our first dedicated People Analytics hire, you will build the foundations for a data-driven People function.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will bring together People data, create reliable reporting, improve our People Tech stack, and turn data into insights that help leaders make informed decisions.





Build a trusted People data foundation by combining data from relevant source systems and ensuring data quality, privacy, and clear ownership
Design and maintain dashboards and reports for core People metrics, such as headcount, hiring, retention, employee lifecycle, and workforce planning

Develop clear, actionable recommendations and communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders
Improve and expand our People Tech ecosystem to support reliable data flows and efficient People processes
Establish practical data governance standards for People data, including definitions, access, quality checks, and privacy requirements
Identify opportunities to develop forecasting and predictive analytics capabilities as the data foundation matures
Shape Scalable’s People Analytics and People Tech foundations from day one with a dedicated budget for analytics tooling and continuous learning
Work in close collaboration with People, Finance, and business leadership to directly improve decision-making, employee experience, and business growth


Qualifications


Experience in People Analytics, People Data Management, Business Intelligence, or a comparable data analytics role
Strong SQL skills and experience with data visualisation tools, such as Metabase, Tableau, or Power BI
Experience working with HR systems and integrating data from multiple sources
A sound understanding of data architecture, data quality, data governance, and privacy principles
Ability to explain complex data clearly and turn findings into practical recommendations
Experience with Python or R is a plus, especially for advanced analytics
Fluent English skills. German is a plus
This role requires you to be based in Munich or Berlin and work from one of our office locations


Additional Information


Be part of one of the fastest-growing and most visible Fintech startups in Europe, creating innovative services that have a substantial impact on the lives of our customers
Work with an international, diverse, inclusive, and ever-growing team that loves creating the best products for our clients

Partner with stakeholders across Finance to identify data needs, improve reporting capabilities, and enable data-driven decision-making.
Develop, maintain, and optimise Finance datasets, reports, and dashboards to provide accurate and actionable insights.
Support data quality, governance, and documentation initiatives to ensure consistency and transparency of Finance data.

Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve efficiency through data solutions and technology.

Understanding of Finance processes and business performance management.
Experience building and maintaining BI solutions and dashboards.

Strong SQL skills and experience working with data platforms and analytical tools.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Payment processing reporting experience.

Title: Senior Quantitative Analyst
Description:
About Schumacher

Schumacher & Co. is an innovative interior design company that is disrupting the$150 billion-dollar global interior design industry. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. With over 500+ employees and growing, we are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life.We are dedicated to the mission of helping our customers “celebrate the feeling of home”. F. Schumacher & Co designs and produces some of the most beautiful fabrics, wallcoverings, trims, rugs, furniture, and accessories in the world. Our portfolio of products is broad, but they are united by a passion for design, a thirst for what is next, an appreciation for what’s come before, a drive to make our products with enormous care and attention for detail. F. Schumacher & Co is a globally recognized company with a myriad of showrooms both domestically and internationally.

Our Competitive Advantage In The Industry Is Our People. We Believe That Our Employees Are Our Most Important Assets. F. Schumacher & Co Is Deeply Anchored In Our Company Core Values Which Are As Follows


Preserve Our Entrepreneurial Spirit
Take Ownership & Accountability
Be Solutions-Oriented
Demonstrate Courage
Practice Adaptability
Embrace Collaboration


We empower our employees to live these values daily because we understand how it will positively impact the customer's journey. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company to many brands within our portfolio. This role is a 12 month contract and is a part of Data Insights & AI team

Role Overview

We're looking for a hands-on, Senior Quantitative Analyst, Product Portfolio (Statistical Modeling) to own analytics and reporting in support of our Portfolio Development team, with a specific focus on SKU productivity & capital allocation across a portfolio of 20,000+ SKUs and growing. This role will report directly to the Sr. Director of AI & Data Insights, but is expected to work directly with the CEO & Chief of Staff on a day-to-day basis.

This is not a role for someone who takes data at face value. You'll need to distinguish real signal from noise (e.g., a SKU selling poorly because it's out of stock, not because demand is weak), and when you find data that's wrong or inconsistent, you'll have the access and judgment to go into Snowflake and fix it — not just flag it and wait.

What You’ll Do


Work hands-on with CEO & Product Strategy stakeholders to understand key strategic questions, and then build analysis and reporting to address them directly
Use statistical methods (e.g. conjoint analysis, multivariate regression) to identify which product attributes and characteristics (e.g., color, pattern, material, price point, availability) drive productivity, and translate that into data-driven guidance on where the portfolio should expand, contract or shift
Cut through data noise at scale: systematically identify and control for confounders like stock-outs, new/discontinued SKUs, and seasonality so reported trends reflect real pattern performance
Identify data inconsistencies at the source (e.g., ERP, web, product master data) and directly and systematically correct records in Snowflake and work with upstream platform owners to improve the accuracy of source data and downstream analytics
Present findings clearly and independently to executive audiences, adapting the message for technical or non-technical stakeholders
Recommend and maintain recurring analytics & reporting to provide accurate and timely snapshot of SKU productivity
Use AI across your own workflow to explore data faster, automate repetitive reporting, catch errors, and multiply output given the scale and growth of the SKU portfolio


What We're Looking For


2-5 years in data science, analytics, statistics in similar SKU-driven businesses
Solid grounding in statistics or operations research (e.g. regression, hypothesis testing, multivariate analysis, optimization). Able to move beyond descriptive reporting to model relationships between variables and quantify drivers, not just flag correlations
Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on Snowflake experience including writing back to correct or clean production data (not just read-only querying)
A track record of presenting findings and challenging assumptions directly with senior stakeholders and executives
Independent executor — sets analysis priorities against business goals without waiting for direction, and ships accurate, high-impact work in a timely manner
Curiosity — asks why the numbers look the way they do and keeps digging until the answer holds up, rather than reporting the first number that looks plausible
Thinks in terms of SKU-level economics: sell-through, margin, inventory position, lifecycle stage — and knows how to separate a true productivity problem from a data artifact
Treats data quality as part of the job, digging into root causes and correcting them directly rather than working around bad data

Description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Wirtschaftsprüfung und prüfungsnahe Beratung suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Consultant Data Analytics (w/m/d).

 

Das erwartet dich

Beratung – Als Teil unseres Teams berätst und/oder prüfst du national und international agierende Unternehmen verschiedener Branchen und unterstützt eine erfolgreiche Projektumsetzung.

IT-Lösungen – Du entwickelst mit deinem Team innovative IT-Lösungen zur Analyse von großen Datenmengen. Dies schließt die Konzeption und die Umsetzung von nachhaltigen Business Intelligence und Big Data Lösungen zur Prüfung und Durchführung von ERP-Transformationsprojekten ein.

Projektarbeit – Du arbeitest in vielseitigen Projekten bei führenden Industrieunternehmen, Banken und Versicherungen im internationalen Kontext. Dabei entwickelst du innovative Produkte und kundenspezifische Lösungen im Bereich Analytics, Reporting und Big Data – Du betreust Kunden und hilfst bei der Neukundenakquise.

Technologieerklärung – Du kennst die Welt der Datenanalyse und kannst Kunden verständlich näherbringen, welche Möglichkeiten ihnen moderne Analytics Methoden und -Werkzeuge im SAP-Umfeld eröffnen und wie sie diese in bestehende BI & Analytics Landschaften integrieren.

 

Das bringst du mit

Dein Studium mit wirtschaftlichem, informationstechnischem oder naturwissenschaftlichem Schwerpunkt hast du erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor.
Du verfügst über Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA in den Bereichen Data & Analytics, Reporting, Planung oder Data Management.
Darüber hinaus bringst du Know-how in Business Intelligence sowie modernen Analysemethoden wie Data Mining, Predictive Analytics oder Machine Learning mit.
Ebenso hast du bereits Erfahrungen im Prüfungs-/Beratungsumfeld gesammelt.
Du kannst sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch einwandfrei kommunizieren und sicher präsentieren, da wir als Team international aufgestellt sind.

 

Deine Benefits

Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.

Masterförderung – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Darüber hinaus bieten wir die Möglichkeit einer Masterförderung für Examensmaster und Spezialisierungsmaster an.

Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. 

Gesundheit –  Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von vergünstigten Beiträgen in diversen Fitnessstudios oder einer Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft

Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.

 

Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Digital Assurance & Transparency (DAT) Teams unterstützt du unsere Kunden – sowohl prüferisch als auch beratend – bei der Bewältigung unternehmerischer Herausforderungen in Zeiten der Digitalisierung und Transformation. Dabei verbinden wir regulatorisches Know-how mit technologischer Expertise und begleiten Unternehmen bei Themen rund um IT- und Prozessprüfungen, interne Kontrollsysteme sowie digitale Transformationsprojekte. So schaffen wir Transparenz, Vertrauen und nachhaltige Lösungen in einer zunehmend digitalen Wirtschaft.

Title: Principal Product Analyst (all genders)
Description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM

Data is a critical pillar of our product development process, and the Product Analytics team serves as the chief advocate for its quality, consistency, and strategic usage.

We are seeking a data-driven and user-centric professional to drive the strategy, evaluation, and optimization of our digital products. In this role, you will define how we value user interactions, measure success, and tie product features directly to overarching business outcomes.

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)


Drive the implementation and evolution of a standardized cross-organizational product performance measurement framework, eliminating metric fragmentation by establishing consistent core KPIs (such as Weekly Active Users, Conversion Rate, and the Overall Evaluation Criterion) across all business units.
Own the technical architecture and attribution models for user value scoring, developing complex data structures to quantify and weigh both upper-funnel engagement actions (e.g., browsing, saving, content interaction) and lower-funnel transactional behaviors.
Advance the content flywheel into a measurable insight engine that definitively proves how content experiences translate into long-term financial, visit frequency, and business value.
Lead the engineering of advanced data solutions and complex analytics pipelines, including session-level tracking, cross-premise identity stitching, and methodologies to mitigate the "Winner’s Curse" in product experiments.

We are Meltwater. Inspired by innovation, powered by people.

Full time; 40 hours per week
Permanent position
Based in: Covent Garden, London.


The Royal Ballet and Opera, situated in our Covent Garden theatre has been at the heart of London and British cultural life for three centuries. We are home to two world-class Companies: The Royal Ballet and The Royal Opera.

The Royal Opera House describes the place we work, not who we are. The whole is always more than the sum of its parts – we may be a House, but three quarters of our audiences experience what we do outside this building. Understanding our global audience (their behaviours, preferences and habits) is central to our mission to engage more people with our art forms through programming and commercial development, as well as reporting accurately to our funders and supporters.

This role will focus on delivering high-quality data analysis, ensuring that we continue to develop a holistic and evolving image of RBO audiences and sales. The postholder will provide clear, actionable insights to stakeholders across the organisation, enabling them to make strategic, evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate will have an analytical mind, with the ability to operate independently to agreed deadlines, producing high quality and accurate work for a range of stakeholders at pace. They will be able to contribute to the output of a multi-functional and collaborative team, working with a range of specialists across UX and CX Research, Pricing, Ticketing and Marketing.

Strong practical data analysis skills, including SQL skills
Strong numeracy, analytical reasoning and attention to detail
The ability to understand the underlying questions of an analytics request and to translate stakeholder requests into clear, focused analysis briefs
Strong collaboration skills, with the confidence to work constructively with stakeholders, technical colleagues and subject matter experts
Clear experience of taking analytical work from an initial question through to accurate findings, clear conclusions and actionable insight.


An Understanding Of The Below Will Be Beneficial And Highly Regarded So Please Do Reflect These In Your Application If You Have


Experience with ticketing or CRM data
Experience working across multiple data sets
Experience with audience, visitor, member or customer data in a performing arts or visitor attraction environment
Experience using Python, R or another analytical programming language for data analysis or automation.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
VOY is a fast growing Healthtech scale-up, aiming to be the healthcare provider that millions of people trust as their partner to a long and healthy life. Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated


Partner across teams


Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation


What we need from you


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office


Experience you may have


A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks


Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Company




We’re Octopus Legacy: one of the fastest growing tech companies in the country, part of the UK’s most exciting and best-trusted group (you may have heard of some of our sister companies…) and we have a mission.




We’re on a path to scale, aiming to become a household name while transforming a long-established industry and helping our customers prepare for, and find support after, death.




But we can’t do it alone, and that’s why we’re assembling a team of top performers to build with us.




Ready to be part of something big?




The Role

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing data team at Octopus Legacy. You’ll play a central role in helping teams across the business make smarter, faster, more informed decisions.




While you’ll sit within the data team, your day-to-day will involve working directly with stakeholders from across the organisation such as Growth, Product and Operations. You’ll turn messy real-world data into actionable insights, bring structure to ambiguity, and help the business better understand what drives performance.




This is a hands-on, high-impact role in a fast-moving environment. You’ll need to be comfortable navigating shifting priorities, championing a data culture, and bringing rigour to complexity.




We’re still early in our data journey - right now, the focus is on building the foundations: modelling key metrics, creating dashboards, and getting reliable data into the hands of the people who need it. As our data maturity grows, there’ll be opportunities to go deeper into analysis, experimentation, and more advanced analytics.




Key Responsibilities:

Act as a thought partner to teams across the business - helping them define problems, clarify questions, and uncover the metrics that matter
Translate stakeholder needs into end-to-end data solutions: from raw data to dbt models to dashboards in Metabase
Define and document clear, consistent metrics to support better decision-making across departments
Build intuitive, impactful dashboards that make data accessible and actionable for non-technical users
Deliver ad-hoc and project-based analysis to evaluate initiatives in growth, product, operations, and beyond
Collaborate with the data team to improve the reliability, clarity, and accessibility of our data models and pipelines
Operate with a high degree of autonomy - scoping projects, pushing for clarity, and challenging assumptions when needed
Contribute to a culture of curiosity and rigour, laying the groundwork for more advanced analytics and data science over time




Who Are You?

You have 2+ years of experience in a data analytics role, ideally in a startup or a company building out its data capability
You're proficient in SQL and have worked with BI tools (like Metabase, Looker, or Tableau) to build dashboards that help teams make better decisions
You have hands-on experience with dbt or similar tools, and a solid understanding of data modelling best practices
You’re comfortable working with messy or incomplete data, and know how to turn it into something clean, structured, and useful
You enjoy working with non-technical stakeholders - you ask thoughtful questions, clarify ambiguous requests, and help teams think through what they really need
You take ownership of your work, are comfortable scoping projects with limited direction, and aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions
You’re curious, pragmatic, and excited by the idea of shaping a modern data function from the ground up
Bonus: you have an interest in experimentation or data science, and are keen to grow into more advanced analytics over time




Skills and Knowledge




Must haves:

Strong curiosity and proactive mindset, with the ability to independently explore data, ask the right questions, identify opportunities, and drive projects forward without requiring constant guidance.
Experience in data analytics and the ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets.
Proficiency with SQL, DBT, python is desirable.
Proven ability to work closely with business stakeholders and translate their needs into data-driven solutions.
Experience in developing reports and dashboards to monitor key metrics.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to present complex data in a way that is understandable and actionable for non-technical stakeholders across departments.
Proficiency with data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Metabase).




Nice to haves/we can work on these:

Basic programming skills in languages such as Python.
Understanding of statistical methods and their application to business problems.
Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment.




Bonus if you:

You have a basic understanding of Data Science concepts and are interested in learning more.
You have experience in training or educating non-technical teams on data literacy.




Our Mission

When people think about planning for death they think about wills, life insurance and funerals. We take these cold processes and turn them into something more human. Share more than money: leave voice notes, music, recipes. Shape a legacy that connects you while you're here. And after you're gone.




Founded by Sam after his mum died suddenly, we’re a group of people who work in death because we’ve been affected by it. We know the difference a good plan makes, and what it’s like when there isn’t one.




Death can come between us, leave mess, legal fees, frustration. But it can also make us stronger. We see a world where people talk openly about death, and work out the real meaning of legacy, one that connects to them. We’re here to make that world happen.




Benefits:

Octopus share incentive scheme.
Hybrid working (London Bridge).
Flexible holiday + extra day off for your Birthday.
Work from anywhere in the world for up to 4 weeks per year.
Vitality Health & Life Insurance.
Pension scheme.
Enhanced parental leave.
Free Will & LPAs + discounts on other Octopus services.
Cycle to Work Scheme and access to the Electric Vehicle (EV) Salary Sacrifice Scheme.
Octopus Giving: we match any charitable fundraising that you do up to £500.
Octopus Springboard: where we help our employees become fully-fledged entrepreneurs.
Dog friendly office.
Breakfast every day, snacks and wellness activities




We know that to be truly innovative, we need to have a diverse team around us. That is why Octopus Legacy is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music?

Universal Music UK is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun.

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. Senior Data Analyst

Up to 90K/Remote

The Overview

This is an exciting opportunity for a Senior Data Analyst to join a fast-growing digital business where data plays a central role in shaping commercial, product, and customer decisions. You'll have the chance to influence business strategy, build impactful self-serve analytics solutions, and work on high-visibility projects that directly support growth.

The Company

They are a high-growth consumer-focused business that places data at the heart of decision-making. With a modern data stack and a strong commitment to analytical innovation, they are continuing to invest in their analytics capability as they scale. The business promotes a collaborative culture where insights drive meaningful action and where analysts are empowered to make a measurable impact. This is an environment where curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

The Role

You will:

Partner with stakeholders across Product, Commercial, Growth, and other business functions to solve complex business challenges through data.
Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches, actionable insights, and clear recommendations.
Develop and enhance BI reporting, dashboards, and self-serve analytics capabilities.
Build scalable reporting solutions that improve data accessibility and support confident decision-making.
Deliver customer, product, and commercial analysis to identify opportunities, trends, and risks.
Support experimentation initiatives, including A/B testing analysis and performance measurement.
Communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Contribute to raising analytical standards and improving data-driven decision-making across the organisation.

Your Skills & Experience

Strong commercial experience in data analytics within a fast-paced environment.
Advanced SQL skills and a proven ability to solve complex analytical problems.
Experience developing BI reporting, dashboards, and self-serve analytics solutions.
Strong experience with Looker, Omni, or similar modern BI platforms.
Understanding of experimentation methodologies and A/B testing analysis.
Experience translating stakeholder requirements into scalable analytical outputs.
Exposure to dbt or analytics engineering principles is beneficial.
Python experience is advantageous but not essential.
Excellent stakeholder management and data storytelling skills.
Ability to work autonomously and thrive in a dynamic, evolving environment.

What They Offer

Salary up to £90,000.
Remote-first working across the UK.
Private healthcare package.
Income protection benefits.
Flexible working arrangements.
Enhanced holiday entitlement linked to tenure.
Home office support.
Access to employee discount and salary sacrifice schemes.
Clear progression opportunities into leadership and broader strategic analytics roles.
Exposure to innovative analytics projects, including customer intelligence, experimentation, and advanced analytics initiatives.

How to Apply

If you're a commercially minded Senior Data Analyst looking to make a significant impact in a growing, data-driven business, apply today to learn more about this opportunity.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
About Salary Finance

Working with employers, we provide a financial wellbeing platform as an employee benefit, helping employees to understand their money better, get out of debt faster and save for their future. We already have a reach of over 4,000,000 employees through our relationships with over 600 of the biggest companies in the UK.




By improving employee financial wellbeing, we have a very real and meaningful impact on people’s lives. We remove the stress and worry associated with financial difficulties by dramatically reducing the interest rates employees pay on their personal debt, and provide them with the tools needed to start saving sooner and be more financially secure. We are backed by some of the biggest brands, including investments from Blenheim Chalcot (the UK’s leading venture builder), Legal and General (the FTSE 100 insurer and asset manager), Experian and funding partnerships with JP Morgan and Blue Owl.




Launched in 2015, we have made excellent progress, and are scaling fast. We are named BITC’s Responsible Business of Year 2018, included in KPMG’s Global Fintech 100, listed top of the Forbes' list of socially-responsible startups, and profiled by the Financial Times, the Times, the Wall Street Journal, the Guardian, the Telegraph, CityAM and the Institute of Directors.




Your role in our mission

We are looking for a talented Enterprise Data Analyst to join our Enterprise Data Hub. Reporting to the Lead Enterprise Data Analyst, you will help translate business questions into trusted data products and Power BI dashboards, supporting Salary Finance's mission to help our customers get out of debt faster and save for their future. You'll work alongside senior analysts, engineers and stakeholders across the business building the datasets, reports, and insights that inform decisions and enable safe growth of our loan book. This is a role where you'll grow your craft, contribute to team standards, and see the impact of your work reach real customers.




What you’ll do

Build High-Impact Dashboarding:

You will liaise with stakeholders of all data literacy levels to develop robust dashboard requirements
You will build, design, develop and maintain best-in-class Power BI dashboards which serve a purpose and deliver value to the business

Drive Operational Efficiency

You will help the automation of manual reporting processes and end-to-end operational workflows, ensuring high uptime and seamless maintenance of production reports.
You will regularly audit existing report performance and SQL scripts to reduce technical debt and improve processing speeds as data demand scales.

Support Data Integrity:

You will follow the team's data governance standards and contribute to documentation across your analytical outputs

Engineer Data Foundations:

You will build optimised scalable data products and robust data marts, creating a structured environment for self-service analytics.
You will collaborate with Enterprise Data Engineers to refine ETL/ELT pipelines, ensuring the upstream data architecture supports downstream analytical requirements.




About you

Essential:

Proven Track Record: At least 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or similar roles, with a demonstrable history of progressing from technical execution to strategic delivery.
SQL Mastery: Advance level proficiency in writing, optimising, and debugging complex queries. You should be comfortable handling large-scale datasets and understanding relational database architecture.
Power BI & DAX Specialist: Advanced command of the Power BI ecosystem. You don't just build reports; you create sophisticated DAX measures and perform complex data modeling to solve intricate business logic.
Strategic Stakeholder Management: A proven ability to act as a bridge between technical data and business needs. You can translate "vague requests" into concrete technical requirements and present findings to executives with confidence.
Insight Delivery & Storytelling: You possess a "so what?" mindset. You have a track record of moving beyond descriptive reporting to deliver predictive insights that drive measurable commercial value.
LLM Literate: You are comfortable using LLMs (e.g., Claude, Gemini) to accelerate your workflow, whether for logic verification, documentation, or streamlining code development.




Nice to have:

Experience in financial services or a similar regulated industry (e.g., FinTech, banking).
Prompt Engineering for Data: You are well-versed in prompt engineering techniques to optimise data cleaning, generate SQL scripts, or automate metadata documentation.
Python for Analytics: Ability to use Python for data manipulation (Pandas/NumPy), automation scripts, or basic statistical modeling to augment standard BI toolsets.
Data Governance Frameworks: Practical experience establishing data dictionaries, lineage, and quality protocols to ensure a "single source of truth."
Forecasting & Predictive Modeling: Experience building time-series forecasts or predictive models to help the business anticipate trends, demand, or churn.
Technical Mentorship: Experience in peer-reviewing code (SQL/DAX) and coaching junior analysts to uphold high standards of accuracy, performance, and design.




Who you are

While we embrace diverse backgrounds and perspectives, we’re united by a shared mindset. We look for team members who live these values every day:

Take Ownership: We own the entire journey and see outcomes through from start to finish
Dig Deeper :We ask why, investigate root causes, and build solutions that last
Stronger Together :We choose collaboration, share knowledge freely, and lift each other up
Momentum Matters :We act with purpose, remove blockers, and default to action
Make a Lasting Impact :We think long-term, put people before numbers, and change the system for good




What do you get for all your hard work?

Company bonus scheme 💰
25 days holiday with an additional day off for every year of service up to 30 days and an extra day off on your birthday 🎂
Hybrid working arrangements so you can work from the office and from home with a budget to help you get set up 🏠
Generous company benefits to include pension and life assurance and an annual allowance to spend on medical insurance, health cash plan, denplan, gym memberships 🤸
Enhanced policies that are family and pet friendly, to include company sick pay and peternity leave 🐶
Great career development in a fast paced environment 🚀
Volunteer days as part of our CSR program 🤝
Regular company socials & more great perks to include weekly snacks, tuckshop, cycle to work, help to save and much more! 🍭




The typical interview process

Introductory call with our Talent Manager (phone call - 20 mins)
1st Stage: Technical interview (PowerBI exercise) with Hiring Manager and team (video call - 60 mins)
2nd Stage: Past work experience and culture interview with Hiring Manager and team (in person - 60 mins)




We’re looking for people that will get stuck in and make a difference. We have a great collaborative, entrepreneurial team and are passionate about what we do. If you want to join a team that is changing people’s lives for the better then we’d love to hear from you.

Learn more at salaryfinance.com




Salary Finance is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where all employees and applicants can flourish.




If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

Job Description



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Global Markets team, where you will play a key role in enabling data-led decision-making across a fast-paced, front-office environment. This is a highly visible role, working closely with traders and quantitative research specialists to deliver scalable data solutions and actionable insights.



You will be part of a collaborative global team, supporting a wide range of market-facing activities while helping to improve data infrastructure, performance, and innovation across the platform.



What you’ll be doing:



Partnering with traders and global markets teams to understand data needs and delivering practical solutions
Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, datasets, and analytical tools
Supporting quantitative research initiatives, including developing and applying analytical models
Identifying gaps in data infrastructure and driving improvements for reliability and scalability
Acting as the first point of contact for data and analytics issues, diagnosing and resolving problems
Collaborating with global stakeholders to support workflows across multiple regions
Enhancing data quality, governance, and accessibility across platforms
Translating complex technical outputs into clear insights for non-technical audiences

Who we’re looking for:



Strong Python experience including Pandas, NumPy or similar data analysis libraries
Advanced SQL skills with experience working across relational databases
Experience building data pipelines, working with cloud platforms, and integrating APIs
Solid understanding of data engineering principles and scalable data architecture
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage and collaborate with non-technical stakeholders
Proven problem-solving ability and experience working in a fast-paced environment
Experience within financial services or a trading environment is beneficial
Experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau and exposure to advanced analytics or machine learning is advantageous

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:



The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
Generous pension contribution
Life assurance
Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
Competitive family leave
Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience

At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.

Title: MI Analyst
Description:
Your Responsibilities

As Lockton’s continued investment in Data and MI the appetite for data is only increasing and is highly valued by senior management. As a result, we are looking to recruit the appropriate data individual to join the team.

First and foremost, the right candidate must fit in with Lockton’s culture. At Lockton we value the following principles:


Client first
Results and impact driven
Self-motivated
Continuous improvement


Role Responsibilities


Partner with business stakeholders to gather, challenge, and translate reporting and analytics requirements.
Extract, transform, analyse, and interpret data from multiple sources to support business decision-making.
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and semantic models.
Write efficient, scalable SQL queries to support reporting.
Deliver insights and recommendations that help stakeholders understand trends, performance, risks, and opportunities.
Collaborate with technical and non-technical teams to promote a data-driven culture across the organisation.


Qualifications

We are seeking a proactive and analytical individual who enjoys solving complex data challenges and turning information into valuable business insight.

Data modelling

Experience analysing large and complex datasets to identify trends and business opportunities.


Excel


Advanced Excel skills, including:
Power Query
