Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Why Bison:


Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability



Bison Transport is committed to Diversity and Inclusion in the Workplace.

Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline

Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

Description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and business-focused Senior Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our Life Insurance operations. Reporting to the Head of Lead Management, this role will be responsible for delivering insights that optimize sales performance, improve customer retention, and support new market expansion initiatives through the transfer of operational knowledge and best practices. The successful candidate will leverage analytics, automation solutions to improve business outcomes, operational efficiency, and customer experience.




Key Responsibilities




1. Sales Optimization & Growth Support (30%)

Analyze sales performance and identify opportunities to improve lead conversion, agent productivity, and overall sales effectiveness
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reporting for key sales metrics
Support forecasting, capacity planning, and sales strategy initiatives
Provide actionable insights to support the continued growth of the sales organization
Identify opportunities to automate reporting and business process




2. Care & Support Analytics (Post-Sales & Retention) (50%)

Analyze customer and policyholder behavior to identify drivers of retention, persistency, and customer satisfaction.
Monitor and report on key post-sales metrics, including retention, service levels, and customer experience.
Partner with Care & Support teams to identify operational improvement opportunities.
Support the development and measurement of customer retention initiatives.
Deliver insights that improve customer lifetime value and operational effectiveness.




3. New Market Expansion & Knowledge Transfer (20%)

Support the organization's expansion into new markets by documenting and transferring key operational, sales, lead management, and customer service learnings from existing business operations.
Partner with stakeholders to capture best practices, processes, reporting frameworks, and performance insights that can be leveraged in future markets.
Develop and maintain knowledge repositories, documentation, and reporting standards to support successful market launches.
Identify opportunities to replicate successful sales, lead management, and customer retention strategies across markets.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure operational readiness and consistency during market expansion initiatives.
Track and report on key readiness milestones and business learnings throughout implementation programs.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, Economics, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related role.
Experience in Life Insurance, Financial Services, or a regulated industry is preferred.




Technical Skills

Strong SQL skills, including Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL).
Experience using Python for data analysis, reporting, and automation.
Proficiency with Power BI and/or Tableau.
Experience with Databricks and modern analytics tools.
Working knowledge of AI/Machine Learning concepts and predictive analytics.
Experience building automated reporting, dashboards, and ETL processes.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.




Core Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Customer-focused mindset with strong business acumen.




Benefits




That's why you can expect to be rewarded for the hard work you put in through job satisfaction, career development and the fantastic range of benefits we offer:




What's in it for you?




4 weeks vacation per year
10 paid sick days per year
Hybrid role – 3 days in office and 2 days work-from-home
100% employer paid health benefits from day 1 including $500 Healthcare Spending Account
Parental leave top-up
5% RRSP matching after 3 months of service
Learning and growth opportunities
Free weekly lunches, epic social events, and more!




Apply Now!




If this role interests you, we would love to hear from you!

Title: Analyste de données / Data Analyst
Description:
***An English version will follow***




À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.




Ce que nous offrons

** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
3 semaines de vacances par année.
5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.




Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.




Responsabilités

Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.




Exigences

D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
Bilinguisme français et anglais.
Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.




La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.




--




About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.




What We Offer

** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
A MacBook computer on your first day.
3 weeks vacation.
5 personal days to use at your discretion.
A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.




About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.




Key Responsibilities

Translate a client’s overarching business objectives into requirements and then into discrete projects that aim to provide insight and/or generate eﬃciencies.
Access, understand, query, and transform data from a large variety of data sources, each with its own set of intricacies.
Design, develop, and deploy custom automated reporting solutions with the goal of providing clients with rapid, actionable insights.
Design and coordinate experimental protocols in various departments to identify strategic eﬃciencies.
Communicate insights and methodologies clearly and succinctly to both technical and lay audiences.
Special projects, and other duties as required.




Candidate Qualifications

Strong problem solving skills.
2+ years experience writing complex SQL queries to transform and extract data from relational databases or data warehouses.
Experience writing R and/or Python code aimed at manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
Understanding of statistical principles.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Fully bilingual in English and French.
Ability to coordinate across teams.




Knowledge of English is required for this position as the incumbent will be required to interact daily with a predominantly English-speaking clientele located outside of Quebec.

Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.

  • ** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **

  • A MacBook computer on your first day.

  • The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
  • A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.


About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.


Key Responsibilities

Work cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success to scope and implement trusted business metrics, proactively identify data integrity issues, and optimize operational workflows.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes to inform business priorities.
Communicate analysis results and outcomes clearly and tailor messaging based on the audience.
Help build and evolve our analytical foundation, including event instrumentation, metric frameworks, and scalable self-serve analytics tools.
Mentor other analysts and raise the bar for data storytelling, analytical rigor, and stakeholder influence across the organization.


What we look for:


Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent years of practical work experience.
5+ years of experience using SQL or similar big data querying languages.
5+ years of experience with a programming language such as Python or R.
5+ years of experience with applied statistical techniques, such as inferential methods, causal methods, A/B testing, or statistical modeling techniques.
Strong experience working with Salesforce or other CRM platforms, including modeling and analyzing customer, pipeline, and revenue data.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex findings from data and models into compelling insights for technical and non-technical audiences.


Bonus (Nice to have):


Advanced degree in applied mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, economics or a related field.
Experience working with sales organizations and familiarity with funnel and pipeline processes.
Strong mentorship and leadership skills, with a track record of elevating scientific standards and developing junior talent across teams.


Benefits & Perks:

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:


Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
A home office stipend.
401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
Paid parental leave.
A local in-person meet-up program.
Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.


(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Founded in 1953, Thomas Cavanagh Construction has continued to set the standard for quality construction and materials in Eastern Ontario. With our strategically located pits and quarries, our unmatched fleet of trucks and heavy equipment, our state-of-the-art facilities, and our dedicated employees, Thomas Cavanagh Construction has earned a reputation as one of Ottawa’s most trusted and respected contractors.




Overview:

The Data Analyst supports the Organizational Change Manager (OCM) and the broader digital transformation initiative by building reports, dashboards, and data views for business leaders and teams across Thomas Cavanagh Construction, using the Palantir Foundry ontology built and maintained by Cavtera. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role suited to someone strong in business intelligence, data querying, and communicating insights across all levels of the organization.

Requests that can be met using existing ontology objects — reports, dashboards, and data views — are handled directly by this role. Requests that require creating, modifying, or removing foundational ontology objects are routed to Cavtera for build. As the digital transformation function grows, this role offers the opportunity to take on broader reporting and analytics responsibilities over time.




Duties and Responsibilities:




Reporting & Dashboard Development

Build reports, dashboards, and data views within the Palantir Foundry ontology, using objects already created by Cavtera
Translate requests from business leaders and teams into clear, usable reports and dashboards
Maintain and update existing reports and dashboards as business needs evolve
Ensure reports and dashboards are accurate, well-organized, and easy for end users to interpret




Data Analysis & BI Support

Query and analyze data across the ontology and connected data sources to answer stakeholder questions
Identify data quality issues, gaps, or inconsistencies and flag them to Cavtera
Support ad hoc reporting and analysis requests from business leaders and operational teams
Apply BI and database best practices to keep reports and dashboards reliable and maintainable




Cross-Functional Collaboration

Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for developers, business leaders, and end users on approved reporting work, with new requests coming through the OCM
Gather and clarify reporting requirements from stakeholders at all levels of the organization
Work closely with the Cavtera team to understand ontology structure and available objects
Communicate reporting timelines, limitations, and options clearly to stakeholders




Scope Awareness & Escalation

Assess incoming requests to determine whether they can be met with existing ontology objects or require ontology changes
Route requests that would create, modify, or remove foundational ontology objects to the Change Management Priorities list for further assessment
Escalate reporting risks, data issues, or unresolved stakeholder needs to the OCM
Support the OCM in maintaining a clear view of reporting and dashboard requests across the organization




Requirements:

1-3 years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, data analysis, or database-related work
Strong working knowledge of SQL and comfort querying structured data to investigate business questions and produce reporting outputs
Experience working with relational data, databases, or business intelligence platforms
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to take an unclear business question and determine what information is needed to answer it
Clear, professional communication skills, with the ability to explain data and reporting concepts to non-technical audiences
Personable and collaborative, comfortable interacting with developers, business leaders, and employees at all levels
Comfort working with ambiguity and evolving processes
Experience in the construction industry is an asset
Exposure to Palantir Foundry, including tools such as Workshop, Quiver, or Contour, is an asset but not required; training will be provided on the job




Cavanagh Employee Benefits:

Family oriented work environment
Attractive, competitive compensation for qualified candidates
Internal growth opportunities
Training and development opportunities
Benefit, Wellness and Pension Plans




Wage Range:

The salary range for this position in Ontario at the start of employment is expected to be between $65K and $90K per year. However, the range offered is based on local job market factors and may vary further depending on factors specific to the selected job candidate, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Company: College of Massage Therapists of Ontario
Description:
WHO WE ARE

The College of Massage Therapists of Ontario (CMTO) is a progressive regulatory body dedicated to protecting the public interest by upholding the highest standards for Registered Massage Therapists (RMTs). We hold RMT’s accountable for providing safe, ethical, and high-quality Massage Therapy care to the public.




At CMTO, we are dedicated to excellence in protecting the public interest, guiding registrants, and promoting the highest possible quality of the practice of Massage Therapy.




WORKING @ CMTO

This full-time, permanent position offers a competitive annual salary, a comprehensive benefits package, RRSP matching, and a professional development fund. At CMTO, we foster a collaborative team culture and a strong commitment to our mission. Our flexible, remote-first work environment allows staff to work remotely most of the time, while our office—located centrally, steps from TTC—is available when needed.

If you are looking to build a meaningful career in a highly varied role within a non-profit, regulatory organization, we want to meet you!




ABOUT THE ROLE

CMTO is seeking a Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst to support the transformation of complex data into clear, actionable insights to drive the College forward. The BI Analyst reports to the Manager, Projects and Data Analytics, provides insights that support regulatory operations, organizational performance and strategic decision-making.




KEY DUTIES

Collect, extract, integrate and analyze data from multiple sources to identify emerging risks.
Translate complex analytical findings into meaningful insights and practical recommendations tailored to technical and non-technical audiences.
Design and create impactful visualizations, dashboards, and reports using Microsoft Power BI to clearly communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
Develop and maintain data governance standards, reports, business terminology and data dictionaries to promote consistency, accuracy and standardization.
Investigate data quality issues, identify root causes and work collaboratively with organization teams to implement corrective actions and improvements.
Partner with business leaders to define KPIs, metrics, reporting requirements and analytical priorities.
Develop and maintain datasets, semantic models, dashboards and reporting solutions leveraging CMTO's Microsoft Azure Data Lakehouse environment to support enterprise reporting, analytics and decision-making.
Perform data validation, reconciliation and quality assurance projects to ensure the integrity, usability and reliability of organizational data used for reporting and analysis.
Support adoption of Power BI and self-service through user training, documentation, coaching and reporting best practices.
Identify opportunities to automate data collection, reporting and analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Present analytical findings, trends and recommendations to senior leadership and organizational teams to support discussions and planning.




SKILLS

Advanced analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Skilled in developing dashboards, reports and data visualizations and data storytelling.
Ability to translate data into actionable business insights and present findings.
Excellent organizational and time management skills.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment;
Ability to work independently and contribute effectively within a team.
Adaptability and continuous improvement mindset.




QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or equivalent business experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence or related field.
Minimum of 5 years of professional experience with at least 3 years of specialization in business intelligence or data analytics.
Expertise in designing, developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models and performance measurement frameworks.
Experience working with enterprise data platforms including Microsoft Azure Data Lakehouse, data pipelines, semantic models and Power BI reporting environments.
Experience with ETL processes, cloud-based storage solutions, and advanced Excel.
Knowledge of Microsoft Azure Data Lakehouse architecture, data engineering concepts, cloud-based analytics platforms, and emerging AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
Proficiency in SQL and data modeling, with experience using Python or other analytical programming languages.
Familiarity with data integration tools and AI-driven analytics is an asset.




LIFE at CMTO

Compensation and Time Off

Hiring salary: $90,000 - $100,000
15 vacation days plus 4 personal days
Office closure every year from December 25 to January 1




Benefits & Support

Group benefits starting on your first day
Health Care Spending Account
Annual professional development funding
Group Retirement Savings Plan
Maternity and parental leave top-up program




Work Environment

Remote-first workplace with in-office expectations 2 times per month on average
Collaborative, collegial team culture
Office located at 175 Bloor Street East, Toronto with easy transit and parking access




INTERESTED?

All application reviews, assessments, and hiring decisions are made by people in accordance with Ontario employment and human rights laws.




CMTO is committed to equity, diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity. We welcome applicants from all communities, including people of all religions, ethnicities, and racial backgrounds; persons with disabilities; LGBTQ2S+ communities; women; Indigenous Peoples; and anyone who may contribute to the diversity of perspectives within our organization.

If you require accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, contact resumes@cmto.com.

Title: Analyst, Data valorization
Description:
Required

As a data analyst, you collect, process, analyze and use data that comes through different channels. You extract, describe, analyze and interpret the data needed to make informed business decisions. You provide guidance and support to clients for analytics solution mandates that involve using data and designing reports adapted to business needs. You use your analytical skills and extensive knowledge of your line of business to work on complex business projects and initiatives using data from different databases. You prepare recommendations, solutions and action plans based on the organization’s objectives and priorities. Your projects and initiatives require extensive knowledge of your field. You serve as a data use resource for various stakeholders. You interact with stakeholders working in other fields to understand needs, and present and explain analysis results. More specifically, you will be required to:


Analyze and identify user needs, work on mandates to collect, process and analyze data, and ensure operationalization through cross-sector coordination
Build and develop complex reports using database management systems and make recommendations to support decision-making
Identify opportunities to improve work methods and processes, and recommend improvements to data management tools
Help clients define their needs, make recommendations and provide advice for selecting, implementing and using data management tools
Do research and perform descriptive and diagnostic analyses to ensure optimal data use and make recommendations in line with business issues and needs


What we offer*


Competitive salary and annual bonus
4 weeks of flexible vacation starting in the first year
Defined benefit pension plan that provides predictable, stable income throughout retirement
Group insurance including telemedicine
Reimbursement of health and wellness expenses and telework equipment
Benefits apply based on eligibility criteria.

Bachelor's degree in a related field
A minimum of four years of relevant experience

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Requisition ID: 268731

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Purpose

The Data Analyst plays a key role in driving data-informed decision-making across Scotiabank by transforming complex data into meaningful insights that support business strategy, operational excellence, and customer outcomes. Working closely with business partners, data engineers, and analytics teams, you will leverage data to uncover opportunities, solve business challenges, and deliver actionable recommendations that create measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Insights


Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable business insights.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools.
Translate data into clear recommendations that support strategic and operational decision-making.


Stakeholder Collaboration


Partner with business leaders across areas such as Retail Banking, Wealth Management, Risk, and Finance to understand business needs and objectives.
Translate business questions into analytical solutions and data-driven recommendations.
Present findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Data Quality & Governance


Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of data used for reporting and analysis.
Support data governance initiatives and adherence to enterprise standards and best practices.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities.


Advanced Analytics & Innovation


Support predictive analytics, customer segmentation, performance measurement, and business improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with data scientists and engineers on advanced analytics and innovation projects.
Identify opportunities to automate reporting and enhance data processes.


What You'll Bring

Technical Skills


Strong SQL and data querying skills.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Advanced Excel proficiency.
Experience with Python or R is an asset.
Familiarity with cloud and data warehousing platforms such as Snowflake, Hadoop, GCP, or similar technologies.


Core Competencies


Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills.
High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Collaborative mindset with strong stakeholder relationship skills.


Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
Experience working with large datasets and relational databases.
Financial services, banking, customer analytics, or risk analytics experience is considered an asset.


Why Join Scotiabank?


Work on high-impact projects that influence strategic business decisions.
Partner with diverse teams across one of Canada's leading financial institutions.
Gain exposure to modern analytics tools, cloud technologies, and enterprise-scale data environments.
Be part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in…

The Data Analyst utilizes their quantitative analytical skills and scientific thought process to interpret and

analyze large sets of complex data, while extracting meaningful insights for Kabam. This role works

closely with our internal gaming team to optimize every facet of player retention and monetization to

ensure the continued success of our games.

This role is a full-time, on-site position based 5 days a week at our Downtown Vancouver studio.

Provide Cross-functional Support

In this role, you can expect to:


Collaborate with various teams across the organization to understand their business goals and data needs.
Improve reporting processes by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting enhancements.
Assist with larger-scale projects as required, contributing data-driven insights.


Data Exploration And Analysis


Use SQL to extract and manipulate data from various sources.
Perform hands-on exploration of data sets to answer business questions.
Utilize statistical analysis to identify trends, correlations, and patterns within the data.
Create data visualizations to communicate findings effectively.


Dashboard And Report Management


Develop and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports tailored to the needs of different teams within the organization.
Ensure that dashboards and reports are up-to-date and accurate.
Prepare ad-hoc reports as requested.


A/B Testing


Design, execute, and manage multiple A/B tests to gain insights into key performance indicators (KPIs) such as retention, acquisition, and monetization.
Analyze the results of A/B tests to draw actionable conclusions.
Make data-driven recommendations for optimizing business strategies based on results of A/B testing.


Product Feature Analysis And Optimization


Measure the success of newly released product features using key metrics and data analysis.
Drive data-driven iteration and optimization of product features to enhance performance and user experience.


Task Prioritization And Project Management


Assist in task prioritization within the data team based on business needs and project requirements.
Collaborate with team members to achieve project goals efficiently.


To Be Successful In This Role, Your Background Includes


Bachelor’s Degree in related field.
3+ years of industry data analysis experience, with solid knowledge of statistical methods.
1+ years of industry data experience in games (mobile, console, PC), online casino, slot games, or any high volume B2C mobile apps.
Expert SQL skills and experience querying very large data sets.
Proven ability to thrive using multiple mixed, varied, and inconsistent data sources.
Fundamental knowledge of project management methodologies.
Regular communication with stakeholders from other departments and drive actionable items for continuous improvement.
Experience with Google BigQuery, Tableau, JIRA and/or other project management software.
Experience working for a social or mobile game developer.
Understanding of game design concepts and principles.


Benefits

Our success is due to the hard work of our people. We share our success with our people through flexible benefits and reward programs, sweet swag, snacks, and more. Here’s a look at some of the support we provide our people:


Extended Health Coverage: effective day one, no waiting period! Our benefits cover health, dental, life, disability, and extended paramedical services such as vision care, mental health practitioners, massage, physiotherapy, acupuncture, and much more.
DEIB Benefits: DEIB is important to us and to our people - that’s why our benefits include gender-affirming care, fertility care, and other hormonal treatments and drugs.
Flexible Spending Accounts: our benefits are built on a flex credit model, so you’re able to choose the coverage levels that are right for you, and allocate the rest to a group RRSP/TFSA, Health Spending account, and/or Personal Spending Account.
RRSP Matching: everyone retires eventually, and we help our people save for their futures with a contribution matching program once you reach 90 days with us.
Commuter Benefit: we believe in the power of in-person collaboration, and want to support you in making it work for you! We provide a flexible, monthly cash allowance to help cover the costs of transit, parking, or even personal logistics like childcare and pet care.
PTO and Parental Leave: we offer paid parental leave, flexible paid time off, paid time off for volunteering, sick leave, and holiday closures.
Employee and Family Assistance Program: this program provides crisis management support, immediate mental health care, and generalized support for emotional, mental, and financial well-being.
Telus Virtual Health: we provide increased access to remote healthcare providers for prescription refills or referrals from the comfort of your home.
Learning and growth: We encourage people to grow both personally and professionally, and support this through regular lunch & learns and an education stipend.
Pay transparency: We share with employees the pay range their role falls within and clear career maps to determine how they can grow within their role or level-up to a promotion.
Cool spaces: Our offices are in Vancouver, Montreal, Los Angeles, and San Francisco. Whether it’s summers on the rooftop patio in Downtown Vancouver, or watching the fireworks in Montreal’s South Shore - we want our people to feel like their time spent in office is worthwhile!
Giving back: Kabammers have a dedicated paid day off every year to volunteer to a cause close to their hearts. Some teams even band together for group volunteer days off-site!


$73,300 - $91,600 a year

The typical hiring range listed above is specific to candidates located in Vancouver. The salary will be determined based on your knowledge, skills and competencies, and you’ll have room to grow after you join!

If you’re interested in the position but your expectations don’t fully align with the provided range, we still encourage you to apply! Considerations may be made based on your experience level.

Plaza Premium Group




Plaza Premium Group is the global leader in 360-degree airport hospitality and passenger service solutions, operating across 600 international and domestic airports in 150 countries, proudly serving 30 million passengers annually with world-class services and 1.8 million Smart Traveller members.




From award-winning lounges to premium airport services, we take pride in delivering exceptional comfort, convenience, and care to travellers. As a dynamic and fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities, a diverse and inclusive workplace, and the chance to be part of a team that’s shaping the future of travel. If you're passionate about hospitality and thrive in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment, we’d love to have you on board!




Job Scope




The Bl analystis responsible for executing businessintelligence initiatives on regionand turning data into business insights that support Region analyticsand initiatives.
The role gathers and analyses data, builds reportsand dashboards, and partners with business stakeholders to defineand track key performance indicators (KPls).
Working closely with business analystsand data engineer that optimize data accessibility and usability.
This role requires strong hands-on expertise, individual capabilities, and a collaborative approach to support data-driven decision-making at scale across the organization.




Responsabilities




Work with business stakeholders to understand objectives, requirements, and KPls.
Design and develop interactive dashboards and reports(e.g., in Power Bl) to support enterprise-wide analytics.
Perform ad hocanalysis to answerbusiness questions and identify opportunities, risks, and root causes.
Maintain and document metric definitions, data logic, and report specifications.
Monitor data quality, investigate anomalies, and collaborate with data engineering to resolve issues.
Provide insightand recommendations to business teams and leadership through clear storytelling and visualization
Contribute to following Bl best practices,standards, and governance across the organization.
Visit Overseasoffices when necessary




Requirements




Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Information Technology, Business or a related field.
2 - 4 years of proven experiences in Bl analyst role, or similar analytical related roles.
Strong SQL skills and experience workingwith relational databases/ data warehouses.
Hands on experience with at least one Bl tool (e.g., Power Bl, Tableau); Power Bl preferred
Solid understanding of data modelling concepts (star schema, fact/dimension, KPls, measures), with ability to work with large datasets
Strong analyticaland problem-solving skills and continuousself-improvement.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to translate business questions into analytical tasks and communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Proficiency in Excel; experience with Python/R is a plus.
Proactive and able to drive changes.




Why Join Us?

At Plaza Premium Group, you’ll be part of a collaborative team that values innovation, excellence, and a shared commitment to delivering exceptional experiences. This is your chance to grow your career in an environment that celebrates your contributions and empowers you to thrive.

Ready to make your next career move?

Apply today and help us shape the future of our workplace.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Title: Data Analyst

Vacancies: This posting is for (1) new role

Location: Toronto, ON (Detailed office location information can be found by visiting this link: https://cancer.ca/en/contact-us)

Work Model: Hybrid Work Model

Salary Band: 5 ($70,000 - $75,000 CAD)

HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE OF CANCER CARE IN CANADA

The Canadian Cancer Society works tirelessly to save lives, improve lives and drive collective action against cancer. Together with patients, volunteers, donors and communities across the country, we raise funds to invest in transformative cancer research, we provide a caring support system for everyone affected by cancer and we advocate to governments to create a healthier future for all. It takes a society to take on cancer – and the Canadian Cancer Society is leading the way




MAKING AN IMPACT

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Data Governance and Analytics, the Data Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining analytics solutions, reports, and dashboards that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Leverage SQL, scripting, and modern analytics platforms to extract, transform, and analyze complex datasets, delivering actionable insights and recommendations that align with business goals
Partner with business and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable, and well-governed analytics solutions
Support a culture of data-driven decision-making by applying automation, engineering best practices, and modern design patterns to improve how data is analyzed, visualized, and utilized across the organization




What You’ll Be Doing




1.Analytics & Reporting Development

Report & Dashboard Development

Design, develop, and maintain reports and dashboards using Salesforce CRM Analytics, Salesforce Reporting, and Power BI to support organization teams
Build and optimize semantic models and datasets to support business reporting and analytics needs
Optimize reporting and dashboard assets for usability, performance and accessibility

Analytics & Insights

Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities across business functions
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for business teams
Use predictive models and statistical analyses to support donor segmentation, campaign targeting, and fundraising forecasting
Leverage advanced analytics techniques including propensity scoring, trend analysis, and cohort modeling to inform business strategy

Collaboration & Engagement

Partner with cross-functional teams including business partners, data engineers, and digital teams
Provide guidance and support to business users on reporting and analytics tools




2.Data Development & Transformation

Data Preparation & Processing

Extract, transform, and prepare analytical datasets using SQL, Python and scripting languages
Build and maintain reporting datasets, dataflows, and curated data assets incorporating key metrics and business data
Utilize enterprise data platforms (e.g., Microsoft Fabric) as supporting data sources where required

Data Modeling & Documentation

Contribute to the design and optimization of data models that support reporting and analytics platforms
Develop and maintain documentation for datasets, data definitions, and analytical processes




3.Operational Excellence

Automation

Automate repetitive reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows using Python and scripting

DevOps

Utilize version control practices for analytics assets, reports, and code
Contribute to CI/CD processes for analytics solution deployment using Azure DevOps

Quality

Develop and maintain automated testing for reports, datasets, and analytics solutions
Support monitoring and validation of analytics pipelines and reporting processes
Apply development best practices including code quality, documentation, and peer review




4.Data Governance & Standards

Governance & Compliance

Apply data governance, compliance, and data quality standards when developing analytics solutions
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting outputs
Adhere to data privacy, security and compliance requirements (PII, PHI etc.)

Data Standards

About The Department

The Regional Municipality of Wood Buffalo (RMWB) is one of Canada's most unique and fast-evolving regions — a place where innovative thinking meets real-world impact. Our Planning and Development Division shapes where we live, work and play.

Planning & Development at RMWB is more than policies and plans, it’s about creating vibrant, inclusive and sustainable communities. Join a collaborative team that leads long-term strategy, supports development initiatives, and partners with residents and community partners to build our shared future.

If you're passionate about smart growth and public service, this is your opportunity to make your mark.

General Description

Under general supervision, the Data Analyst supports Planning and Development Services in all data extraction, transformation, and analysis functions for the department. The incumbent extracts, transforms, structures, and analyzes data on all Planning and Development Services key performance indicators (KPIs) and overall metrics to provide insight into permitting and licensing activities in the Municipality. This position also researches, analyzes, and reports on the Municipality's economic and demographic trends using municipal and third-party data to inform various municipal projects and statutory plans.

Responsibilities


Prepares and releases scheduled or ad-hoc reports on Planning and Development Services activities by extracting, transforming, and analyzing permit and licensing data.
Supports Planning and Development Services department with strategies and process enhancements to reduce data input errors in the Accela permitting database.
Processes and responds to internal and external stakeholder Planning and Development Services data and analysis requests.
Supports department with data extraction and transformation from the Accela permitting database.
Uses statistical and data visualization tools to implement and maintain an interactive dashboard that provides real-time information and interprets data on permitting and licensing activities in the Municipality.
Works with Planning and Development Services to support all Accela functionality improvement efforts through best practice research.
Creates documentation that allows stakeholders to understand the steps of the data analysis process.
Analyzes municipal-specific primary and secondary demographic and socio-economic data to generate insight into population trends in the Municipality.
Supports all infield data collection analysis and reporting during the Municipal census.
Other related duties as required.


Qualifications

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:


Ability to work independently or in a team and establish and maintain cooperative, collaborative, and productive work relationships.
Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources.
Exceptional research and reporting skills, with the ability to analyze information from a variety of sources and accurately present in a concise manner.
High degree of precision and accuracy in data entry, documentation, and investigative procedures.
Ability to learn, understand, and apply new technologies in data science and analytics.
Strong analytic and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in computer technology, as it relates to data science and analytics, particularly in the use of spreadsheets, databases, presentation, and data visualization tools (SQL, R, Python, Tableau, Microsoft Power BI, etc.).


Education And Experience


Degree in Geography, Economics, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, or other related field is required.
Three (3) years of experience in data analysis and research, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), or data science is required.
Experience with GIS tools such as ArcMap 10.8 or ArcGIS Pro is an asset.
Experience in policy analysis and project management is an asset.
Experience working with third-party data sources such as Statistics Canada is an asset.


Other Requirements


Submission of a Criminal Record Check.
Pre-employment testing may be required as part of the interview process.


Safety

As an employee of the Regional Municipality of Wood Buffalo, the incumbent is responsible for understanding and actively participating in the RMWB’s health and safety management system, including all policies, practices, procedures, as well as properly utilizing all control measures including the required use of personal protective equipment. All employees must take reasonable care to protect the health and safety of themselves and others, as well as immediately report any concerns, near misses, incidents, and hazardous conditions to their supervisor.

To apply: Please visit our website at jobs.rmwb.ca

Current employees must apply through the internal careers site.

We appreciate the interest of all applicants; however, only those individuals

selected for interviews will be contacted. Late applications will not be accepted.

Title: Analyste BI senior
Description:
Overview

Join the Business Systems Team and help turn complex project data into clear, useful insights. As a Senior BI Analyst, you will work with project teams, business stakeholders and technology specialists to develop and improve business intelligence solutions for the Major Projects Sector.

You do not need to have experience with every technology listed below. We are looking for someone with a solid BI foundation, strong analytical skills and an interest in learning and growing with the team.

Your role


Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into practical BI solutions.
Design data models, reports and dashboards that transform raw data into meaningful information.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, data transformation processes and reporting solutions.
Contribute to the development, enhancement and maintenance of Power BI solutions.
Support the quality, integrity and reliability of data used for reporting and analysis.
Participate in solution testing and deployment, from development through production.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, project managers and business owners.
Recommend practical improvements to existing dashboards, reporting methods and BI practices.
Help automate recurring business and reporting processes where appropriate.


About You


A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Practical experience developing business intelligence, reporting or data analytics solutions.
Experience using Power BI, including data modelling, Power Query and DAX.
The following experience would help you succeed in the role, but candidates with comparable or transferable experience are encouraged to apply:
Experience designing, developing or maintaining BI reports, data models or data warehouse solutions.
Experience working with data from multiple sources, such as databases, files, spreadsheets, SharePoint, enterprise applications or cloud platforms.
Experience supporting solutions from development through production.
Experience with one or more of the following would be an asset; expertise across the full list is not expected:
Microsoft Power Automate for workflow or business-process automation.
REST APIs and Web services, including authentication, JSON, endpoints, pagination and error handling.
Python for data preparation, automation or analytics.
Power BI Dataflows.
Microsoft SQL Server.
Microsoft Azure services such as Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage or Azure Functions.
Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.
SharePoint and enterprise application integration.
Other cloud data and analytics platforms.
Data warehouse design or advanced data integration patterns.
Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Understanding of data quality, governance, security and access-management practices.
Familiarity with ETL or data integration processes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills.
Ability to communicate in both French and English when supporting stakeholders in both languages. The specific business need for English should be validated and stated in the posting where applicable.*
Ability to understand business needs and translate them into clear technical or analytical solutions.
Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment.
The ability to explain technical topics clearly.
An interest in continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
Curiosity and a willingness to learn new tools and business domains.
A collaborative and client-focused approach.
Sound judgement and attention to detail.
A practical, solution-oriented mindset.
This position requires knowledge of a language other than French, namely English, as it involves collaboration with members of the Canadian or global leadership team located outside Québec.

Enjoy competitive compensation, employee recognition, and a brilliant range of flexible benefits you can tailor to your health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle needs.

Description:
Company: CGIC

Department: Claims

Employment Type: Regular Full-Time

Work Model: Hybrid (2 days in office)

Language: Bilingualism in English and French is an asset.

The Opportunity

We are a leading Canadian financial services co-operative committed to being a catalyst for a sustainable and resilient society and our team is essential to deliver on this strategy. That’s why we prioritize our people, to ensure we provide a strong culture and development opportunities which enables our team to thrive and to live our purpose. The best part is that you will work with people that care passionately about you, our clients and our communities.

Our Claims team aspires to create peace of mind for our clients and our communities. Our national team of knowledgeable and trusted professionals serve our clients with compassion. We are passionate about continuous improvement and operate with high-integrity, motivated by our desire to do the right thing for our clients.

As Data Analyst, you actively contribute to various initiatives by analyzing data to solve business problems and providing valuable insights. You understand the insurance business domain and ensure your own tasks contribute to meeting the business objectives by applying appropriate methods and critical thinking and performing analysis.

How You Will Create Impact


Autonomously perform descriptive and diagnostic analysis using recommended methods (ex: regression, cohort analysis, cluster analysis, A/B testing, factor analysis).
Design and develop metrics to enable descriptive analysis and diagnostic analysis.
Autonomously design proof of concept and deliver with guidance a prototype analytical solution to enable effective storytelling and descriptive/diagnostic analysis.
Work on Data querying (T-SQL, SQL, MySQL, etc.)
Extract, clean, reconcile and prepare the data required for the analysis.
Autonomously communicate findings to colleagues and your manager in an effective manner.



To Join Our Team


You have 3-5 years of relevant experience in Business Intelligence or other relevant domain.
You have a University Degree in Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent technical experience.
ACAS or FCAS designations are considered an asset.
You have experience solving standard problems by analyzing possible solutions by using our experience, judgment and precedent & challenging status quo.
You have good knowledge and understanding of data analysis, programing, modeling techniques, data warehouse and data management, research, architecture and design.
Experience with the following technologies is required: Sql, Python, R, Microsoft Fabric
Experience with the following technologies is an asset: Service now , Jira, Databricks



How You Will Succeed


You influence change and are committed to continuous improvement, in order to exceed client expectations.
You leverage critical thinking skills to identify problems and proactively propose solutions.
Your strong communication skills allow you to clearly convey messages.
You’re an effective team player who shares knowledge to support our peers.



What You Need To Know


You will be subject to a Background check as a condition of employment, in the event you are the successful candidate.



What’s in it for you?


Training and development opportunities to grow your career.
Flexible work options and paid time off to support your personal and family needs.
A holistic approach to your well-being, with physical and mental health programs and a supportive workplace culture.
Paid volunteer days to give back to your community.
In addition to our competitive salary and incentive programs, eligible employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package including group retirement savings plans, pension and benefits (e.g., health and wellness, dental, disability and life coverage), mental health support and an employee assistance program.



Salary information

Expected Salary range : CAD $60,574.00 to $100,956.00 CAD

The salary amount for the successful candidate is determined by Co-operators in its discretion and will vary depending on several criteria including but not limited to: local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualification, experience and education.

Employees may also have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and earn additional compensation tied to individual and/or business performance, or other business metrics.

Description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.




We are seeking experienced Data Analysts to support a large-scale data migration and integration initiative. You will be responsible for investigating existing data structures, analyzing business logic hidden in queries and reports, mapping source data to target systems, and collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.




This role is highly investigative and requires a blend of technical analysis and business communication skills. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented environments, reverse-engineering logic, and documenting findings clearly for both technical and business audiences.




This role follows our in‑office work model and requires employees to be onsite four days per week to support collaboration and business needs.




Key Responsibilities




Source System Analysis

Investigate source systems and databases to understand data structures, relationships, and logic.
Analyze existing SQL queries, reports, and stored procedures to reverse engineer business rules.

Data Mapping & Transformation

Map source fields to target model requirements.
Identify gaps, data quality issues, and transformation needs.
Work closely with data engineers to validate ETL/transformation rules.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with business SMEs and stakeholders to clarify definitions, logic, and requirements.
Translate technical findings into clear documentation for non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

Produce detailed data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Capture undocumented business logic and processes uncovered during investigation.

Validation & Testing Support

Support data validation and reconciliation efforts during development and UAT.
Assist in resolving discrepancies between source and target systems.




Required Skills & Experience




Strong SQL skills, with ability to read, analyze, and write complex queries.
Proven experience in data migration, data warehousing, or system integration projects.
5 years of Data Analyst experience with a strong background in analyzing large datasets.
Strong data profiling, mapping, and reconciliation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities in ambiguous environments.
Strong communication skills to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Experience with dashboard tools such as Sigma or equivalent
Experience with code repository systems – Bitbucket or Git




Nice to Have




Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries

SYSTRA Canada is an engineering and consulting firm whose primary focus is to offer transportation solutions, whether for passengers or goods: feasibility studies of building a new railway line, increasing the capacity of the existing infrastructure, privatization of a railway.

The ALTO project is a major infrastructure initiative in Canadian history, aimed at developing over 1,000 km of new passenger rail service between major urban centers, including Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal and Quebec City.

Missions/Main Duties


Manage, structure, analyze, and standardize project data to support business and user requirements.
Develop and automate data processes and optimize tools across the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem to improve efficiency and data quality.
Build and maintain dashboards, visualizations, dataflows, and semantic models in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to monitor performance and generate insights.
Work with stakeholders to define reporting needs, deliver effective solutions, and support informed decision-making.

Years of experience: 2 to 3 years of experience in a similar role.

Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Dataflow Gen2, Data Factory, and Notebooks, for data ingestion, storage, organization, transformation, and orchestration of analytics workflows.
Proficiency in Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to design, maintain, and optimize semantic models, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
Strong command of DAX and Power Query for data modeling, extraction, cleansing, transformation, and advanced analytics.
Solid understanding of data modeling, data governance, and data quality principles.
Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing, in French and English*

Analytical mindset, rigor, and autonomy

L'analyste sera également responsable de promouvoir et d'assurer l'application de bonnes pratiques en matière de gestion et d'utilisation sécuritaire des données. Le développement de relations solides, tant avec les collègues multidisciplinaires de l'équipe qu'avec les clients internes sur le terrain, demeure essentiel pour réussir dans ce rôle.

Le·la titulaire de ce poste sera, entre autres, appelé à :

  • Collecter, transformer, nettoyer et organiser les données provenant de différentes sources internes, en veillant à leur qualité et à leur cohérence;
  • Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord et rapports à l'aide d'outils de visualisation comme Power BI ou outils similaires;
  • Accompagner les équipes dans la gestion du changement lors de l'implantation de nouvelles solutions, notamment par la formation et la documentation;
  • Proposer et réaliser des analyses descriptives et exploratoires pour identifier des tendances, infos pertinentes, anomalies ou opportunités;
  • Collaborer avec l'ensemble des équipes métiers AGA (actuariat, finances, opérations, marketing, etc.) afin de comprendre leurs besoins, analyser leurs flux de travail afin de proposer des solutions et identifier des axes d'amélioration basées sur les données;
  • Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de gestion de données et de production de rapports;
  • Documenter les méthodologies, les besoins, les indicateurs de performance, les mesures, les tableaux de bord, les schémas de données, les sources de données, les processus afin d'assurer la traçabilité et la fiabilité des analyses;

  • Créer et maintenir des flux Power Automate;
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe de même nature et en relation directe avec cet emploi ou à la demande de son supérieur.

Formation et expérience

  • Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, finances, intelligence d’affaires, informatique / sciences informatiques / informatique de gestion, gestion de l'information ou Baccalauréat d’ingénieur (génie informatique / génie des technologies de l’information) et/ou d’ingénierie et analytique des données (Maîtrise est un atout);
  • 5-7 ans d’expérience en analyse de données, prévisions et création de tableaux de bord;
  • Expérience en assurances collectives est un atout.

Compétences techniques

  • Maîtrise de Power BI;
  • Maîtrise d’Excel, de la suite Office et de SQL;
  • Compétences mathématiques et/ou académiques nécessaires pour recueillir, mesurer, organiser et analyser des données et effectuer des prévisions statistiques;
  • Capacité à transformer des données brutes en informations utiles et compréhensibles;
  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, pour collaborer efficacement avec nos équipes partout au Canada;
  • Connaissance de Power Automate un atout;
  • Connaissance de Power BI Report Builder un atout;
  • Familiarité avec un langage de programmation analytique (Python ou R) un atout;
  • Connaissance de base de JIRA et de Confluence un atout.

Qualités personnelles et professionnelles

  • Esprit analytique développé et grande rigueur;
  • Forte curiosité analytique et esprit critique pour proposer des axes d’analyse innovants et des visualisations percutantes;
  • Excellent sens de l’organisation et de la gestion des priorités;
  • Aptitude à travailler en équipe et à communiquer clairement avec des interlocuteurs non techniques (vulgarisation des calculs ou des résultats);
  • Discrétion et respect de la confidentialité des données.

The Senior Data Analyst I, Product  within Mistplay's Data department will play a crucial role in enhancing Mistplay's business performance through insightful analysis and driving analytics strategy. Reporting to the Manager of Data Analytics & Experimentation, you will collaborate with Product & Lifecycle Managers to plan and analyze the results of A/B tests, and drive insights reporting in order to inform the release of new product features and engagement strategies.

Conduct proactive analysis to identify actionable insights, including diving into the core product funnel, user cohorts, and analyzing user behaviour data, in order to identify areas of the user experience that can be improved to drive new business opportunities.








Define KPIs for the company and build automated dashboards, reports, and models to enable teams at Mistplay to make better decisions.

BA/BS in Computer Science, Math, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative fields








4+ years of work experience doing quantitative analysis (preferably in the tech industry) and a proven track record of impacting a business or product decisions








Pro-level ability to synthesize and communicate complex concepts and analyses in simple, easy-to-understand ways, to a wide range of technical and non-technical audiences








Past experience in A/B testing, and a strong foundational knowledge of core inferential statistics concepts (significance, power, confidence intervals, variance, etc.)








Fluency in SQL. Experience pulling highly dimensional and complex data, as well as modeling scenarios and sensitivity analysis using Excel








Experience with Python or another programming tool for statistical modeling








Familiarity with Tableau or any BI tool 








Familiarity with cloud data technologies such as AWS, Azure, or Databricks to query and build data models and reports 








Positive attitude and a healthy dose of natural curiosity. Questions have to be answered and our data isn't just going to analyze itself. (We're working on that.)

A love of gaming and familiarity with the games industry








Understanding of data science and machine learning techniques








Experience working with very large data sets and distributed computing (Hive/Hadoop)

BA/BS en informatique, mathématiques, économie, statistiques ou autres domaines quantitatifs.








4+ ans d'expérience dans l'analyse quantitative (de préférence dans l'industrie technologique) et une expérience avérée de l'impact sur les décisions relatives à l'entreprise ou au produit.

Expérience de Python ou d'un autre outil de programmation pour la modélisation statistique

Familiarité avec les technologies de données en nuage telles que AWS, Azure ou Databricks pour interroger et construire des modèles de données et des rapports.

BA/BS in Computer Science, Math, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative fields

Positive attitude and a healthy dose of natural curiosity. Questions have to be answered and our data isn't just going to analyze itself. (We're working on that.)

A love of gaming and familiarity with the games industry








Understanding of data science and machine learning techniques








Experience working with very large data sets and distributed computing (Hive/Hadoop)
