Title: Senior Data Analyst, Ethics and Compliance
Description:
When applicable, Bombardier promotes flexible and hybrid work policies.

Why join us?

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

Bombardier’s Benefits Program

With our employees’ well-being top of mind, we offer a comprehensive and competitive Benefits Program, which includes the following:


Insurance plans (Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)
Competitive base salary
Retirement savings plan
Employee Assistance Program
Tele Health Program



What are your contributions to the team?


Develop dashboards and reporting solutions that provide clear visibility into Ethics & Compliance metrics, trends, and risks (e.g., investigations, hotline, third-party risk, training).
Integrate and analyze data across multiple Ethics & Compliance datasets, creating a unified view to support decision-making and oversight.
Perform in-depth data analysis to identify anomalies, patterns, and potential indicators of misconduct or non-compliance.
Design and optimize data pipelines, data models, and automation processes to improve scalability, timeliness, and reliability of compliance data.
Partner with cross-functional teams (including Legal, HR, Audit, Risk, IT) to understand data needs and deliver actionable insights.
Enable data-driven investigations by extracting, analyzing, and interpreting relevant data.
Lead the evolution of analytics for our Ethics and Compliance organization, including the development of predictive analytics and forward-looking risk indicators.
Support the Strategy & Governance analyst to translate complex data into clear, business-friendly insights for leadership and stakeholders.



How to thrive in this role?


You have a Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Statistics, or a related field.
You have 5–8+ years of experience in data analytics.
You have advanced technical skills in:
SQL and data querying
Data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
You have familiarity with Databricks and programming languages such as Python or R; this would be considered an asset.
You have experience working with multiple, complex datasets and integrating them into cohesive reporting solutions.

Comment vous créez un impact :


Effectuer des analyses descriptives et diagnostiques de manière autonome en utilisant les méthodes appropriées (p. ex. : analyse de régression, analyse de cohortes, analyse typologique, test A/B, analyse de facteurs).
Concevoir et développer des mesures visant à permettre l’analyse descriptive et diagnostique.
Concevoir une preuve de concept et de livrer une solution analytique prototype de manière guidée pour permettre une communication narrative efficace et une analyse descriptive ou diagnostique.
Travailler sur les requêtes de données (T-SQL, SQL, MySQL, etc.)
Extraire, nettoyer, rapprocher et préparer les données aux fins d’analyses.
Transmettre vos résultats à vos collègues et à votre gestionnaire de manière efficace et autonome.

Vous possédez de trois à cinq années d’expérience en intelligence d’affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.

Vous avez de l’expérience en résolution de problèmes standard en analysant les solutions possibles au moyen de votre expérience, de votre jugement et du statu quo précédent et complexe.

Posséder de l’expérience avec les technologies suivantes est un atout : Service now, Jira, Databricks

Vous stimulez le changement et l’amélioration continue en vue de dépasser les attentes de la clientèle.

Occasions de formation et de perfectionnement vous permettant de bâtir votre carrière.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

We are currently hiring a Data Analyst to join our Event Analysis and Insight team. Candidates must have a passion for data manipulation and visualization and the ability to think both independently and collaboratively. They will work on the analysis of post event data, reports and providing insight.

Candidates must be comfortable working within a fast-paced, and at times highly demanding environment. They must possess a keen sense of enthusiasm and attention to detail, as well as a sense of commitment and dedication to both teams.

You’ll Feel Right At Home If You


Have at least 1 year of relevant experience.
Have exceptional attention to detail and data gathering skills
Are great at finding patterns
Are great at presenting findings
Love digging through data in search of clues
Strong desire to leverage the use of AI
Are able to balance several time sensitive requests
Have effective communication skills (oral and written)
Are extremely organized
Are willing to learn and adapt to a quickly-changing environment
Have completed a Bachelor’s degree in a related field - economics, finance, commerce, Information Technology or computer science
Have a good knowledge of Python for data manipulation and visualization
Thrive in environments where multitasking is routine and can prioritize tasks effectively.
Thrive in a fast-paced working environment
Ability to work off hours when necessary


What You’ll Be Working On


Analyzing non-financial post event data in order to gain insight and discover potential issues.
Creating reports and visualizations to help bring forward relevant information to the stake holders.
Collaborating with the development team to improve and/or create the necessary analysis tools.
Creating issue tickets and following up with the appropriate teams.
Participating in the research effort revolving around the trade strategies.
Developing necessary scripts for data gathering and manipulation.


For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

Title: Analyste Power BI F/H
HTML:
Groupe international d’ingénierie, fortil repose sur un modèle indépendant et rassemble plus de 2 500 collaborateurs. Avec 30 agences réparties dans 14 pays, fortil cultive la liberté d'entreprendre et la libération des potentiels.

Contexte

Dans le cadre du soutien aux activités de gestion de projets majeurs et complexes, l’Analyste Power BI contribue à la collecte, au traitement et à la valorisation des données provenant de plusieurs systèmes d’information. Il accompagne les équipes dans la production d’indicateurs de performance, la reddition de comptes et l’amélioration continue des processus de gestion grâce à des solutions analytiques adaptées.

Responsabilités

  • Supporter les opérations liées à l’information de gestion, notamment en matière de reddition de comptes, de suivi de performance et d’analyse de données pour des projets majeurs et complexes;
  • Collecter, transformer et analyser des données issues de différents systèmes afin de produire des rapports de gestion, des tableaux de bord et des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI);
  • Concevoir, développer et maintenir des tableaux de bord interactifs sous Power BI permettant de faciliter la prise de décision;
  • Effectuer des analyses de données avancées via Excel et des outils spécialisés en intelligence d’affaires;
  • Assurer le suivi et l’analyse des coûts, des échéanciers et de la performance des projets;
  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes afin de comprendre leurs besoins en matière de reporting et proposer des solutions adaptées;
  • Identifier des opportunités d’amélioration des processus, des outils et des systèmes en place afin d’optimiser leur utilisation et renforcer les contrôles associés;
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques de gestion de données et des processus de reddition de comptes.

Profil recherché

  • Formation universitaire pertinente en intelligence d’affaires, analyse de données, administration, gestion de projets, informatique ou domaine connexe (Diplôme d’ingénieur requis) ;
  • 10 ans d’expérience dans un rôle d’analyste de données, analyste BI ou analyste en gestion de projets;
  • Solide expérience dans la création de rapports, l’analyse de données et la production de tableaux de bord décisionnels;
  • Bonne maîtrise de Power BI (modélisation de données, création de rapports, visualisations et exploitation des données);
  • Très bonne connaissance d’Excel et de la suite Microsoft Office;
  • Connaissance des principes de contrôle de coûts et de suivi budgétaire;
  • Expérience dans des environnements de gestion de projets majeurs et complexes;
  • Capacité à analyser des données complexes, synthétiser l’information et présenter des recommandations claires aux parties prenantes;
  • Autonomie, rigueur, esprit analytique et bonnes habiletés de communication.

Les raisons de nous rejoindre

Chez fortil, nous mettons en place des leviers concrets pour accompagner votre évolution et garantir un environnement de travail stimulant :

  • L’accompagnement sur la montée en compétences
  • Un écosystème pour sortir de votre zone de confort
  • La possibilité de devenir associé
  • L’engagement dans des projets associatifs
  • Une politique dédiée à la parentalité

Fortil s’engage en faveur de l’égalité des chances.

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap, sans distinction de genre, d’origine ou d’orientation sexuelle.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Mandate

Reporting to the Analytics and Business Intelligence Manager, the Data Analyst plays a central role in establishing a data driven culture across Alumni and Development (A&D). The Data Analyst works closely with the Data Analyst, Report Writer to develop data analytics, segmentations and business intelligence solutions for Alumni and Development and campus partners.

Objectives


Maintain high-quality data management by supporting complex queries and lists in Raiser’s Edge and NXT.
Support data-driven decision-making through reports, dashboards, and visualizations that enhance fundraising and alumni engagement.
Analyze and compile data for key A&D projects, including CASE, CCAE, EAI surveys, and campaign reports.
Assist in managing confidential Alumni and Development data, ensuring accuracy, security, and compliance.
Support training efforts to enhance data literacy and system adoption for A&D and external stakeholders in NXT and Power BI.


This position requires a level of education, training, and experience equivalent to a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, plus a minimum 3 years of relevant experience, preferably in an educational or non-profit setting. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Include


Demonstrated experience creating queries, lists, segmentations, and reports in fundraising or alumni engagement environments.
Expertise in retrieving, analyzing, and reporting on data from Raiser’s Edge to support decision-making.
Proficiency with Business Intelligence tools like NXT Report Builder, Tableau, and Power BI for developing dashboards and data visualizations.
Experience with large data sets, complex queries, and segmentation for direct mail, email, and event lists.
Strong knowledge of database management, including Microsoft SQL Server or Access.
Familiarity with NXT Online tools for email and event management.
Commitment to diversity and creating an inclusive work environment.
Proven ability to manage projects and deliver actionable insights within deadlines.
Ability to collaborate effectively with teams and manage independent projects.
Knowledge of data privacy regulations.
Experience applying project management best practices to deliver data solutions efficiently.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Poker
Description:
Level Up Your Career with Zynga!

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

Zynga Poker is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to help drive decisions that impact millions of players worldwide. As part of our analytics team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of our game through data-driven insights.

Here's How You'll Shape The Player Experience


Product Strategy: Analyze long and short-term trends to deliver insights that influence product direction
Experimentation: Design statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impact
Business Intelligence: Maintain comprehensive dashboards and ETL pipelines to keep the organization informed on game performance
Game Integrity: Enhance fraud detection and bad actor models to maintain a healthy gaming ecosystem


Join us if you love solving analytical puzzles that impact millions!

What You'll Do


Collaborate with the Product team to enhance revenue, retention, and engagement metrics. This includes conducting A/B testing, performing insights analysis, and developing dashboards.
Analyze player behaviour to understand motivations and preferences, partnering with game design and consumer insights teams to translate findings into actionable experience improvements.
Design and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources, ensuring source of truth for analyses and business intelligence.
Design game telemetry to capture meaningful player interaction data to improve the game experience.
Design and maintain a suite of highly visible dashboards used by game leadership and game designers to make strategic decisions for Zynga Poker
Support the economy team in tuning the different features in the game to optimize for long term game and feature health
Play a leading role in the design and continuous improvement of our fraud and bad actor models
Actively play and engage with our games to maintain first-hand understanding of player experience, game mechanics, and potential pain points.
Monitor and maintain the integrity of a wide range of tools and models used to streamline workflows and personalize the player experience, in collaboration with other data analysts and scientists on the team.
Participate in and contribute to the Analytics Org’s AI initiative, which aims to significantly increase each analyst’s impact through the power of LLMs
Continuously learn about analytics best practices, and actively share and promote these practices across various games and teams.


What You Bring


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degrees (Masters or PhD) are a plus.
Minimum of 4 years in data science or analytics roles, preferably in a Product Data Science or Gaming Analytics team
Demonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous data
Proficiency in Python and SQL.
Demonstrated experience in data mining, data visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning.
Experience/ Demonstrated interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.
Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau and version control systems such as Git is advantageous.
Strong ability in both written and oral communication.
Highly self-motivated with a keen interest in problem-solving.
Willingness to take ownership of challenges.
Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
Strong communication skills - you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus


Bonus Points


Familiarity with poker gameplay and terminology
Familiarity with social casino economies


What We Offer You

Zynga offers a world-class benefits package that helps support and balance the needs of our teams. To find out more about our benefits, visit the Zynga Benefits site

The pay range for this position in Ontario at the start of employment is expected to be between $96,400 and $135,000 per Year.

However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program. Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses. Description:
Value Proposition

As a leading partner in healthcare, Medline Canada's sole purpose is to make healthcare run better – this means being deeply committed to the health and well-being of our customers, employees, partners and our communities. We employ a diverse group of top talent focused on growing and making a difference in the lives of Canadians, coast-to-coast.

Compensation Is Only One Part Of The Employee Value Proposition That Medline Canada Offers Our Employees. As Part Of Our Mission, We Offer One Of The Most Competitive And Engaging Employee Experience Programs In Canada, Which Includes


Collaborative work environment with highly engaged employees
Market competitive compensation and benefits plan, including LTD & Insurance
RRSP with a company match
Annual Employee Appreciation Week
Paid vacation and personal days
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Resources supporting mental, physical, family and financial well-being
Career growth and training programs
Open communication with Senior Leaders
Tailored incentives for eligible employee groups, such as home office reimbursement
Employee referral program
Education support programs
Fitness subsidy
Recognition programs
Social activities
And much more…


Job Description Summary

We are seeking an Analyst, Business Intelligence to support the design, development, and maintenance of interactive dashboards and reports for Inventory Management stakeholders. This role will work closely with Inventory Management, Accounting, FP&A, and business teams to translate financial data into meaningful insights that support decision-making.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in Microsoft Power BI, solid understanding of Inventory Management processes, and the ability to transform complex datasets into intuitive visualizations.

Responsibilities

Job Description


Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports for Inventory Management processes (e.g., inventory health, stock levels, turns, aging, service levels, fill rate, OTIF, and KPI tracking).
Collaborate with Inventory Management, Demand Planning, and Purchasing stakeholders to gather business requirements and translate them into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
Build and optimize Power BI data models, measures, and relationships to support inventory visibility and decision-making.
Develop and maintain ETL processes using Power Query and related data transformation tools to integrate inventory, supply, and demand data.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across inventory reports and analytics outputs.
Manage and maintain Power BI workspaces, including access control, deployment pipelines, and governance practices.
Leverage Microsoft Fabric capabilities (e.g., dataflows, lakehouse, semantic models) to enhance data integration, scalability, and performance of inventory analytics.
Work with data from ERP systems (e.g., SAP), warehouse management systems, and other enterprise data sources.
Optimize report performance and troubleshoot issues related to data refresh, model performance, and visualization efficiency.
Document data models, report logic, KPIs, and business definitions related to inventory management.
Provide training and support to end-users on Power BI dashboards and self-service inventory analytics capabilities.
Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on inventory optimization, working capital reduction, and service level performance.
Leverage Python for advanced data analysis, automation, and data transformation (e.g., building data pipelines, performing complex calculations, and enhancing Power BI datasets through integrated workflows).


Qualifications


3–5 years of experience in BI/reporting roles, with at least 2–3 years of hands-on experience in Power BI.
Strong proficiency in:
Power BI Desktop & Service
Power Query (M language)
Data modeling concepts

Collaborative mindset with strong stakeholder relationship skills.

En près de 100 ans, nous avons réalisé de nombreuses percées dans le développement de moteurs qui assurent le transport de marchandises et de matériel, luttent contre les feux de forêt et effectuent le transport de passagers.

Un employeur de choix

Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l'un des 10 meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2025 selon Forbes, en plus d’être classée au premier rang des employeurs dans l'industrie de l'aérospatiale et de la défense au pays! Notre siège social figure sur le palmarès des meilleurs employeurs dans la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d'employeur de choix dans la région de Montréal, au Canada et dans le monde.

Nos attentes :

L’Analyste de données au département des pièces de rechange est responsable de l'automatisation et de l’optimisation de divers rapports. Il développe également des outils d’analyse pour détecter ou anticiper des enjeux. Il assume la responsabilité de plusieurs composantes d'un projet ou d'une composante complexe d'un projet plus vaste. Si vous êtes un professionnel capable de travailler de manière assez autonome et que vous avez une connaissance approfondie de la discipline et de la fonction, nous vous invitons à poser votre candidature.

Le poste est à temps plein du lundi au vendredi selon des horaires flexibles à Longueuil et s’effectue exclusivement en présentiel.

À quoi ressemblera votre travail quotidien :

  • Automatiser et améliorer les rapports existants
  • Développer avec Power BI, des outils et des rapports pour aider à la prise de décision pour l'organisation des pièces de rechange
  • Développer le processus et des méthodes pour améliorer la qualité des données (codes ELM , model family group,...)
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des modèles d’intelligence artificielle (modélisation, visualisation, …)

Ce dont vous avez besoin pour réussir :

Les incontournables :

  • Baccalauréat en ingénierie, sciences appliquées, science de la gestion;
  • 7 années d’expérience pertinente
  • Connaissance de langages de programmation (idéalement Python)
  • Connaissance d’outils de visualisation (idéalement Power BI)
  • Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais (parlé/écrit) et idéalement en français.
  • Excellente connaissance d’Excel (VBA)
  • Sens de l'organisation et capacité à travailler sous pression avec des priorités concurrentes et variables
  • Compétences en gestion des données
  • Esprit d’analyse développé (débogage)
  • Compétences en matière de gestion de projet
  • Compétences en analyste d’affaire (communication)

Ce poste s’inscrit dans un milieu de travail francophone, néanmoins il nécessite une très bonne connaissance de l’anglais pour lire et comprendre, sur une base quotidienne, de la documentation et des termes techniques qui peuvent émaner d’organisations internationales, ainsi que pour écrire et communiquer en anglais avec des clients, des fournisseurs ou des collègues internationaux.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in…

The Data Analyst utilizes their quantitative analytical skills and scientific thought process to interpret and

analyze large sets of complex data, while extracting meaningful insights for Kabam. This role works

closely with our internal gaming team to optimize every facet of player retention and monetization to

ensure the continued success of our games.

This role is a full-time, on-site position based 5 days a week at our Downtown Vancouver studio.

Provide Cross-functional Support

In this role, you can expect to:


Collaborate with various teams across the organization to understand their business goals and data needs.
Improve reporting processes by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting enhancements.
Assist with larger-scale projects as required, contributing data-driven insights.


Data Exploration And Analysis


Use SQL to extract and manipulate data from various sources.
Perform hands-on exploration of data sets to answer business questions.
Utilize statistical analysis to identify trends, correlations, and patterns within the data.
Create data visualizations to communicate findings effectively.


Dashboard And Report Management


Develop and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports tailored to the needs of different teams within the organization.
Ensure that dashboards and reports are up-to-date and accurate.
Prepare ad-hoc reports as requested.


A/B Testing


Design, execute, and manage multiple A/B tests to gain insights into key performance indicators (KPIs) such as retention, acquisition, and monetization.
Analyze the results of A/B tests to draw actionable conclusions.
Make data-driven recommendations for optimizing business strategies based on results of A/B testing.


Product Feature Analysis And Optimization


Measure the success of newly released product features using key metrics and data analysis.
Drive data-driven iteration and optimization of product features to enhance performance and user experience.


Task Prioritization And Project Management


Assist in task prioritization within the data team based on business needs and project requirements.
Collaborate with team members to achieve project goals efficiently.


To Be Successful In This Role, Your Background Includes


Bachelor’s Degree in related field.
3+ years of industry data analysis experience, with solid knowledge of statistical methods.
1+ years of industry data experience in games (mobile, console, PC), online casino, slot games, or any high volume B2C mobile apps.
Expert SQL skills and experience querying very large data sets.
Proven ability to thrive using multiple mixed, varied, and inconsistent data sources.
Fundamental knowledge of project management methodologies.
Regular communication with stakeholders from other departments and drive actionable items for continuous improvement.
Experience with Google BigQuery, Tableau, JIRA and/or other project management software.
Experience working for a social or mobile game developer.
Understanding of game design concepts and principles.


Benefits

Our success is due to the hard work of our people. We share our success with our people through flexible benefits and reward programs, sweet swag, snacks, and more. Here’s a look at some of the support we provide our people:


Extended Health Coverage: effective day one, no waiting period! Our benefits cover health, dental, life, disability, and extended paramedical services such as vision care, mental health practitioners, massage, physiotherapy, acupuncture, and much more.
DEIB Benefits: DEIB is important to us and to our people - that’s why our benefits include gender-affirming care, fertility care, and other hormonal treatments and drugs.
Flexible Spending Accounts: our benefits are built on a flex credit model, so you’re able to choose the coverage levels that are right for you, and allocate the rest to a group RRSP/TFSA, Health Spending account, and/or Personal Spending Account.
RRSP Matching: everyone retires eventually, and we help our people save for their futures with a contribution matching program once you reach 90 days with us.
Commuter Benefit: we believe in the power of in-person collaboration, and want to support you in making it work for you! We provide a flexible, monthly cash allowance to help cover the costs of transit, parking, or even personal logistics like childcare and pet care.
PTO and Parental Leave: we offer paid parental leave, flexible paid time off, paid time off for volunteering, sick leave, and holiday closures.
Employee and Family Assistance Program: this program provides crisis management support, immediate mental health care, and generalized support for emotional, mental, and financial well-being.
Telus Virtual Health: we provide increased access to remote healthcare providers for prescription refills or referrals from the comfort of your home.
Learning and growth: We encourage people to grow both personally and professionally, and support this through regular lunch & learns and an education stipend.
Pay transparency: We share with employees the pay range their role falls within and clear career maps to determine how they can grow within their role or level-up to a promotion.
Cool spaces: Our offices are in Vancouver, Montreal, Los Angeles, and San Francisco. Whether it’s summers on the rooftop patio in Downtown Vancouver, or watching the fireworks in Montreal’s South Shore - we want our people to feel like their time spent in office is worthwhile!
Giving back: Kabammers have a dedicated paid day off every year to volunteer to a cause close to their hearts. Some teams even band together for group volunteer days off-site!


$73,300 - $91,600 a year

The typical hiring range listed above is specific to candidates located in Vancouver. The salary will be determined based on your knowledge, skills and competencies, and you’ll have room to grow after you join!

If you’re interested in the position but your expectations don’t fully align with the provided range, we still encourage you to apply! Considerations may be made based on your experience level.

Title: Analyste BI senior
Description:
Overview

Join the Business Systems Team and help turn complex project data into clear, useful insights. As a Senior BI Analyst, you will work with project teams, business stakeholders and technology specialists to develop and improve business intelligence solutions for the Major Projects Sector.

You do not need to have experience with every technology listed below. We are looking for someone with a solid BI foundation, strong analytical skills and an interest in learning and growing with the team.

Your role


Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into practical BI solutions.
Design data models, reports and dashboards that transform raw data into meaningful information.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, data transformation processes and reporting solutions.
Contribute to the development, enhancement and maintenance of Power BI solutions.
Support the quality, integrity and reliability of data used for reporting and analysis.
Participate in solution testing and deployment, from development through production.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, project managers and business owners.
Recommend practical improvements to existing dashboards, reporting methods and BI practices.
Help automate recurring business and reporting processes where appropriate.


About You


A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Practical experience developing business intelligence, reporting or data analytics solutions.
Experience using Power BI, including data modelling, Power Query and DAX.
The following experience would help you succeed in the role, but candidates with comparable or transferable experience are encouraged to apply:
Experience designing, developing or maintaining BI reports, data models or data warehouse solutions.
Experience working with data from multiple sources, such as databases, files, spreadsheets, SharePoint, enterprise applications or cloud platforms.
Experience supporting solutions from development through production.
Experience with one or more of the following would be an asset; expertise across the full list is not expected:
Microsoft Power Automate for workflow or business-process automation.
REST APIs and Web services, including authentication, JSON, endpoints, pagination and error handling.
Python for data preparation, automation or analytics.
Power BI Dataflows.
Microsoft SQL Server.
Microsoft Azure services such as Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage or Azure Functions.
Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.
SharePoint and enterprise application integration.
Other cloud data and analytics platforms.
Data warehouse design or advanced data integration patterns.
Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Understanding of data quality, governance, security and access-management practices.
Familiarity with ETL or data integration processes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills.
Ability to communicate in both French and English when supporting stakeholders in both languages. The specific business need for English should be validated and stated in the posting where applicable.*
Ability to understand business needs and translate them into clear technical or analytical solutions.
Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment.
The ability to explain technical topics clearly.
An interest in continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
Curiosity and a willingness to learn new tools and business domains.
A collaborative and client-focused approach.
Sound judgement and attention to detail.
A practical, solution-oriented mindset.
This position requires knowledge of a language other than French, namely English, as it involves collaboration with members of the Canadian or global leadership team located outside Québec.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career at AtkinsRéalis in Canada.

Enjoy competitive compensation, employee recognition, and a brilliant range of flexible benefits you can tailor to your health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle needs.

Make the most of diverse opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise.

And take advantage of our hybrid working culture and generous time-off policies to balance a fulfilling career with your personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a CBRE Business Intelligence Sr. Analyst, you will be responsible for conducting advanced research, data mining,reporting and interpretation of company performance metrics.

This job is part of the Data Science & Analytics job function. They are responsible for reviewing data that supports improving effectiveness and predicting outcomes to develop business intelligence.

What You’ll Do


Generate and review reports using aggregate data from multiple sources to assist in creating a complete evaluation, improvement, or recommendation.
Review the accuracy of information provided and respond to escalated requests from management and vendors.
Understand and work with advanced scenario planning tools and models. Investigate new trends in general business conditions.
Identify opportunities for large improvements among the clients and company.
Work with personnel from other departments and information technology groups to facilitate successful project implementations.
Review the maintenance and reporting of benchmarks and performance metrics.
Act as subject matter expert for key systems and processes and day-to-day functions.
Apply general knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish assigned tasks and solve routine problems.
Have a broad knowledge of own job discipline and some knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.
Lead by example and model behaviors consistent with CBRE RISE values. May convince to reach an agreement.
Impact the quality of own work and the work of others on the team.
Work primarily within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
Explain complex information to others in straightforward situations.


What You’ll Need


Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.

About The Department

The Regional Municipality of Wood Buffalo (RMWB) is one of Canada's most unique and fast-evolving regions — a place where innovative thinking meets real-world impact. Our Planning and Development Division shapes where we live, work and play.

Planning & Development at RMWB is more than policies and plans, it’s about creating vibrant, inclusive and sustainable communities. Join a collaborative team that leads long-term strategy, supports development initiatives, and partners with residents and community partners to build our shared future.

If you're passionate about smart growth and public service, this is your opportunity to make your mark.

General Description

Under general supervision, the Data Analyst supports Planning and Development Services in all data extraction, transformation, and analysis functions for the department. The incumbent extracts, transforms, structures, and analyzes data on all Planning and Development Services key performance indicators (KPIs) and overall metrics to provide insight into permitting and licensing activities in the Municipality. This position also researches, analyzes, and reports on the Municipality's economic and demographic trends using municipal and third-party data to inform various municipal projects and statutory plans.

Responsibilities


Prepares and releases scheduled or ad-hoc reports on Planning and Development Services activities by extracting, transforming, and analyzing permit and licensing data.
Supports Planning and Development Services department with strategies and process enhancements to reduce data input errors in the Accela permitting database.
Processes and responds to internal and external stakeholder Planning and Development Services data and analysis requests.
Supports department with data extraction and transformation from the Accela permitting database.
Uses statistical and data visualization tools to implement and maintain an interactive dashboard that provides real-time information and interprets data on permitting and licensing activities in the Municipality.
Works with Planning and Development Services to support all Accela functionality improvement efforts through best practice research.
Creates documentation that allows stakeholders to understand the steps of the data analysis process.
Analyzes municipal-specific primary and secondary demographic and socio-economic data to generate insight into population trends in the Municipality.
Supports all infield data collection analysis and reporting during the Municipal census.
Other related duties as required.


Qualifications

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:


Ability to work independently or in a team and establish and maintain cooperative, collaborative, and productive work relationships.
Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources.
Exceptional research and reporting skills, with the ability to analyze information from a variety of sources and accurately present in a concise manner.
High degree of precision and accuracy in data entry, documentation, and investigative procedures.
Ability to learn, understand, and apply new technologies in data science and analytics.
Strong analytic and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in computer technology, as it relates to data science and analytics, particularly in the use of spreadsheets, databases, presentation, and data visualization tools (SQL, R, Python, Tableau, Microsoft Power BI, etc.).


Education And Experience


Degree in Geography, Economics, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, or other related field is required.
Three (3) years of experience in data analysis and research, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), or data science is required.
Experience with GIS tools such as ArcMap 10.8 or ArcGIS Pro is an asset.
Experience in policy analysis and project management is an asset.
Experience working with third-party data sources such as Statistics Canada is an asset.


Other Requirements


Submission of a Criminal Record Check.
Pre-employment testing may be required as part of the interview process.


Safety

As an employee of the Regional Municipality of Wood Buffalo, the incumbent is responsible for understanding and actively participating in the RMWB’s health and safety management system, including all policies, practices, procedures, as well as properly utilizing all control measures including the required use of personal protective equipment. All employees must take reasonable care to protect the health and safety of themselves and others, as well as immediately report any concerns, near misses, incidents, and hazardous conditions to their supervisor.

To apply: Please visit our website at jobs.rmwb.ca

Current employees must apply through the internal careers site.

We appreciate the interest of all applicants; however, only those individuals

selected for interviews will be contacted. Late applications will not be accepted.

Vacancies: This posting is for (1) new role

Location: Toronto, ON (Detailed office location information can be found by visiting this link: https://cancer.ca/en/contact-us)

Work Model: Hybrid Work Model

Salary Band: 5 ($70,000 - $75,000 CAD)

HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE OF CANCER CARE IN CANADA

The Canadian Cancer Society works tirelessly to save lives, improve lives and drive collective action against cancer. Together with patients, volunteers, donors and communities across the country, we raise funds to invest in transformative cancer research, we provide a caring support system for everyone affected by cancer and we advocate to governments to create a healthier future for all. It takes a society to take on cancer – and the Canadian Cancer Society is leading the way




MAKING AN IMPACT

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Data Governance and Analytics, the Data Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining analytics solutions, reports, and dashboards that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Leverage SQL, scripting, and modern analytics platforms to extract, transform, and analyze complex datasets, delivering actionable insights and recommendations that align with business goals
Partner with business and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable, and well-governed analytics solutions
Support a culture of data-driven decision-making by applying automation, engineering best practices, and modern design patterns to improve how data is analyzed, visualized, and utilized across the organization




What You’ll Be Doing




1.Analytics & Reporting Development

Report & Dashboard Development

Design, develop, and maintain reports and dashboards using Salesforce CRM Analytics, Salesforce Reporting, and Power BI to support organization teams
Build and optimize semantic models and datasets to support business reporting and analytics needs
Optimize reporting and dashboard assets for usability, performance and accessibility

Analytics & Insights

Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities across business functions
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for business teams
Use predictive models and statistical analyses to support donor segmentation, campaign targeting, and fundraising forecasting
Leverage advanced analytics techniques including propensity scoring, trend analysis, and cohort modeling to inform business strategy

Collaboration & Engagement

Partner with cross-functional teams including business partners, data engineers, and digital teams
Provide guidance and support to business users on reporting and analytics tools




2.Data Development & Transformation

Data Preparation & Processing

Extract, transform, and prepare analytical datasets using SQL, Python and scripting languages
Build and maintain reporting datasets, dataflows, and curated data assets incorporating key metrics and business data
Utilize enterprise data platforms (e.g., Microsoft Fabric) as supporting data sources where required

Data Modeling & Documentation

Contribute to the design and optimization of data models that support reporting and analytics platforms
Develop and maintain documentation for datasets, data definitions, and analytical processes




3.Operational Excellence

Automation

Automate repetitive reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows using Python and scripting

DevOps

Utilize version control practices for analytics assets, reports, and code
Contribute to CI/CD processes for analytics solution deployment using Azure DevOps

Quality

Develop and maintain automated testing for reports, datasets, and analytics solutions
Support monitoring and validation of analytics pipelines and reporting processes
Apply development best practices including code quality, documentation, and peer review




4.Data Governance & Standards

Governance & Compliance

Apply data governance, compliance, and data quality standards when developing analytics solutions
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting outputs
Adhere to data privacy, security and compliance requirements (PII, PHI etc.)

Data Standards

Support adherence to established data policies, standards, and best practices




5.Other

Contribute to our culture of diversity, inclusion, belonging and equity (DIBE) by ensuring that all staff feel represented, valued, and heard across all aspects of their identity, including gender, age, religion, ethnicity, nationality, race, and sexuality.
Other duties as assigned




QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related discipline
More than 3 years, up to and including 5 years - similar or related general experience in progressively more important positions




Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and analytical dataset development
Proficiency in Python and/or scripting languages for data analysis and automation
Experience designing and developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Salesforce Reporting, Salesforce CRM Analytics and Power BI
Experience building and optimizing semantic models and analytical datasets
Experience working with Fabric to build and manage data pipelines, dataflows, automated workflows, and analytics solutions.
Understanding of data modeling concepts and relational database design
Others may apply




Operational Excellence

Experience with DevOps practices including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks
Experience automating reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows
Knowledge of Agile development practices including code quality, testing, documentation, and peer review
Experience developing and maintaining automated testing for analytics solutions and reports




Analytical Skills

Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, scalable analytics solutions
Strong exploratory data analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
Ability to identify trends, patterns, and insights from large and complex datasets
Experience with predictive modeling, statistical analysis, or data-driven segmentation techniques




Communication Skills

Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to present complex data findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience collaborating across business functions to support data-driven decision-making
Bilingualism (French/English) is highly preferred , with French being an asset due to the organization’s nationwide operations and the need for effective communication across various regions




What You Can Expect From Us

CCS provides impactful opportunities to transform the lives of Canadians affected by cancer. We are devoted to creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates diverse experiences and skills, encouraging all qualified candidates to join us. Title: Data Analyst - Product & Business Analytics
Description:
-Version française à suivre-

About Stay22

Based in Montreal, Stay22 helps ambitious creators and intent-rich digital platforms turn their existing traffic into incremental revenue, with technology that works quietly in the background.

Today, more than 6,500 creators and platforms rely on Stay22, with over $1 billion in annual transactions flowing through the platform. Originally built for travel, the company now supports partners across retail, lifestyle, publishing, events, and transport as it expands its monetization infrastructure for the modern creator economy.

Position overview

Every creator and platform that works with Stay22 relies on clear, trustworthy data to understand whether their content and traffic are creating value. In this role, you will help make that picture reliable. You will join a small but high-impact Data & Analytics team and work across three squads: Hub, where partners sign up, manage their accounts and track performance; Integrations, which connects supplier and partner data; and Social, which helps creators turn social content into revenue opportunities.

This is a true analytics role, not a position limited to dashboard production. You will turn ambiguous product and business questions into analysis and recommendations, validate data quality and limitations, and help teams make better decisions. You will use SQL, Python, funnels, cohorts, experimentation and dashboards, while bringing curiosity, asking thoughtful questions and owning problems from the first question through to the next step.

Key responsibilities


Partner with Product Managers, engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to support product and business initiatives through data.
Turn unclear questions into clear hypotheses, success metrics and analysis plans.
Support product experiments and A/B tests by validating setup, defining KPIs and analyzing results.
Deliver end-to-end analysis for Hub, Social and Integrations, using funnels, cohorts, segmentation, retention and other practical methods.
Build, maintain and improve dashboards, recurring reports and trusted metrics.
Validate data quality by checking definitions, duplicates, missing events, freshness and differences between sources.
Present findings, limitations and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Help teams become more self-sufficient in using data and interpreting results through documentation, clear definitions and reusable analysis.
Partner with Data Engineering to improve data quality and analytical workflows without owning ETL architecture or infrastructure.


Requirements


At least 5 years of experience in data analytics, product analytics, business intelligence, growth analytics, strategy, insights or a related field.
Strong SQL skills and experience owning analyses from clarifying the question through validation, interpretation and recommendation.
Experience with BI or visualization tools such as Sigma, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or a comparable platform.
Practical Python experience for data cleaning, exploration, automation, prototyping or working with larger datasets.
A solid understanding of statistics, metric definition, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, experimentation and A/B testing.
Strong data-quality judgment, including the ability to identify anomalies, missing events, duplicates, inconsistent definitions and limitations across sources.
Clear communication skills and the ability to turn complex analysis into practical recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Curiosity, autonomy and comfort asking questions, working through ambiguity, adapting to changing priorities and validating AI-assisted analysis when used.


What to expect during our hiring process

We know your time is valuable, here is a quick look at the next steps:


Call with our Talent Acquisition Advisor (30 min).
Interview with the hiring manager (45 min).
Technical interview and live case with members of the Data team and a Product partner (60 min).
Final interview with our CEO (30 min).
Offer and onboarding 🎉


Note: this process may evolve based on the team's needs.

Why join Stay22?


Prime Montreal Location: Work from our vibrant Little Italy HQ with a cafeteria allowance, full gym access, and a rooftop terrace complete with a seasonal basketball/pickleball court & hockey rink.
Comprehensive Benefits: Health & dental coverage, RRSP matching, fully paid STM pass’, and regular team socials, events, and retreats.
Flexibility That Works: Flexible schedules, work-from-anywhere opportunities, year-end shutdown, and flex days.


(Stay22 is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration. If you have a disability or particular need that requires accommodation, please contact us at careers@stay22.com)

Your application will be reviewed by Nayo, our internal recruiter- even if you don’t meet every requirement but you’re excited, let’s talk.

Analyste senior, opérations de revenus et données GTM

Aperçu du poste

Chaque créateur et chaque plateforme qui travaille avec Stay22 dépend de données claires et fiables pour comprendre si son contenu et son trafic génèrent de la valeur. Dans ce rôle, tu contribueras à rendre cette lecture fiable. Tu rejoindras une équipe Data & Analytics à taille humaine et à fort impact, et tu travailleras avec trois squads : Hub, où les partenaires s’inscrivent, gèrent leur compte et suivent leur performance; Integrations, qui relie les données des fournisseurs et des partenaires; et Social, qui aide les créateurs à transformer leur contenu social en opportunités de revenus.

Il s’agit d’un véritable rôle en analytique, et non d’un poste limité à la création de tableaux de bord. Tu transformeras des questions produit et business ambiguës en analyses et recommandations, tu évalueras la qualité des données et leurs limites, et tu aideras les équipes à prendre de meilleures décisions. Tu utiliseras SQL, Python, les analyses de conversion et de cohortes, l’expérimentation et les tableaux de bord, tout en faisant preuve de curiosité, en posant de bonnes questions et en prenant en charge les problèmes de la première question jusqu’à la prochaine étape.

Principales responsabilités


Collaborer avec les gestionnaires de produit, les ingénieurs et les parties prenantes de différentes équipes pour soutenir les initiatives produit et d’affaires grâce aux données.
Transformer des questions peu précises en hypothèses claires, indicateurs de succès et plans d’analyse.
Soutenir les expérimentations produit et les tests A/B en validant leur mise en place, en définissant les KPI et en analysant les résultats.
Mener des analyses de bout en bout pour Hub, Social et Integrations, à l’aide d’entonnoirs, de cohortes, de segmentation, de rétention et d’autres méthodes pratiques.
Construire, maintenir et améliorer les tableaux de bord, les rapports récurrents et les indicateurs fiables.
Vérifier la qualité des données en contrôlant les définitions, les doublons, les événements manquants, la fraîcheur des données et les écarts entre les sources.
Présenter clairement les constats, les limites et les recommandations à des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.
Aider les équipes à devenir plus autonomes dans l’utilisation et l’interprétation des données grâce à une bonne documentation, des définitions claires et des analyses réutilisables.
Collaborer avec Data Engineering pour améliorer la qualité des données et les méthodes d’analyse, sans être responsable de l’architecture ETL ou de l’infrastructure.


Expérience recherchée


Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en analytique de données, analytique produit, intelligence d’affaires, analytique de croissance, stratégie, insights ou dans un domaine connexe.
Solide expérience en SQL et capacité à prendre en charge une analyse, de la clarification de la question jusqu’à la validation, l’interprétation et la recommandation.
Expérience avec des outils de BI ou de visualisation comme Sigma, Looker, Tableau, Power BI ou une plateforme comparable.
Expérience pratique avec Python pour nettoyer et explorer des données, automatiser des tâches, créer des prototypes ou travailler avec de grands volumes de données.
Bonne compréhension des statistiques, de la définition des métriques, de l’analyse d’entonnoirs, de l’analyse de cohortes, de l’expérimentation et des tests A/B.
Bon jugement en matière de qualité des données, notamment pour repérer les anomalies, les événements manquants, les doublons, les définitions incohérentes et les limites entre différentes sources.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication et capacité à transformer une analyse complexe en recommandations concrètes pour des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.
Curiosité, autonomie et aisance à poser des questions, à avancer dans l’ambiguïté, à s’adapter aux priorités changeantes et à valider les analyses assistées par l’IA lorsque nécessaire.


À quoi t'attendre pendant notre processus de recrutement

Nous savons que ton temps est précieux, voici un aperçu rapide des prochaines étapes :


Appel avec notre conseiller en acquisition de talents (30 min).
Entrevue avec la gestionnaire d’embauche (45 min).
Entrevue technique et étude de cas en direct avec des membres de l’équipe Data et une personne de l’équipe Produit (60 min).
Entrevue finale avec notre PDG (30 min).
Offre et intégration 🎉


Note : ce processus peut évoluer selon les besoins de l'équipe.

Pourquoi rejoindre Stay22?


Emplacement de choix à Montréal : Travaillez depuis notre dynamique siège social situé dans la Petite-Italie, avec une allocation pour la cafétéria, un accès complet au gym, ainsi qu’une terrasse sur le toit comprenant un terrain saisonnier de basketball/pickleball et une patinoire de hockey.
Une gamme complète d’avantages sociaux : Couverture santé et dentaire, contribution de l’employeur au REER, titre de transport STM entièrement payé, ainsi que des activités d’équipe, événements et retraites réguliers.
Une flexibilité adaptée à votre réalité : Horaires flexibles, possibilités de travailler de n’importe où, fermeture des bureaux en fin d’année et journées flexibles.


(Stay22 est un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées seront examinées. Si vous avez un handicap ou des besoins particuliers nécessitant des aménagements, contactez-nous à careers@stay22.com.)

Ton CV sera lu par Nayo, notre recruteur interne, même si tu ne coches pas toutes les cases, on aimerait quand même te rencontrer.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
Proficiency in SQL
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
Strong statistical knowledge
Working knowledge of Python
Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$121,100 - CA$181,700. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Title: DevOps - Data Analyst
Description:
About F12: F12 was built by uniting IT consulting firms across Canada with a shared vision: to reduce risk and complexity by crafting technology platforms that empower leaders to focus and thrive. We elevate IT conversations from ingredients to outcomes, delivering fully designed solutions with no bad options. If you’re looking for the fast lane into an IT career or want to supercharge your professional development, you’ve come to the right place. At F12, you’ll collaborate with a diverse team and gain exposure to technology services across countless businesses—building a resume rich with experience and accomplishments. Our mission is to elevate our employees by building and retaining an elite team of IT professionals equipped to deliver unmatched service to Canadian business leaders. We value humble service, continuous improvement, and hard work—and we’re looking for like-minded individuals to join us.

The Position: Support the Data Operations team by developing reporting solutions, validating data quality, documenting business definitions, and maintaining governed data products. The Data Analyst acts as a bridge between business stakeholders and the DataOps team to ensure trusted, consistent, and actionable reporting.

Responsibilities

Reporting & Analytics


Build and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards and scorecards for management and executives
Perform variance analysis between actuals, forecasts, budgets, and targets
Develop and maintain KPIs, measures, and visualizations aligned to business requirements.


Data Quality & Validation


Investigate reporting discrepancies and reconcile metrics across systems.
Support resolution of data quality issues by identifying root causes and documenting findings.
Validate reporting accuracy following deployments, system changes, or business logic updates.


Business Engagement & Requirements


Translate business questions into reporting and analytics solutions.
Partner with business teams to understand operational processes, KPIs, and reporting needs.


Governance & Documentation


Maintain KPI definitions, business glossaries, and reporting documentation.
Assist in semantic model and report certification activities.
Ensure reporting assets align with established governance standards and business definitions.


Data Product & Semantic Model Support


Support development and maintenance of reusable semantic models and views.
Support users in discovering and effectively utilizing certified reports and datasets.


Continuous Improvement


Recommend improvements to reporting, data quality, and analytics processes.
Contribute to ongoing DataOps initiatives that improve efficiency, governance, and data accessibility.


Experience


1-3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related field.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for business stakeholders.
Experience working with multiple business systems and datasets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Ability to translate business requirements into reporting and analytics solutions.


Requirements


Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, formulas, data analysis).
Power BI report development and dashboard design.
Ability to trace data lineage from source systems through transformations to reporting outputs.
Basic to intermediate DAX development.
Basic SQL querying and data validation.
Experience gathering, documenting, and validating business requirements.
Strong documentation and communication skills.
Ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications

Technical Skills


Microsoft Fabric experience (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Semantic Models, Dataflows Gen2).
Experience with HubSpot CRM.
Experience with NetSuite ERP and revenue-related datasets.
Azure DevOps or similar work management platform.
PySpark, Python, or notebook development experience.
Experience working with APIs and data integrations.
Advanced DAX development and performance optimization.
Experience supporting or developing semantic models.


Revenue Analytics & Business Performance


Experience supporting revenue operations, sales operations, or marketing analytics functions.
Understanding of recurring revenue business models.


Governance & DataOps


Experience maintaining data dictionaries, metric glossaries, or metadata repositories.
Experience supporting certification, quality assurance, or report validation processes.
Understanding of modern analytics architectures, including data warehousing, lakehouse, and medallion architecture concepts.
Working knowledge of dimensional modeling concepts including fact tables, dimensions, star schemas, and snowflake schemas.


What You Can Expect from Us: We are proud of our forward-thinking, dynamic culture that champions diversity, inclusivity, and a respectful working environment. We also want to make sure that however you get IT done in all parts of your life, we’ve got your back. Our comprehensive total rewards program includes:


Work-Life & Growth: Three weeks vacation plus extra Flex Days, leadership development opportunities, growth coaching, and reimbursements for educational advancement and certifications.
Health & Financial Well-Being: Health Spending Account or RRSP matching, extended health care, dental and vision coverage, disability and life insurance, and an employee assistance program.
Additional Perks: Tuition reimbursement, paid time off, on-site parking, high-class office amenities, and company events.


Our Equal Opportunity Commitment


F12.net practices as an equal opportunity employer in all services locations. We are committed to building and maintaining a workforce diverse in experience, skills, and knowledge. The company maintains a strict policy to ensure equal employment opportunities and do not discriminate based on any grounds and elements protected by law.
For those requiring assistance with disabilities, information relating to accommodation and accommodation measures addressed confidentially. Please notify us in advance if any accommodations required.


Please note that this position represents a true vacancy and we do not currently use artificial intelligence (AI) to at any stage of the hiring process to screen, assess or select candidates.
