Title: Analyste de données
Description:
Entreprise: CAGC

Service: Sinistres

Catégories d’emplois: Poste permanent à temps plein

Modèle de travail: Hybride (2 jours au bureau)

Langue: Le bilinguisme français et anglais est un atout.

L’opportunité :

Nous sommes une coopérative canadienne de services financiers de premier plan engagée à promouvoir activement une société durable et résiliente, et notre équipe est essentielle au succès de cette stratégie. C’est pourquoi nos gens sont notre priorité. Nous offrons une culture d’entreprise vivante et des occasions de perfectionnement qui permettent à notre équipe d’exploiter tout son potentiel et de concrétiser notre raison d’être. Et le meilleur : vous travaillerez avec des personnes qui se soucient vraiment de vous, de notre clientèle et de nos collectivités.

Nous souhaitons apporter la tranquillité d’esprit chez nos clients et dans nos collectivités. Notre équipe nationale des sinistres, caractérisée par son savoir-faire et ses professionnels de confiance, sert les clients avec compassion. Nous agissons avec la plus grande intégrité envers nos clients, animés par le désir d’intervenir de la bonne façon et de constamment nous améliorer.

En qualité d’analyste de données, vous contribuez activement à diverses initiatives en analysant des données pour résoudre les problèmes de l’entreprise et en offrant des conseils judicieux Vous comprenez le domaine de l’assurance et vous faites en sorte que vos tâches contribuent à l’atteinte des objectifs de l’entreprise en appliquant les méthodes appropriées, en faisant preuve de pensée critique et en effectuant des analyses.

Comment vous créez un impact :


Effectuer des analyses descriptives et diagnostiques de manière autonome en utilisant les méthodes appropriées (p. ex. : analyse de régression, analyse de cohortes, analyse typologique, test A/B, analyse de facteurs).
Concevoir et développer des mesures visant à permettre l’analyse descriptive et diagnostique.
Concevoir une preuve de concept et de livrer une solution analytique prototype de manière guidée pour permettre une communication narrative efficace et une analyse descriptive ou diagnostique.
Travailler sur les requêtes de données (T-SQL, SQL, MySQL, etc.)
Extraire, nettoyer, rapprocher et préparer les données aux fins d’analyses.
Transmettre vos résultats à vos collègues et à votre gestionnaire de manière efficace et autonome.


Pour joindre notre équipe :


Vous possédez de trois à cinq années d’expérience en intelligence d’affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.
Vous détenez un diplôme universitaire en intelligence d’affaires, en informatique, en actuariat, en mathématiques ou en statistique, ou une expérience technique équivalente.
Les certifications ACAS ou FCAS constituent un atout.
Vous avez de l’expérience en résolution de problèmes standard en analysant les solutions possibles au moyen de votre expérience, de votre jugement et du statu quo précédent et complexe.
Vous avez une bonne connaissance et une compréhension de l’analyse des données, de la programmation, des techniques de modélisation, des entrepôts de données, de la gestion des données, de la recherche, de l’architecture et de la conception.
Posséder de l’expérience avec les technologies suivantes est requis : Sql, Python, R, Microsoft fabric
Posséder de l’expérience avec les technologies suivantes est un atout : Service now, Jira, Databricks
La personne qui occupe ce poste travaille principalement avec des groupes non francophones et avec des équipes à l’extérieur du Québec. La maîtrise de l’anglais est donc obligatoire. Les tâches essentielles qui nécessitent la connaissance d’une autre langue que le français ne peuvent être réattribuées à d’autres membres de l’équipe. 


Comment vous brillez :


Vous stimulez le changement et l’amélioration continue en vue de dépasser les attentes de la clientèle.
Vous faites appel à votre esprit critique afin de cerner les problèmes et de proposer des solutions de façon proactive.
Vos solides compétences en communication vous permettent de transmettre clairement les messages.
Vous faites preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe et vous partagez vos connaissances afin de soutenir vos pairs.


Ce que vous devez savoir :


Si votre candidature est retenue, nous procéderons à la vérification de votre solvabilité et de vos antécédents judiciaires comme condition d’embauche.


Comment vous en bénéficiez :


Occasions de formation et de perfectionnement vous permettant de bâtir votre carrière.
Horaire de travail flexible et congés rémunérés pour subvenir à vos besoins et à ceux de votre famille.
Approche globale à l’égard de votre bien-être, programmes de santé physique et mentale et culture solidaire en milieu de travail.
Journées de bénévolat rémunérées pour redonner à votre collectivité.
En plus de nos salaires concurrentiels et de nos programmes incitatifs, les employées et employés admissibles bénéficient également d’un programme de rémunération globale complet, y compris des régimes d’épargne-retraite collectifs et une assurance collective (p. ex., assurance soins médicaux, mieux-être, soins dentaires, invalidité et vie), du soutien en santé mentale et un programme d’aide aux employés et employées.


Renseignements sur les salaires

Échelle salariale prévue de : CAD $60,574.00 to $100,956.00 CAD

Le salaire du candidat retenu sera déterminé à la discrétion de Co-operators et variera selon plusieurs critères, notamment les conditions du marché local, la situation géographique et des facteurs liés à l'emploi tels que les connaissances, les compétences, les qualifications, l'expérience et la formation.

Les employés pourront également participer à des programmes de primes et obtenir une rémunération supplémentaire liée à leur rendement individuel et/ou à celui de l'entreprise, ou à d'autres indicateurs de performance.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Mandate

Reporting to the Analytics and Business Intelligence Manager, the Data Analyst plays a central role in establishing a data driven culture across Alumni and Development (A&D). The Data Analyst works closely with the Data Analyst, Report Writer to develop data analytics, segmentations and business intelligence solutions for Alumni and Development and campus partners.

Objectives


Maintain high-quality data management by supporting complex queries and lists in Raiser’s Edge and NXT.
Support data-driven decision-making through reports, dashboards, and visualizations that enhance fundraising and alumni engagement.
Analyze and compile data for key A&D projects, including CASE, CCAE, EAI surveys, and campaign reports.
Assist in managing confidential Alumni and Development data, ensuring accuracy, security, and compliance.
Support training efforts to enhance data literacy and system adoption for A&D and external stakeholders in NXT and Power BI.


This position requires a level of education, training, and experience equivalent to a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, plus a minimum 3 years of relevant experience, preferably in an educational or non-profit setting. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Include


Demonstrated experience creating queries, lists, segmentations, and reports in fundraising or alumni engagement environments.
Expertise in retrieving, analyzing, and reporting on data from Raiser’s Edge to support decision-making.
Proficiency with Business Intelligence tools like NXT Report Builder, Tableau, and Power BI for developing dashboards and data visualizations.
Experience with large data sets, complex queries, and segmentation for direct mail, email, and event lists.
Strong knowledge of database management, including Microsoft SQL Server or Access.
Familiarity with NXT Online tools for email and event management.
Commitment to diversity and creating an inclusive work environment.
Proven ability to manage projects and deliver actionable insights within deadlines.
Ability to collaborate effectively with teams and manage independent projects.
Knowledge of data privacy regulations.
Experience applying project management best practices to deliver data solutions efficiently.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Poker
Description:
Level Up Your Career with Zynga!

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

Zynga Poker is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to help drive decisions that impact millions of players worldwide. As part of our analytics team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of our game through data-driven insights.

Here's How You'll Shape The Player Experience


Product Strategy: Analyze long and short-term trends to deliver insights that influence product direction
Experimentation: Design statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impact
Business Intelligence: Maintain comprehensive dashboards and ETL pipelines to keep the organization informed on game performance
Game Integrity: Enhance fraud detection and bad actor models to maintain a healthy gaming ecosystem


Join us if you love solving analytical puzzles that impact millions!

What You'll Do


Collaborate with the Product team to enhance revenue, retention, and engagement metrics. This includes conducting A/B testing, performing insights analysis, and developing dashboards.
Analyze player behaviour to understand motivations and preferences, partnering with game design and consumer insights teams to translate findings into actionable experience improvements.
Design and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources, ensuring source of truth for analyses and business intelligence.
Design game telemetry to capture meaningful player interaction data to improve the game experience.
Design and maintain a suite of highly visible dashboards used by game leadership and game designers to make strategic decisions for Zynga Poker
Support the economy team in tuning the different features in the game to optimize for long term game and feature health
Play a leading role in the design and continuous improvement of our fraud and bad actor models
Actively play and engage with our games to maintain first-hand understanding of player experience, game mechanics, and potential pain points.
Monitor and maintain the integrity of a wide range of tools and models used to streamline workflows and personalize the player experience, in collaboration with other data analysts and scientists on the team.
Participate in and contribute to the Analytics Org’s AI initiative, which aims to significantly increase each analyst’s impact through the power of LLMs
Continuously learn about analytics best practices, and actively share and promote these practices across various games and teams.


What You Bring


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degrees (Masters or PhD) are a plus.
Minimum of 4 years in data science or analytics roles, preferably in a Product Data Science or Gaming Analytics team
Demonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous data
Proficiency in Python and SQL.
Demonstrated experience in data mining, data visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning.
Experience/ Demonstrated interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.
Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau and version control systems such as Git is advantageous.
Strong ability in both written and oral communication.
Highly self-motivated with a keen interest in problem-solving.
Willingness to take ownership of challenges.
Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
Strong communication skills - you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus


Bonus Points


Familiarity with poker gameplay and terminology
Familiarity with social casino economies

Zynga offers a world-class benefits package that helps support and balance the needs of our teams. To find out more about our benefits, visit the Zynga Benefits site

The pay range for this position in Ontario at the start of employment is expected to be between $96,400 and $135,000 per Year.

However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program. Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Borrowell:

At Borrowell, we're on a mission to help Canadians feel confident about their money. We empower individuals to take control of their financial futures by providing the tools and insights needed to understand, build, and use their credit effectively.

1 in 10 Canadians use Borrowell for comprehensive credit monitoring and personalized insights. Our innovative services, including Credit Builder and rent reporting, help consumers build credit so they can unlock access to a wider range of financial products at more competitive rates. Additionally, we offer personalized financial product recommendations from Canada's most trusted providers based on each member's credit profile and financial goals.

Our team is diverse, inclusive, and driven by a shared passion for making a meaningful difference in the lives of Canadians. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of collaboration, humility, and innovation. If you're looking to join a company that's transforming the financial landscape and empowering Canadians to achieve their financial aspirations, we invite you to explore career opportunities at Borrowell. Together, we can help Canadians feel confident about money.

About this role:

As a Data Analyst you will be a key member of Borrowell's Data Analytics Team. Your role will be pivotal in informing new marketing and product initiatives and powering the recommendations we personalize to each of our 3+ million members.

You'll provide a window into business performance and help to make recommendations on what we build next. You can expect to be responsible for creating and managing insights, experimentations, forecasting, and reporting for various business partners at Borrowell. You'll monitor existing key performance indicators, explore new areas of data to drive business growth and product development, and make company data accessible, insightful and actionable to the different business divisions.

This role specifically focuses on being a data thought partner to a designated Product Manager and related cross-functional Product pod (in-house folks in engineering, devops, QA, mobile, and more).

Key Responsibilities


Data Modeling & Infrastructure: Build, maintain, and optimize data models daily using SQL and dbt to ensure a robust, high-quality data infrastructure
Reporting & Forecasting: Deliver business reporting, forecasting, and actionable insights to guide business decisions, leveraging Looker (or similar BI tools)
End-to-End Experimentation: Design, analyze, and validate statistical experiments to support product and business initiatives
Data Proficiency: Write clean, efficient SQL queries using joins, aggregates, subqueries, and window functions to query and structure complex datasets
Stakeholder Communication: Partner cross-functionally to translate complex analytics into clear, actionable business recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences


Requirements

Nice to Have


Undergraduate (or higher) degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Science, Eng, or Social Sciences).
Basic knowledge of Python (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib, seaborn) or R (tidyverse: dplyr, data.table, ggplot2...etc.)
Proven experience interpreting data and translating analytical results into impactful business strategies


Benefits


The Opportunity - join and have a major impact at a growing company that is helping Canadians feel confident about money
Comprehensive Health Benefits - medical, dental, vision, and paramedical health benefits for you and your family, with extra yearly coverage for psychotherapists and massage therapists
Additional Health Benefits - virtual benefit offering that allows you to connect 24/7 with nurses, doctors and mental health professionals
Maternity & Parental Leave Top-up - available to new parents
WFH Reimbursement - we ship you gear like a laptop, mouse, keyboard, and you can reimburse additional items to make your workplace better for you
Employee Development Benefit - annual reimbursements on payments to help your learning
Givewell Benefit - 1 paid volunteer day a year to give back to the community
Flexibility - flexible working hours and a flexible vacation policy


We are remote-first across Canada with an office in Toronto. This role requires you to attend in-person meetings and team-building events. While this role is remote, we are currently only able to hire candidates physically located in Ontario, BC, or Alberta.

At Borrowell, one of our core values and firm beliefs is that diversity makes us better. If you're unsure about your qualifications for this position we'd still encourage you to apply. We're looking for candidates who have experience but know that not everyone's had a chance to demonstrate what they can do. What's most important is that you have a growth mindset and care about helping people with their finances - an area in their lives that causes a lot of stress.

Please note that due to the sensitive nature of the work we do, clearing a credit and criminal record check is a condition of employment.

By submitting your application, you consent to Borrowell's use and processing of your personal information in connection with your job application at Borrowell and its recruitment processes.

Borrowell encourages applications from candidates with differing abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodation at any stage in the selection process.

This posting represents a current and active vacancy within our organization.

The budgeted annual salary range for this role is $75,000 - $125,000 CAD. Starting pay is determined by the candidate's relevant experience and skills. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for Borrowell's full benefits package.

Ability to write efficient SQL and Python queries to extract, integrate, and transform data from multiple sources, and to automate data pipelines
Proficiency in Power BI, Data Modelling, Power Query, and DAX
Experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets

Strong communication and presentation skills

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Product Analytics & Telemetry: Analyze product usage, feature adoption, and telemetry data alongside financial metrics to optimize user experience and support product strategy.

Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with cross-functional business stakeholders, managing requirements and delivering precise insights on tight turnarounds.
Mentorship: Serve as a technical guide to coach and mentor the team’s cohort of associate-level analysts.
Execution Metrics: Maintain high standards for ticket throughput, speed of delivery, and on-time completion rates for analytics tasks.


What You'll Bring


Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).
Technical Stack:
Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.

Experience with ETL processes, cloud-based storage solutions, and advanced Excel.

The College of Massage Therapists of Ontario (CMTO) is a progressive regulatory body dedicated to protecting the public interest by upholding the highest standards for Registered Massage Therapists (RMTs). We hold RMT’s accountable for providing safe, ethical, and high-quality Massage Therapy care to the public.


At CMTO, we are dedicated to excellence in protecting the public interest, guiding registrants, and promoting the highest possible quality of the practice of Massage Therapy.


WORKING @ CMTO

This full-time, permanent position offers a competitive annual salary, a comprehensive benefits package, RRSP matching, and a professional development fund. At CMTO, we foster a collaborative team culture and a strong commitment to our mission. Our flexible, remote-first work environment allows staff to work remotely most of the time, while our office—located centrally, steps from TTC—is available when needed.

If you are looking to build a meaningful career in a highly varied role within a non-profit, regulatory organization, we want to meet you!


ABOUT THE ROLE

CMTO is seeking a Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst to support the transformation of complex data into clear, actionable insights to drive the College forward. The BI Analyst reports to the Manager, Projects and Data Analytics, provides insights that support regulatory operations, organizational performance and strategic decision-making.


KEY DUTIES

  • Collect, extract, integrate and analyze data from multiple sources to identify emerging risks.
  • Translate complex analytical findings into meaningful insights and practical recommendations tailored to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Design and create impactful visualizations, dashboards, and reports using Microsoft Power BI to clearly communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain data governance standards, reports, business terminology and data dictionaries to promote consistency, accuracy and standardization.
  • Investigate data quality issues, identify root causes and work collaboratively with organization teams to implement corrective actions and improvements.
  • Partner with business leaders to define KPIs, metrics, reporting requirements and analytical priorities.
  • Develop and maintain datasets, semantic models, dashboards and reporting solutions leveraging CMTO's Microsoft Azure Data Lakehouse environment to support enterprise reporting, analytics and decision-making.
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation and quality assurance projects to ensure the integrity, usability and reliability of organizational data used for reporting and analysis.
  • Support adoption of Power BI and self-service through user training, documentation, coaching and reporting best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to automate data collection, reporting and analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Present analytical findings, trends and recommendations to senior leadership and organizational teams to support discussions and planning.


SKILLS

  • Advanced analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Skilled in developing dashboards, reports and data visualizations and data storytelling.
  • Ability to translate data into actionable business insights and present findings.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment;
  • Ability to work independently and contribute effectively within a team.
  • Adaptability and continuous improvement mindset.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or equivalent business experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence or related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience with at least 3 years of specialization in business intelligence or data analytics.
  • Expertise in designing, developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models and performance measurement frameworks.
  • Experience working with enterprise data platforms including Microsoft Azure Data Lakehouse, data pipelines, semantic models and Power BI reporting environments.
  • Experience with ETL processes, cloud-based storage solutions, and advanced Excel.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Azure Data Lakehouse architecture, data engineering concepts, cloud-based analytics platforms, and emerging AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
  • Proficiency in SQL and data modeling, with experience using Python or other analytical programming languages.
  • Familiarity with data integration tools and AI-driven analytics is an asset.


LIFE at CMTO

Compensation and Time Off

  • Hiring salary: $90,000 - $100,000
  • 15 vacation days plus 4 personal days
  • Office closure every year from December 25 to January 1


Benefits & Support

  • Group benefits starting on your first day
  • Health Care Spending Account
  • Annual professional development funding
  • Group Retirement Savings Plan
  • Maternity and parental leave top-up program


Work Environment

  • Remote-first workplace with in-office expectations 2 times per month on average
  • Collaborative, collegial team culture
  • Office located at 175 Bloor Street East, Toronto with easy transit and parking access


INTERESTED?

To be considered, apply online or via email to resumes@cmto.com on or before September 11, 2026. Please state the job posting title and your name in the subject line of the email.


Artificial intelligence is not used to screen, assess, or select applicants for this role. Recruiters may use AI‑supported tools only to help identify potential candidates on public platforms. All application reviews, assessments, and hiring decisions are made by people in accordance with Ontario employment and human rights laws.


CMTO is committed to equity, diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity. We welcome applicants from all communities, including people of all religions, ethnicities, and racial backgrounds; persons with disabilities; LGBTQ2S+ communities; women; Indigenous Peoples; and anyone who may contribute to the diversity of perspectives within our organization.


CMTO upholds the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). We work to ensure that our recruitment, assessment, and selection processes are accessible and will provide accommodations upon request. If you require accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, contact resumes@cmto.com.


We thank all applicants for their interest. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Most recruitment activities, including interviews and onboarding, may be conducted virtually.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Requisition ID: 268731

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Purpose

The Data Analyst plays a key role in driving data-informed decision-making across Scotiabank by transforming complex data into meaningful insights that support business strategy, operational excellence, and customer outcomes. Working closely with business partners, data engineers, and analytics teams, you will leverage data to uncover opportunities, solve business challenges, and deliver actionable recommendations that create measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Insights


Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable business insights.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools.
Translate data into clear recommendations that support strategic and operational decision-making.


Stakeholder Collaboration


Partner with business leaders across areas such as Retail Banking, Wealth Management, Risk, and Finance to understand business needs and objectives.
Translate business questions into analytical solutions and data-driven recommendations.
Present findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Data Quality & Governance


Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of data used for reporting and analysis.
Support data governance initiatives and adherence to enterprise standards and best practices.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities.


Advanced Analytics & Innovation


Support predictive analytics, customer segmentation, performance measurement, and business improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with data scientists and engineers on advanced analytics and innovation projects.
Identify opportunities to automate reporting and enhance data processes.


What You'll Bring

Technical Skills


Strong SQL and data querying skills.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Advanced Excel proficiency.
Experience with Python or R is an asset.
Familiarity with cloud and data warehousing platforms such as Snowflake, Hadoop, GCP, or similar technologies.


Core Competencies


Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills.
High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Collaborative mindset with strong stakeholder relationship skills.


Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
Experience working with large datasets and relational databases.
Financial services, banking, customer analytics, or risk analytics experience is considered an asset.


Why Join Scotiabank?


Work on high-impact projects that influence strategic business decisions.
Partner with diverse teams across one of Canada's leading financial institutions.
Gain exposure to modern analytics tools, cloud technologies, and enterprise-scale data environments.
Be part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Title: Data Analyst, Disability Operations
Description:
The Disability Analytics & Reporting team has an immediate opportunity for a Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. We are seeking a highly imaginative and motivated individual with a combination of analytic, programming and data visualization skills to enhance our business intelligence and analytics capabilities.

In this role, you will be tasked with using data to discover opportunities and solve business problems. You should have a passion for how data can be used to drive deep, meaningful insights that enhance the customer experience, grow our businesses, minimize risk, and engage our employees.

Position Responsibilities


Work with operational teams to develop analytic and business intelligence solutions
Create complex stored procedures to extract and transform data for use in data analysis and process automation
Become a Disability data subject matter expert
Visualize and present data for management using software tools such as Microsoft Power BI
Support ad-hoc requests for data & analysis from the business
Partner with the Advanced Analytics team of Data Scientists on various projects


What motivates you?


You obsess about customers, listen, engage and act for their benefit.
You think big, with curiosity to discover ways to use your agile approach and enable business outcomes.
You thrive in teams and enjoy getting things done together.
You take ownership and build solutions, focusing on what matters.
You do what is right, work with integrity and speak up.
You share your humanity, helping us build a diverse and inclusive work environment for everyone.


Required Qualifications


Expert database knowledge with the ability to create complex code to process and interpret large volumes of detailed data
Experience with visualization and BI tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau or QlikView
Advanced experience in SQL in using Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio 2016+
Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate)
A capacity for constant learning from both success and failure, remaining open to change and continuous improvement
Superior written and verbal communication skills, ability to explain technical concepts to management
Demonstrated ability to work with both technical and non-technical resources
Expert knowledge of MS Office Suite
Very strong problem solving, decision making, multi-tasking, prioritization, and collaboration skills
Experience with Agile/Lean Six Sigma


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in Python, Java, R, VBA, Visual Studio
Familiarity with predictive models and advanced analytics
Experience & Business knowledge in Financial Services and Group Benefits


When You Join Our Team


We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a CBRE Business Intelligence Sr. Analyst, you will be responsible for conducting advanced research, data mining,reporting and interpretation of company performance metrics.

This job is part of the Data Science & Analytics job function. They are responsible for reviewing data that supports improving effectiveness and predicting outcomes to develop business intelligence.

What You’ll Do


Generate and review reports using aggregate data from multiple sources to assist in creating a complete evaluation, improvement, or recommendation.
Review the accuracy of information provided and respond to escalated requests from management and vendors.
Understand and work with advanced scenario planning tools and models. Investigate new trends in general business conditions.
Identify opportunities for large improvements among the clients and company.
Work with personnel from other departments and information technology groups to facilitate successful project implementations.
Review the maintenance and reporting of benchmarks and performance metrics.
Act as subject matter expert for key systems and processes and day-to-day functions.
Apply general knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish assigned tasks and solve routine problems.
Have a broad knowledge of own job discipline and some knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.
Lead by example and model behaviors consistent with CBRE RISE values. May convince to reach an agreement.
Impact the quality of own work and the work of others on the team.
Work primarily within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
Explain complex information to others in straightforward situations.


What You’ll Need


Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
Understanding of existing procedures and standards to solve slightly complex problems.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.




We are seeking experienced Data Analysts to support a large-scale data migration and integration initiative. You will be responsible for investigating existing data structures, analyzing business logic hidden in queries and reports, mapping source data to target systems, and collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.




This role is highly investigative and requires a blend of technical analysis and business communication skills. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented environments, reverse-engineering logic, and documenting findings clearly for both technical and business audiences.




This role follows our in‑office work model and requires employees to be onsite four days per week to support collaboration and business needs.




Key Responsibilities




Source System Analysis

Investigate source systems and databases to understand data structures, relationships, and logic.
Analyze existing SQL queries, reports, and stored procedures to reverse engineer business rules.

Data Mapping & Transformation

Map source fields to target model requirements.
Identify gaps, data quality issues, and transformation needs.
Work closely with data engineers to validate ETL/transformation rules.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with business SMEs and stakeholders to clarify definitions, logic, and requirements.
Translate technical findings into clear documentation for non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

Produce detailed data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Capture undocumented business logic and processes uncovered during investigation.

Validation & Testing Support

Support data validation and reconciliation efforts during development and UAT.
Assist in resolving discrepancies between source and target systems.




Required Skills & Experience




Strong SQL skills, with ability to read, analyze, and write complex queries.
Proven experience in data migration, data warehousing, or system integration projects.
5 years of Data Analyst experience with a strong background in analyzing large datasets.
Strong data profiling, mapping, and reconciliation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities in ambiguous environments.
Strong communication skills to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Experience with dashboard tools such as Sigma or equivalent
Experience with code repository systems – Bitbucket or Git




Nice to Have




Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
Proficiency in SQL
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
Strong statistical knowledge
Working knowledge of Python
Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$121,100 - CA$181,700. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

L’opportunité :

Nous sommes une coopérative canadienne de services financiers de premier plan engagée à promouvoir activement une société durable et résiliente, et notre équipe est essentielle au succès de cette stratégie. C’est pourquoi nos gens sont notre priorité. Nous offrons une culture d’entreprise vivante et des occasions de perfectionnement qui permettent à notre équipe d’exploiter tout son potentiel et de concrétiser notre raison d’être. Nous souhaitons apporter la tranquillité d’esprit chez nos clients et dans nos collectivités. Notre équipe nationale des sinistres, caractérisée par son savoir-faire et ses professionnels de confiance, sert les clients avec compassion. Nous agissons avec la plus grande intégrité envers nos clients, animés par le désir d’intervenir de la bonne façon et de constamment nous améliorer.

En qualité d’analyste de données, vous contribuez activement à diverses initiatives en analysant des données pour résoudre les problèmes de l’entreprise et en offrant des conseils judicieux Vous comprenez le domaine de l’assurance et vous faites en sorte que vos tâches contribuent à l’atteinte des objectifs de l’entreprise en appliquant les méthodes appropriées, en faisant preuve de pensée critique et en effectuant des analyses.

Comment vous créez un impact :


Effectuer des analyses descriptives et diagnostiques de manière autonome en utilisant les méthodes appropriées (p. ex. : analyse de régression, analyse de cohortes, analyse typologique, test A/B, analyse de facteurs).
Concevoir et développer des mesures visant à permettre l’analyse descriptive et diagnostique.
Concevoir une preuve de concept et de livrer une solution analytique prototype de manière guidée pour permettre une communication narrative efficace et une analyse descriptive ou diagnostique.
Travailler sur les requêtes de données (T-SQL, SQL, MySQL, etc.)
Extraire, nettoyer, rapprocher et préparer les données aux fins d’analyses.
Transmettre vos résultats à vos collègues et à votre gestionnaire de manière efficace et autonome.


Pour joindre notre équipe :


Vous possédez de trois à cinq années d’expérience en intelligence d’affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.
Vous détenez un diplôme universitaire en intelligence d’affaires, en informatique, en actuariat, en mathématiques ou en statistique, ou une expérience technique équivalente.
Les certifications ACAS ou FCAS constituent un atout.
Vous avez de l’expérience en résolution de problèmes standard en analysant les solutions possibles au moyen de votre expérience, de votre jugement et du statu quo précédent et complexe.
Vous avez une bonne connaissance et une compréhension de l’analyse des données, de la programmation, des techniques de modélisation, des entrepôts de données, de la gestion des données, de la recherche, de l’architecture et de la conception.
Posséder de l’expérience avec les technologies suivantes est requis : Sql, Python, R, Microsoft fabric
Posséder de l’expérience avec les technologies suivantes est un atout : Service now, Jira, Databricks
La personne qui occupe ce poste travaille principalement avec des groupes non francophones et avec des équipes à l’extérieur du Québec. La maîtrise de l’anglais est donc obligatoire. Les tâches essentielles qui nécessitent la connaissance d’une autre langue que le français ne peuvent être réattribuées à d’autres membres de l’équipe. 


Comment vous brillez :


Vous stimulez le changement et l’amélioration continue en vue de dépasser les attentes de la clientèle.
Vous faites appel à votre esprit critique afin de cerner les problèmes et de proposer des solutions de façon proactive.
Vos solides compétences en communication vous permettent de transmettre clairement les messages.
Vous faites preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe et vous partagez vos connaissances afin de soutenir vos pairs.


Ce que vous devez savoir :


Si votre candidature est retenue, nous procéderons à la vérification de votre solvabilité et de vos antécédents judiciaires comme condition d’embauche.


Comment vous en bénéficiez :


Occasions de formation et de perfectionnement vous permettant de bâtir votre carrière.
Horaire de travail flexible et congés rémunérés pour subvenir à vos besoins et à ceux de votre famille.
Approche globale à l’égard de votre bien-être, programmes de santé physique et mentale et culture solidaire en milieu de travail.
Journées de bénévolat rémunérées pour redonner à votre collectivité.
En plus de nos salaires concurrentiels et de nos programmes incitatifs, les employées et employés admissibles bénéficient également d’un programme de rémunération globale complet, y compris des régimes d’épargne-retraite collectifs et une assurance collective (p. ex., assurance soins médicaux, mieux-être, soins dentaires, invalidité et vie), du soutien en santé mentale et un programme d’aide aux employés et employées.

Échelle salariale prévue de : CAD $60,574.00 to $100,956.00 CAD

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Poker
Description:
Level Up Your Career with Zynga!

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

Zynga Poker is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to help drive decisions that impact millions of players worldwide. As part of our analytics team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of our game through data-driven insights.

Here's How You'll Shape The Player Experience


Product Strategy: Analyze long and short-term trends to deliver insights that influence product direction
Experimentation: Design statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impact
Business Intelligence: Maintain comprehensive dashboards and ETL pipelines to keep the organization informed on game performance
Game Integrity: Enhance fraud detection and bad actor models to maintain a healthy gaming ecosystem


Join us if you love solving analytical puzzles that impact millions!

What You'll Do


Collaborate with the Product team to enhance revenue, retention, and engagement metrics. This includes conducting A/B testing, performing insights analysis, and developing dashboards.
Analyze player behaviour to understand motivations and preferences, partnering with game design and consumer insights teams to translate findings into actionable experience improvements.
Design and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources, ensuring source of truth for analyses and business intelligence.
Design game telemetry to capture meaningful player interaction data to improve the game experience.
Design and maintain a suite of highly visible dashboards used by game leadership and game designers to make strategic decisions for Zynga Poker
Support the economy team in tuning the different features in the game to optimize for long term game and feature health
Play a leading role in the design and continuous improvement of our fraud and bad actor models
Actively play and engage with our games to maintain first-hand understanding of player experience, game mechanics, and potential pain points.
Monitor and maintain the integrity of a wide range of tools and models used to streamline workflows and personalize the player experience, in collaboration with other data analysts and scientists on the team.
Participate in and contribute to the Analytics Org’s AI initiative, which aims to significantly increase each analyst’s impact through the power of LLMs
Continuously learn about analytics best practices, and actively share and promote these practices across various games and teams.


What You Bring


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degrees (Masters or PhD) are a plus.
Minimum of 4 years in data science or analytics roles, preferably in a Product Data Science or Gaming Analytics team
Demonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous data
Proficiency in Python and SQL.
Demonstrated experience in data mining, data visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning.
Experience/ Demonstrated interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.
Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau and version control systems such as Git is advantageous.
Strong ability in both written and oral communication.
Highly self-motivated with a keen interest in problem-solving.
Willingness to take ownership of challenges.
Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
Strong communication skills - you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus


Bonus Points


Familiarity with poker gameplay and terminology
Familiarity with social casino economies


What We Offer You

Zynga offers a world-class benefits package that helps support and balance the needs of our teams. To find out more about our benefits, visit the Zynga Benefits site

The pay range for this position in Ontario at the start of employment is expected to be between $96,400 and $135,000 per Year.

However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program. Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses. The use of Artificial Intelligence is not being used to screen candidates. The position is for an existing vacancy.

Please note that Zynga is unable to provide visa sponsorship or assistance for this position. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring current or future employer sponsorship.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, which means we are committed to creating and celebrating diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds throughout our organization. Employment with us is based on substantive ability, objective qualifications, and work ethic – not an individual’s race, creed, color, religion, sex or gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, status as a victim of domestic violence or sex offenses, reproductive health decision, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing the necessary support and accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities, health conditions, or impairments (subject to any local qualifying requirements) to ensure their full participation in the job application or interview process. Please contact us at accommodationrequest@zynga.com to request any accommodations or for support related to your application for an open position.

Please be aware that Zynga does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. Zynga also does not engage in any financial exchanges during the recruitment or onboarding process, and will never ask a candidate for their personal or financial information over an app or other unofficial chat channel. Any attempt to do so may be the result of a scamp or phishing attack, and you should not engage. Job Description Summary

We are seeking an Analyst, Business Intelligence to support the design, development, and maintenance of interactive dashboards and reports for Inventory Management stakeholders. This role will work closely with Inventory Management, Accounting, FP&A, and business teams to translate financial data into meaningful insights that support decision-making.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in Microsoft Power BI, solid understanding of Inventory Management processes, and the ability to transform complex datasets into intuitive visualizations.

Responsibilities

Job Description


Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports for Inventory Management processes (e.g., inventory health, stock levels, turns, aging, service levels, fill rate, OTIF, and KPI tracking).
Collaborate with Inventory Management, Demand Planning, and Purchasing stakeholders to gather business requirements and translate them into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
Build and optimize Power BI data models, measures, and relationships to support inventory visibility and decision-making.
Develop and maintain ETL processes using Power Query and related data transformation tools to integrate inventory, supply, and demand data.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across inventory reports and analytics outputs.
Manage and maintain Power BI workspaces, including access control, deployment pipelines, and governance practices.
Leverage Microsoft Fabric capabilities (e.g., dataflows, lakehouse, semantic models) to enhance data integration, scalability, and performance of inventory analytics.
Work with data from ERP systems (e.g., SAP), warehouse management systems, and other enterprise data sources.
Optimize report performance and troubleshoot issues related to data refresh, model performance, and visualization efficiency.
Document data models, report logic, KPIs, and business definitions related to inventory management.
Provide training and support to end-users on Power BI dashboards and self-service inventory analytics capabilities.
Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on inventory optimization, working capital reduction, and service level performance.
Leverage Python for advanced data analysis, automation, and data transformation (e.g., building data pipelines, performing complex calculations, and enhancing Power BI datasets through integrated workflows).


Qualifications


3–5 years of experience in BI/reporting roles, with at least 2–3 years of hands-on experience in Power BI.
Strong proficiency in:
Power BI Desktop & Service
Power Query (M language)
Data modeling concepts
Solid understanding of Inventory Management and accounting principles.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
Experience integrating data from ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.) is an asset.
Hands-on experience with Power BI Service, including workspace management and deployment pipelines.
Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric (Dataflows Gen2, Lakehouse, or related components) is an asset.
Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

The Anticipated Salary Range For This Position

$81,600.00 - $122,400.00 Annual

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

About the Canadian Bankers Association

The Canadian Bankers Association is the voice of more than 60 domestic and foreign banks that help drive Canada’s economic growth and prosperity. Job title: Analyst, Benchmarking & Data Analytics

Division: Corporate Strategy & Operations

Location: Toronto

Reports to: Director, Data Strategy, Information Management & Governance




Overview




Reporting to the Director, Data Strategy, Information Management & Governance, the Analyst is responsible for collecting, validating, and analyzing data related to the financial services industry to produce banking industry reports and benchmarking outputs. The role places a strong emphasis on interpreting industry data, identifying trends, and translating findings into meaningful insights that reflect banking sector activity and developments. The Analyst will actively engage with member banks to support accurate data submissions, clarify context, and ensure reporting remains representative of the industry. The Analyst is also expected to analyze data trends to support briefing notes, publications, and other advocacy-related materials. The role includes applying strong data governance and data quality practices, and maintaining clear documentation of data structures, definitions, and metadata to support transparency and consistency across reporting. Familiarity with business intelligence and data platforms (such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric or equivalent tools) is required to support report creation.




Description of Responsibilities




Serve as a primary resource for banking industry benchmarking reports and a secondary resource for supporting advocacy and industry-focused initiatives
Perform regular updates by working with member banks to collect, validate, and input data into banking industry databases and benchmarking reports, ensuring reporting is timely and accurate
Analyze, evaluate, validate, manipulate, and cross-reference data while applying formal data quality rules, controls, and reconciliation processes to ensure accuracy, consistency and completeness of industry reporting
Interpret financial services data to identify trends, patterns, and developments within the banking industry
Support the development of briefing notes, publications, and other advocacy‑related materials through data analysis and trend interpretation
Apply departmental procedures to ensure the confidentiality, integrity and consistency of the data collected
Co-ordinate and participate in meetings with member banks, as required, to address concerns relating to data quality
Assist with industry surveys, as required, including supporting development, data collection, and analysis of results
Provide research and analytical support to cross‑divisional teams, CBA staff, and member banks to support understanding of banking industry trends and current issues
Maintain and update data dictionaries, metadata definitions, and data catalog entries to ensure transparency, usability, and alignment across benchmarking datasets and industry report
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of data governance frameworks, including standards for data definitions, metadata management, quality controls, and documentation




Key Qualifications, Abilities and Skills




Undergraduate degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related analytical discipline, with 3–5 years of experience in data analytics and reporting, including hands-on use of BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Microsoft Fabric)
Experience applying data governance and data quality practices, including validation, reconciliation, and maintaining clear documentation of data structures, definitions, and metadata
High level of accuracy and attention to detail, with a structured approach to data validation, documentation, and reporting consistency
Exceptional numeracy, quantitative, analytical and research skills including the ability to think critically and present concise and accurate information
Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain data insights and work effectively with bank members and stakeholders
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders, as required
Experience in the financial services industry is preferred; related knowledge such as financial and accounting principles, completion of the Canadian Securities Course (CSC) and a working knowledge of French are considered beneficial

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Borrowell:

At Borrowell, we're on a mission to help Canadians feel confident about their money. We empower individuals to take control of their financial futures by providing the tools and insights needed to understand, build, and use their credit effectively.

1 in 10 Canadians use Borrowell for comprehensive credit monitoring and personalized insights. Our innovative services, including Credit Builder and rent reporting, help consumers build credit so they can unlock access to a wider range of financial products at more competitive rates. Additionally, we offer personalized financial product recommendations from Canada's most trusted providers based on each member's credit profile and financial goals.

Our team is diverse, inclusive, and driven by a shared passion for making a meaningful difference in the lives of Canadians. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of collaboration, humility, and innovation. If you're looking to join a company that's transforming the financial landscape and empowering Canadians to achieve their financial aspirations, we invite you to explore career opportunities at Borrowell. Together, we can help Canadians feel confident about money.

About this role:

As a Data Analyst you will be a key member of Borrowell's Data Analytics Team. Your role will be pivotal in informing new marketing and product initiatives and powering the recommendations we personalize to each of our 3+ million members.

You'll provide a window into business performance and help to make recommendations on what we build next. You can expect to be responsible for creating and managing insights, experimentations, forecasting, and reporting for various business partners at Borrowell. You'll monitor existing key performance indicators, explore new areas of data to drive business growth and product development, and make company data accessible, insightful and actionable to the different business divisions.

This role specifically focuses on being a data thought partner to a designated Product Manager and related cross-functional Product pod (in-house folks in engineering, devops, QA, mobile, and more).

Key Responsibilities
