Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Description:
Description

The Client Data Analyst II (analyst) position is responsible for partnering with our clients and teams to drive their initiatives with strategy, analytics and actionable insights, optimizing program measurement to drive field team success, and constantly engaging with the team to better understand where they can have the greatest impact. The analyst will leverage business and market relevant information to make data-driven decisions that allow Mosaic to achieve its sales and marketing objectives and quickly adapt tactics. The analyst will play a key role in evolving, leading, and growing the data-driven discipline within the program they support.

Responsibilities


Collect, inspect, cleanse, transform, model and diagram of complex data sets
Daily use of various business intelligence and analytical software tools
Interpret data, formulate reports, and make recommendations to the team
Lead the standardized measurement strategy for clients and team leaders
Design or collaborate on specific research methods such as questionnaires and market testing approaches (A/B testing, multi-variate, etc)
Use statistical analysis to understand the key drivers of the business and provide recommendations for optimization and go-to-market strategies
Compile data into professional reports that support both findings and recommendations quantitatively and qualitatively. Clearly articulate compelling business insights and actions with data and context
Remain fully informed on market trends, other parties’ research and implement best practices, with a willingness to evolve and grow skillset
Remain fully engaged in the program, understanding strategic vision, key performance indicators, and the day-to-day tactical activities
Regularly attend client and internal team meetings, and in-field ride alongs to stay in tune with program activities
Other assigned duties



Qualifications


Remain fully informed on latest marketing and data trends, practice, and process
3-5 years of related work experience
1-2 years of project management experience
Intermediate (advanced is ideal, not required) Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills including formulas, pivot tables, V-look-up
Intermediate statistical analysis skills
Experience with SPSS, Python, R, or other stats software
Intermediate PowerBI, Tableau, or Looker skills; other data visualization platform skills a plus
Ability to tell a relevant, powerful story with data that matters to clients
Ability to lead research activities including developing a plan, collecting data, and taking action
Ability to execute standard measurement strategies within a project
Strong analytical and critical thinking with the ability to disseminate insight from large datasets

Proven ability to timely complete projects and achieve results in an ambiguous work environment

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Citylitics Inc.

Citylitics delivers predictive intelligence on where, how, and why infrastructure investments will occur across North America.

Infrastructure includes the foundational systems that shape our quality of life: water, transportation, transit, roads and highways, broadband, and power. It represents a multi-trillion-dollar market and a 20+ year megatrend in North America.

Citylitics transforms millions of documents across more than 40,000 cities, utilities, and public agencies into real-time market signals and high-value sales intelligence. Leading infrastructure vendors, engineering firms, and construction companies use the platform to identify and pre-position for major infrastructure opportunities earlier, helping them build relationships, shape project priorities, and influence scope before projects move to formal procurement.

Citylitics combines a network of AI agents, fine-tuned models, a proprietary infrastructure signals graph, and daily human-in-the-loop quality assurance workflows to deliver highly nuanced and reliable sales intelligence. The platform integrates seamlessly with CRMs, ERPs, and data lakes, embedding actionable insights directly into sales workflows so teams can prioritize the right pursuits and build stronger pipelines.

Our mission is to improve how infrastructure investments get made so critical needs can be addressed earlier and communities benefit from stronger, more resilient infrastructure.

Join Citylitics to work in a meaningful industry that will matter for decades to come while helping grow a company at the forefront of applied AI. We operate with a Results-Driven Mentality and a commitment to Raise The Bar, in a collaborative environment where Teamwork Makes the Dream Work as we tackle big challenges and celebrate wins together.

Who Are We Looking For?

Citylitics is looking for a Data Analyst to own our Custom Solutions practice. You'll scope and deliver client-specific data requests that don't fit our standard product.

You will partner directly with Sales, Customer Success, Product and leadership to triage incoming requests, assess feasibility before anything is promised to a client, query and validate data in BigQuery, and build the one-off dashboards or reports that answer a client's actual question.

This role fits someone analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, and disciplined about scope. You size up a vague ask fast, align stakeholders when it's over-committed, and educate clients on data availability and nuances while developing solution options to discuss with them. Once you've validated an approach with the customer, you hand the engineering work to the team. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need enough confidence in SQL and data structures to know what's realistic. You're also comfortable presenting data findings and methodology directly to clients and helping them interpret what the results mean. You move quickly and decisively, without overanalyzing.

This role is based in our downtown Toronto office and requires 3+ days in-office per week.

Vacancy Status: This position is for an existing and active vacancy that Citylitics is currently seeking to fill.

What Will You Accomplish?

Triage and Scope Custom Solution Requests

You will own the front door for custom solutions requests, deciding what's worth committing to before it reaches a client.

Responsibilities include:


Field new custom-solution requests from Sales and Customer Success as they come in (Slack, demo follow-ups, live calls)
Assess feasibility and turnaround before anything is committed to a client
Align stakeholders when a request is over-scoped or under-priced
Educate clients on data availability and nuances
Develop solution options to discuss with the client before committing to delivery


Query, Validate, and Build One-Off Deliverables

You will do the actual data work behind each request, once it's been scoped.

Responsibilities include:


Query BigQuery to test and validate client-specific hypotheses
Build or update lightweight dashboards (Looker, etc) for one-off client deliverables
Disambiguate against existing coverage to avoid duplicating work


Hand Off to Engineering Once Customer Validation Is Achieved

You validate the approach with the customer before engineering builds it.

Responsibilities include:


Write up findings and requirements clients or account teams can act on directly
Hand off anything requiring pipeline or scraper-level work to engineering, with a clear spec
Surface it immediately when a client's own criteria don't hold up
Other duties as assigned


Requirements

Must-Have Experience


2+ years of experience in data analysis, solutions consulting, business analysis, or a similar role
Strong SQL fluency (BigQuery a plus), comfortable self-serve querying
Scopes an ambiguous request before diving in and defines what "done" looks like from the start
Strong written and verbal communication for client-facing summaries
Comfortable working directly with clients or internal commercial teams under a fast turnaround pace
Comfortable presenting data findings and methodology directly to clients and helping them interpret results, not just retrieving data
Moves quickly and decisively, without overanalyzing


Nice-to-Have Experience


Enough SQL/notebook fluency to spec engineering work credibly (not to build it)
Prior consulting or client-facing analyst background
Familiarity with a BI/dashboarding tool (Looker, Tableau, etc.)


Benefits

Why Citylitics?


This is a rare opportunity to influence positive change within one of the biggest societal challenges of our generation: sustainable public infrastructure
You get to support a disruptive solution with a compelling value proposition into an industry that is eager to hear from you and in a market with no direct competition
We live at the cross section of infrastructure, scaleup and data science/AI. There is no other team like us in Toronto
There is no corporate bureaucracy here. You will accomplish more here in a few months than what you would in a few years at a large, entrenched technology company
We believe that Data and AI will play an outsized role in our future, so we equip every team member with access to Generative AI tools and our full Data Universe to enhance their productivity and encourage innovation through experimentation
We are proud to offer every CityZen in-role professional growth, skill-based development & learning, and internal promotion opportunities
We work hard, we play together, we win as a team! We are on a mission to solve infrastructure while savoring the moment and celebrating the little details along the way


Citylitics is an equal opportunity employer. We are passionate about providing a safe workplace where everyone is accepted and has the opportunity to grow with us. We are committed to making diversity and inclusivity part of our culture!

Description:

Toronto

Job Title

Sr. Analyst, Loyalty Analytics

Canada Goose isn't like anything else. We've built something great, something special - an iconic lifestyle brand with an inspirational and authentic story. At the heart of it is our promise to inspire and enable all people to thrive in the world outside. To Live in the Open. At Canada Goose, you're part of a movement that belongs to something bigger. One that seeks out the restorative power of nature and is driven by a purpose to keep the planet cold and the people on it warm. We endure any condition, observe every detail, and are building a community that believes in living bravely and coming together to support game-changing people.

Here, opportunities are everywhere - to try something new, to learn, to do meaningful and impactful work, and they're yours for the taking.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior Loyalty Analytics Analyst to lead data-driven insights for our CRM & loyalty program. You will own the analytics function for loyalty, turning complex customer, transaction, and engagement data into strategic recommendations that boost retention, increase lifetime value, and maximize program ROI. This is a high-impact senior role where your expertise will directly shape loyalty strategy.

What You'll Do


Development and optimization of advanced SQL queries and data models to extract, transform, and analyze large volumes of loyalty, transactional, subscription, and behavioral data from multiple sources.
Design, build, and maintain self-served Power BI dashboards and reports using advanced DAX, star-schema modeling, and performance optimization techniques to track key loyalty metrics such as retention/churn, customer lifetime value (CLV), segment performance, redemption rates, campaign ROI, and tier effectiveness.
Conduct in-depth Ad Hoc analysis about customer segmentation, cohort evaluation, behavioral deep-dives, and program performance to identify opportunities and risks.
Support end-to-end loyalty analytics: evaluate marketing campaigns effectiveness and provide clear, actionable recommendations to the loyalty and Marketing teams.
Partner closely with Product, Finance, and Executive teams to translate insights into prioritized business strategies and roadmaps.
Present compelling, executive-ready insights and storytelling dashboards/Presentations to senior leadership.


Let's Talk About You


Advanced SQL expertise – highly proficient with complex queries (CTEs, window functions, performance tuning, and optimization) on large-scale datasets.
Expert-level Power BI proficiency is a must – strong command of DAX, data modeling, row-level security, custom visuals, and Power BI Service governance.
Previous experience with loyalty programs – proven track record analyzing loyalty initiatives (points, tiers, rewards, redemption, retention mechanics).
5+ years of hands-on analytics experience, preferably in loyalty, CRM, customer retention, or related domains.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong business acumen and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and present to executive audiences.


What’s in it For You?


A company built on Canadian roots and heritage
Your work is recognized with a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards Program
Opportunities for career growth through numerous internal and external programs
Recognize and be recognized by your peers with our Goose Rewards & ICON Rewards
Be a part of CG Gives. Donation matching and paid volunteer time to help the organizations you care about
Access to tools and resources to support physical and mental health, embracing change and connecting with colleagues
Inspiring leaders and colleagues who will lift you up and help you grow


Salary Range

$73,000.00 - $102,000.00 / year

About the salary range: We’re committed to being open and fair about pay. The range provided is intended as a guideline and does not represent a guaranteed offer. When we make an offer, we consider the responsibilities of the position, market data, and internal equity to ensure consistency across our team. Your actual offer will depend on your experience, skills, and alignment with the role.

Vacancy status: This posting represents an active vacancy for which we are currently hiring.

Capital One is more than you think. We're a data-driven tech company that just happens to do credit cards. We focus on customer-first solutions, and we're united with this common goal. Transform raw data into data structures in our data lake and Snowflake data warehouse that are leveraged for business decision making.
Create, enhance and maintain critical data pipelines and processes.
Act as a steward for our data: ensuring it is high quality, trustworthy, well documented, and easy to use.
Build, automate, and maintain critical business reporting and visualizations that helps deliver insights.
Perform investigative analysis leveraging large/diverse datasets.

Will have obtained a Bachelor’s degree or higher in 2027.

Familiarity with SQL and/or data transformation tools such as dbt.
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines.
Ability to clearly explain technical terms to a non-technical audience.


Preferred Qualifications:


Experience in a Linux environment
Experience using Python
Experience using Git or other version control systems
Experience with AWS or other cloud service providers
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Previous intern experience


Working at Capital One

Here you’ll uncover personal strengths, explore new interests and make an impact that matters. The work you’ll find here will keep you inspired and guide you in your career journey.


Take ownership of your own potential:


As you begin your career, you’ll define your own path by gaining exposure across the business, learning new skills, and having access to tools and mentorship to understand your potential.

We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.

Waterdown, Ontario

Work with senior leadership and other business leaders to identify opportunities for improvement;

Familiarity with applying AI-driven analytics tools (e.g. predictive analytics in Microsoft Fabric) an asset

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Reference no. R2867765

Position title: Data Analyst

Department: Diamond

Location: Toronto, ON

About The Job

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible? Join Sanofi in one of our corporate functions and you can play a vital part in the performance of our entire business while helping to make an impact on millions around the world.

Reporting directly to the Sales and Demand Insights Data Product Manager, the Data Analyst (L2) is responsible for managing, analyzing, and transforming commercial data into AI-ready, trusted assets that power business decisions across US Brands.

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, and AI enablement. The ideal candidate brings a strong command of data management and analytics, hands-on AI fluency, and a commitment to Sanofi's AI-Ready Data principles: Understood, Trusted, Safe, and Shared.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities

AI-ENABLED ANALYTICS AND INSIGHT GENERATION


Leverage AI and machine learning tools and techniques, including generative AI and statistical models, to identify patterns, trends, and high-leverage insights from large commercial datasets
Develop and maintain AI-ready datasets, ensuring data is structured, governed, and fit-for-purpose for use in AI and ML solutions across US Brands
Apply Sanofi's Responsible AI (RAISE) framework principles when building or consuming AI-powered analytics, ensuring transparency, fairness, and ethical use
Explore opportunities to integrate AI and ML capabilities such as predictive demand modeling, sales forecasting, and segmentation into the Sales and Demand Insights product


DATA ANALYSIS AND BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE


Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that drive commercial decisions
Leverage data and facts to challenge conventional wisdom, form evidence-based conclusions, and identify high-leverage intervention points
Identify and analyze business needs that support the product strategy, harmonizing across business areas for a unified commercial data foundation for all US Brands
Communicate solution trade-offs clearly to frame and influence project decisions


DATA ENGINEERING AND AI-READY DATA DEVELOPMENT


Design and define ingestion processes to ensure efficient data flow and integration aligned with Sanofi's Data Mesh architecture
Build and maintain data pipelines that meet Sanofi's AI-Ready Data standards: quality-scored, classified, governed, and discoverable in the Data Marketplace
Develop detailed functional specifications and test cases based on business requirements
Apply strong understanding of data warehousing concepts including design patterns and ETL and ELT load strategies


DATA QUALITY AND GOVERNANCE


Implement and monitor Data Quality rules in line with Sanofi's AI-Ready Data standards covering accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness
Ensure datasets are scored via Informatica CDGC and remediated when below defined quality thresholds
Support data classification, access policy definition, and privacy-by-design principles in compliance with Data Privacy, GxP, SOX, and cybersecurity requirements
Collaborate with Business Data Stewards and Digital roles to maintain shared data ownership and accountability


INNOVATION AND CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT


Proactively monitor industry, functional, and technology trends, particularly in AI and ML, generative AI, and commercial analytics
Identify new opportunities to leverage data and integrate internal and external sources to enhance business value
Aggregate and evaluate digital data sources including web, email, social media, and CRM to enrich commercial insights


About You

Required Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
Minimum 3 years of experience in data analysis, data manipulation, and data management
Expert proficiency in SQL and data querying
Proficiency in Python for data analysis and AI and ML workflows
Hands-on experience building or consuming AI-ready datasets and working with AI and ML platforms
Familiarity with Responsible AI principles and ethical data use including bias, fairness, and transparency
Experience with data warehousing, Snowflake, ETL and ELT pipelines, and cloud platforms
Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-moving, agile environment


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in commercial pharmaceuticals, biotech, or healthcare
Familiarity with Sanofi's AI Foundry, Data Mesh, or Informatica CDGC
Knowledge of generative AI tools and large language model-based analytics applications
Experience with digital data sources including web analytics, CRM, email, social media, and TV
Knowledge of Six Sigma and Agile practices


Tools And Technologies


Snowflake, SQL, Python, Informatica, AWS
JIRA, Confluence
Microsoft Suite including Teams, Excel, and PowerPoint
Power BI or equivalent data visualization tools


Sanofi Skills Profile - Data Analysis L2

(Aligned to Sanofi Global Jobs and Skills Official Taxonomy 2025)

Technical Skills


Structured Query Language - SQL (Experienced)
Data Visualization (Intermediate)
Applied Statistics (Experienced)
Data Modeling (Experienced)


Functional Skills


Data Analytics (Intermediate)
Data Quality (Intermediate)
Data Management (Intermediate)
Responsible AI (Intermediate)


Transversal Skills


Business Acumen (Experienced)
Communication (Experienced)
Decision Making (Intermediate)
Professional Collaboration (Experienced)


Why Choose Us?


Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

Title: Senior Analyst, Market Intelligence
Description:
As a Senior Analyst on the Market Intelligence team at Canadian Tire Corporation, you will play a critical role in shaping and executing competitive intelligence and pricing strategies across multiple banners. You will work collaboratively with cross‑functional partners to translate competitive pricing data into actionable insights that inform pricing decisions at both national and regional levels.

This role is ideal for a strong data analyst or analytics‑leaning candidate who enjoys working with complex datasets, building analytical workflows, and translating data into insights that directly inform pricing and executive decision‑making. Your insights will directly support pricing strategy, executive decision‑making, and the continued evolution of Market Intelligence as a more data‑driven, insight‑led capability.

What You'll Do


Own advanced analysis of competitive pricing data across banners, supporting national and regional initiatives, including competitive pricing behaviour, dispersion, and positioning
Design and execute structured, repeatable analytical approaches that move beyond ad‑hoc reporting to support scalable insight generation
Build and enhance analytical workflows (ex. KNIME-based workflows) to support ongoing pricing analysis, monitoring, and insight delivery, evolving processes from manual to more automated and standardized where appropriate
Translate complex competitive pricing datasets into clear, actionable insights that inform pricing strategy, regional decisions, and leadership discussions
Support the readiness, structure, and usability of competitive pricing data to ensure it is fit for downstream analytics, reporting, and decision‑making
Design, build, and maintain standardized reports and interactive dashboards (ex. Power BI) to monitor competitive pricing, trends, and performance across initiatives
Develop reporting that clearly communicates insights, key drivers, and exceptions to cross‑functional teams and leadership
Ensure all reporting and insights are delivered with appropriate context, assumptions, definitions, and implications to support informed decision‑making
Support executive‑level materials by embedding analytical depth, clear visuals, and concise narratives into competitive pricing updates and presentations
Collaborate closely with Pricing Strategy, Regional Pricing, and Merchandising teams to support and expand Market Intelligence initiatives
Partner with stakeholders to understand analytical needs and translate business questions into well‑structured, actionable analyses
Act as a senior contributor to ensuring competitive data accuracy, consistency, and analytical integrity.
Partner closely with internal teams and external vendor to investigate data issues, define business logic, and resolve data quality challenges.
Proactively identify data gaps or risks and recommend improvements to strengthen analysis and outputs.


What You Bring


3+ years of experience in analytics, pricing, market intelligence, business intelligence, or a related analytical role, preferably within retail, pricing, or a data‑driven business environment
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative or analytical discipline
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) also data analytics and BI tools such as Power BI, ThoughtSpot, and/or SQL, with experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at various levels within the organization and externally with dealers.
Demonstrated leadership skills to provide thought leadership, influence stakeholders, cultivate relationships with key stakeholders of varied levels, representing a broad range of functions.
Experience using KNIME is an asset.
Ability to work independently and take initiative in a fast-paced business environment with rapidly changing priorities
Highly organized and detail-oriented; able to manage multiple projects and deadlines effectively.


We’re always looking for great talent! In addition to competitive pay, we offer:


Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs
Performance incentives, Continuing Education Programs
Other perks to support your well-being
Career growth opportunities and product discounts


Broadband Salary Range: $64,000 – 106,000.

Our typical hiring range is between $64,000 and $75,000. Salary decisions are also dependent on other factors such as your experience, industry benchmarks, internal equity and other role-specific requirements. For critical roles, the compensation offering will be reviewed to ensure alignment with market rate and conditions and the unique value you bring to the role.

This posting represents an existing vacancy within our organization.

We may use artificial intelligence tools as part of our recruitment process to assist in the initial screening of resumes. All hiring decisions, including candidate evaluation, selection, and disposition, are made by human recruiters.

About Us

Canadian Tire Corporation, Limited (“CTC”) is one of Canada’s most admired and trusted companies. With more than 90 Owned Brands, over 1,600 retail locations, financial services, exemplary e-commerce capabilities, and exciting market-leading merchandising strategies. We dream big and work as one to innovate with purpose for our customers at every level of our business, investing in new technologies and products, and doubling down on top talent to drive the company forward. We offer competitive salaries and wages to CTC employees, as well as store discounts, supported learning through our Triangle Learning Academy, Canadian Tire Profit Sharing, and retirement and savings programs for eligible employees. As part of our enhanced flex benefits program, we offer mental health benefits in the amount of $5,000 per year for benefits-eligible employees and their families, including total well-being, and mental health tools and resources for all employees. Join us in helping to make life in Canada better through living and working our Core Values: we are innovators and entrepreneurs at our core, outcomes drive us, inclusion is a must, we are stronger together and we take personal responsibility. It is an especially exciting time to join CTC and its family of companies where career opportunities are wide-ranging! Join us, where there's a place for you here.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging

We are committed to fostering an environment where belonging thrives, and diversity, inclusion and equity are infused into everything we do. We believe in building an organizational culture where people are consistently treated with dignity while respecting individual religion, nationality, gender, race, age, perceived ability, spoken language, sexual orientation, and identification. We are united in our purpose of being here to help make life in Canada better.

Accommodations

We stand firm in our Core Value that inclusion is a must. We welcome and encourage candidates from equity-seeking groups such as people who identify as racialized, Indigenous, 2SLGBTQIA+, women, people with disabilities, and beyond. Should you require any accommodation in applying for this role, or throughout the interview process, please make them known when contacted and we will work with you to help meet your needs.

Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics***Analyste de données, Analytique RH
Description:
IPEX is one of North America’s leading providers of advanced plastic piping systems. Our mission is to shape a better tomorrow by connecting people with water and energy.

We currently have an exciting opportunity as a Data Analyst, People Analytics. This role is based in Montreal or Oakville and reports to the Lead, People Analytics.

Do not miss the opportunity to join a diverse group of people-centric professionals, thought leaders and rapid thinkers, entrepreneurs in spirit and status quo-fighters!

Job Summary

As the Data Analyst, People Analytics, you will help IPEX deliver accurate, meaningful workforce insights that support stronger HR and business decisions. You will be a key partner in managing reporting requests, maintaining data quality, improving reporting processes, and helping stakeholders understand what the data is telling them.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys structure, problem-solving, and continuous improvement. You will join a People Analytics team that is evolving its reporting practices, strengthening governance, and finding smarter ways to reduce manual work. If you enjoy working with HR data, asking thoughtful questions, and improving how reporting gets done, this role offers the opportunity to make a practical and visible impact.

Principal Responsibilities

Workforce Reporting & Analytics


Help strengthen HR and business decision-making by delivering accurate, timely, and meaningful workforce reporting across recurring cycles and ad hoc requests.
Bring clarity to workforce trends by analyzing metrics such as headcount, turnover, attrition, hiring, retention, demographics, and organizational changes.
Turn reporting needs into practical insights by clarifying business questions and shaping outputs that are useful, relevant, and easy for stakeholders to apply.


Reporting Governance & Data Integrity


Contribute to a trusted people data environment by supporting consistent metric definitions, reporting standards, documentation, and governance practices.
Improve confidence in workforce reporting by validating and reconciling data from multiple sources, investigating discrepancies, and supporting quality checks and data integrity reviews.
Help ensure sensitive HR information is handled with accuracy, consistency, confidentiality, and appropriate governance.


Reporting Operations, Automation & Process Improvement


Support a more efficient People Analytics function by maintaining and improving recurring reporting tools, templates, and reporting packages.
Reduce manual effort and improve scalability by applying advanced Excel, Power Query, and automation techniques to recurring reporting activities.
Contribute to ongoing process improvement by identifying opportunities to standardize workflows, simplify reporting processes, and support smaller HR technology or Dayforce-related initiatives where applicable.


Stakeholder Partnership & Reporting Support


Build effective partnerships with HR and business stakeholders by helping clarify reporting needs, priorities, timelines, and appropriate reporting solutions.
Promote stronger data literacy by guiding stakeholders on available reports, metric definitions, governance practices, and appropriate use of workforce data.
Support better reporting discipline by constructively challenging unclear, duplicative, or misaligned requests while communicating findings in a clear and practical way.


Qualifications & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in People Analytics, Workforce Analytics, HR Reporting, HRIS Reporting, Workforce Planning Analytics, or a related analytical role.
Experience delivering recurring and ad hoc workforce reporting, including requirements gathering, data validation, reporting governance, and stakeholder support.
Strong knowledge of HR metrics and workforce data, including headcount, turnover, attrition, hiring, retention, demographics, and organizational information.
Advanced Excel skills, with experience using formulas, pivot tables, reporting templates, data validation, and large datasets.
Experience using Power Query or similar tools to transform data, consolidate sources, and improve reporting efficiency.
Experience with HR systems such as Dayforce, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or similar platforms, and with maintaining or troubleshooting Power BI reports or dashboards.
Strong attention to detail, communication skills, and ability to work independently while managing competing priorities and supporting technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience with SQL, Power Automate, Dayforce reporting, workforce planning analytics, reporting automation, or data analytics/visualization certifications is considered an asset.


The compensation for this position is between $70,800.00 and $ 88,500.00 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

The Driver Earnings team at Lyft is responsible for managing our suite of driver earnings products, driving top business goals around financial metrics and marketplace performance. The team develops and improves automation & execution of driver earnings products, develops new earnings products, and manages financial performance of these products to manage the growth of the business.

We are looking for an analyst to join the team that is responsible for working with cross-functional stakeholders to analyze and improve existing earnings products and manage the products’ financial outcomes within the broader Marketplace organization. You will influence existing and future strategy with your data analysis, insights, and storytelling to deliver strategic recommendations on experimentation and product improvements. We’re looking for a data & process-driven individual who has extraordinary attention to detail and a track record of analytical problem-solving.

Responsibilities:


Support marketplace operations to provide world-class analysis, product recommendations, and reporting to stakeholders.
Become an expert in marketplace trends and support weekly reporting structures for the Rideshare organization.
Develop domain-specific subject matter expertise in our lever portfolio and support cross-functional initiatives to improve existing products and develop new ones.
Analyze marketplace product & financial levers and provide cross-functional teams with actionable insights on improvements and problem areas.
Operate within Rideshare decision-making frameworks with a critical lens, evaluating areas of improvement and business growth opportunities.
Prepare regular business reviews for leadership, highlighting key areas of focus.
Work with stakeholders and other teams to track, report, and reconcile budget allocation across marketplace programs.
Analyze data, conduct research and synthesize feedback into plans, processes and playbooks.


Experience:


1-3 years of experience in a high growth environment in data and/or financial analytics.
Very strong attention to detail, experience developing processes to remove human error.
Proficient in SQL and quantitative analysis, you can deep dive into large amounts of data, draw meaningful insights, dissect business issues and draw actionable conclusions.
Outcome-driven approach to developing recommendations and demonstrated ability to develop a story and execution plan to support our goals and objectives.
Exceptional communication (listening, written, and oral) skills with the ability to present findings and recommendations targeted to the audience in question.
A drive to understand the core issues along with the determination to uncover the solution.
Excels at dealing with ambiguity and change management.


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Job Title: Manager, Data Analytics

Data Analyst plays a critical role in enabling enterprise-wide data-driven decision-making by managing and advancing McKesson’s data assets. This position is responsible for identifying, capturing, analyzing, and organizing data to support strategic and operational objectives. The role ensures adherence to information governance standards and leverages advanced analytics to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that inform key business decisions. The analyst designs and maintains relational databases, creates dashboards and reports, and implements statistical models to guide decision-making. Collaborating with governance teams, data stewards, and business stakeholders, this position drives improvements in data quality, accessibility, and usability while influencing best practices across the organization.

Job Responsibilities:

What You’ll Do:


Manage and advance the data fabric to organize, integrate, and deliver enterprise data assets.
Design, create, and maintain relational databases and data systems, ensuring scalability and reliability.
Implement and apply statistical models to identify trends, patterns, and relationships that support decision-making.
Contribute to the management of central data stores and metadata, establishing and enforcing quality expectations.
Identify opportunities to improve data quality, including automation and procedural enhancements for data entry and validation.
Develop and implement techniques for data collection, accuracy, and management, ensuring compliance with governance standards.
Accountable for data accessibility, profiling, and reporting of quality issues, driving remediation strategies.
Collaborate with data governance, stewards, and business systems to propose and implement solutions for data quality improvement.
Recommend analytics opportunities and best practices, influencing enterprise adoption of advanced analytics.
Ensure development of solutions that enable actionable insights, supporting strategic and operational decision-making.



What We’re Looking For: Minimum Requirements:


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience; advanced degree preferred.
Typically requires 7+ years of relevant professional experience advancing data programs, including quality management, integration pipelines, and cloud data warehousing for scalable analytics.



Critical Skills/Experience:


Advanced capability in data modeling and database design for complex analytical systems.
Proficiency in data quality management programs, including accuracy, completeness, and timeliness checks.
Advanced capability in cloud data warehousing and performance optimization for large-scale analytics.
Proficiency in metadata management and lineage documentation for compliance and governance.
Ability to implement advanced data integration pipelines and monitor data flow reliability.
Competence in Business Function Knowledge, Customer & Business Driven, Problem Solving, Building Relationships, Adaptability, Digital Acumen, and Creativity.
Clear written and verbal communication tailored to both business and technical audiences.



Technical Expertise:


Advanced experience leveraging Databricks, Snowflake, and SQL to develop scalable analytical datasets, models, and reporting solutions.
Strong proficiency with Power BI to deliver executive-ready dashboards, KPIs, and self-service analytics capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to partner closely with business stakeholders to frame problems, identify opportunities, and translate data into actionable recommendations.

This role sits within Laurentian Bank.

Responsibilities


Participate in the production of dashboards used to monitor the performance of the Bank’s credit portfolios.
Participate in the analysis of performance indicators related to the Bank’s credit portfolio.
Produce analyses, interpret data, explain variances, and assess their implications on the Bank’s results.
Participate in data quality analysis in collaboration with governance teams.

University degree in Data Science and Business Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Actuarial Science, Engineering, Econometrics, Finance, or any other related field.

Strong knowledge of database querying and management using SQL, as well as specialized statistical tools such as SAS (Enterprise Guide), Power BI and Tableau.
Ability to influence stakeholders and innovate in the solutions proposed.
Ability to simplify and communicate complex ideas effectively.
Knowledge of the banking industry, Canadian credit products, and credit risk management tools.
Strong analytical mindset with a problem-solving orientation.
Strong attention to detail and a meticulous approach to work.

Professional working proficiency in French and English languages required as position involves frequent written and oral communication on complex matters with internal and external parties in both languages.

Title: Staff Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Risk Data Science team builds the data foundations, models, and measurement frameworks that power Stripe's risk and product decisions — from underwriting and reserves to merchant interventions and enablements. We're at an inflection point: as Stripe increasingly offers risk capabilities as a product to platforms and users, we need a data leader to shape how we build, measure, and evolve our risk data strategy.

What you’ll do

We are looking for an experienced data analyst to drive the data strategy for our risk as a product offering. Define the metrics, data products, and analytical frameworks needed as Stripe brings risk capabilities to platforms and connected accounts at scale. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Risk leadership to ensure data investments align with the product roadmap. You will design metrics, pipelines, and data products that serve as the analytical backbone for risk decisioning.

You will own the definition, reliability, and visibility of our most important risk metrics. Establish a canonical set of north star and operational metrics and ensure they are trustworthy, well-documented, and consistently surfaced to the right audiences. Build and maintain the infrastructure that keeps these metrics accurate as our data and product landscape evolves, including clear ownership, alerting on regressions, and scalable pipelines that reduce the cost of keeping insights current.

You will also own and evolve Stripe's risk experimentation strategy by defining what we test, how we measure, and how we learn. Ensure we can rigorously evaluate the impact of changes to risk policies, merchant journeys, and risk models across diverse merchant populations.

Finally, you will mentor and raise the bar for the Data Analysts on the team. Set technical and strategic standards. Guide junior and senior analysts on how to frame ambiguous problems, structure analyses for maximum impact, and communicate findings to senior stakeholders.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


10+ years in Data Analytics, Data Science, or related roles
Track record of defining and driving data strategy across multiple teams — not just executing on a roadmap, but shaping it
Experience designing experimentation frameworks or measurement strategies for complex, multi-variant systems (e.g., risk policies, pricing, marketplace dynamics)
Deep expertise in SQL; proficiency in Python
Strong ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical approaches and communicate findings to executive stakeholders
Experience building and scaling data products (metrics frameworks, pipelines, dashboards) that become operational infrastructure, not one-off analyses
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority across engineering, product, and business teams
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis and coding



Preferred Qualifications


Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, or a related technical field
Experience in risk, trust & safety, or related domains and understanding of risk in the Fintech space
Experience building data for platform/product offerings where data is part of the product surface, not just internal analytics
Familiarity with causal inference and A/B testing in non-standard environments (e.g., where randomization is constrained by risk considerations)



Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $179,000 - $268,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

The application window will remain open for 100 days after the Job Post is published. However, this opportunity will remain open based on the needs of the business, which may cause the application window to close before or after the 100-day mark.

Title: Analyst, Inbound Logistics
Description:
Sysco is the global leader in foodservice distribution. With over 71,000 colleagues and a fleet of over 13,000 vehicles, Sysco operates approximately 333 distribution facilities worldwide and serves more than 700,000 customer locations. We offer our colleagues the opportunity to grow personally and professionally, to contribute to the success of a dynamic organization, and to serve others in a manner that exceeds their expectations. We're looking for talented, hard-working individuals to join our team. Come grow with us and let us show you why Sysco is at the heart of food and service.

Compensation:

52,500.00 - 98,300.00 CAD Annual

Purpose:
Within the greater Inbound Logistics organization, the Analyst role will act as the dedicated resource for managing performance & financial data and the respective reporting for team KPI objectives.

The Analyst, Inbound Logistics, will additionally participate and contribute collaboratively with the Supply Chain Manager on data mining and providing analytics related to supplier freight programs and new customer onboardings/freight quotes.

Responsibilities:

Track and report on logistics KPIs, weekly, monthly, and ad-hoc as needed
Provide visuals and summaries around team performance and key financials
Produce content for the greater Logistics team for simple consumption and facilitation
Extract data from TMS, VRFS, IDS, Insights, Cognos, etc. to create actionable insights for growth opportunity
Develop reporting solutions for opportunities presented by department leaders
Accommodate ad-hoc reporting needs / deep-dives upon request
Monitor / audit freight revenue application accuracy and market relevance
Assist the Supply Chain Manager with freight quote development, supplier analysis, Sourcing requests, etc.
Participate in the new CMU customer onboarding process
Maintain supplier freight programs in FRDT (Freight Rate Database Tool) as needed
Update published freight programs to IDS via CFM (Centralized Freight Management)
Manage the True FOB supplier Sysco Fuel Surcharge program via CFM

Process Improvement:

Identify and assist with the implementation of new logistics conversions to achieve continuous LEI and CPU growth
Analyze supplier published freight programs and current state TFOB rates for accuracy and improved Sysco equity
Interpret potential opportunities from reporting generated by other departments / sources
Simplify data presentation for the greater Logistics team for create quicker actionable insights
Use increased levels of technology to modernize current state Logistics reporting


Collaboration:

Continuous cross-functional engagement with the overall Logistics Org to successfully advance initiatives and achieve KPI objectives
Ongoing engagement with Procurement, Sourcing, Category Manager, and Sales to further develop and implement opportunities and optimization
Formal direction from Merch leadership on departmental initiatives and related analytics


Skills:

Logistics Expertise - In-depth knowledge of advanced transportation and logistics principles
Advanced Excel, SQL, Power BI, and/or Tableau to perform data analysis and visualization
Colleague consumable KPI analysis and reporting
Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills to share analyses with multiple teams
Anticipatory mindset for the comprehensive data requirements of the greater logistics team

Education/Experience:

Bachelor's degree in related discipline or 3+ years of relevant logistics experience in lieu of a degree

Physical Demands:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk and use hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and telephone to talk and hear.
The employee is frequently required to sit and reach with hands and arms.

Travel Requirements: 0-10%

Title: (CAN) Manager, Data Analytics (IC)
Description:
Position Summary...The Manager, Data Analyst supports the Canadian Technology Data Engineering team by delivering hands on analytics, reporting, and insights for priority initiatives. This role focuses on translating defined business needs into high quality analysis, dashboards, and repeatable datasets—while partnering closely with Data Engineering to ensure reliable data sourcing, quality, and security practices. (No direct people management.)

What You'll Do...

Hands-on analytics delivery


Translate business questions into analytic requirements, data pulls, and repeatable reporting outputs.
Perform exploratory analysis and produce clear, decision‑ready insights; present findings in business language.


Data sourcing and integration


Identify and evaluate data sources; support processes to acquire, join, and validate data from multiple sources.
Partner with Data Engineering to improve dataset usability, documentation, and accessibility for analytics consumption.
Collaborate with other teams to aid with building visuals that directly support business decisions and ongoing operational tracking.


Data quality and controls


Monitor data quality indicators; proactively identify issues, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate fixes with engineering partners.
Coordinate and support security measures to safeguard information.


Initiative execution


Support multiple initiatives by tracking deliverables, documenting assumptions/definitions, and ensuring outputs are reproducible.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in analytics/data work.
Strong experience in Retail (Brick & Mortar and eCommerce) and as a Data Analyst (7+ years)
Strong SQL experience and proficiency with at least one analytics/programming tool (e.g., Python/R).
Demonstrated ability to assess data quality, validate sources, and communicate limitations/assumptions.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with GCP/BigQuery and/or cloud data ecosystems.
Familiarity with statistical techniques (hypothesis testing, inference) and experiment measurement.
Experience with Generative and Agentic AI


Core Competencies


Strong execution, attention to detail, and documentation
Practical problem solving and data validation discipline
Clear communication and stakeholder responsiveness
Builds reusable assets; continuous improvement mindset


Leadership Expectations

Respect the Individual:

Demonstrates and encourages respect for others; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all; embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas, and experiences; supports workplaces where associated feel seen and connected through a culture of belonging, so all associates thrive and perform; contributes to an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work.

Demonstrates engagement and commitment to the team, developing others through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; and recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively to achieve objectives; communicates with impact and listens attentively to a range of audiences; and demonstrates energy and positivity for own work.

Acts With Integrity

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by making a positive impact for associates, customers, and the world around us (e.g., creating a sense of belonging, eliminating waste, participating in local giving).

Follows the law, our code of conduct and company policies, and encourages others to do the same; supports an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns; reinforces our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action; acts with accountability for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Is consistently humble, self-aware, honest, and transparent.

Serve Our Customers

Delivers results while putting the customer first and applying an omni-merchant mindset and acts with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a broad perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans.

Strive For Excellence

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions; supports innovation and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Implements and supports continuous improvements and willingly embraces new digital tools and ways of working.

Company: Shoppers Drug Mart Specialty Health Network
Description:
Location:

1685 Tech Ave, Mississauga, Ontario, L4W 0A7

At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

Why this role is important?

Nature And Scope

The Senior Analyst, Business Intelligence and Insights is an individual with strong technical skills that will leverage SHN program, patient, and system data to generate outputs and insights that guide effective business decision making. They will work with key stakeholders within the BII team and within the program management and operations teams to understand requirements and develop data-driven solutions.

What You Will Do


Act as a conduit between client partners, SHN program management and operations teams, and the BII team to effectively understand and translate business and/or operational requirements into data-driven solutions and outputs.
Recommend and facilitate the development of specific data solutions, both as ad-hoc requests/support and for ongoing scheduled outputs
Adhere to best practices for testing and deploying aligned-on solutions
Validate outputs, analyze trends, identify opportunities and weaknesses for end users
Maintain business requirements, functional requirements and technical specification documentation for all outputs to ensure easy usability, referencing, and knowledge transfer
Assess impact to existing solutions/outputs due to proposed operational and system process changes


What You Will Need


Minimum 2-3 years of experience preferably in a pharmaceutical or healthcare industry
Post-Secondary education equivalent to a university degree in a numerate or analytical discipline such as Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or similar.
Strong knowledge and understanding of relational databases and querying ability using SQL is a key skill
Familiarity with CRM platforms (eg. SalesForce) is a strong asset
Experience with Business Intelligence Platforms (eg. PowerBI) is a strong asset
Effective organizational and communication skills
Well-developed analytical and problem-solving skills
Must be able manage time effectively through flexibility & prioritization in an environment of fast-paced change and ambiguity


Why work at Shoppers Drug Mart?

Acting as consultants, supporting internal customers and the Associate-Owners, you will get experience unique to the retail industry while working for an award-winning national brand. Benefit from a purchase discount program, competitive pay and online learning through Academy.

Take ownership of your work and find more ways to care about your work, co-workers, customers and community.

How You’ll Succeed

At Shoppers Drug Mart Inc., we seek great people to continually strengthen our culture. We believe great people model our values, are authentic, build trust and make connections.

If that sounds like you, and you are open-minded, responsive to change and up to the challenges provided in a fast-paced retail environment, apply today.

Full time

Regular

About Capital One Canada

For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated.

You’ll be empowered to grow your career in a supportive environment where you can own and shape your journey on your own terms. You’ll redefine what’s possible by contributing to work that impacts millions of Canadians, taking ownership of your decisions and outcomes, supported by mentors who will push you to think bigger and challenge the status quo.

Are you ready to redefine what’s next?

About The Team

Capital One is more than you think. We're a data-driven tech company that just happens to do credit cards. We focus on customer-first solutions, and we're united with this common goal. We have all the advantages of a startup, with the resources of a big company. Working here means you're curious, innovative spirit will be encouraged as you push boundaries and try new things, while your career is nurtured and supported. Our environment is creative and filled with teams that are passionate about the dynamic work they're doing. We're ahead of other banks in tech and we want to keep it that way.

About The Role

As a Data Analytics Associate, you will work with cross-functional teams to develop tools and data structures. As a creative problem-solver, you will be challenged to consider multiple options and select the optimal solution to meet the needs of your customers. You will own the recommendation and resolution to an existing business problem and will be involved end to end, from problem identification to solution deployment.

Your Responsibilities:


Transform raw data into data structures in our data lake and Snowflake data warehouse that are leveraged for business decision making.
Create, enhance and maintain critical data pipelines and processes.
Act as a steward for our data: ensuring it is high quality, trustworthy, well documented, and easy to use.
Build, automate, and maintain critical business reporting and visualizations that helps deliver insights.
Perform investigative analysis leveraging large/diverse datasets.


Basic Qualifications:


Will have obtained a Bachelor’s degree or higher in 2027.
Pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline with a strong coding background.
Familiarity with SQL and/or data transformation tools such as dbt.
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines.
Ability to clearly explain technical terms to a non-technical audience.


Preferred Qualifications:


Experience in a Linux environment
Experience using Python
Experience using Git or other version control systems
Experience with AWS or other cloud service providers
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Previous intern experience


Working at Capital One

Here you’ll uncover personal strengths, explore new interests and make an impact that matters. The work you’ll find here will keep you inspired and guide you in your career journey.


Take ownership of your own potential:


As you begin your career, you’ll define your own path by gaining exposure across the business, learning new skills, and having access to tools and mentorship to understand your potential.


Find your rhythm:


We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.


A supportive community from day one:


Through our robust onboarding program, orientation sessions, buddy program for new hires and early career development programs, you’ll get foundational training while building connections with your peers and leaders – cultivating a supportive community you can lean on for support and guidance.

You’ll find that Capital One is committed to helping you thrive and evolve every step of the way.

Job Title

Canada Goose isn't like anything else. We've built something great, something special - an iconic lifestyle brand with an inspirational and authentic story. Title: Client Data Analyst II
Description:
Description

The Client Data Analyst II (analyst) position is responsible for partnering with our clients and teams to drive their initiatives with strategy, analytics and actionable insights, optimizing program measurement to drive field team success, and constantly engaging with the team to better understand where they can have the greatest impact. The analyst will leverage business and market relevant information to make data-driven decisions that allow Mosaic to achieve its sales and marketing objectives and quickly adapt tactics. The analyst will play a key role in evolving, leading, and growing the data-driven discipline within the program they support.

Responsibilities


Collect, inspect, cleanse, transform, model and diagram of complex data sets
Daily use of various business intelligence and analytical software tools
Interpret data, formulate reports, and make recommendations to the team
Lead the standardized measurement strategy for clients and team leaders
Design or collaborate on specific research methods such as questionnaires and market testing approaches (A/B testing, multi-variate, etc)
Use statistical analysis to understand the key drivers of the business and provide recommendations for optimization and go-to-market strategies
Compile data into professional reports that support both findings and recommendations quantitatively and qualitatively. Clearly articulate compelling business insights and actions with data and context
Remain fully informed on market trends, other parties’ research and implement best practices, with a willingness to evolve and grow skillset
Remain fully engaged in the program, understanding strategic vision, key performance indicators, and the day-to-day tactical activities
Regularly attend client and internal team meetings, and in-field ride alongs to stay in tune with program activities
Other assigned duties



Qualifications


Remain fully informed on latest marketing and data trends, practice, and process
3-5 years of related work experience
1-2 years of project management experience
Intermediate (advanced is ideal, not required) Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills including formulas, pivot tables, V-look-up
Intermediate statistical analysis skills
Experience with SPSS, Python, R, or other stats software
Intermediate PowerBI, Tableau, or Looker skills; other data visualization platform skills a plus
Ability to tell a relevant, powerful story with data that matters to clients
Ability to lead research activities including developing a plan, collecting data, and taking action
Ability to execute standard measurement strategies within a project
Strong analytical and critical thinking with the ability to disseminate insight from large datasets
Develop understanding of all areas phases of Mosaic business to find new opportunities for insights, measurement, and analytics
Proven ability to timely complete projects and achieve results in an ambiguous work environment
