Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Citylitics Inc.

Citylitics delivers predictive intelligence on where, how, and why infrastructure investments will occur across North America.

Infrastructure includes the foundational systems that shape our quality of life: water, transportation, transit, roads and highways, broadband, and power. It represents a multi-trillion-dollar market and a 20+ year megatrend in North America.

Citylitics transforms millions of documents across more than 40,000 cities, utilities, and public agencies into real-time market signals and high-value sales intelligence. Leading infrastructure vendors, engineering firms, and construction companies use the platform to identify and pre-position for major infrastructure opportunities earlier, helping them build relationships, shape project priorities, and influence scope before projects move to formal procurement.

Citylitics combines a network of AI agents, fine-tuned models, a proprietary infrastructure signals graph, and daily human-in-the-loop quality assurance workflows to deliver highly nuanced and reliable sales intelligence. The platform integrates seamlessly with CRMs, ERPs, and data lakes, embedding actionable insights directly into sales workflows so teams can prioritize the right pursuits and build stronger pipelines.

Our mission is to improve how infrastructure investments get made so critical needs can be addressed earlier and communities benefit from stronger, more resilient infrastructure.

Join Citylitics to work in a meaningful industry that will matter for decades to come while helping grow a company at the forefront of applied AI. We operate with a Results-Driven Mentality and a commitment to Raise The Bar, in a collaborative environment where Teamwork Makes the Dream Work as we tackle big challenges and celebrate wins together.

Who Are We Looking For?

Citylitics is looking for a Data Analyst to own our Custom Solutions practice. You'll scope and deliver client-specific data requests that don't fit our standard product.

You will partner directly with Sales, Customer Success, Product and leadership to triage incoming requests, assess feasibility before anything is promised to a client, query and validate data in BigQuery, and build the one-off dashboards or reports that answer a client's actual question.

This role fits someone analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, and disciplined about scope. You size up a vague ask fast, align stakeholders when it's over-committed, and educate clients on data availability and nuances while developing solution options to discuss with them. Once you've validated an approach with the customer, you hand the engineering work to the team. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need enough confidence in SQL and data structures to know what's realistic. You're also comfortable presenting data findings and methodology directly to clients and helping them interpret what the results mean. You move quickly and decisively, without overanalyzing.

This role is based in our downtown Toronto office and requires 3+ days in-office per week.

Vacancy Status: This position is for an existing and active vacancy that Citylitics is currently seeking to fill.

What Will You Accomplish?

Triage and Scope Custom Solution Requests

You will own the front door for custom solutions requests, deciding what's worth committing to before it reaches a client.

Responsibilities include:


Field new custom-solution requests from Sales and Customer Success as they come in (Slack, demo follow-ups, live calls)
Assess feasibility and turnaround before anything is committed to a client
Align stakeholders when a request is over-scoped or under-priced
Educate clients on data availability and nuances
Develop solution options to discuss with the client before committing to delivery


Query, Validate, and Build One-Off Deliverables

You will do the actual data work behind each request, once it's been scoped.

Responsibilities include:


Query BigQuery to test and validate client-specific hypotheses
Build or update lightweight dashboards (Looker, etc) for one-off client deliverables
Disambiguate against existing coverage to avoid duplicating work


Hand Off to Engineering Once Customer Validation Is Achieved

You validate the approach with the customer before engineering builds it.

Responsibilities include:


Write up findings and requirements clients or account teams can act on directly
Hand off anything requiring pipeline or scraper-level work to engineering, with a clear spec
Surface it immediately when a client's own criteria don't hold up
Other duties as assigned


Requirements

Must-Have Experience


2+ years of experience in data analysis, solutions consulting, business analysis, or a similar role
Strong SQL fluency (BigQuery a plus), comfortable self-serve querying
Scopes an ambiguous request before diving in and defines what "done" looks like from the start
Strong written and verbal communication for client-facing summaries
Comfortable working directly with clients or internal commercial teams under a fast turnaround pace
Comfortable presenting data findings and methodology directly to clients and helping them interpret results, not just retrieving data
Moves quickly and decisively, without overanalyzing


Nice-to-Have Experience


Enough SQL/notebook fluency to spec engineering work credibly (not to build it)
Prior consulting or client-facing analyst background
Familiarity with a BI/dashboarding tool (Looker, Tableau, etc.)


Benefits

Why Citylitics?


This is a rare opportunity to influence positive change within one of the biggest societal challenges of our generation: sustainable public infrastructure
You get to support a disruptive solution with a compelling value proposition into an industry that is eager to hear from you and in a market with no direct competition
We live at the cross section of infrastructure, scaleup and data science/AI. There is no other team like us in Toronto
There is no corporate bureaucracy here. You will accomplish more here in a few months than what you would in a few years at a large, entrenched technology company
We believe that Data and AI will play an outsized role in our future, so we equip every team member with access to Generative AI tools and our full Data Universe to enhance their productivity and encourage innovation through experimentation
We are proud to offer every CityZen in-role professional growth, skill-based development & learning, and internal promotion opportunities
We work hard, we play together, we win as a team! We are on a mission to solve infrastructure while savoring the moment and celebrating the little details along the way


Citylitics is an equal opportunity employer. We are passionate about providing a safe workplace where everyone is accepted and has the opportunity to grow with us. We are committed to making diversity and inclusivity part of our culture!

The role performs tasks of technical depth and breadth, utilizing a solid understanding of business dynamics to conduct impact analysis and provide feedback on problems with recommended solutions involving Business Intelligence.

Data Analysis & Insights - Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to uncover trends and opportunities. Use SQL and Pyspark to process and prepare data for PowerBI dashboard.

Strategic Thinking – Drive, manage and execute data and reporting projects and initiatives in alignment with CIBC Strategy while supporting the business goals, objectives, and key performance indicators. Ability to think strategically about how to mobilize and engage teams across the enterprise to deliver strategic change.
Innovative Problem Solving - Actively lead the development, delivery, and continuous improvement of complex data analytics and visualization solutions

Ability to produce a variety of business documents that demonstrate command of language, clarity of thought and orderliness of presentation.

You can demonstrate experience in: 3–5 years in data analytics, business intelligence, or related roles. You must have at least 2 years of experience with PowerBI; coupled with at least 4 years of SQL experience. It’s an asset if you have Python and Microsoft Copilot Studio experience, and if you’ve worked within Capital Markets/Equities.
You have a degree in a quantitative field (i.e. mathematics, statistics, computer science, economics, engineering, physics, business) or equivalent experience. Advanced degree is an asset (i.e. MMA, MBAN, MSc, MA, MBA). You have the “Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate” certification.

You demonstrate knowledge in organization's Information Technology (IT) environment and understand the integration / interdependencies of various processes across a line of business.
Your influence makes a difference. You know that relationships and networks are essential to success. You inspire outcomes by sharing your expertise.
You’re digitally savvy. You seek out innovative solutions and embrace evolving technologies. You can easily adapt to new tools and trends.
You're motivated by collective success. You know that teamwork can transform a good idea into a great one. You know that an inclusive team that enjoys working together can bring a vision to life.
Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work and you live our values - trust, teamwork, and accountability.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Capital Markets)
Description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Data Analyst to join the GWAM Data Engineering team within the Global Wealth and Asset Management division. In this role, you will partner closely with Data Management, Data Delivery, Business Stakeholders, Data Architects, and Data Modelers to design and deliver scalable, high-quality data solutions that drive business value and align with the organization's Information Management standards. The ideal candidate will be a strong Techno-Functional professional with deep Capital Markets experience/knowledge and a solid understanding of data warehousing, data modeling, and enterprise data management.

You will play a key role in translating complex business requirements into logical and physical data models, collaborating on the design of data structures and tables, defining data lineage and governance standards, and ensuring the successful delivery of data products across the investment and wealth management landscape. Strong analytical skills, stakeholder management capabilities, and hands-on experience working with large-scale financial data ecosystems are essential for success in this role.

Responsibilities


Deliver flexible, reusable and well-maintained core data repositories
Use accelerated delivery methodologies to ensure data initiatives provide timely business value
Develop and maintain expertise in the Investment domain, as well as expertise in accessing, querying, testing and validating data content to drive quality and consistency within solutions
Partner with the Data Governance group to establish appropriate standards and methodologies, template and tools related to documenting, analyzing and testing data - work with management to implement these standards within the IS and Data Governance organizations
Developing templates and methodologies to ensure data requirements are accurately and completely captured and can be effectively communicated to other data stakeholders, including Business Users, Business Architects, Business Analysts, Solutions Architects, Solutions Developers, Quality Assurance Analysts, Data Governance and Data Management Staff
Ensuring the proposed technical solutions effectively meet the business need
Conducting data profiling to analyze quality of incoming data and advising on any data cleansing rules
Assisting in the creation of business glossaries (data dictionaries)
Collaborating with the QA group to develop methods to test data components
Evaluating existing and proposed data models and how to best access and query them
Evaluating existing and proposed data interfaces and how to clearly document them, including specification of data flow models, data flow timing, source-to-target  mapping, and data  transformation rules including data validations and controls
Keeping current on evolving Investment business knowledge domains to accurately assess the quality of the data
Providing guidance to project teams via peer reviews


Required Qualifications


5-10 years related experience in working with Investment domain data and Data Management solutions
Experience with data-centric projects delivering the following (within a capital markets or investment banking domain): Master data management, Data integration, Data warehousing and reporting. Big Data environment for analytics
Significant experience in major trading platforms, book of record systems, performance management platforms, such as Bloomberg Polar Lake, SimCorp Dimension, Findur, Apex, Eagle, Charles River, Sylvan, Calypso
Experience delivering data documentation artifacts in organizations of similar size and complexity within project deadlines


Preferred Qualifications


Experienced writing complex SQL queries to analyze data and provide results to business users or project team members
Able to communicate clearly, both verbally and in written form at various levels within the project teams
Strong work ethic, results oriented, and accuracy / attention to detail are critical
Demonstrated initiative, able to work both independently and as a team member
Able to clearly communicate complex methodologies and approaches to stakeholders, peers and management
Able to work in agile or scrum delivery environments
Good understanding of techniques and tools pertaining to the planning, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and maintenance of technology solutions
exposure to Azure


When You Join Our Team


We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

Description:
Job Description

What is the Opportunity?

The global functions technology group supports Finance and Risk Business partners by using our extraordinarily rich data set that spans multiple versions and geographies globally and captures detailed datasets. Our focus lies on building creative solutions that have an immediate impact on the business of our highly analytical partners. We work in complementary teams comprising members from Data Engineering and various groups at the Bank. To support our rapidly growing group we are looking for Senior Data Analyst/Engineer who are equally passionate about the opportunity to use rich data to tackle meaningful business problems. The candidate will apply extensive, in-depth knowledge, skills, and practices to perform complex assignments to bridge the gap between business and technology by delivering critical insights and analysis to shape strategy, evolve data connectivity, and provide insights into data transformation.

What will you do?


Utilize Hive/SQL/ Python to perform daily data analysis and advanced data mining and analytics on large transactional datasets
Work closely with Program sponsors, SMEs in various business areas, technology teams to finalize functional business requirements and support implementation activities
Make recommendations and build use cases on new sources of value by addressing the biggest gaps in our data sources in relation to completeness
Find opportunities to create and automate repeatable analyses or build self-service tools for business users
Research industry metrics and business context and bring this context to bear in analyses
Oversee processes such as data gathering, transformation, reporting, and advanced analytics to ensure the integrity and reliability of large datasets.
Drive the highest standards of quality, rigor, and thought leadership across the entire data lifecycle.


What do you need to Succeed?

Must have:


Solid understanding of Finance business processes such as Balance Sheet Reporting, Profit and Loss Reporting, Capital Reserve Reporting, Capital Markets products and processes, and Regulatory Reporting
Minimum of 5+ years of analytical experience in applying solutions to business problems in relevant fields such as analytics, business requirements, consulting, or other data-driven functions
Demonstrated Experienced in quantitative, qualitative, analytical, problem solving, and critical thinking skills.
Exceptional storytelling skills, with a track record of translating complex data into compelling business insights. Ability to communicate findings derived from complex analytics to Senior Leadership, both verbally and visually.
Experienced in databases, data engineering, ETL, ELT concepts with utilizing querying, automation, and big data technologies (e.g. Python, SQL, Spark, Teradata, Hadoop, Snowflake, Databricks) to produce repeatable insights
Proficiency with creating compelling presentations


Nice-to-have:


Data Engineering / Data Science certification and/or completion of Business Analysis training courses.
Copilot , Git hub , Python knowledge


What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.


A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities

Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team

Opportunities to do challenging work.

Lifemark Health Group (LHG) is a market leader in customized healthcare solutions. With over 20 years of service excellence, LHG is one of the largest, most trusted, and most comprehensive providers in Canada. As a national healthcare company, LHG employs over 5,000 highly trained clinicians, medical experts, and team members in almost 400 locations coast-to-coast and continues to grow both organically as well as through acquisitions. With that growth is a vision to be the most innovative healthcare provider in community rehabilitation, workplace health and wellness, and medical assessment services. Lifemark was acquired by Loblaw Companies on May 10, 2022.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Senior Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst to design, build, and deliver enterprise reporting and analytics solutions within a modern Microsoft Fabric and Azure ecosystem.

This is a development-focused role. You will be responsible for building Power BI dashboards, semantic models, and reporting assets from end to end—transforming raw data into scalable, production-ready reporting solutions that drive business decisions across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in Power BI, data modeling, SQL, and Microsoft Fabric with a passion for delivering high-quality reporting experiences that are performant, reliable, and user-friendly.

Key Responsibilities:

Power BI Development & Reporting Delivery


Design, develop, test, and deploy Power BI dashboards and reports from concept to production
Build operational, financial, and executive reporting solutions that support strategic decision-making
Create intuitive, visually compelling, and pixel-perfect dashboards following UX and visualization best practices
Develop reusable reporting frameworks, templates, and standards
Deliver both standardized reporting solutions and ad hoc analytical reporting requests
Serve as the primary owner for reporting deliverables and dashboard lifecycle management



Data Modeling & Semantic Layer Development


Design and maintain enterprise semantic models and Power BI datasets
Develop advanced DAX measures, KPIs, and business calculations
Build scalable dimensional and star-schema data models optimized for reporting performance
Establish and maintain a trusted single source of truth for business metrics and reporting
Ensure consistency and accuracy across all reporting assets



Microsoft Fabric & Data Integration


Develop solutions using Microsoft Fabric components, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Dataflows, and Data Pipelines
Source, cleanse, transform, and prepare data for reporting and analytics use cases
Partner with Data Engineering teams to consume curated Gold-layer datasets
Contribute to reporting-focused data pipeline development and optimization
Support data integration efforts across multiple business systems and data sources

Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into actionable reporting solutions
Lead report design discussions and iterative feedback sessions
Prioritize and deliver reporting assets aligned with business objectives
Communicate insights, recommendations, and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences



Performance Optimization & Scalability


Optimize report performance through efficient DAX, model design, and query tuning
Ensure reporting solutions remain scalable across large and growing datasets
Monitor dashboard adoption, usage patterns, and performance metrics
Continuously improve reporting efficiency, usability, and responsiveness

Apply enterprise standards for naming conventions, documentation, and metadata management
Validate data accuracy and ensure reporting reliability
Support governance initiatives related to reporting, metrics, and business definitions
Maintain documentation for datasets, reports, and reporting processes



Mentorship & Best Practices


Promote best practices in Power BI development, data modeling, and visualization design
Mentor junior analysts and BI developers
Contribute to establishing a Reporting and Analytics Center of Excellence
Drive continuous improvement in BI development standards and methodologies

5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Reporting-focused roles
Proven experience building Power BI dashboards, reports, and semantic models from scratch
Advanced expertise in Power BI, DAX, Power Query, and data modeling
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and/or Azure-based data platforms
Strong SQL skills for data extraction, transformation, and optimization
Experience delivering enterprise-scale, production-grade reporting solutions
Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, star schema design, and reporting best practices
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Strong builder mindset with a passion for hands-on development
Ability to independently translate business requirements into production-ready solutions
Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data quality
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Excellent collaboration and stakeholder engagement abilities
Focus on performance, scalability, maintainability, and user experience
Continuous learning mindset and willingness to adopt emerging technologies



Nice to Have


Experience with Python for automation, analytics, or data preparation
Familiarity with CI/CD processes for Power BI deployments
Experience with Power BI deployment pipelines and workspace administration

Experience with Microsoft Fabric components, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, and Real-Time Analytics
Strong understanding of Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold)
Experience implementing reporting governance and enterprise BI standards
Familiarity with additional reporting and visualization tools such as Tableau, SSRS, or Looker
Exposure to advanced analytics, machine learning, or data science workflows

Delivery of high-quality Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions

Report performance, reliability, and scalability
Stakeholder satisfaction and business impact
Reduction in manual reporting effort
Consistency and adherence to BI standards and governance practices

Career growth opportunities into BI Lead, Analytics Architect, or Data Platform leadership roles

Title: Data & Insights Analyst
Description:
Transform Lives with Children Believe!

Join us to help break the barriers to education that steal children’s choices one by one until they have none. Together, we can foster an environment where education unlocks a world of choices, nurturing creativity, resilience, and hope for a better tomorrow. At Children Believe, we won’t stop until every child can dream fearlessly and grow up to live the life they choose to live.

Children Believe is currently recruiting for the following position:




Data & Insights Analyst

Canada Office

The Data & Insights Analyst is the data engine of Children Believe's Marketing & Development (M&D) division. This role is responsible for turning raw data into clear, actionable intelligence — ensuring the division runs on facts, not assumptions, and that every team has the reporting and insights it needs to make smarter decisions and demonstrate impact.

Reporting to the Manager, M&D Operations, this role owns the integrity and usability of M&D's CRM data, manages the full reporting and dashboard ecosystem, and drives innovation in how the division uses digital data and AI-powered tools. It is a hands-on, execution-focused role with real strategic value — the outputs produced here directly shape how the CMDO and M&D Directors measure performance, allocate resources, and tell their story to donors and stakeholders.

This is an ideal role for an analytically strong early-career professional who is eager to grow, build meaningful systems, and see their work directly connected to a mission that changes children's lives.

This role includes, but not limited to:

1. Reporting & Dashboards - 35%

Build, maintain, and continuously improve M&D's suite of performance dashboards and KPI reports — ensuring every team has timely, accurate visibility into what matters most.
Produce the monthly M&D KPI dashboard for the CMDO and Directors, incorporating charts, trend analysis, and narrative highlights.
Develop standardized reporting templates that reduce manual effort and increase consistency across the division.
Respond to ad hoc data and reporting requests from M&D Directors and the CMDO with accuracy and speed.
Proactively surface insights, anomalies, and trends — don't just report the numbers, explain what they mean.

2. CRM Data Management & Integrity - 30%

Own the quality and reliability of M&D's CRM data — including donor records, contact information, gift history, and segmentation — ensuring it is clean, consistent, and complete.
Design and implement data entry standards, hygiene protocols, and audit processes to prevent data degradation over time.
Lead regular data clean-up initiatives: deduplication, record merging, field standardization, and validation.
Build CRM queries, segments, and lists to support fundraising campaigns, donor communications, and strategic analysis.
Act as the go-to resource for CRM data questions across M&D — supporting teams in getting the most out of the system.
Liaise with the CRM platform provider and IT as needed on system issues, upgrades, and data imports/exports.

3. Digital Data & External Sources - 20%

Manage and interpret data from digital channels including website analytics (Google Analytics), SEO platforms, email marketing tools, and social media insights.
Ensure digital data sources are properly connected, consistently tracked, and integrated into M&D reporting where relevant.
Monitor digital performance trends and provide regular reporting to the Digital & Community Engagement team and the CMDO.
Support campaign measurement and attribution — helping teams understand what is driving donor acquisition, engagement, and conversion.

4. AI & Innovation - 15%

Research, pilot, and implement AI-powered tools that improve reporting efficiency, data quality, and analytical depth across M&D.
Identify repetitive or manual data tasks that can be automated — and build or configure solutions to eliminate them.
Stay current on emerging data and AI tools relevant to non-profit fundraising and digital marketing; bring recommendations to the Manager, M&D Operations.
Support the broader M&D team in developing data literacy and comfort with new tools through documentation, training, and hands-on support.

The ideal candidate possesses:

Required

Post-secondary diploma or degree in a relevant field (Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Marketing, Communications, Statistics, or equivalent experience).
1–3 years of experience in a data, reporting, or analytics role; non-profit or fundraising experience is an asset but not required.
Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and data visualization.
Working proficiency in Power BI (or equivalent BI/dashboard tool), with the ability to build and maintain reporting dashboards.
Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4) and digital marketing measurement fundamentals.
Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet reporting deadlines consistently.
Clear and effective written communication — can explain findings to non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated commitment to Children Believe's Vision, Mission, and Values.

Assets

Experience with AI or automation tools applied to data tasks (e.g., Python scripting, ChatGPT/Claude for data analysis, Zapier, or similar).
Proficiency in CRM platforms (Dynamics or equivalent); experience with data entry standards and database hygiene.
Experience with SEO platforms (SEMrush, Moz, Google Search Console).
Knowledge of email marketing platforms and campaign performance metrics.
Experience in a fundraising, marketing, or donor communications environment.
Familiarity with Intacct or similar accounting/finance software.
Proficiency in French or Spanish.

Attributes, Traits, Behaviours:

Analytical Rigour

Finds patterns and meaning in complex datasets. Works accurately under pressure and checks their own work before presenting it. Numbers tell a story — this person knows how to read it.

Attention to Detail

Data quality is only as good as the person maintaining it. This role requires someone who notices what others miss and takes ownership of getting things exactly right.

Curiosity & Initiative

Doesn't wait to be told what to investigate. Proactively digs into the data, asks good questions, and brings ideas — including how AI and automation can improve the way M&D works.

Communication Clarity

Translates technical findings into plain language that non-data audiences can act on. Knows when a table works and when a chart tells the story better.

Systems Thinking

Understands how data flows connect across tools, teams, and processes. Builds solutions that are sustainable and scalable — not just fixes for today's problem.

Type: Hybrid

Our Hybrid Workplace Program is a flexible work arrangement that permits employees to work remotely while also occasionally being required to come into the Organization’s office. If approved to work from home as part of our Hybrid workplace program; the incumbent must be available to work from the Organization’s office from time to time as determined by the supervisor or as otherwise directed by the Organization.

Compensation: Between $51,000 - $60,000 annually based on experience.




We value our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your professional and personal growth:

Competitive Compensation Package: We provide an attractive compensation package with clearly stated hiring ranges.
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a flexible work environment, including hybrid work options, flexible hours, “No Meeting Mondays,” and the option to work up to 20 days out of province per year.
Comprehensive Benefits Plan: Our group benefits plan includes health and dental coverage, an Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP), and RRSP matching up to 5%, starting from day one.
Health Spending Account: Access to our $500 Healthcare Spending Account to top up expenses not covered in the benefits program
Performance Incentives: Participate in our Pay for Performance Plan with up to 6% performance incentive pay.
Professional Development: Benefit from 5 paid professional development days and experience professional growth through a variety of learning opportunities.
Paid Time Off: Enjoy an annual Christmas closure, receive 2 float days, and have access to up to 10 sick day
Generous Vacation Policy: Enjoy 3 weeks paid vacation with incremental increase every 5 years up to 6 weeks.
Other Employee Perks: Take advantage of our Employee Discount Program and various other perks designed to enhance your overall well-being and work-life balance.




Application Process:

If you believe you have that unique combination of a not-for-profit heart combined with the skills and interest for the “Data & Insights Analyst” position, then click the “Apply” button found at the bottom of this screen.

In this role as an Economic Data Analyst/Scientist on the Data Development team, you will assist in building our core financial demographic products by processing, integrating, analysing, and visualizing a wide variety of large and small datasets. You will quickly understand and execute existing data processes while providing innovative feedback and ideas for improvement. We seek a detail-oriented, curious, and creative individual who can drive change and has a strong interest in economics and household finance. Your responsibilities will include building data products, analyzing financial and demographic data, and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of models and processes.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

To effectively fulfill the responsibilities of this position, the employee must be able to complete the following:


Work within the Data Development team to produce high-quality, reliable financial data products.
Learn and apply advanced concepts and methodologies related to data products and sources.
Acquire, analyze, visualize, cleanse, impute, and transform large datasets from various sources.
Ensure data products meet strict quality control standards at various stages of the product lifecycle.
Analyze financial data outputs to ensure adherence to macroeconomic, microeconomic, and industry trends.
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders clearly and concisely.
Stay updated with changes within the Canadian Economic landscape and advancements in data science and analytics.
Skilled in Python for data processing, statistical analysis, and visualizations.
Proficient in advanced SQL queries with a strong understanding of relational databases.
Optimize data pipelines and workflows for efficiency and scalability.
Strong problem-solving abilities, communication skills, and attention to detail.


___________________________________________________________________

QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIRED SKILLS:


Education – Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Quantitative Finance, Economics, Statistics, or a related Engineering degree.


Preferred Qualifications


1+ years of experience in building models and developing algorithms for data analysis, with a focus on macro and microeconomic data.
Familiarity with financial databases and APIs.
Understanding of Canadian geography and spatial analysis concepts.
Experience working with Census and Financial Datasets (e.g., Statistics Canada, Canadian Revenue Agency, Equifax) is an asset.
Highly skilled in Python and SQL
Analytical Skills– Effectively researches and synthesizes complex or diverse information; uses intuition and experience to complement data and designs workflows and procedures. Innovative and capable of applying new and enhanced solutions to existing processes.
Judgment– Displays willingness to make timely decisions, including appropriate people in the decision-making process and exhibits sound and accurate judgment; supports and explains reasoning for decisions
Planning/Organizing– Prioritizes and plans work activities effectively. Ability to multitask. Teamwork– Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views, giving and welcoming feedback. Puts the team's success above one's own interests and demonstrates the ability to build morale and group commitment to goals and objectives. Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.

Communication Skills– Able to clearly communicate ideas and expectations. Effectively listens for understanding and asks questions for clarification. Presents ideas effectively in both verbal and written form.

Title: Analyst, Walmart Services – Insights & Reporting (WFS)
Description:
Position Summary...The Analyst, Insights & Reporting will support the Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) Account Management team by generating data-driven insights and identifying opportunities the team can act on to grow seller adoption, performance, and program participation. This role will also partner closely with Campaigns & Events teams to ensure WFS-enrolled items are properly featured, in-stock, and positioned for success across all major campaigns and seasonal events throughout the year. The ideal candidate is analytically curious, comfortable working across dashboards and datasets, and confident using AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, and reporting.

What You'll Do...


Generate actionable insights and opportunity recommendations for the WFS Account Management team, surfacing seller-level trends, program gaps, and growth levers they can act on directly.
Partner with Account Management to translate insights into prioritized outreach lists, program enrollment targets, and seller engagement strategies.
Collaborate with Campaigns & Events teams to plan ahead of the annual events calendar, ensuring WFS-enrolled items are adequately featured, represented, and inventory-ready for every major campaign and seasonal moment throughout the year.
Monitor business performance and key metrics across WFS programs, proactively flagging trends, anomalies, and risks to relevant stakeholders before they become issues.
Support ad-hoc analysis requests from Account Management and cross-functional partners, turning raw data into clear, actionable narratives and recommendations.
Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify emerging opportunities for WFS sellers and surface them to Account Management.
Assist in preparing business reviews and presentations that summarize performance, insights, and recommended next steps for leadership and stakeholders.
Partner across Account Management, Campaigns & Events, Strategic Account Management, and Product teams to make sure WFS priorities are represented in planning calendars and event roadmaps.
Leverage AI tools to support research, analysis, automation, and day-to-day productivity.


Qualifications


1-3 years of experience in account management, analytics, business operations, insights, or account/program support, preferably within retail, CPG, 3PL, logistics, e-commerce, or marketplace environments.
University degree, MBA Preferred
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
Hands-on experience building or maintaining dashboards in Looker, Tableau, and/or Power BI.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with SQL, R, and/or Python is a plus.
Comfortable leveraging AI tools to support research, analysis, automation, and productivity.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to work cross-functionally with Account Management, Campaigns & Events, and other partner teams.
Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent insight requests and stay ahead of a fast-moving events and campaigns calendar.


Leadership Expectations

Respect the Individual:

Demonstrates and encourages respect for others; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all; embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas, and experiences; supports workplaces where associated feel seen and connected through a culture of belonging, so all associates thrive and perform; contributes to an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work.

Demonstrates engagement and commitment to the team, developing others through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; and recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively to achieve objectives; communicates with impact and listens attentively to a range of audiences; and demonstrates energy and positivity for own work.

Acts With Integrity

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by making a positive impact for associates, customers, and the world around us (e.g., creating a sense of belonging, eliminating waste, participating in local giving).

Follows the law, our code of conduct and company policies, and encourages others to do the same; supports an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns; reinforces our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action; acts with accountability for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Is consistently humble, self-aware, honest, and transparent.

Serve Our Customers

Delivers results while putting the customer first and applying an omni-merchant mindset and acts with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a broad perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans.

Strive For Excellence

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions; supports innovation and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Implements and supports continuous improvements and willingly embraces new digital tools and ways of working.

The pay range for this position is $64,700.00 - $88,990.00. Pay will be determined based on relevant experience.

Title: Senior Analyst - The Sims, Enterprise Intelligence
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

The Enterprise Intelligence (EI) team is involved in every aspect of data at EA, using it to deliver valuable insights and solutions for game teams and players. We drive strategy, build data and AI tools, and support personalization, experimentation, and analytics. Join D&I to work with experts dedicated to improving understanding, workflows, and player experiences.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our analytics team supporting a high-definition title in development. In this hybrid role based in Vancouver, you’ll collaborate with product managers, engineers, and quality teams to enhance development quality, product stability and drive business outcomes through data. Reporting to the Manager of Analytics, you’ll use your expertise to inform strategic decisions across product optimization, technology, testing, and overall quality.

What You'll Do


Communicate with studio stakeholders to identify opportunities where data can better support decision making
Work with partners to define the right questions to ask and the right data to use, helping embed data in daily decision-making
Present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
Build dashboards, reports, and visualisations that help stakeholders make better, faster decisions
Contribute to the development of predictive models and other applications of machine learning that personalise player experiences or support product decisions
Explore and apply generative AI tools to increase the efficiency of your own work and support scalable insights


What You'll Bring


4+ years of experience in data analysis or applied analytics, in gaming, mobile apps, or other digital products
Proficiency in SQL for querying large datasets; experience with analysis and modelling in Python or R
Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, PowerBI
Ability to translate business needs into technical data requirements
Experience with or interest in using machine learning and generative AI tools to support analytics or player insights
You will use storytelling to convert business objectives into analytical questions, and communicate results with practical recommendations and actionable steps.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$92,900 - $129,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in…

The Data Analyst utilizes their quantitative analytical skills and scientific thought process to interpret and

analyze large sets of complex data, while extracting meaningful insights for Kabam. This role works

closely with our internal gaming team to optimize every facet of player retention and monetization to

ensure the continued success of our games.

This role is a full-time, on-site position based 5 days a week at our Downtown Vancouver studio.

Provide Cross-functional Support

In this role, you can expect to:


Collaborate with various teams across the organization to understand their business goals and data needs.
Improve reporting processes by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting enhancements.
Assist with larger-scale projects as required, contributing data-driven insights.


Data Exploration And Analysis


Use SQL to extract and manipulate data from various sources.
Perform hands-on exploration of data sets to answer business questions.
Utilize statistical analysis to identify trends, correlations, and patterns within the data.
Create data visualizations to communicate findings effectively.


Dashboard And Report Management


Develop and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports tailored to the needs of different teams within the organization.
Ensure that dashboards and reports are up-to-date and accurate.
Prepare ad-hoc reports as requested.


A/B Testing


Design, execute, and manage multiple A/B tests to gain insights into key performance indicators (KPIs) such as retention, acquisition, and monetization.
Analyze the results of A/B tests to draw actionable conclusions.
Make data-driven recommendations for optimizing business strategies based on results of A/B testing.


Product Feature Analysis And Optimization


Measure the success of newly released product features using key metrics and data analysis.
Drive data-driven iteration and optimization of product features to enhance performance and user experience.


Task Prioritization And Project Management


Assist in task prioritization within the data team based on business needs and project requirements.
Collaborate with team members to achieve project goals efficiently.


To Be Successful In This Role, Your Background Includes


Bachelor’s Degree in related field.
3+ years of industry data analysis experience, with solid knowledge of statistical methods.
1+ years of industry data experience in games (mobile, console, PC), online casino, slot games, or any high volume B2C mobile apps.
Expert SQL skills and experience querying very large data sets.
Proven ability to thrive using multiple mixed, varied, and inconsistent data sources.
Fundamental knowledge of project management methodologies.
Regular communication with stakeholders from other departments and drive actionable items for continuous improvement.
Experience with Google BigQuery, Tableau, JIRA and/or other project management software.
Experience working for a social or mobile game developer.
Understanding of game design concepts and principles.


Benefits

Our success is due to the hard work of our people. We share our success with our people through flexible benefits and reward programs, sweet swag, snacks, and more. Here’s a look at some of the support we provide our people:


Extended Health Coverage: effective day one, no waiting period! Our benefits cover health, dental, life, disability, and extended paramedical services such as vision care, mental health practitioners, massage, physiotherapy, acupuncture, and much more.
DEIB Benefits: DEIB is important to us and to our people - that’s why our benefits include gender-affirming care, fertility care, and other hormonal treatments and drugs.
Flexible Spending Accounts: our benefits are built on a flex credit model, so you’re able to choose the coverage levels that are right for you, and allocate the rest to a group RRSP/TFSA, Health Spending account, and/or Personal Spending Account.
RRSP Matching: everyone retires eventually, and we help our people save for their futures with a contribution matching program once you reach 90 days with us.
Commuter Benefit: we believe in the power of in-person collaboration, and want to support you in making it work for you! We provide a flexible, monthly cash allowance to help cover the costs of transit, parking, or even personal logistics like childcare and pet care.
PTO and Parental Leave: we offer paid parental leave, flexible paid time off, paid time off for volunteering, sick leave, and holiday closures.
Employee and Family Assistance Program: this program provides crisis management support, immediate mental health care, and generalized support for emotional, mental, and financial well-being.
Telus Virtual Health: we provide increased access to remote healthcare providers for prescription refills or referrals from the comfort of your home.
Learning and growth: We encourage people to grow both personally and professionally, and support this through regular lunch & learns and an education stipend.
Pay transparency: We share with employees the pay range their role falls within and clear career maps to determine how they can grow within their role or level-up to a promotion.
Cool spaces: Our offices are in Vancouver, Montreal, Los Angeles, and San Francisco. Whether it’s summers on the rooftop patio in Downtown Vancouver, or watching the fireworks in Montreal’s South Shore - we want our people to feel like their time spent in office is worthwhile!
Giving back: Kabammers have a dedicated paid day off every year to volunteer to a cause close to their hearts. Some teams even band together for group volunteer days off-site!

Title: Advanced Data Analyst - EA SPORTS™ FC
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst, Experimentation Lead - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking an Advanced Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will lead the Experimentation program for FC Premium Analytics. You’ll also collaborate closely with data, production, and product management partners to drive informed decision-making within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of cultivating and uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data leader, driving design, implementation, and evaluation of numerous player-facing experiments.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Design and implement player-facing experimentation using best practices in a complex, live environment
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners
Explore user behavioral patterns through experimentation to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making
Act as a subject-matter expert in all things experimentation, helping to drive adoption of a data-driven, test-and-learn focused culture across FC’s development team


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research) or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making
Expert knowledge or equivalent practical experience in leading an experimentation function for a live product
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a strong plus.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$114,300 - $156,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Amazon Canada Fulfillment Services is hiring a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control / Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. The Data Analyst assigned to ICQA will work closely with the ICQA and operations teams in Inbound and Outbound to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, root cause investigation of defects, and will provide support to ensure compliance to ICQA-related SoX requirements.

The Data Analyst will own the insights, set up analysis, and create automated dashboards and reporting. They will be responsible for identifying data sources (internal / external) to invent and simplify mechanisms and create custom reporting and analytics automation tools.

Operating in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, you will be required to work autonomously, taking full control and responsibility for achieving business objectives. This role provides real opportunity to develop original ideas, approaches and solutions in an ever-changing and competitive business climate.

Key job responsibilities


Development of data collection processes and data management systems
Maintenance of data integrity (0% error rate)
Designing of queries, compiling of data, and generation of reports in MS Excel
Charting and graphing of data for reporting purposes
In depth research of defect trends
Data collection and entry as needed
Data mining and problem solving
Back up for Process Assistant duties


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of professional or military experience
Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Are 18 years of age or older
2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or an equivalent role experience
1+ years of using SQL to extract and manipulate data experience
Bachelor's degree, or High school or equivalent diploma
2+ years of professional work experience, or experience in MS Office, with an emphasis on Excel
Experience writing complex Excel VBA macros
Experience in advanced SQL, Python, Tableau
Experience demonstrating problem solving and root cause analysis
Experience with modern software development, web development frameworks, APIs
1+ years of project management experience


Preferred Qualifications


3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling
Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Supply Chain or related field.

Title: Senior Operations Data Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
Your opportunity

By joining the Kardium team, you can help make a difference in the lives of millions around the world. We have developed a ground-breaking medical device for the diagnosis and treatment of the most common heart rhythm disorder, atrial fibrillation – which can cause stroke, heart failure, and other heart-related complications.

Kardium’s mission is to deliver the best treatment for atrial fibrillation. To achieve this, we have developed The Globe® Pulsed Field System – we have a fantastic technical team that has developed a product with strong, unique, and customer-valued differentiators versus other solutions on the market. We have built connections with key opinion leaders who are already using the Globe System and are helping to tell our story.

We have obtained FDA approval and officially begun the commercial launch of the Globe® Pulsed Field System. This is a pivotal and exciting time in our journey, as we bring this life-changing technology to patients!

We are seeking an Operational Analyst who you will be responsible for delivering high-impact dashboards, metrics and reporting across various operational teams. You will play a critical role in enabling real-time operational visibility and data-informed decision-making, supporting both daily execution and strategic planning initiatives. The analyst will work cross-functionally with operations, purchasing, and quality teams, with a strong focus on data quality and continuity during our transition to Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP system.

Please note, this opportunity is a hybrid work arrangement, located in Burnaby, BC.

Meaningful work you will be a part of

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Develop and maintain critical operational metrics and key process indicators (KPIs) to support manufacturing, planning, and quality functions
Create and manage visual dashboards to provide real time insight into operational performance using tools such as Power BI and Excel
Provide analytical support for continuous improvement initiatives and projects to identify and prioritize optimization opportunities for cost reduction and performance improvements.
Query and extract relevant data from ERP and other data sources using SQL or other relevant tools.
Partner with cross-functional teams to identify data requirements and alignment with operational goals
Collaborate with stakeholders to develop scalable reporting frameworks and templates to support future growth.
Advise on data architecture and structure as systems evolve and new systems introduced, ensuring the right data is collected and accessible.
Lead initiatives to improve data quality and governance, identifying gaps and implementing data validation processes.
Train and support end-users in interpreting dashboard data and utilizing insights for decision-making.
Ensure data security and compliance with relevant regulations and company policies.


What You Bring To The Team

Our Kardium team is smart, creative, and passionate about developing cutting-edge medical devices to help improve people’s lives. We work in a collaborative environment based on trust and respect. We understand that only by working together can we solve what was thought unsolvable.

You will be successful in this role because you possess these attributes:


Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years experience in data analytics or reporting in a manufacturing or supply chain environment.
Advanced skills in Power BI, SQL and Excel.
Highly analytic and data driven with the ability to organize data and derive conclusions
Demonstrated experience building and maintaining dashboards and reporting systems used by cross-functional teams.
Strong understanding of operational process (manufacturing, supply chain) as well as key operations metrics (e.g., OEE, throughput, inventory turns, supplier performance).
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working with ERP systems (Microsoft D365 or equivalent is a strong asset).
Knowledge and experience working in the regulated manufacturing industry is an asset.


Compensation

Kardium has listed the total cash compensation range (base salary + 5% RRSP contribution) that we expect to pay applicants for this role, as of the time of this posting. Pay offered will be determined based on numerous relevant business and candidate factors including, for example, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, and business or organizational needs. For candidates with more or less experience than listed above, the pay range will be adjusted.

As a permanent employee, you will also participate in Kardium’s stock option plan.


$90,000 – 125,000 (CAD Annually)


Your Benefits & Well-being

The total cash we’ve listed for this position includes a base salary, plus an annual contribution to a Retirement Savings Plan account to help support your financial goals.

Comprehensive medical & dental coverage for all permanent employees – effective as of Day 1, with no waiting period.

Work-day flexibility – we offer a flexible work environment for daily working hours. In addition, we provide 3 personal days per year.

Support for you (and your dependents) overall well-being.

Family building – we provide top up for maternity leave, adoptive leave, and parental leave for non-birthing parents. Employees can also enroll in benefit coverage for fertility drug treatment.

Career progression and learning support.

Professional membership support.

Life at Kardium

What makes us a great place to work?


Our Purpose
Our People
Our Culture


At Kardium, we embrace diversity of background, experience, and perspective and we’re committed to inclusion and equity at every level. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of all communities.

We collaborate with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), as volunteer-led groups who share a common dimension of diversity and come together to provide support, education, and other opportunities across Kardium. Examples of our ERGs include Women ERG, Pride ERG, Race Ethnicity & Cultural Heritage (REACH) ERG, Truth & Reconciliation ERG, Persian ERG, Chinese ERG, Barangay Kardium (Filipino) ERG, Irish ERG, Brazilian ERG, and Early Career at Kardium ERG.

As part of your application, we encourage you to note if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations). There will be an optional section in the application form where you can provide this information to the recruitment team.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada's top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Enterprise Data Solutions team. In this role, you'll help build integrated, reliable, and scalable data solutions that support business decision-making across the organization. Working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Greenhouse, and Dayforce, you'll collaborate with business and technology partners to analyze data, support system integrations, improve data quality, and contribute to impactful enterprise-wide data initiatives. If you're curious, analytical, and enjoy working at the intersection of business, data, and technology, this could be an exciting next step in your career. Our offices operate on a hybrid model with three days per week in-office to support team collaboration.

What You Will Do


Analyze and profile data across enterprise systems to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into data solutions.
Support the design and development of scalable data models and data structures for reporting, analytics, and integrations.
Collaborate with data engineers and application teams to define and validate data transformation rules.
Test and validate REST APIs, integrations, and data flows between business applications and data platforms.
Perform data quality, reconciliation, and validation activities to ensure accuracy and completeness of information.
Develop and execute test cases for data mappings, APIs, and end-to-end integration processes.
Document data models, mappings, integration requirements, and technical processes.
Participate in Agile delivery activities, including testing, defect resolution, and release validation.
Help identify opportunities to improve data usability, consistency, and operational efficiency across the organization.


What You Bring


3-5 years of experience in data analysis, business systems analysis, data integration, or a related technology role.
Strong SQL skills with experience querying and analyzing relational data.
Experience working with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Dayforce, Greenhouse, or similar CRM, ATS, HRIS, or SaaS platforms.
Knowledge of relational data modelling concepts and data integration principles.
Experience working with and testing REST APIs, including JSON and API testing tools such as Postman.
Strong experience in data validation, reconciliation, and data quality analysis.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to document requirements, data mappings, testing activities, and technical processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.
Familiarity with Agile delivery practices and software development lifecycles.
Experience with Power BI or other reporting and analytics platforms.
Experience with Python or another scripting language.
Exposure to cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, or modern data technologies.
Experience working with HR, recruiting, CRM, finance, or other enterprise business data.
Financial services or other regulated industry experience.


The starting salary for this position is $110,000 - $130,000. The starting salary provided reflects the base salary for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation of this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

Title: Advanced Data Analyst - EA Sports FC Live
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst - FC Live Service Forecasting

Our FC Data & Analytics team is looking for an Advanced Analyst to join our group, leading forecasting and performance modelling for FC’s live service business. Reporting to a Senior Analytics Manager, you will be part of a growing team providing data and insights around player behaviour and live content performance within the FC franchise. We’re looking for someone who combines strong quantitative forecasting expertise with business intuition, bringing the ability to translate historical trends, player behaviour, and live content strategies into actionable projections that inform decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and live service operations - helping shape how FC plans and measures performance at scale.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Own the forecasting framework that underpins performance measurement, planning, and strategic decision-making across FC’s live service business.
Employ an extensive toolkit of financial modelling techniques, time series analysis, and a deep knowledge of their use cases.
Develop a robust model that projects our live service funnel metrics to a high degree of fidelity, incorporating player behaviour, in-game content, and macroeconomic trends.
Collaborate with partners across Product Management, Finance, and Commercial teams to align on projections, and keep the business updated on how our latest live service performance impacts our model’s assumptions.
Establish scalable forecasting processes that enable us to work with our cross-functional partners to efficiently & effectively refine our projections over time.
Lead presentations to diverse audiences including senior and executive level management, distilling complex model results into clear insights & recommendations.
Run risk and opportunity scenarios based on live content plans, new feature additions, and other potential changes in the FC product.
Mentor and collaborate with other analysts in order to collaboratively develop our forecasts, working together to drive evolutions in our modelling in this space.


What We're Looking For


A degree in a quantitative discipline (Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, or similar)
7+ years of experience in a data-driven role performing quantitative analysis with big data to help guide decisions
4+ years of experience developing financial/product performance projections and forecasts using various modelling techniques
Strong experience in statistical and/or time series modelling for predictive purposes
Expertise in SQL and working with large-scale, complex datasets
Proficient in analyzing large datasets using programmatic tools (e.g. Python, R)
Experience with data visualization software (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI)
Strong capabilities in project management processes
Very comfortable presenting analysis in an executive facing environment


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$114,300 - $156,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
