Join the EDC Team!

At EDC, we support Canadian businesses to succeed globally. We provide the financial tools and expertise they need to explore new markets, reduce risks, all towards the goal of making Canada and the world better through trade.

Position: Sr Reporting Analyst

Employment Type: Contract

Compensation Details:


Data Analyst 18: Salaries typically range from $96,557 to $128,743 annually, based on qualifications and experiences


Location:


Export Development Canada operates under a hybrid work model, with employees currently required to work from the office two days per week. Effective September 2026, this requirement will increase to three days per week and will be implemented gradually through a phased approach based on employee location. (subject to change).
This role can be performed from EDC's headquarters in Ottawa or from one of our community hubs located in Montreal, Toronto, Mississauga, Brossard, Laval, Calgary, Edmonton, Vancouver, or Halifax


Internal Employees, please consult the ServiceNow article entitled Internal movements - what you need to know.

About EDC:

At Export Development Canada (EDC), we empower Canadian businesses to succeed globally. As a financial Crown corporation, we offer innovative financial solutions and expert insights to help businesses explore new markets, mitigate risks, and achieve growth.

Why Join EDC?


Comprehensive Benefits: EDC offers a competitive compensation & benefits package, work-life balance, & the opportunity to help make Canada and the world better through trade
Work-Life Balance: EDC offers a competitive compensation package & work-life balance. We have hybrid work options, 3 to 4 weeks paid vacation, a corporate closure period, summer early Friday's & no meeting Fridays
Professional Development: Take advantage of our continuous learning opportunities, including training programs, workshops and language training
Inclusive Culture: Be part of a diverse and inclusive workplace that champions employment equity & values diversity of ideas, strengths, & backgrounds to succeed
Wellness Programs: Access to wellness initiatives, mental health support, and fitness programs to keep you healthy and happy
Community Engagement: Participate in volunteer opportunities and give back to the community through our various social responsibility programs


Team Overview:

The Digital & Technology Solutions (DTS) group under the leadership of the Chief Information Officer was established in 2023 with the mission of empowering our customers and colleagues to take on the world, by seamlessly delivering secure and reliable digital experiences. Digital & Technology Solutions has set out to achieve the following objectives for EDC:


Define, execute, and sustain the integrated technology target state, target data model and technology operations required to enable EDC's 2030 business transformation
Establish and manage the rolling 3 Year Digital Roadmap that sequences the technology outcomes required to achieve the technology target state and facilitate its execution across all domains in the organization
Keep pace with industry trends and emerging technologies, ensuring EDC has access to the digital technology tools it needs to stay relevant in the market and grow Canadian global trade
Lead and ensure integrated digital, data, infrastructure, and cybersecurity implementations to create excellent customer, user, and employee experiences


The Data Transformation Initiative team oversees transformation initiatives to enable business areas across EDC to make timely, informed decisions through trusted reporting, analytics, and data products. As EDC continues to modernize its reporting ecosystem, this role will support the migration and modernization of legacy Cognos reports to Microsoft Power BI/Fabric.

What you will be doing:

The Reporting Analyst will play a key role in assessing, rationalizing, redesigning, and rebuilding existing Cognos reporting assets on the Power BI platform. The successful candidate will work closely with business users, data teams, technology partners, and report owners to understand current-state reporting needs, document data and business logic, validate source-to-target mappings, and build Power BI reports and semantic models that meet EDC standards for governance, performance, usability, and supportability.


Analyze existing Cognos reports, packages, queries, prompts, calculations, filters, security requirements, and usage patterns to determine migration scope and complexity.
Work with business stakeholders to confirm reporting requirements, identify redundant or low-value reports, and recommend opportunities for consolidation, redesign, or retirement.
Document current-state report logic, data sources, field mappings, report layouts, dependencies, and business rules.
Design and develop Power BI reports, dashboards, paginated reports, and semantic models that align with EDC reporting standards and business needs.
Transform and validate data using SQL, Power Query, DAX, and approved enterprise data sources, ensuring accuracy and traceability from legacy reports to new Power BI outputs.
Support user acceptance testing, reconcile results between Cognos and Power BI, investigate variances, and document testing outcomes.
Collaborate with data engineering, architecture, governance, and platform teams to ensure reports are secure, performant, maintainable, and aligned with EDC's target data architecture.
Prepare report inventory updates, technical documentation, user guidance, and knowledge transfer materials for support teams and business users.
Contribute to migration planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, status reporting, and issue/risk tracking.
Support production deployment, post-implementation validation, and transition of migrated reports into ongoing support.


What we are looking for:


Undergraduate degree in Business, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Data Analytics, Finance, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum of 7 years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, developing large scale reporting/analytics in enterprise analytics platforms such as Cognos, Tableau, Power BI or similar
Experience working with Microsoft Fabric
Experience developing Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, or paginated reports.
Experience analyzing, reverse engineering, or migrating reports from IBM Cognos Analytics to Power BI: Report Studio, Framework Manager, Cognos packages, prompts, and audit/usage analysis.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases, data marts, data warehouses, or enterprise data platforms.
Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, document business logic, validate results, and communicate findings to both technical and business audiences.
Experience supporting report testing, reconciliation, defect resolution, and stakeholder sign-off


What will make you stand out:


You can quickly understand complex legacy reports and translate them into modern, user-friendly analytics products.
You balance business context with technical detail, ensuring that migrated reports are not simply replicated but improved where appropriate.
You communicate clearly with report users, developers, architects, and platform teams, helping bridge business needs and technical implementation.
Experience working in financial services, insurance, banking, Crown corporations, or regulated reporting environments.
Experience with data governance, metadata documentation, lineage, report inventory management, and controlled report retirement.
Familiarity with Agile delivery, Azure DevOps, backlog management, and iterative report development.
Bilingualism in both official languages, English and French


Eligibility:

EDC is committed to Fair Employment Practices and preference will be given to a candidate who is able to work legally in Canada at the time of application (Canadian Citizens or Permanent Residents). Candidates must meet the requisite government security screening requirements. Internal applicants must also meet EDC's eligibility criteria for applying to internal opportunities. For more information, please refer to Section 2.1 in the Talent Acquisition Standard, available on LINK under the Resources tab in the Policies & Procedures section. The position is open to those who meet all of the essential requirements stated above and whose applications are received by the closing date. The position is open to those who meet all of the essential requirements stated above and whose applications are received by the closing date.

EDC's Commitment to Employment Equity

Export Development Canada (EDC) is dedicated to fostering employment equity and building a diverse workforce. We are committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment that respects people from all cultures, backgrounds, and abilities. At EDC, we nurture a culture of inclusion and belonging where everyone has equal opportunity to grow, develop, succeed, and be their truest selves.

We actively encourage applications from women, Indigenous peoples, visible minorities, persons with disabilities, and members of the 2SLGBTQI+ community.

Your application must clearly demonstrate how you meet all the requirements. We thank all applicants' interest in a career at EDC; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Please note that qualified candidates may be considered for similar roles at this level within EDC.

EDC recognizes that disclosing the need for accommodations can be a personal matter. Please know that as an organization, we are committed to maintaining confidentiality and ensuring that any accommodations provided are tailored to support your needs. Our aim is to ensure you have a comfortable and positive experience throughout the recruitment process, so please do not hesitate to contact us directly for any accommodation requests at accessibility@edc.ca. We are here to support you every step of the way.

By applying for this job you acknowledge that you have read and understood EDC's Privacy Notice for Job Applicants, which outlines how we collect, use, retain, and safeguard personal information during the recruitment process, as well as your rights of access and correction

  • Prepare report inventory updates, technical documentation, user guidance, and knowledge transfer materials for support teams and business users.
  • Contribute to migration planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, status reporting, and issue/risk tracking.
  • Support production deployment, post-implementation validation, and transition of migrated reports into ongoing support.

  • Undergraduate degree in Business, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Data Analytics, Finance, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, developing large scale reporting/analytics in enterprise analytics platforms such as Cognos, Tableau, Power BI or similar
  • Experience working with Microsoft Fabric
  • Experience developing Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, or paginated reports.
  • Experience analyzing, reverse engineering, or migrating reports from IBM Cognos Analytics to Power BI: Report Studio, Framework Manager, Cognos packages, prompts, and audit/usage analysis.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases, data marts, data warehouses, or enterprise data platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, document business logic, validate results, and communicate findings to both technical and business audiences.
  • Experience supporting report testing, reconciliation, defect resolution, and stakeholder sign-off

  • You balance business context with technical detail, ensuring that migrated reports are not simply replicated but improved where appropriate.
  • You communicate clearly with report users, developers, architects, and platform teams, helping bridge business needs and technical implementation.
  • Experience working in financial services, insurance, banking, Crown corporations, or regulated reporting environments.

26WD100682, Spécialiste en analyse marketing

Aperçu du Poste

En tant que spécialiste des analyses marketing, vous contribuerez à établir des liens entre les différents points de contact clients, numériques et non numériques, chez Autodesk, afin de générer des résultats commerciaux clés. Vous aurez l’opportunité d’influencer directement la croissance du marketing et du commerce électronique, ainsi que d’améliorer l’expérience client. Ce poste est fortement transversal et collaboratif ; vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des parties prenantes internationales ainsi qu’avec d’autres équipes en dehors de votre structure immédiate.

Il s'agit d'une opportunité de carrière passionnante pour un(e) analyste marketing chevronné(e) et doté(e) d'un sens aigu des affaires, animé(e) par la passion de l'analyse, de la mise en valeur des données et de l'amélioration de l'impact du marketing sur l'activité, ainsi que de l'amélioration de l'expérience client et des résultats. Si vous recherchez un poste stimulant, mais aussi très gratifiant et à fort impact, alors poursuivez votre lecture !

Responsabilités


Prendre en charge divers projets d’analyse liés au numérique, au marketing et au commerce électronique afin d’accompagner les équipes internationales à l’aide de données, de tableaux de bord et d’informations sur les éléments standards du cycle de vie des clients par abonnement, notamment l’acquisition, la fidélisation et l’expansion
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires commerciaux et les membres de l’équipe pour explorer divers sujets, tels que les opportunités de marché, les parcours sectoriels/produits, la contribution du numérique, l’entonnoir d’achat et les analyses du comportement client, afin d’en extraire des informations précieuses
Collecter, analyser et visualiser les données à l’aide d’outils permettant d’exploiter et de synthétiser efficacement les informations pour présenter un récit concis et exploitable, et communiquer des conclusions qui éclairent les décisions commerciales
Collaborer de manière proactive et efficace avec d’autres équipes d’Autodesk afin d’harmoniser les indicateurs et les définitions. Identifier les éventuelles lacunes dans les mesures et/ou les indicateurs, définir les rapports et analyses supplémentaires requis et rationaliser les rapports existants
Encourager l’autogestion et permettre aux parties prenantes de mieux comprendre les données


Qualifications Minimales


Solides aptitudes logiques, avec la capacité de présenter des données complexes sous forme de récits et de visualisations simples, concis et captivants qui mettent les informations clés en avant.
Un sixième sens pour les « données pertinentes », avec la capacité de trouver des solutions créatives mais pragmatiques à des problèmes liés aux données.
Esprit d’initiative, capable de prendre des initiatives et ayant fait ses preuves dans la collaboration et l’influence auprès des parties prenantes et des partenaires commerciaux de manière transversale.
Attitude positive et volontariste – Capacité à faire preuve de flexibilité et d’ouverture face aux changements d’exigences, d’orientations ou de circonstances, avec un besoin minimal de réorientation


Qualifications Souhaitées


Solides connaissances de l’environnement numérique et marketing (e-commerce), avec une expérience des indicateurs et analyses liés au marketing, au e-commerce ou aux modèles d’abonnement
Capacité à réfléchir de manière stratégique aux problèmes commerciaux concrets dans le domaine du marketing et à les mettre en corrélation avec les données sous-jacentes afin de mener des analyses approfondies et d’identifier des solutions innovantes
Solides compétences en matière de présentation et d’expression orale, avec une expérience des présentations devant la direction
Solide expérience des outils de visualisation tels que Power BI (y compris DAX), Tableau, etc.
Solides bases en manipulation de données à l’aide de SQL ainsi que d’Excel avancé (visualisation, tableaux croisés dynamiques, etc.) ; une expérience des macros et/ou de VBA constitue un atout certain
Expérience en analyse web avec des outils tels qu’Adobe Analytics ou Google Analytics
Une expérience en modélisation analytique et dans les langages de programmation associés (R, Python) est un atout


26WD100682, Marketing Insights Specialist

Position Overview

As a Marketing Insights Specialist, you will help connect the dots across various digital and non digital customer touch points at Autodesk that lead to key business outcomes. You will have the opportunity to directly influence Marketing and eComm growth and improve customer experience. This position is highly cross-functional and collaborative, working closely with global stakeholders as well as other teams outside of the immediate organization.

If you are searching for a challenging, yet highly rewarding role with great impact, then read on!

Responsibilities


Take ownership of a variety of Digital, Marketing and eCommerce related analytics projects to support global teams with data, dashboards and insights around standard Subscription customer life cycle elements including acquisition, retention and expansion
Work closely with business partners and team members to explore a variety of topics, such as market opportunity, industry/product journeys, digital contribution, purchase funnel and customer behavior analyses to extract valuable insights
Source, analyze and visualize data using tools to effectively mine and condense insights to tell a concise and actionable story and communicate findings that inform business decisions
Collaborate proactively and effectively with other Autodesk teams to align on metrics and definitions. Identify any gaps in measurements and/or metrics, define the additional reports and analyses required and streamline existing reporting
Encourage self-service and enable stakeholders to better understand data


Minimum Qualifications


Strong logical aptitude with the ability to present complex data as simple, concise, and engaging stories and visualizations that bring insights to the forefront.
Sixth sense for “meaningful data” with the ability to find creative, yet pragmatic solutions to data-oriented problems.
Self-starter, who takes initiative and demonstrated success in working with and influencing stakeholders, business partners cross-functionally.
Positive, can-do attitude – Ability to be flexible and open to changes in requirements, directions or circumstances with minimal need for reorientation


Preferred Qualifications


Solid knowledge of digital and marketing (eCommerce) environment with experience in related Marketing, eComm or Subscription model-based metrics and analytics
Ability to think strategically about real-world business problems in Marketing and co-relate them with underlying data to conduct deeper analyses and identify innovative solutions
Strong presentation and language skills with experience presenting to upper management
Strong experience in visualization tools such as Power BI (including DAX), Tableau etc.
Solid foundation in manipulating data using SQL as well as advanced Excel (visualization, pivot tables etc.), experience with macros and/or VBA is a definite plus
Experience in web analytics with tools such as Adobe Analytics or Google Analytics
Experience with analytical modelling and related programming languages (R, Python) a plus

Title: System and Data Analyst
Description:
Description

This position is open until filled. To ensure consideration, applications should be received by Monday, August 24.

Applications must have direct, hands-on experience with Yardi software to be considered.

The Systems and Data Analyst position performs advanced technical work developing and implementing solutions that support the Authority’s business strategy. This position serves as an all-tier support for the agencies Yardi system, including issue documentation, user account and access management, workflow support, and resolution of technical problems. The Analyst will triage, troubleshoot, and resolve software incident; support testing of updates and system changes; and debug reports, queries, and code.

Other Essential Functions Include But Are Not Limited To


Designing, developing, and maintaining operational and management reports, forms, letters, and statistical outputs; ensuring data accuracy through research, validation, and quality control.
Analyze and document business process and system workflows; evaluate system efficiency and ensure compatibility of in-house and SaaS applications.
Manage test environments and coordinate date refreshes.
Create, modify, and maintain SQL queries, scripts, reports, and data imports/exports; monitor system jobs and take corrective action as needed.
Develop and update software applications by converting specifications into code, compiling programs, and resolving errors.
Providing technical support for application and data-related issues; collaborate with IT team members to troubleshoot and resolve software, database, and system problems.
Work with end users to identify, document, and resolve root causes of system or process issues, ensuring timely and effective solutions.
Train end users and technical support staff on system functionality, workflow, and best practices.


Pay And Benefits

In compliance with the Equal Pay & Opportunities Act, the full salary range for the Systems and Data Analyst position is $85,020 to $127,530. Starting salary is determined by the required qualifications for the role and the candidate’s relevant experience. This is a full-time exempt position working primarily in office Monday through Friday.

We offer a generous contribution toward health care: 100% paid for employees’ only medical and vision coverage, 85% paid for dependent tier coverage. 100% paid for dental. Up to 26 days of accrued paid time off annually in the first year (13 vacation/13 sick days), and 12 paid holidays. This position is required to participate in Washington PERS (Public Employee Retirement Services).

Requirements

Knowledge and Attributes


Strong understanding of data administration and management functions, including data collection, analysis, and distribution.
Ability to improve system business processes using recognized process-improvement techniques.
Familiarity with modern database and information-system technologies.
Knowledge of program evaluation and outcome-based assessment methods.
Ability to work effectively with others, participate as a team member, communicate constructively, and navigate conflict professionally.
Skill in analyzing problems, identifying solutions, evaluating alternatives, and implementing recommendations aligned with organizational goals.
Ability to perform highly detailed work accurately and efficiently, organize tasks effectively, and work independently despite frequent interruptions.
Strong project-planning and organizational skills, with the ability to meet schedules and timelines and work with minimal direction.
Proficiency with data-analysis tools and programming languages such as SQL.
Experience with database-management systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Effective communication skills to explain complex or technical information to non-technical users.
Knowledge of modern office procedures, methods, and equipment, including computers and common word-processing and spreadsheet applications.


Job Skills

Technical skills


SQL (writing queries, joins, CTWs, optimization)
Microsoft Windows and Windows Server Operating Systems
Microsoft Azure
Cloud Platforms
Microsoft 365 Suite
Online Exchange
Windows Virtual Desktop
SharePoint
Networking and Security
System and Network Configuration
Virtualization
Backup and Disaster Recovery

Title: Junior Analyst, Career Launch Program
Description:
Hiive is redefining how private companies and their shareholders access liquidity. Through its institutional-grade platform, Hiive brings together buyers, sellers, and issuers to facilitate secondary transactions in venture-backed, pre-IPO companies, introducing efficiency, transparency, and standardization to an otherwise opaque asset class.

Recognized as one of Canada’s fastest-growing companies and backed by leading U.S. investors, Hiive is profitable, well-capitalized, and building a high-performance team to meet growing demand and pursue new market opportunities.

Interested in learning more about life at Hiive? Check out our careers page to see how you can grow with us!

Are you the kind of person who's always raising your hand for the toughest challenge? Do you thrive in fast-paced environments, learn quickly, and want to build a career where finance meets technology?

We're looking for exceptional new graduates and early career professionals to join Hiive as Junior Analysts. This is an opportunity to accelerate your career by working alongside experienced operators, supporting high-impact initiatives, and gaining exposure to multiple areas of our business. You'll tackle meaningful work from day one, take ownership of real projects, and develop the analytical, operational, and client-facing skills that define top performers in financial services.

The strongest candidates won't just execute — they'll ask great questions, solve problems, and continuously look for ways to improve how we work. You will gain exposure to many aspects of the private securities industry.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Include


Supporting live transactions and marketplace activity across Hiive's business.
Analyzing data, building reports, and generating insights that help drive business decisions.
Partnering with teams across Marketplace, Institutional Markets, Operations, and Client & Transaction Services to deliver exceptional client outcomes.
Maintaining accurate records and workflows using Salesforce and Hiive's internal systems.
Identifying opportunities to improve processes and help implement scalable solutions.
Working closely with experienced team members who will mentor and challenge you as you grow.
Taking on increasing ownership and responsibility as you demonstrate impact.


Required Skills


Recently completed (or are completing) an undergraduate degree in any discipline with an exceptional GPA (transcript required).
A proven track record of excellence, whether through academics, athletics, leadership, entrepreneurship, or extracurricular activities.
Internship, co-op, or work experience where you've demonstrated initiative, accountability, and strong execution.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in Excel.
Demonstrated experience using generative AI tools to solve complex problems.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Curiosity, humility, and a desire to learn quickly in a high-performance environment.
Excited to work in person from Hiive's Vancouver headquarters.


Preferred Skills


Internship or coursework in finance, business, economics, engineering, or another quantitative field.
Experience using Salesforce or other CRM platforms.
Interest in private markets, venture capital, startups, or financial technology.


Compensation: Highly competitive compensation commensurate with experience and contribution.


Vancouver, BC: $65,000-$85,000


For this role, the estimated total compensation range is listed above. The actual base salary, variable bonus (if applicable), and options grant will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the range for this role may be modified.

Benefits & Perks


Opportunity to participate in ownership of a rapidly growing company through our employee stock option plan.
Comprehensive 100% employer-paid health & dental premiums and a Health/Personal Spending Account for Canadian employees. (An employer-subsidized benefits program is available for US-based team members).
If you are based in Vancouver, enjoy a dedicated desk in our Vancouver, BC HQ, in the heart of downtown, with a fridge stocked with healthy snacks and drinks, an onsite gym, and a gorgeous rooftop amenity.
Vancouver based employees enjoy a $20-per-day commuter benefit for every day you work in our downtown HQ.
An engaging social calendar, including bi-weekly catered lunches, bi-weekly “Friday bar,” team workouts, annual summer party, and holiday party, two “onsite” all-team retreats each year, semi-annual team-building events, and Hiive Women’s Network events.
Significant opportunities for growth into team leadership and management roles.
Entrepreneurial culture and a small and dynamic team.
Sponsorship, immigration, and relocation for exceptional candidates.


Hiive is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed.

AI, Automated Tools, And Applicant Privacy Notice

As part of our recruitment and hiring process, Hiive may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to assist in screening applications, evaluating candidate qualifications, and supporting interview processes. These tools are designed to support and inform human decision-making and are not used as the sole basis for any employment decision.

We may collect, use, and analyze personal information you provide in connection with your application, including generating insights or inferences to assess job-related qualifications. This information is used for recruitment, evaluation, and compliance purposes in accordance with applicable law.

We take reasonable steps to evaluate and monitor our hiring tools and practices to promote fairness, consistency, and non-discrimination. Where required by applicable law - including in Ontario, Quebec, New York City, Illinois, and California - we conduct or rely on assessments such as bias audits, honor rights related to automated decision-making, and provide additional disclosures on request.

Depending on your location, you may have certain rights with respect to your personal information and the use of automated processing, including the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your information, or to receive additional information about our data practices. We honor such rights where required by applicable law.

For accommodation requests or questions about this notice, contact careers@hiive.com.

As the province’s largest energy provider with more than 100 years of knowledge and experience, we proudly deliver renewable energy, natural gas, electricity and propane to 1.3 million customers.

We're actively seeking new talent to join our mission of delivering a stronger energy future in B.C. As one of BC's Top Employers with a diverse team of over 2,700 employees, we are committed to a safe and inclusive culture where each of us can connect, belong, and grow. Join us, and together, let's shape a brighter future for B.C.

Position Overview

You’re a sharp analytical thinker with a knack for leveraging utility planning optimization software tools. Along with your love for quantitative analysis, you’re a numbers guru who excels in forecasting and modelling analyses.

In this role, you will:


Ensure the execution of strategies at the departmental and organizational level, both for analytical and regulatory submissions, that support business priorities.
Strengthen internal modelling expertise and capabilities while strategically guiding and integrating third-party consultant analyses into resource planning activities.
Analyze markets, energy utility planning environment, customer energy use, and provide useful qualitative and comparative insights.
Support workshops between our Gas and Electric utility resource planning analyses and reporting activities.
Collaborate with internal and external cross-functional experts to use energy demand and other business data to support recommendations on planning and project strategies.


What it takes:


A degree in economics, computer science, finance, business administration, or a related resource development field.
A minimum of four years of related analytical experience.
A demonstrated ability to learn coding languages such as R, Python, or other.
Prior experience with optimization models, production cost analytics, and macroeconomic modeling through software such as Plexos, Aurora, Navius, or other energy modelling tools is an asset.
Strong attention to detail and organization skills to conduct accurate analyses and forecasts.
Excellent interpersonal and time management skills to develop and deliver presentations with succinct recommendations and supported strategic arguments.


In this role, you will have the option to participate in a flexible work program, enabling you to work from an approved flex location in British Columbia up to 85 days a year (equivalent to approximately two days a week), subject to business or operational needs.

Our engaging workplace offers a wide range of challenging opportunities, while being safe, inclusive, and diverse. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, while supporting life-long career development. We also encourage volunteerism and nourish the need to give back to your community.

Title: Data Support Senior Consultant
Description:
Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

The Central Data Support Team (CDST) is a part of the national audit center, audit support team. The CDST is tasked with implementing new technologies in the audit practice and providing digital and data & analytics services to our clients. The group works as part of a multi-disciplinary team providing and supporting KPMG proprietary and third-party data & analytics solutions to our teams.

Support consultants will work as part of the CDST to assist clients facing teams with data extraction, transformation, and load capabilities into our various audit tools. In addition, they provide critical support with data analysis, reporting and data visualization. This work will enable us to deliver innovative solutions to our clients.

This position requires written and oral fluency in English. The successful candidate may be required to support or collaborate with English-speaking colleagues or stakeholders while at KPMG. The successful candidate may be required to create, interpret and/or apply policies, practices, laws and and/or regulations during the regular course of their employment.

What You Will Do


Work with audit engagement teams to support the use of Data and Analytics (D&A) in the performance of external audits including data acquisition, movement and transformation; utilize a range of technologies and data capabilities such as Alteryx, SQL, Python, PySpark, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake Storage, Power BI and other Azure technologies
Communicate the technical implications of D&A capabilities to audit engagement teams; identify issues / challenges, and provide recommendations, opportunities, and mitigation strategies
Work with audit engagement teams to scope D&A capabilities, review analytic results and deliver innovative solutions that enhance audit planning and execution.
Collaborate with client technology teams to understand ERP environments and data architecture, assess the technical implications of data acquisition and analysis, and deliver clear, well‑structured audit documentation across the D&A lifecycle, while building long‑term client relationships through high-quality engagement delivery and professional networking
Participate in business development by identifying new opportunities and assisting with proposal development for a high-quality technology and data enabled audit


What You Bring To The Role


Bachelors or Diploma in Computer Science, Database Management, Data Programming, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, or other IT-related degree;
Strong database proficiency (e.g., SQL, My SQL, Oracle etc.) and experience in Microsoft SQL Server technology, MSBI suite (including SQL stored procedures and data modeling) or cloud technologies (Azure suite, Databricks pipelines in Python) for financial analysis
SQL code scripting, including creation/implementation of API’s and debugging ability.
Proficiency and knowledgeable with analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, Python, R, Alteryx, Microsoft PowerApps is preferred.
Knowledge of data extraction tools and utilities and aptitude to quickly learn various technologies (MS Office, ERP systems, KPMG Audit tools, client applications, Azure cloud technologies)
Strong communication skills (verbal and written) - ability to work with multiple stakeholders and communicate priorities/ manage expectations
Proven time management and organizational skills
Comfortable managing diverse responsibilities from day to day administrative and operational work to project and deadline driven tasks
Resourceful and creative problem-solving skills- you are proactive and always bring new ideas and ways of working forward
Ideal candidate has experience in the Accounting and/or Finance industry Keys to your success
Ability to clearly articulate, identify and define problems and develop creative and practical solutions to address different and unique client requirements
Able to employ sound professional judgment and professional skepticism; flexible and adaptable team player; leadership experience; resourceful in delivering high-quality, detail-oriented deliverables; ability to demonstrate sound organization and project management skills


KPMG Ontario Region pay range information

The expected base salary range for this position is $66,500 to $101,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills, & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program.

KPMG BC Region Pay Range Information

The expected base salary range for this position is $59,500 to $94,500 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills, & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program.

Providing you with the support you need to be at your best

Our Values, The KPMG Way

Integrity, we do what is right | Excellence, we never stop learning and improving | Courage, we think and act boldly | Together, we respect each other and draw strength from our differences | For Better, we do what matters

KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice.

This position plays a key role as an experienced senior data engineer and analyst to design, develop, and support enterprise-scale data platforms and solutions.

Development and Analysis:

Dashboard and Reporting:

Documentation & Collaboration:

Collaborate with business users and functional analysts to gather requirements.
Use AI tools like Cursor or Claude to document data flows, transformations, and business rules to support transparency and sustainability.

An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.
Effective oral and written communication skills.
Must have demonstrated specific current IT knowledge.
Proven commitment to providing and maintaining the highest level of customer service.
Proven analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage changing priorities and meet deadlines.
Ability to work effectively as part of a team and with cross-departmental groups.
Ability to learn quickly and apply new knowledge and techniques.
Commitment to ongoing professional development.
High level of professionalism and ethical responsibility, particularly in the handling of institutional data.




Qualifications Specifics:

Proficiency Oracle PL/SQL or T-SQL, and stored procedures for querying, data manipulation, and analysis in large, complex databases environment.
Experience in MS Fabric platform including data factory, and One Lake.
Proficiency with DAX, Power Query and Microsoft Power BI.
Solid understanding of data governance principles, data quality, and data lifecycle management
Experience in enterprise or corporate data modeling with strong understanding of dimensional modelling, analytical data structures and reporting requirements
Experience with data analysis, profiling, and validation techniques
Experience designing and creating SSIS and executing ETL/ELT processes to support enterprise reporting and analytics platforms.
Familiarity with data integration tools, orchestration platforms, or pipelines used in enterprise environments.
Experience working in agile or hybrid delivery environments.




Nice-to-Have Qualifications:

Hands-on experience working with a post-secondary ERP, preferably Ellucian Banner ERP, including understanding of core data structures and functional modules.
Experience with Ellucian Ethos and Ethos Data Models.
Experience supporting Banner SaaS implementations or migrations.
Experience working with post-secondary institutional data standards and regulatory reporting.
Experience with data governance or metadata management tools.
Familiarity with JIRA or similar work management tools.
Experience with other analytics tools like Tableau, Ellucian Insights, and Argos.

Title: Quantitative Equity Analyst Process Engineering
Description:
We are looking for a Quantitative Equity Analyst to join our Quantitative Equity Team! We are a high-performance team embedded in a top-performing quantitative equity fund that manages over $78+ billion USD in financial assets. We are dedicated to the mission-critical operation of our investment engine—a well-tuned machine responsible for generating key decisions that drive trades and investment insights. Leveraging finance skills and cutting-edge technology, we ensure data quality, continuous process improvement, and operational excellence.

As a core member of our team, you'll collaborate with investment experts to tackle challenging analytical problems, be accountable to ensure accurate and timely trade generation, and drive operational innovation. Based in West Coast Vancouver, we value mentorship, collaboration, and growth in a supportive and innovative environment. Join us to make a significant impact on our investment engine and overall success.

What You Will Do

This is an exciting full-time role for individuals who are passionate about learning the quantitative equity investment management business and excited to tackle a broad range of investment, mathematical, and technology challenges.

You will start with a comprehensive training program, learning about various elements of quantitative equity investment management and our investment process.

You will then continue to a specialized role utilizing data science and process engineering skillsets to accelerate the Quantitative Equities Team’s various investment functions. Your specialized role may involve building, scaling, managing and/or analyzing our quantitative model, portfolios, data assets and optimizers.

You will be supported with coaching and mentorship from senior members of the team.

We are creating the conditions for you to grow your career steadily over time.

Investment Process Management

The team you will be joining is our Investment Process Management (IPM) group within our Quantitative Equities Team. IPM plays a central role in building highly scalable, efficient, and robust process management systems. The processes and infrastructure we maintain are critical in the team’s ability to develop systematic investment insights and generate daily trades to capture these insights in portfolios. The opportunity within the IPM group allows ambitious individuals to drive their career growth within IPM, or across the other functions of the Quantitative Equities Team in Research, Portfolio Construction, or Trading.

Skills

While we take the approach of tailoring the career path for the individual, we have found our functions to cover two main overarching technical skillsets:

Process and Reliability Engineering


Design, implement and test production processes to run the alpha and risk, portfolio optimization and market implementation processes.
Design robust, high performance and effective process orchestration.
Monitor production health and respond to critical issues in a timely manner.
Effectively communicate real-time production issues to portfolio managers, traders and researchers.
Identify computational bottle necks and improve run speeds in production systems.
Collaborate with investment teams to ensure their process needs are being met.
Find and evaluate areas for process improvements.
Assess and evaluate data quality of production processes.
Maintain process repos, clean code and tools within production processes.


Data Science


Construct and run algorithms to explore and assess data effectively.
Validate structured and unstructured data sets for data quality.
Design and test data loaders and security matching processes and specifications.
Perform data analysis and provide data expertise to support researcher’s projects.
Facilitate production machine learning operational pipelines with effective and timely auditing and analysis.
Enable accessibility and clarity within our data assets through robust documentation and data scrubbing.
Develop robust methodologies for assessing and analyzing data in time critical production environments.
Respond to and mitigate vendor data issues effectively in a production setting.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate traditional and alternative data into existing analytical frameworks and decision-making processes.
Present findings and recommendations to key stakeholders in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.


What You Bring


Analytical Mindset – You think critically and creatively and are adept at balancing intuition with statistical validation.
Financial Knowledge – You possess a thorough understanding of (or strong desire to learn) key drivers of business success, including financial theory, economic models, and corporate financial statements.
Self-Starter – You are motivated and willing to take personal accountability for quality and timeliness of work.
Collaborative Approach – You thrive in a collaborative environment and value shared success. You proactively solicit and provide input and excel at communicating complex and technical concepts.
Time Management – You have the ability to manage and prioritize multiple ongoing projects and daily responsibilities.
Academic Training – At a minimum, an undergraduate degree in finance, mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or related discipline. Completion of CFA or relevant graduate degree is considered an asset.
Industry Experience – You have a passion for quantitative finance, equity investment, data science or related fields.


We welcome applications from candidates with different levels of experience, including interns, new graduates, and experienced professionals. The base salary range for full-time roles is $125,000 – $200,000 annually plus a competitive performance bonus. Compensation will be determined based on experience and qualifications.

To apply for this position, please submit your resume, cover letter, and academic transcript.

Learn more by exploring our website: www.cclimq.com

CC&L Financial Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or expression, disability, or age. 

Your application will be reviewed by a member of the hiring team - AI is not used in the screening, assessment or selection of applications at this time.

Title: Senior Associate, Strategy & Operations - Integrity (International)
Description:
About the Team

The Integrity team is seeking a Strategy & Operations Senior Associate to help reduce fraud costs and drive solutions that safeguard the integrity of our platform. In this role, you'll develop a deep understanding of our three core audiences—Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants—and become a key resource for analyzing behaviors that may indicate risky or abusive patterns. You'll lead investigations into high-risk activity, design data-informed strategies, and implement cross-functional initiatives to mitigate losses while maintaining a seamless and trusted user experience. Most importantly, you'll help strike the right balance between user trust and risk management, ensuring we continue to support growth while protecting the platform.

About the Role

Our best Senior Associates are data-driven, truth seeking, strategic thought partners and operators. They combine business context and analytics to take on a problem area and implement a customized solution. Think this is you? Read on…

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Establish and refine DoorDash's strategic approach to payments, credit and refund risks - work on the operations, engineering, and analytics needed to protect DoorDash's audiences from bad actors
Analyze user behavior across DoorDash's platform – complete end-to-end analysis that allows us to better identify the bad actors and improve the experience of good users
Influence and engage across the company - partner with the product, engineering, and analytics teams to establish goals and build strategic programs
Improve through experimentation – use data-driven decision-making to run tests in order to reduce risk while accelerating growth


We're excited about you because…


2+ years of experience in consulting, strategy, business development, operations, technology, investment banking, analytics or related experience
Experience leading projects, hitting goals, and succeeding in a team environment
Strong communicator, both written and verbal
Problem solving and analytical skills, including proficiency in SQL and expertise in Excel (can maintain complex spreadsheets/sheets)
You have a bachelor's degree


Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That's why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.

Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.

$97,000—$121,000 CAD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Title: Actuarial Analyst
Description:
We’re searching for an Actuarial Analyst. Are you searching for new possibilities?

Westland Insurance Group Ltd is growing and has an exciting opportunity for an Actuarial Analyst to join our growing team. This hybrid role is based out of our Head Office in Surrey, BC.

Expected Compensation: The expected hiring range for this role is $80,000- $105,000 with a 35-hour work week. Your rate of pay will be determined based on your individual qualifications and experience, while considering internal equity.  Westland also offers a competitive annual short-term incentive program that enables employees to share in the rewards of the business and emphasizes the measures that are key to our success.

Discover What’s Possible, With Westland.

The Westland story is all about growth, and that means plenty of possibility for everyone on our team. Every day, Westland proves that building a great business means taking care of clients, communities, and each other with equal commitment. As we continue to open new doors, we're inviting amazing people like you to join us.

As an Actuarial Analyst, you'll play a key role in supporting pricing strategy and data-driven decision making across Westland's in-house insurance products. Working alongside actuaries, data engineers, and analysts, you'll help shape the future of our pricing capabilities while building expertise in actuarial analysis, predictive modelling, and insurance analytics.

Interested in learning more?

Why You'll Love Westland


An open, flexible and welcoming workplace
Plenty of opportunities to grow and learn
Autonomy to drive your own success
Be part of our inclusive culture, alongside an extraordinarily talented community of people with a wide variety of backgrounds
A total rewards program that takes care of your financial, physical, and mental health
Flexible paid Values Days to celebrate days important to you
Paid Volunteer Days for employees as part of Amplifying Communities, a program to support causes that matter most to our employees and clients


Why We’ll Love You


You love working with data and using analytical thinking to uncover trends, solve problems, and support business decisions
You have a bachelor's degree in Actuarial Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Economics, or another quantitative field and are actively pursuing an actuarial designation (CAS or SOA), with actuarial exams considered an asset
You have at least two years of experience in an actuarial, analytical, or data-focused role, with experience using SQL, Python, and/or R for analysis and modelling
You enjoy collaborating with actuaries, analysts, engineers, and business partners to translate data into meaningful insights and recommendations
You can communicate complex findings clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical audiences
You have strong attention to detail, sound critical-thinking skills, and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work
Bonus: Experience with insurance pricing, predictive modelling, Power BI, Databricks, or P&C insurance


Once Here, You'll


Be a contributing member of our inclusive culture, alongside an extraordinarily talented community of people with a wide variety of backgrounds
Support actuarial pricing analyses and help monitor rate adequacy across Westland's portfolio of Personal and Commercial Lines insurance products
Partner with underwriting, operations, actuarial, and data teams to implement pricing changes and improve pricing processes
Extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources to support pricing decisions, portfolio insights, and business objectives
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and visualizations while identifying opportunities to automate recurring analysis and reporting
Contribute to the development, testing, and enhancement of predictive models that support pricing, retention, and conversion strategies
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders while continuously developing your actuarial, technical, and analytical expertise


Want to get to know each other better? Send your resume our way.

You belong here

We strive to be much more than a great place to work. Here, you join a collective of incredibly vibrant, purpose driven, and open-minded people. Every day, Westland proves that building a great business means taking care of communities, clients, and each other with equal commitment. You will be supported and respected for who you are and for the voice you add to the conversation.

At Westland, you will feel the power of community. Westland Insurance Ltd. is an inclusive organization that values diversity in its workforce. We listen, champion equity and diversity, and create safe welcoming spaces where everyone has a voice and is free to be themselves. Westland Insurance Ltd. encourages applications from all qualified individuals and will accommodate applicants' disability-related needs, up to the point of undue hardship, throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

If you require a disability-related accommodation in order to participate in the recruitment process, please contact the recruitment team by email at careers@westlandinsurance.ca

Title: Lead Analyst, Employee Benefits
Description:
Who We Are

We are BC’s largest Insurance Broker and looking for individuals to grow with us! A career at HUB means your career opportunities are endless. From auto, personal or commercial lines, claims, employee benefits, administration, to becoming a full-time producer or account manager, we have a role for you. Our culture is renowned within the industry, and we value our people. Helping our clients protect what matters most is crucial to who we are, and we are on the lookout for those who share the same passion.

What We’re Looking For

The Lead Analyst works closely with a team of Analysts that provide financial analysis of carrier and client statements, assist in the day-to-day data administration as well as supporting and providing high-level analysis and detailed commentary over their work.

Our Burnaby Still Creek head office location is centrally located in the Willingdon Business Park near The Amazing Brentwood. This location is easily accessible by the Gilmore sky train station with many shops, restaurants and other amenities nearby.

Responsibilities


Collect and analyze plan data in preparation for client meetings, including claims history updates, annual rate renewals, ASO reconciliations, financial analysis, and other ad-hoc projects as required.
Conduct plan market reviews, including production of Request-For-Proposal package, analysis of insurer quotations, and preparation of the report for the client.
Analyze client data to identify trends and opportunities.
Managing of client information on internal databases and client management system including policy details, renewal dates, reporting requirements, broker details, commission details, documentation etc.
Utilize partner software to generate Benchmarking Reports.
Communicate regularly with insurance carriers.
Manage monthly workflow and deliverables with various brokers, liaise with key project stakeholders to ensure adherence to specific timelines.
Develop client communication materials and other documents as required in coordination with HUB Communication & Design team.
Feedback and assist in continuous improvement on HART renewal tool.
Manage Adhoc project and custom reporting requests.
Facilitate training for new analysts on the various tools/enroll team members for additional training courses.
Provide Management with quarterly updates on output of team
Other projects and responsibilities as required by brokers and account managers.


Skills, Characteristics & Qualifications


Strong analytical skills and a strong math aptitude.
Solid working knowledge in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).
A high level of initiative and independence and being able to work effectively with minimal supervision.
Superior interpersonal skills; excellent oral and written communication skills.
Highly organized with an attention to detail.
Experience working with Customer Relationship Management software would be an asset.
A proven ability to work in a team environment with a flexible attitude.
Experience in the Employee Benefits or group insurance industry is considered an asset but is not required.
Experience with Group Retirement programs is considered an asset but is not required.
Willingness to obtain or actively working towards CEBS designation is an asset but is not required.
Some understanding of Labour Standards and Human Rights legislation, particularly as they relate to employee benefits programs is an asset but is not required.


What We Offer


Competitive compensation
Company matching RRSP contributions
Tuition financing and career-related training and development
Customizable flexible benefits options for you and your family
Mental and physical wellness initiatives
A positive, collaborative and team-oriented environment
Ongoing personal and career development


If this sounds like a place you want to be or want to talk to us about the role and opportunities, contact us/apply now.

The expected salary range for this position is $70,000 to $85,000 and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate’s skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position’s business line, scope and level. HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include extended health benefits, disability insurance, RRSP matching, paid-time-off benefits, and eligible bonuses, and commissions for some positions. We invest in our employees! Your journey with HUB can open doors to a diverse, rewarding career within the insurance industry and beyond!

Our Culture Starts with You


We are looking for SELF-STARTERS with an ENTREPRENEURIAL mindset who will take OWNERSHIP of their business
We want you to be INNOVATIVE and open to sharing your ideas
You work with URGENCY while providing a high level of PROFESSIONAL SERVICE towards our customers, communities, & colleagues.

Description:
Ready to take your career to the next level? Invest in yourself! MSP Corp is a dynamic and evolving organization.  Our team is energetic and multidisciplinary, performing at the highest levels.  We thrive on the diversity of our team and believe that any candidate could be the talent to take us to the next level. We drive technology and performance by providing powerful toolsets, business support and professional services. Our team provides complete, turn-key solutions with one goal in mind — to ensure that we can deliver 100% any day, any time. 




As we continue to grow, we are seeking a Data Analytics Consultant to join our West team. 




About the Role   




As an experienced Data Analytics Consultant this individual will work as part of our data analytics team, supporting clients with requirements gathering, prototyping, development, and support. Client scenarios range in complexity. This individual must have a good blend of people, functional, and technical skills for cross-team collaboration and support. We are looking for individuals who will interface with multiple business and technology stakeholders and teams to evaluate and improve existing processes using multiple technology platforms. 





Location: Canada


Schedule: Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week, 8:30 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. 


Work Mode: Remote













What You Will Do  





Architecting, designing, and developing end to end analytical data solutions from source raw data all the way to Power BI front end 


Providing oversight and expertise in Data Modeling and Database Design 


Working with business/project team members to understand the requirements 


Defining BI framework model, semantic layers and Metadata repositories to support reporting and administration 


Developing and managing BI end user presentation layer training and documentation. 


Technical documentation 


Supporting business development efforts (proposals and client presentations) 


Estimating effort for development and support engagements in Data Engineering and related technologies 


Status reporting 


Interacting with various client and management stake holders to get the work completed 


You would represent the company in the market and must reflect the core values of the company which include: 


Continuous improvement as a way of life 


Fair and generous relationships with our people and customers 


Certifications helpful to role: 






Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals 


Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals 


Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals 


Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals 


Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate 


Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate 


Azure Databricks Data Engineer Associate - Certifications





Microsoft Certified: SQL AI Developer Associate
































What We Are Looking For  





5+ years hands-on experience in Microsoft Data Stack incl. SQL Server, data warehousing, MS Fabric/Data Bricks


3+ years hands-on experience in Microsoft BI Stack incl. Power BI, SSAS, SSRS, SSIS 


Proficiency in the development and administration of at least one of the following areas: 


Back end data integration and architecture including dimensional data modeling, database design, data warehousing, ETL development (e.g. ADF), and performance tuning, front-end reporting and analytics platforms including OLAP cube design, tabular data modeling.


Strong Data Modeling skills for Star-Schema 


Strong Programming skills in T-SQL, Spark (PySpark, SQL, Scala, etc), DAX, Power Query 


Strong analytical thinking for translating data into informative visuals and reports 


Experience developing visual reports including custom visuals, dashboards and KPI scorecards using Power BI 


The ability to implement row level security on data and have an understanding of application security layer models in the data platforms of SQL Server, Azure, MS Fabric and Power BI 


Foundational knowledge of the following areas: Metadata Management; Master Data Management; Data Governance; Data Analytics 


Good understanding of AI fundamentals.


Certifications required: 


-Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate


-Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate


Strong written and verbal communications skills 













Why Work at MSP Corp  





Benefits package. 


Dynamic work environment. 


Corporate gym discounts. 


Wellness day. 


Opportunities for growth and training. 













Ready to make a difference? Join us and shape the future. Apply today!

Title: Commercial Analytics and Insights Lead
Description:
We’re seeking an Analytics & Insights Lead to support complex customer and utility reporting needs while partnering with Product to design scalable, long-term solutions and shape the roadmap for our data and reporting productes. This role plays a critical part in translating bespoke reporting requests into repeatable insights and helping retire manual workflows over time.

This is a highly visible, cross-functional role working across Analytics, Product, Customer Success, and external partners—including direct interaction with customers to clarify reporting needs, explain insights, and ensure alignment on data outputs.

Key Responsibilities


Fulfill complex, short-term reporting requests for utilities and enterprise customers
Triangulate data across internal systems (e.g., platform + BI tools)
Identify patterns in ad hoc requests and document recurring needs as inputs to product requirements
Partner with Product to:
Define canonical metrics
Validate data models
Inform reporting roadmap decisions
Create interim standardized templates where possible
Improve documentation and data definitions used by internal teams
Help reduce reliance on bespoke reporting over time
Serve as a customer-facing analytics resource—responding to questions, clarifying requirements, and communicating insights in a clear, approachable way


This role is expected to evolve over time from fulfilling complex reporting requests to owning the product roadmap for standardized insights and reporting – including metric definitions and executive facing analysis – as reporting becomes productized. For the right candide, this is a path toward product management for our data products.

What Success Looks Like


Fewer “net-new” reporting requests each quarter
Faster turnaround on remaining requests
Clear documentation of metrics and definitions
Seamless handoff of repeatable insights into productized reporting
A clear, prioritized view of which reporting needs should be built into the product


Qualifications


2+ years in analytics, data science, or BI roles
2+ years in the EV Charging/eMobility space.
Strong BI experience (Domo preferred)
Experience supporting enterprise customers or external stakeholders
Comfortable working with ambiguity and imperfect data
Strong communicator—can explain data tradeoffs clearly
Demonstrated ability to handle customer-facing communication, including clarifying requests, gathering requirements, and translating technical data concepts for non-technical audiences
Interest in growing toward product management – i.e. translating recurring customer needs into product requirements – is a strong plus


Let us learn about you! Apply today.

At Schneider, we believe that every employee is a talent who deserves equal opportunities. This means you matter. Every individual needs to feel valued, supported, and treated fairly to do their best work.

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: “We see you. We value you”. It’s more than just pay and benefits- it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed for you to perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential to shine as an impact maker.

Description:

Come work as an Analyst/Administrative Assistant with Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH)!

Vancouver Coastal Health is looking for an Analyst/Administrative Assistant to join the Facility Functional Planning team. Apply today to join our team!

As an Analyst/Administrative Assistant with Vancouver Coastal Health you will


Provide analytical support to the Program team for purposes such as data analysis, statistical reporting, benchmarking activities, developing and generating queries, preparing and compiling reports and technical documents utilizing various software and tools.
Provide confidential administrative and secretarial assistance and research support to the Director and to the IWMS team.
Maintain the Manager and management team’s appointment calendars, coordinate meetings, process and prioritize information, screen, triage and act upon requests and inquiries, including confidential and sensitive information.
Work independently and interface with other Executive Directors, Managers and staff at all levels of the organization.
Effectively partner with other VCH departments and liaises on behalf of the department with external agencies to coordinate the flow of information, keeping the Director apprised of relevant issues and activities.



This work is framed within VCH’s commitments to our pillars of Indigenous Cultural Safety, Anti-Racism, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, and Planetary Health.

Education & Experience


Diploma in a related program plus three to four (3-4) years' recent, related experience in a complex health care environment with progressively more responsible secretarial and administrative positions supporting senior level management, experience in information analysis and benchmarking, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Advanced computer skills in spreadsheet, database, graphics and word processing programs is required, e.g. Microsoft Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word, and Visio.



Knowledge & Abilities


Employs expertise in the use of computer software and applications to create a variety of analytical reports, documents, and presentations, and to maintain databases.
Applies acquired skills and knowledge to efficiently and independently resolve administrative issues/ problems.
Effectively utilizes both verbal and written communication skills when providing advice or information or seeking/acquiring information.
Develops and maintains strong relationships with key internal and external partners to promote and enhance services provided with sensitivity to diversity and indigenous lens.
Practices the recognition, inclusion and support of all types and aspects of diversity at all stages of engagement, with an understanding of the issues faced by people from equity-deserving groups.
Optimizes departmental effectiveness and contributes to organizational success by applying excellent time management skills to prioritize and complete assignments and schedule activities.
Practices diligence and care when maintaining, monitoring, calculating and summarizing data, records and budget information.
Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.



As per Ministry of Health policy, all health care workers working in publicly-funded health care facilities are required to report their past receipt of certain vaccines or history of certain infections. Collecting these records will allow for offering of any missing vaccines, and for appropriate actions to be taken in the event of any future exposure to a communicable disease or during outbreaks. For all new hires and appointments to Vancouver Coastal Health, you will be asked to provide this information as part of the onboarding process.

Why Join Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH)

VCH is a world class innovator in medical care, research and teaching, delivering service to more than one million BC residents. At VCH, we embrace thinking boldly, taking smart risks, and 'going first' when we believe it will lead to the best possible outcomes for patients and their families. We invite you to join us in creating healthy lives in healthy communities by showcasing our passion for care, connection to the communities we serve and our culture of teamwork that makes VCH a great place to work.


Comprehensive health benefits package, including MSP, extended health and dental and municipal pension plan
Grow your career with employer-paid training and leadership development opportunities
Wellness supports, including counselling, critical incident and innovative wellness services are available to employees and their immediate families
Award-winning recognition programs to honour staff, medical staff and volunteers
Access to exclusive discount offers and deals for VCH staff



At Vancouver Coastal Health, our vision of healthy lives in healthy communities inspires us and our values and pillars guide us. We support equitable practices, diverse teams and inclusive environments, which are vital to creating welcoming spaces where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and feel supported. We encourage applications from equity-deserving communities, including Indigenous Peoples and members of racialized groups, people with disabilities and people of all gender identities and expressions and sexual orientation.

Vancouver Coastal Health is proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers, BC’s Top Employers, Canada’s Best Diversity Employers and Canada's Top Employers for Young People in 2026.

Refer to the https//my.vch.ca/working-here/job-postings site for instructions on how to view internal job postings and how to apply as an employee. Current VCH employees who apply to this posting using this external site will be considered as an external candidate. Seniority will not apply.***

Thank you for your interest in Vancouver Coastal Health.
