Title: Compensation Analyst
Description:
We know it is our people who make us great at what we do.




We are looking for a compensation professional to support our growing compensation consulting team on several current and up coming client projects, and other initiatives. We are looking for someone, based in Vancouver or Toronto, with superb analytical and communication skills who is highly motivated, has a fine eye for detail, and can juggle multiple tasks and deliverables.




A typical day-in-the life of a Compensation Analyst involves meeting with clients, performing data analysis, understanding compensation trends to inform clients on compensation-related inquiries, and supporting internal projects. As a team member, you will work in partnership with the project managers to support clients all across Canada and gain exposure to the many areas of compensation practices including salary structure design, market analysis, job documentation and evaluation, executive pay, pay equity, salary surveys and many more!




If you are looking to take your HR and compensation career to the next level, this may be the right role for you!




This posting is for an existing vacancy that we are actively seeking to fill.




Roles and Responsibilities

Utilize Excel and other analysis tools to build compensation-related tools, dashboards, and analysis by adopting advanced techniques to compute and aggregate data, and conduct market comparisons
Interpret data and derive key market insights for clients and other reports
Support consulting team members on client projects by providing high-touch data analysis covering a wide-spread of broad compensation activities, including external market analysis using salary surveys, salary structure design, executive pay, incentive plan design, pay equity, and job evaluation
Conduct market benchmarking by reviewing client data, determining appropriate peer groups, and performing data compilation/aggregation among multiple sources, sectors, and industry databases
Collect, organize, track, and interpret client pay program information and policy material
Support national and custom external market compensation survey activities relating to questionnaire setup, create job capsules, survey tracking, database management, administration, data validation, and client communications
Help clients write job descriptions (JDs) by reviewing existing job documentation, organizational structures, JD templates, and conducting interviews
Support consultants on project management duties, including managing client documentation, coordination, scheduling, meeting note documentation, and general status tracking
Support the job evaluation process by reviewing and creating job descriptions and evaluating roles using a job evaluation methodology
Conduct research and perform financial analyses of industry sectors and client peer groups to understand business strategy, corporate performance, compensation, and rewards practices and trends
Support the team in preparation of client and business development-related presentations and executive reports; translate data into broader total rewards themes and recommendations, utilizing multiple applications including MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint




What we offer

Collaborative and engaging atmosphere
Variety in work and ability to evolve and grow your career
Working with colleagues across Canada and across multiple practice areas
Opportunities to help build and evolve our practice
Competitive compensation in terms of salary, bonus and paid vacation time (commensurate with experience)
An entrepreneurial, collegial work environment
Hybrid work style and dress for your day approach

What you offer

0-2 years of relevant experience is preferred but not required. Previous co-op terms, internships, or other related experience will be considered an asset
Bachelor's degree specifically in Business, Commerce, Economics, or a related field (required) with a baseline understanding of the different organization structures
Analytical skills and basic proficiency in MS Excel (comfortable with lookups, pivot tables, and basic formulas) combined with a strong knowledge of Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and database management
Strong oral and written communication skills including the ability to independently write a strong first draft report or insights presentation for clients
Strong desire to learn and develop through exposure to various projects and clients
Demonstrated ability to follow established standards and procedures
Ability to work in a team environment while managing multiple priorities and projects
Excellent interpersonal skills, strong verbal and written communication skills
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
Commitment to superior client satisfaction




Strong assets but not required

Prior co-op/ internship experience in data analysis, consulting, and/or compensation
Previous work experience in compensation with knowledge in market matching and benchmarking, job evaluation, job description writing, pay equity, or executive compensation
In the process of completing or willingness to complete the Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) designation
Bilingual in both English and French (reading, writing, and speaking)




Who we are:

At Eckler, we are driven by our purpose to care and to do right by people so that together we can achieve a brighter, more secure future. It’s just one of the reasons Eckler has been recognized multiple times as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures. Our origins go back to 1927, making us one of Canada’s first actuarial practices. Based in Canada and the Caribbean, we’re a team of committed and highly skilled professionals consulting in the areas of pension, retirement, financial wellness, investment, group benefits, insurance, change management and communication and technology. Owned and operated by its active Principals, the company has earned a reputation for service continuity and high professional standards. Eckler is a founding member of Abelica Global – an international alliance of independent actuarial and consulting firms operating in over 20 countries.




At Eckler, we value diversity of all types. Our organization is made up of smart, collaborative, and thoughtful people with a wide range of backgrounds, skills, and experiences. We are committed to an inclusive, diverse, and accessible workplace and encourage all interested applicants to submit a cover letter and resume for consideration. Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process or those needing job postings in an alternative format may e-mail a request to careers@eckler.ca.




Artificial intelligence (AI) tools may be used during the recruitment process to screen or assess applications. All evaluations involving AI are reviewed by in-house recruiters prior to making any final decisions.




We thank all applicants for their interest, but only those selected for the short list will be contacted.

Title: Senior Associate, New Verticals - Canada Strategy & Operations
Description:
About the Team

New Verticals launched in 2020 to take the DoorDash marketplace beyond restaurants: it now spans 100,000+ grocery, convenience, alcohol, retail, and DashMart stores across the US and Canada. This team focuses on building our Canadian marketplace to ensure we are able to deliver exactly what consumers are looking for when they want it, with speed and quality.

About the Role

We are hiring a few Senior Associates on our Canada New Verticals Strategy & Operations. One role will focus on improving how we partner with our Dashers and driving efficiencies to how they operate. The second role will focus on driving quality improvements to our platform that enhances the shopping experience resulting in higher consumer spend. Both roles will require you to understand marketplace data and constraints to strategize actionable plans to improve efficiency levers impacting things like in-store navigation, in-app experience, dasher pay, pricing & promotions and so much more! These roles require you to understand our three-sided marketplace and the unit economics that impact our financial success all while balancing growth, cost and quality. You'll need to weigh both sides of that tradeoff in every lever you pull.

These roles sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, and product. The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. We expect this person to stay at the forefront of how AI is reshaping the work, actively exploring new tools, automating repetitive workflows, and finding ways to do in hours what used to take weeks.

You will report into a Manager on our New Verticals Strategy & Operations team and be an individual contributor position. We operate in a hybrid model and spend a few days a month in person together. We have two positions so throughout the interview process, we will consider you for two roles and align on role fit throughout the interview process!

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Strategize. From first principles, you'll develop the optimal strategy for best serving all sides of the marketplace - dashers, merchants and consumers.

Title: Senior Analyst, FP&A
Description:
Procurify is the AI-enhanced procurement and AP automation platform for the mid-market. We make it easy for organizations to take control of spend and save money. We’re looking for a talented and team-driven Senior FP&A Analyst to join us on our journey.

About The Role

Procurify is looking for a curious, proactive, and data centric person who is passionate about supporting strategic decision making.

You are a person with a knack for detail, and you’re motivated by helping our internal customers achieve the best version of themselves.

Everyone at Procurify is a team player. A big part of this role involves building relationships internally and driving adoption of new tools, metrics, or processes. We’re seeking entrepreneurial people who are willing to challenge the status quo and contribute to larger strategic objectives.

What you’ll be working on:


Build and maintain driver-based operating models tied to business assumptions (headcount, ARR growth, pipeline)
Perform meaningful and in-depth financial analyses on current and future financial performance, which includes but is not limited to budget variance analysis, standard monthly, quarterly and annual financial analysis.
Champion the adoption of AI and LLM-powered workflows across the team by defining best practices, identifying high-impact use cases, and enabling knowledge sharing.
Drive effective application of AI tools for data analysis, insight generation, and narrative commentary to improve accuracy, increase efficiency, and streamline day-to-day operations.
Research and analyze historical, current and projected financial data for use in planning, forecasting and management decision making
Partner with broader Finance and RevOps teams to ensure data integrity and consistency across systems
Develop/maintain automated reporting and dashboards to track key SaaS metrics, providing commentary and actionable insights to support decision making
Drive improvements in planning processes, reporting cadence, and tooling
Build relationships across the organization to ensure alignment on assumptions, definitions and support storytelling through data
Other Ad Hoc duties as assigned


Who we’re looking for


5+ years of relevant experience in FP&A, Finance or other data focused roles
Advanced proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets
Demonstrated ability to work with large, complex datasets
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate financial insights into business recommendations
Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
Must maintain a professional and current LinkedIn profile, ensuring it is updated upon joining Procurify to reflect their new role and maintain a consistent company presence.


WHY PROCURIFY?

Help us modernize spend management

Procurify is a remote-first company with a big heart and a strong ambition to modernize the way organizations manage business spend. We’re trusted by hundreds of companies around the world — across industries like biotechnology, education, health care, manufacturing, and software — to manage over $30B in spend. We recently closed $50M in Series C funding to help us strengthen our core offering, launch new payment capabilities, and provide customers with an AI-enhanced procure-to-pay experience. Read the press release here.

Be empowered to do your best work

We’ve created an environment where personal and professional growth is a real priority. Some of the great perks we offer include:


Flexible working: We’re a remote-first organization with flexible working hours. Work anywhere from within Canada!
Responsible time off: We trust our team to take the time they need to rest and recharge while staying accountable to their commitments.
Extended health benefits: We prioritize our team’s health and well-being. We offer a competitive health, vision, and dental package along with an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness spending account.
Community initiatives: We have a strong commitment to giving back to our communities, including regular volunteer days, our Donate Your Day program, and education lunch and learns.
Stock options: Everyone has a chance to own a part of Procurify with our competitive stock program.
Base Salary Range: $72,000-$90,000 (This range is dependent on experience and not inclusive of any bonus, commission, benefits or equity that might exist in your total compensation package.)


Work with an amazing team

We’ve welcomed team members who were boat captains, funeral directors, swing dancers, competitive gamers, plumbers, and novelists. Everyone has a story and we’re here to embrace them!

LEARN MORE

Procurify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any team members or applicants for employment because of race, color, disability, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity and/or expression.

If you feel like you don’t meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that feelings of imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates, and we certainly don’t want those feelings to get in the way of meeting you! We really want to get to know you and why you're great for the role. Please avoid including your picture and age on your resume.

Apply online today and let’s start a conversation.

To learn more about Procurify, check out these resources:


Check out what our customers are saying about us
Learn more about our procure-to-pay platform

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
RLG is an implementation firm that partners with clients to accelerate their improvement journey. We drive transformative change through on-site coaching that shifts the processes and behaviours – connecting the front line to the bottom line.




We are seeking a sharp, early-career Business Analyst to join our finance team, which sits at the intersection of finance, strategy, and business development. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), you will be the analytical engine behind our commercial operations, owning the day-to-day management of financial and pricing models, producing executive-quality presentation materials, and working directly with senior partners to keep our sales pipeline accurate and up to date.




This is a full-time, in-person role based at our Vancouver, BC office. It's a rare early-career seat: you'll see how a global consultancy prices, pitches, and wins multi-million-dollar engagements, with real responsibility from day one. This role is ideal for someone who wants broad exposure to corporate finance, strategy, and business development before specializing, and who thrives on structure, accuracy, and polish.




As a Business Analyst, you will:

Maintain, update, and quality-check pricing models, cost models, and financial forecasts in Excel; support scenario analysis for active client pursuits.
Build and refine executive-level PowerPoint decks (proposals, pitch materials, board updates) to brand standard, working from partner input and existing templates.
Partner directly with senior consultants and Managing Partners to keep Microsoft Dynamics CRM entries complete, current, and accurate; run regular pipeline hygiene reviews and follow up on gaps.
Assist the CFO with monthly forecast cycles, variance analysis, and reporting packs.
Support business intelligence reporting in Power BI, working with our data science and IT teams on data refreshes, dashboard updates, and ad hoc analysis; you own the business logic and requirements, they own the infrastructure.
Take on research, data pulls, and one-off analytical requests from the CFO and senior leadership.




You will thrive in this role if you bring:

Strong Excel skills and comfort building and auditing multi-tab models, using lookups, and structuring clean, logical workbooks.
Proficiency in PowerPoint with a genuine eye for clarity, consistency, and visual polish.
A highly organized, detail-oriented mindset with a knack for catching the errors others miss.
Confidence communicating with and following up on senior stakeholders, holding them (politely) accountable.
Comfort working cross-functionally, translating business needs into clear requirements for data science and IT colleagues.
A self-starter mentality that can manage multiple recurring tasks and deadlines without close supervision.




To qualify for this role, you must have:

A bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
1–3 years of professional experience (new graduates are encouraged to apply; internships and co-op terms count).
Strong Excel skills, including comfort with lookups and structuring clean, multi-tab workbooks.
Proficiency in PowerPoint for executive-level presentation development.
Experience with Microsoft Dynamics CRM or another CRM platform is an asset.
Exposure to SQL, Power BI, Power Query, or DAX is an asset.
Exposure to AI tools such as Copilot, Claude or ChatGPT is an asset.
Interest in energy, mining, capital projects, or management consulting is an asset.
Co-op, internship, or work experience in FP&A, consulting, banking, or a corporate finance function is an asset.




What success looks like

A successful Business Analyst at RLG becomes the reliable analytical backbone behind our commercial operations - keeping pricing models accurate, presentations polished, and the pipeline clean, while earning the trust of senior partners and the CFO along the way. Over time, this role is designed as a launchpad into strategy, FP&A, or client-facing consulting work. Along the way, you'll get direct mentorship from the CFO and senior leadership with no layers between you and the decision-makers, and exposure to live, high-stakes commercial pursuits with global energy and industrial clients.




What we offer

Three weeks of vacation annually so you can recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance.
Six paid sick days each year to support your health and give you the time you need to recover.
A competitive RRSP matching program to support your long-term financial well-being.
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.
Competitive salary aligned to experience.




RLG is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible, and equitable workplace where individuals of all backgrounds feel valued, supported, and empowered to succeed. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please contact recruiting@rlginternational.com.




AI Use: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools are used solely to support the recruitment process and provide additional insights. Final hiring decisions are made by qualified recruitment team members based on a comprehensive review of each candidate. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Product Analytics Lead
Description:
We are seeking a Product Analytics Lead to own analytics and insights for all tests and experimentation across our product landscape.

This role is a highly analytical individual contributor who operates with broad scope, influence, and accountability. You will define how success is measured for product experiments, establish scalable analytics frameworks, and analyze experimentation data to provide actionable insights.

You will own the end-to-end analytics process for all experiments across product experiences—spanning measurement, data collection, experimentation, and insight generation.

Major Responsibilities

Hands-On Analysis & Technical Execution


Conduct and oversee deep, hands-on analysis of product tests and experiments using multiple data sets
Translate complex behavioral and business data into clear strategic recommendations that influence senior leadership decisions
Partner with Product and Engineering to define instrumentation requirements, ensuring data is collected safely and accurately, and embedding analytics best practices into the development cycle


Experimentation & Optimization Leadership


Evolve the experimentation analytics/data strategy across product
Lead hypothesis development and test design in partnership with cross-functional teams
Ensure experimentation insights are translated into measurable business impact and scaled learnings


Required Education/Professional Experience


5+ years of experience in product analytics, data analytics, data science, business intelligence, or related fields


Required Skills/Knowledge Attributes


Strong expertise in business intelligence, dashboarding, and data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, etc.)
Strong experience with experimentation tools such as VWO
Deep understanding of product analytics and user behaviour metrics
Experience working in a cloud-based data warehouse environment (Azure, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
Strong Experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing methodologies
Sets the standard for analytical rigour and excellence across the organisation


Compensation & Benefits

Salary Range: $100,000 – $140,000 per annum

(The actual salary offered will be commensurate with education, experience, and internal equity.)

We offer a competitive Total Compensation Package designed to support your financial, personal, and professional well-being. This includes:


Participation in our Company Profit Sharing Program of up to 8% of base salary
Eligibility for a Sales Incentive/Bonus Program for revenue-generating roles, based on performance and role criteria
Comprehensive Extended Health and Dental Benefits
Generous Paid Time Off, including annual vacation and personal days

Toronto, ON / Vancouver, BC; Hybrid

About The Role

The Portfolio Intelligence Analyst is responsible for producing trusted portfolio intelligence that enables effective enterprise portfolio management and informed executive decision-making. Reporting to the Enterprise Portfolio Manager, the role gathers, validates, analyses and maintains portfolio information across the enterprise technology portfolio. The Portfolio Intelligence Analyst develops executive dashboards, portfolio analytics, governance information and performance reporting while supporting portfolio planning, investment prioritization, and ongoing portfolio monitoring.

Support business case intake, validation, investment appraisal, and enterprise portfolio prioritization activities.
Maintain business case repositories and associated supporting documentation.


Portfolio Health Monitoring & Continuous Improvement


Monitor portfolio financial performance, resource utilization, delivery health, risks, dependencies, benefits realization, and key portfolio metrics.
Maintain high standards of data quality and information integrity across the portfolio.
Identify and implement improvements to portfolio analytics, reporting, processes, automation, and AI-enabled portfolio intelligence capabilities.

Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP)

Responsibilities


Executes accurate, scheduled daily, weekly, and monthly reports.

Maintains report contact database, controls user access to shared network drives and other common resources, and executes regular backups.

Ability to work independently, check your results, troubleshoot problems and exercise judgment.

Knowledge of Microsoft Access, including creating basic queries, code and reports.
Understanding of relational databases, including creating SQL statements.

Excellent analytical and problem solving skills, proven ability to apply these in business environment.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Title: Supply Chain Business Analyst
Description:
Reporting to the Director, Inventory Management, the Supply Chain Business Analyst provides analytical, forecasting, reporting, and process‑optimization support across the supply chain organization. This role focuses on developing insights, improving systems and processes, and supporting data‑driven decisions that enhance inventory performance, forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, and the overall customer experience.

What You Will Do


Develop, enhance, and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking tools to monitor supply chain performance
Analyze supply chain data across forecasting, inventory, procurement, and logistics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
Conduct root‑cause analyses on service failures, forecast variances, and inventory challenges
Support the development of data governance standards and ensure data integrity across systems
Support demand planning cycles through trend analysis, modeling, and scenario planning
Evaluate forecast accuracy and partner with teams to improve inputs and assumptions
Collaborate with Sales and Inventory teams to align demand forecasts with budgets and category growth plans
Assess end‑to‑end supply chain processes and identify opportunities for efficiency, automation, and standardization
Support ERP enhancements, functional improvements, and system implementation projects
Prepare business cases, cost‑benefit analyses, and operational assessments to drive continuous improvement
Act as the central strategic bridge, connecting the dots between Sales, Procurement, Operations, and Logistics to ensure a unified strategy and a seamless customer experience.
Work closely with Inventory, Procurement, Operations, Logistics, and Sales teams to support strategic and operational initiatives
Participate in supplier and logistics partner performance reviews by providing analytical insights
Support issue resolution related to supply disruptions, service delays, or data inconsistencies
Assist in inventory investment planning, demand/supply balancing, and capacity assessments
Provide analytical support for annual budgeting and long‑range planning
Support compliance with supply chain regulatory requirements (import/export, sustainability, documentation


About You


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent post‑secondary education in Supply Chain, Business, Analytics, Engineering, or a related field
3-5 years of experience in supply chain analytics, business analysis, or a similar analytical supply chain function
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience using data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau)
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities
Proficiency with ERP systems and supply chain planning tools
Certifications: SCMP, CPIM, CSCP, or other relevant designations considered an asset

Date limite pour postuler : 25 Septembre, 12h HE

Joignez-vous à l'équipe d'EDC !

À EDC, nous aidons les entreprises canadiennes à réussir à l'étranger. Nous leur offrons les outils financiers et l'expertise dont elles ont besoin pour explorer de nouveaux marchés et réduire les risques, dans un seul but : bâtir un Canada et un monde meilleurs grâce au commerce.

Poste : Analyste principal(e) des rapports

Type d'emploi : contractuelle

Détails de la rémunération :


Analyste de données (18): Les salaires annuels varient généralement de 96 557 $ à 128 743 $, en fonction des qualifications et de l'expérience.


Lieu de travail:


Exportation et développement Canada applique un modèle de travail hybride selon lequel les employés sont tenus de travailler au bureau deux jours par semaine. À compter de septembre 2026, cette exigence passera à trois jours par semaine. Cette transition sera mise en œuvre graduellement selon une approche progressive adaptée surle lieu de travail des employés. (sous réserve de modifications)
La personne choisie peut travailler à partir du siège social d'EDC à Ottawa ou à partir du Carrefour communautaire à Toronto, à Mississauga, à Montréal, à Brossard, à Laval, à Calgary, à Edmonton, à Halifax ou à Vancouver


Candidats internes, veuillez consulter la page Service Now intitulée « Mouvements internes - ce que vous devez savoir ».

À propos d'EDC

À Exportation et développement Canada (EDC), nous aidons les entreprises canadiennes à réussir à l'étranger. En tant que société d'État à vocation financière, EDC propose des solutions financières innovantes et des conseils d'experts pour aider les entreprises à explorer de nouveaux marchés, à atténuer leurs risques et à se développer.

Pourquoi vous joindre à EDC?


Gamme complète d'avantages sociaux : EDC offre un régime de rémunération et d'avantages sociaux concurrentiel, une bonne conciliation travail-vie personnelle et la chance de contribuer à bâtir un Canada et un monde meilleurs grâce au commerce
Conciliation travail-vie personnelle : EDC offre un régime concurrentiel en ce qui concerne la rémunération et la conciliation travail-vie personnelle : différentes options de travail hybride, trois à quatre semaines de vacances, une période de fermeture, des vendredis d'été raccourcis et les vendredis sans réunion
Perfectionnement professionnel : Profitez de nos occasions d'apprentissage continu, notamment des programmes de formation, des ateliers et de la formation linguistique
Culture inclusive : Intégrez un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif qui lutte pour l'équité en matière d'emploi et valorise la diversité des idées, des forces et des origines pour favoriser la réussite
Programmes de bien-être : Nous offrons des initiatives de bien-être, de l'aide à la santé mentale et des programmes de conditionnement physique pour veiller à votre santé et à votre bonheur
Investissement dans la collectivité : Participez à des activités de bénévolat et donnez au suivant grâce à un éventail de programmes de responsabilité sociale


Aperçu de l'équipe

Le groupe Solutions numériques et technologiques (DTS - Digital & Technology Solutions), sous la direction du chef de l'information, a été créé en 2023 avec pour mission de permettre à nos clients et à nos collègues de relever les défis du monde en offrant de façon harmonieuse des expériences numériques sécurisées et fiables.

Les Solutions numériques et technologiques se sont fixé les objectifs suivants pour EDC :

Diriger et assurer la mise en œuvre intégrée des initiatives numériques, de données, d'infrastructure et de cybersécurité afin d'offrir d'excellentes expériences aux clients, aux utilisateurs et aux employés

Title: Senior Customer Analytics Manager
Description:
Are you passionate about using data to drive impactful business decisions?

We’re looking for a Senior Customer Analytics Manager to be part of our Analytics team.

The Team:

Analytics is part of the Strategy & Analytics department, our internal consulting team - they’re the decision support mechanism that connects data & business insights with the rest of the organization. In essence, Analytics is a central function that exists to drive business outcomes in all corners of Jobber’s ecosystem.

The Role:

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Customer Analytics, the Senior Customer Analytics Manager will be a senior analytics partner for one or more of Jobber’s high-priority Customer Analytics domains.

This role will partner closely with business leaders and cross-functional teams to help Jobber better understand customer behaviour, business performance, growth opportunities, and the drivers of long-term customer value. Depending on business priorities, this work may span areas such as acquisition, onboarding, lifecycle engagement, product adoption, monetization, retention, expansion, customer success, or other strategic customer domains.

You will lead high-impact analytical work across the customer journey, including funnel performance, customer segmentation, conversion, engagement, product usage, retention, expansion, operational effectiveness, and long-term value.

This is an individual contributor leadership role, not a people leadership role. You will not directly manage a team, but you will be expected to lead through influence, own one or more important business domains, shape analytical roadmaps, mentor and guide analysts, manage senior stakeholder relationships, and ensure analytics work translates into better decisions.

The ideal candidate brings strong business acumen, deep analytical expertise, and excellent communication skills. They are comfortable turning ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches, building clear recommendations, and influencing decisions at multiple levels of the organization.

The Senior Customer Analytics Manager will:

Lead strategic customer analytics and insight


Act as a strategic thought partner and internal consultant to stakeholders across one or more high-priority Customer Analytics domains, helping them clarify business questions, evaluate opportunities, measure performance, and make better decisions.
Collaborate closely with teams across Jobber, including Revenue Operations, Strategy, Marketing Analytics, Product & Fintech Analytics, BI & Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and relevant go-to-market or customer-facing teams.
Lead deep-dive analyses across the customer journey, including acquisition, onboarding, engagement, product adoption, monetization, retention, expansion, customer quality, and long-term customer value.
Help define, refine, and govern the KPIs that matter most for the assigned domain or domains, including performance, efficiency, customer quality, customer outcomes, and downstream business impact.
Translate complex business questions into clear analytical plans, decision frameworks, and actionable recommendations.
Evaluate the impact of strategic initiatives, operational changes, go-to-market motions, customer programs, product or lifecycle initiatives, and other business priorities.
Help leaders understand not just what happened, but why it happened, what it means, and what Jobber should do next.


Support decision-making across assigned domains


Build a strong analytical understanding of the assigned domain or domains, including how different customer segments, behaviours, channels, products, teams, or motions contribute to business performance.
Identify opportunities to improve growth, efficiency, prioritization, customer experience, customer quality, and long-term value.
Support strategic planning, forecasting, target setting, business cases, and resource allocation decisions.
Partner with cross-functional teams and business leaders to improve reporting foundations, metric definitions, funnel or journey visibility, and decision-making workflows.
Analyze the quality and long-term value of different customer groups, helping Jobber optimize for durable growth rather than short-term volume alone.
Create reusable frameworks and decision tools that help teams evaluate trade-offs across growth, efficiency, customer outcomes, and operational complexity.


Drive experimentation, impact evaluation, and advanced analytics


Support experimentation and measurement strategies for strategic initiatives, including A/B tests, pilots, campaigns, lifecycle programs, product initiatives, operational changes, and customer-facing programs.
Apply advanced analytics techniques such as impact evaluation, scenario analysis, simulation modelling, forecasting, segmentation, and predictive analytics to inform strategic decisions.
Partner with Data Science on more complex modelling opportunities, such as customer scoring, prioritization, churn or expansion propensity, automation, AI-assisted workflows, or other predictive systems.
Bring strong judgment to ambiguous measurement problems, including cases where perfect experimentation is not possible and directional decision support is still needed.
Help stakeholders understand analytical confidence, limitations, trade-offs, and recommended next actions.


Build trusted stakeholder partnerships and executive-ready communication


Build trusted relationships with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders by understanding their goals, shaping analytical roadmaps, and proactively identifying opportunities.
Communicate insights through clear, compelling, executive-ready narratives that connect analysis to decisions and business outcomes.
Present findings, recommendations, dashboards, and decision frameworks in business reviews, leadership forums, and cross-functional meetings.
Make trade-offs visible when stakeholder demand exceeds capacity, helping teams prioritize the work that will have the greatest business impact.
Collaborate across Analytics & Insights to ensure Customer Analytics work connects cleanly with other analytics teams and pods, BI & Analytics Engineering, and Data Science.


Advance scalable analytics and AI-enabled workflows


Identify recurring or repeatable analytics work that should become automated, standardized, documented, or moved into self-serve.
Partner with BI & Analytics Engineering to improve the data foundation, semantic layer, reporting infrastructure, and self-serve capabilities that support Customer Analytics decision-making.
Use AI-assisted analytics workflows responsibly to accelerate exploration, coding, documentation, QA, and storytelling while maintaining strong ownership of output quality.
Promote high-quality analytics practices, including clear metric definitions, reproducible workflows, thoughtful QA, documentation, peer review, and data quality stewardship.
Build scalable assets, dashboards, models, and analytical frameworks that reduce manual reporting and shift analyst time toward higher-judgment work.
Ensure insights are timely, trusted, actionable, and connected to meaningful business outcomes.


Lead as a senior individual contributor, you will:


Lead one or more important Customer Analytics domains through influence, ownership, and strong judgment.
Provide mentorship, peer review, and analytical guidance to analysts working in or adjacent to those domains.
Raise the bar for analytical quality, stakeholder communication, and business impact across the Customer Analytics team.

At Export Development Canada (EDC), we empower Canadian businesses to succeed globally. As a financial Crown corporation, we offer innovative financial solutions and expert insights to help businesses explore new markets, mitigate risks, and achieve growth.

Why Join EDC?


Comprehensive Benefits: EDC offers a competitive compensation & benefits package, work-life balance, & the opportunity to help make Canada and the world better through trade
Work-Life Balance: EDC offers a competitive compensation package & work-life balance. We have hybrid work options, 3 to 4 weeks paid vacation, a corporate closure period, summer early Friday's & no meeting Fridays
Professional Development: Take advantage of our continuous learning opportunities, including training programs, workshops and language training
Inclusive Culture: Be part of a diverse and inclusive workplace that champions employment equity & values diversity of ideas, strengths, & backgrounds to succeed
Wellness Programs: Access to wellness initiatives, mental health support, and fitness programs to keep you healthy and happy
Community Engagement: Participate in volunteer opportunities and give back to the community through our various social responsibility programs


Team Overview:

The Digital & Technology Solutions (DTS) group under the leadership of the Chief Information Officer was established in 2023 with the mission of empowering our customers and colleagues to take on the world, by seamlessly delivering secure and reliable digital experiences. Digital & Technology Solutions has set out to achieve the following objectives for EDC:


Define, execute, and sustain the integrated technology target state, target data model and technology operations required to enable EDC's 2030 business transformation
Establish and manage the rolling 3 Year Digital Roadmap that sequences the technology outcomes required to achieve the technology target state and facilitate its execution across all domains in the organization
Keep pace with industry trends and emerging technologies, ensuring EDC has access to the digital technology tools it needs to stay relevant in the market and grow Canadian global trade
Lead and ensure integrated digital, data, infrastructure, and cybersecurity implementations to create excellent customer, user, and employee experiences


The Data Transformation Initiative team oversees transformation initiatives to enable business areas across EDC to make timely, informed decisions through trusted reporting, analytics, and data products. As EDC continues to modernize its reporting ecosystem, this role will support the migration and modernization of legacy Cognos reports to Microsoft Power BI/Fabric.

What you will be doing:

The Reporting Analyst will play a key role in assessing, rationalizing, redesigning, and rebuilding existing Cognos reporting assets on the Power BI platform. The successful candidate will work closely with business users, data teams, technology partners, and report owners to understand current-state reporting needs, document data and business logic, validate source-to-target mappings, and build Power BI reports and semantic models that meet EDC standards for governance, performance, usability, and supportability.


Analyze existing Cognos reports, packages, queries, prompts, calculations, filters, security requirements, and usage patterns to determine migration scope and complexity.
Work with business stakeholders to confirm reporting requirements, identify redundant or low-value reports, and recommend opportunities for consolidation, redesign, or retirement.
Document current-state report logic, data sources, field mappings, report layouts, dependencies, and business rules.
Design and develop Power BI reports, dashboards, paginated reports, and semantic models that align with EDC reporting standards and business needs.
Transform and validate data using SQL, Power Query, DAX, and approved enterprise data sources, ensuring accuracy and traceability from legacy reports to new Power BI outputs.
Support user acceptance testing, reconcile results between Cognos and Power BI, investigate variances, and document testing outcomes.
Collaborate with data engineering, architecture, governance, and platform teams to ensure reports are secure, performant, maintainable, and aligned with EDC's target data architecture.
Prepare report inventory updates, technical documentation, user guidance, and knowledge transfer materials for support teams and business users.
Contribute to migration planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, status reporting, and issue/risk tracking.
Support production deployment, post-implementation validation, and transition of migrated reports into ongoing support.


What we are looking for:


Undergraduate degree in Business, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Data Analytics, Finance, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum of 7 years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, developing large scale reporting/analytics in enterprise analytics platforms such as Cognos, Tableau, Power BI or similar
Experience working with Microsoft Fabric
Experience developing Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, or paginated reports.
Experience analyzing, reverse engineering, or migrating reports from IBM Cognos Analytics to Power BI: Report Studio, Framework Manager, Cognos packages, prompts, and audit/usage analysis.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases, data marts, data warehouses, or enterprise data platforms.
Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, document business logic, validate results, and communicate findings to both technical and business audiences.
Experience supporting report testing, reconciliation, defect resolution, and stakeholder sign-off


What will make you stand out:


You can quickly understand complex legacy reports and translate them into modern, user-friendly analytics products.
You balance business context with technical detail, ensuring that migrated reports are not simply replicated but improved where appropriate.
You communicate clearly with report users, developers, architects, and platform teams, helping bridge business needs and technical implementation.
Experience working in financial services, insurance, banking, Crown corporations, or regulated reporting environments.
Experience with data governance, metadata documentation, lineage, report inventory management, and controlled report retirement.
Familiarity with Agile delivery, Azure DevOps, backlog management, and iterative report development.
Bilingualism in both official languages, English and French

  • Work-Life Balance: EDC offers a competitive compensation package & work-life balance. We have hybrid work options, 3 to 4 weeks paid vacation, a corporate closure period, summer early Friday's & no meeting Fridays
  • Professional Development: Take advantage of our continuous learning opportunities, including training programs, workshops and language training
  • Inclusive Culture: Be part of a diverse and inclusive workplace that champions employment equity & values diversity of ideas, strengths, & backgrounds to succeed
  • Wellness Programs: Access to wellness initiatives, mental health support, and fitness programs to keep you healthy and happy
  • Community Engagement: Participate in volunteer opportunities and give back to the community through our various social responsibility programs

Team Overview:

The Digital & Technology Solutions (DTS) group under the leadership of the Chief Information Officer was established in 2023 with the mission of empowering our customers and colleagues to take on the world, by seamlessly delivering secure and reliable digital experiences. Digital & Technology Solutions has set out to achieve the following objectives for EDC:

  • Define, execute, and sustain the integrated technology target state, target data model and technology operations required to enable EDC's 2030 business transformation
  • Establish and manage the rolling 3 Year Digital Roadmap that sequences the technology outcomes required to achieve the technology target state and facilitate its execution across all domains in the organization
  • Keep pace with industry trends and emerging technologies, ensuring EDC has access to the digital technology tools it needs to stay relevant in the market and grow Canadian global trade
  • Lead and ensure integrated digital, data, infrastructure, and cybersecurity implementations to create excellent customer, user, and employee experiences

The Data Transformation Initiative team oversees transformation initiatives to enable business areas across EDC to make timely, informed decisions through trusted reporting, analytics, and data products. As EDC continues to modernize its reporting ecosystem, this role will support the migration and modernization of legacy Cognos reports to Microsoft Power BI/Fabric.

What you will be doing:

The Reporting Analyst will play a key role in assessing, rationalizing, redesigning, and rebuilding existing Cognos reporting assets on the Power BI platform. The successful candidate will work closely with business users, data teams, technology partners, and report owners to understand current-state reporting needs, document data and business logic, validate source-to-target mappings, and build Power BI reports and semantic models that meet EDC standards for governance, performance, usability, and supportability.

  • Analyze existing Cognos reports, packages, queries, prompts, calculations, filters, security requirements, and usage patterns to determine migration scope and complexity.
  • Work with business stakeholders to confirm reporting requirements, identify redundant or low-value reports, and recommend opportunities for consolidation, redesign, or retirement.
  • Document current-state report logic, data sources, field mappings, report layouts, dependencies, and business rules.
  • Design and develop Power BI reports, dashboards, paginated reports, and semantic models that align with EDC reporting standards and business needs.
  • Transform and validate data using SQL, Power Query, DAX, and approved enterprise data sources, ensuring accuracy and traceability from legacy reports to new Power BI outputs.
  • Support user acceptance testing, reconcile results between Cognos and Power BI, investigate variances, and document testing outcomes.
  • Collaborate with data engineering, architecture, governance, and platform teams to ensure reports are secure, performant, maintainable, and aligned with EDC's target data architecture.
  • Prepare report inventory updates, technical documentation, user guidance, and knowledge transfer materials for support teams and business users.
  • Contribute to migration planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, status reporting, and issue/risk tracking.
  • Support production deployment, post-implementation validation, and transition of migrated reports into ongoing support.

What we are looking for:

  • Undergraduate degree in Business, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Data Analytics, Finance, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, developing large scale reporting/analytics in enterprise analytics platforms such as Cognos, Tableau, Power BI or similar
  • Experience working with Microsoft Fabric
  • Experience developing Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, or paginated reports.
  • Experience analyzing, reverse engineering, or migrating reports from IBM Cognos Analytics to Power BI: Report Studio, Framework Manager, Cognos packages, prompts, and audit/usage analysis.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases, data marts, data warehouses, or enterprise data platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, document business logic, validate results, and communicate findings to both technical and business audiences.
  • Experience supporting report testing, reconciliation, defect resolution, and stakeholder sign-off

What will make you stand out:

  • You can quickly understand complex legacy reports and translate them into modern, user-friendly analytics products.
  • You balance business context with technical detail, ensuring that migrated reports are not simply replicated but improved where appropriate.
  • You communicate clearly with report users, developers, architects, and platform teams, helping bridge business needs and technical implementation.
  • Experience working in financial services, insurance, banking, Crown corporations, or regulated reporting environments.
  • Experience with data governance, metadata documentation, lineage, report inventory management, and controlled report retirement.
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery, Azure DevOps, backlog management, and iterative report development.
  • Bilingualism in both official languages, English and French

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
Requisition ID: 46984

Organization

Vancouver is consistently ranked as one of the world’s most liveable and environmentally sustainable cities. Recognized among BC’s Top Employers and Canada’s Greenest Employers, the City of Vancouver is seeking colleagues who can help advance our core commitments to exceptional public service, sustainability, equity, and an outstanding quality of life for all residents.

With a strong commitment to being a City of Reconciliation, we invite you to join our dedicated team and become part of an innovative, inclusive, and engaging workplace. A career with the City of Vancouver and within the broader public service, offers meaningful work where you play a key role in ensuring equitable access to services, upholding ethical governance, and supporting the needs of citizens with integrity and dedication.

Main Purpose & Function

Business Analyst is responsible for leading and supporting a diverse portfolio of work spanning strategic initiatives, enterprise projects, operational effectiveness improvements, data-enabled transformation, and business process modernization. This role applies advanced business analysis, data analysis, data mapping, research, business process review and re-engineering, and management reporting to identify opportunities, solve complex problems, and develop practical, evidence-based recommendations. The position works across a broad range of business areas and initiatives, requiring the ability to move effectively between project-based assignments, operational problem-solving, and enterprise improvement work.

Operating with a high degree of independence, the Business Analyst is expected to scope, structure, and deliver work in areas that may be complex, cross-functional, or not fully defined. The role translates broad direction into clear workplans, analysis, options, recommendations, and implementation actions.

The work directly informs and influences leadership and executive decision-making, including the assessment of options, trade-offs, risks, operational impacts, and recommended courses of action. Assignments may involve significant organizational, service delivery, financial, operational, data, technology, or change-management implications.

Business Analysts play a key role in improving how the organization uses data, optimizes processes, delivers services, and aligns operational practices with strategic priorities. The role supports scalable, efficient, data-informed, and client-focused service delivery across the organization.

This role reports to the Director, Enterprise Data, Analytics and AI and regularly works with business unit leaders, operational managers, technical teams, data teams, subject matter experts, vendors, consultants, and external partners. The role is expected to build productive working relationships across diverse stakeholder groups and influence outcomes without always having direct authority.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities


Leads and supports projects and analytical initiatives of varying size, complexity, and organizational impact, including defining scope, developing workplans, coordinating activities, managing deliverables, identifying dependencies, tracking issues and risks, and supporting successful delivery within established timelines, constraints, and budgets.
Leads cross-functional work by aligning stakeholders, clarifying objectives, structuring ambiguous problems, and driving work forward through analysis, collaboration, and sound judgement.
Supports project governance by preparing decision materials, briefing notes, presentations, options analysis, recommendations, and implementation updates for senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
Develops recommendations that improve efficiency, effectiveness, scalability, consistency, accountability, and client service. This may include identifying systemic issues, operational gaps, duplication of effort, manual processes, data quality concerns, unclear accountabilities, or opportunities for standardization and automation.
Supports the design and implementation of improved operating models, business practices, service delivery approaches, and management reporting processes.
Applies structured business and data analysis methods to support strategic and operational decision-making. Analyze quantitative and qualitative information to identify patterns, trends, risks, issues, opportunities, and business impacts.
Uses data to support problem definition, root cause analysis, options assessment, performance measurement, benefits identification, and implementation planning.
Translates complex data and business information into clear insights that can be understood and acted on by technical, operational, and executive audiences.
Leads or supports data mapping activities to document data sources, data flows, data definitions, business rules, system relationships, ownership, dependencies, and handoffs across processes and systems.
Works with business and technical stakeholders to understand how data is created, used, transformed, stored, governed, reported, and relied upon for decision-making.
Identifies opportunities to improve data quality, consistency, usability, reporting, governance, and alignment between business processes and data systems.
Supports initiatives that improve the organization’s ability to use data as a strategic asset, including analytics, reporting, dashboarding, operational metrics, and data-informed decision-making.
Leads and supports end-to-end reviews of business processes across a variety of operational and strategic areas. Document current-state processes, identify pain points, assess root causes, and develop improved future-state processes.
Applies methods such as process mapping, value stream mapping, workflow analysis, fit/gap analysis, service design, requirements analysis, and performance measurement to develop practical and implementable recommendations.
Assesses the operational, data, technology, people, policy, governance, and change-management implications of proposed process changes.
Develops implementation considerations, transition plans, success measures, and reporting approaches to help sustain process improvements over time.
Conducts targeted and in-depth research to support complex business questions, operational reviews, data initiatives, and transformation efforts. Research may include leading practices, peer jurisdiction comparisons, service delivery models, performance indicators, standards, frameworks, emerging technologies, and organizational trends.
Provides advisory support to business areas by helping stakeholders clarify objectives, understand current-state challenges, assess alternatives, and make informed decisions.
Leads or supports the implementation of recommendations arising from projects, operational reviews, data initiatives, and process improvement work.
Coordinates with business and technical teams to support adoption of new processes, tools, data practices, reporting approaches, and operating procedures.
Identifies risks, dependencies, stakeholder impacts, training needs, communications requirements, and change-management considerations to support successful and sustainable implementation.
Synthesizes complex and sometimes ambiguous information into practical decision-ready materials, including options analysis, risk analysis, implementation considerations, and recommended courses of action.
Develops and maintains effective working relationships with stakeholders across business, operational, technical, and leadership groups.
Facilitates discussions, workshops, interviews, requirements sessions, process reviews, and decision-making conversations with diverse participants.
Other duties/responsibilities as assigned


Qualifications

Education and Experience:


A bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline such as Business, Commerce, Public Administration, Public Policy, Economics, Data Analytics, Information Management, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, and/or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
Significant progressive experience, typically 6 to 8 years or an equivalent depth of experience, in business analysis, data analysis, operational effectiveness, process improvement, management reporting, business advisory, project delivery, or related functions within a complex organization.
Experience in consulting, advisory services, public sector, technology-enabled transformation, data and analytics, or enterprise service delivery environments is considered an asset.
Training or experience in analytics, business analysis, project delivery, process improvement, data management, or quality improvement methodologies is required. Certifications or formal training such as IIBA, Lean Six Sigma, project management, change management, data analytics, or related disciplines are considered assets.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Strong knowledge of business analysis methods, including requirements gathering, stakeholder analysis, current-state and future-state assessment, options analysis, gap analysis, and benefits identification.
Strong understanding of business process review and re-engineering methods, including current-state documentation, value stream mapping, workflow analysis, service delivery analysis, fit/gap assessment, and future-state design.
Ability to apply business analysis techniques to define complex problems, assess current and future states, identify risks, dependencies and opportunities, evaluate options, and develop practical, evidence-based recommendations.
Ability to balance strategic objectives, operational realities, data insights, stakeholder needs, risks, and implementation considerations.
Ability to analyze data, interpret results, identify trends, and communicate insights.
Ability to document data sources, flows, definitions, relationships, ownership, dependencies, and business rules across systems and processes.
Ability to identify data quality issues, reporting gaps, and opportunities to improve the use of data in decision-making.
Ability to work with data, reporting, visualization, workflow, and business analysis tools as required by the assignment
Ability to develop workplans, manage timelines, coordinate stakeholders, track risks and issues, and deliver high-quality work with limited direction.
Ability to lead cross-functional work, facilitate alignment, influence decisions, and move work forward without direct reporting authority.
Ability to build trust and credibility with senior leaders, operational teams, technical experts, and external partners.
Ability to develop and maintain strong working relationships across diverse business, technical, and leadership groups.
Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills.
Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise, and decision-ready products for a range of audiences, including senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
Ability to prepare compelling reports, presentations, briefing notes, dashboards, and recommendations.
Judgement and Independence
Ability to exercise sound professional judgement, discretion, and objectivity when working on sensitive, complex, or high-impact matters.
Ability to work independently, make recommendations within scope, identify when escalation is required, and provide balanced advice based on evidence and organizational context.
Ability to independently manage multiple concurrent initiatives, shifting priorities, and complex deliverables in a dynamic environment.
Ability to move between strategic initiatives, operational reviews, data work, process improvement, and implementation support.
Strong client-service orientation, with the ability to understand business needs, support problem-solving, and deliver practical outcomes.
Proficiency with office productivity and analytical tools, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and collaboration platforms.
Demonstrated interest in learning about a broad range of business areas, operational models, data practices, technologies, and emerging approaches.
Ability to quickly develop sufficient subject-matter understanding to contribute meaningfully across varied assignments.

Title: Analyst/Administrative Assistant
Description:

Come work as an Analyst/Administrative Assistant with Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH)!

Vancouver Coastal Health is looking for an Analyst/Administrative Assistant to join the Facility Functional Planning team. Apply today to join our team!

As an Analyst/Administrative Assistant with Vancouver Coastal Health you will


Provide analytical support to the Program team for purposes such as data analysis, statistical reporting, benchmarking activities, developing and generating queries, preparing and compiling reports and technical documents utilizing various software and tools.
Provide confidential administrative and secretarial assistance and research support to the Director and to the IWMS team.
Maintain the Manager and management team’s appointment calendars, coordinate meetings, process and prioritize information, screen, triage and act upon requests and inquiries, including confidential and sensitive information.
Work independently and interface with other Executive Directors, Managers and staff at all levels of the organization.
Effectively partner with other VCH departments and liaises on behalf of the department with external agencies to coordinate the flow of information, keeping the Director apprised of relevant issues and activities.



This work is framed within VCH’s commitments to our pillars of Indigenous Cultural Safety, Anti-Racism, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, and Planetary Health.

Education & Experience


Diploma in a related program plus three to four (3-4) years' recent, related experience in a complex health care environment with progressively more responsible secretarial and administrative positions supporting senior level management, experience in information analysis and benchmarking, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Advanced computer skills in spreadsheet, database, graphics and word processing programs is required, e.g. Microsoft Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word, and Visio.



Knowledge & Abilities


Employs expertise in the use of computer software and applications to create a variety of analytical reports, documents, and presentations, and to maintain databases.
Applies acquired skills and knowledge to efficiently and independently resolve administrative issues/ problems.
Effectively utilizes both verbal and written communication skills when providing advice or information or seeking/acquiring information.
Develops and maintains strong relationships with key internal and external partners to promote and enhance services provided with sensitivity to diversity and indigenous lens.
Practices the recognition, inclusion and support of all types and aspects of diversity at all stages of engagement, with an understanding of the issues faced by people from equity-deserving groups.
Optimizes departmental effectiveness and contributes to organizational success by applying excellent time management skills to prioritize and complete assignments and schedule activities.
Practices diligence and care when maintaining, monitoring, calculating and summarizing data, records and budget information.
Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.



As per Ministry of Health policy, all health care workers working in publicly-funded health care facilities are required to report their past receipt of certain vaccines or history of certain infections. Collecting these records will allow for offering of any missing vaccines, and for appropriate actions to be taken in the event of any future exposure to a communicable disease or during outbreaks. For all new hires and appointments to Vancouver Coastal Health, you will be asked to provide this information as part of the onboarding process.

Why Join Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH)

VCH is a world class innovator in medical care, research and teaching, delivering service to more than one million BC residents. At VCH, we embrace thinking boldly, taking smart risks, and 'going first' when we believe it will lead to the best possible outcomes for patients and their families. We invite you to join us in creating healthy lives in healthy communities by showcasing our passion for care, connection to the communities we serve and our culture of teamwork that makes VCH a great place to work.


Comprehensive health benefits package, including MSP, extended health and dental and municipal pension plan
Grow your career with employer-paid training and leadership development opportunities
Wellness supports, including counselling, critical incident and innovative wellness services are available to employees and their immediate families
Award-winning recognition programs to honour staff, medical staff and volunteers
Access to exclusive discount offers and deals for VCH staff



At Vancouver Coastal Health, our vision of healthy lives in healthy communities inspires us and our values and pillars guide us. We support equitable practices, diverse teams and inclusive environments, which are vital to creating welcoming spaces where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and feel supported. We encourage applications from equity-deserving communities, including Indigenous Peoples and members of racialized groups, people with disabilities and people of all gender identities and expressions and sexual orientation.

Vancouver Coastal Health is proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers, BC’s Top Employers, Canada’s Best Diversity Employers and Canada's Top Employers for Young People in 2026.

Current VCH employees who apply to this posting using this external site will be considered as an external candidate. Seniority will not apply.***

Developing and managing BI end user presentation layer training and documentation. 


Technical documentation 


Supporting business development efforts (proposals and client presentations) 


Estimating effort for development and support engagements in Data Engineering and related technologies 


Status reporting 


Interacting with various client and management stake holders to get the work completed

Continuous improvement as a way of life 


Fair and generous relationships with our people and customers

Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals 


Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals

Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals 


Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate 


Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate 


Azure Databricks Data Engineer Associate - Certifications





Microsoft Certified: SQL AI Developer Associate
































What We Are Looking For  





5+ years hands-on experience in Microsoft Data Stack incl. SQL Server, data warehousing, MS Fabric/Data Bricks


3+ years hands-on experience in Microsoft BI Stack incl. Power BI, SSAS, SSRS, SSIS 


Proficiency in the development and administration of at least one of the following areas: 


Back end data integration and architecture including dimensional data modeling, database design, data warehousing, ETL development (e.g. ADF), and performance tuning, front-end reporting and analytics platforms including OLAP cube design, tabular data modeling.


Strong Data Modeling skills for Star-Schema 


Strong Programming skills in T-SQL, Spark (PySpark, SQL, Scala, etc), DAX, Power Query 


Strong analytical thinking for translating data into informative visuals and reports 


Experience developing visual reports including custom visuals, dashboards and KPI scorecards using Power BI 


The ability to implement row level security on data and have an understanding of application security layer models in the data platforms of SQL Server, Azure, MS Fabric and Power BI 


Foundational knowledge of the following areas: Metadata Management; Master Data Management; Data Governance; Data Analytics 


Good understanding of AI fundamentals.


Certifications required: 


-Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate


-Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate


Strong written and verbal communications skills

Dynamic work environment. 


Corporate gym discounts. 


Wellness day. 


Opportunities for growth and training.
